title: Internship - UAV Robotics/Mechatronics (Drone Prototyping, Integration & Field Testing)
description: Opening WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP Details Preferred starting date: ASAP Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week) Period: 6 months Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands About the company Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety. Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering. We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment. Your role If you’ve ever spent a weekend building a drone, tuning a flight controller, soldering a power harness, or figuring out why your FPV setup won’t arm, this internship is literally designed for you. We’re looking for a hands-on builder who loves working with real hardware: wiring sensors mounting compute boards setting up flight controllers testing drones outdoors fixing whatever breaks and making it better If phrases like ArduPilot, PX4, Jetson, ESCs, power distribution, 3D printing, or FPV gear make you smile, you’re the kind of person we want. This is not a “sit behind a desk” internship. You will be on the drones. You will be in the field. You will fly. What you’ll do Build and integrate hardware onto real drone platforms used in active R&D. Work hands-on with flight controllers (ArduPilot) and compute boards (Jetson, Orange Pi). Deploy and debug embedded perception software. Solder, assemble, and prototype wiring, adapters, mounts, and housings. 3D-print parts and quickly turn ideas into working physical prototypes. Support and participate in drone flight tests (you’ll fly regularly). Troubleshoot issues, iterate fast, and improve our hardware setups. You’ll see your work fly, literally! Who you are You’ve built or flown drones / RC systems (any level counts). You tinker with electronics, FPV, embedded software, or robotics. You enjoy making physical things work. You like fast iteration and getting your hands dirty. Linux doesn’t scare you. You are independent, curious, and resourceful. We don’t care about grades, we care about what you’ve made. Please include photos/links of: your drone builds FPV rigs electronics projects CAD/3D-printed parts GitHub repos anything that shows you build things If you’ve ever crashed something, fixed it, and sent it back into the sky — you’ll fit right in. Requirements Enrolled in a relevant study (Aerospace, Robotics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Engineering etc.). Linux basics. Interest in UAVs, robotics, embedded systems, or autonomy. English proficiency. Organized and proactive. Bonus: driver’s license, drone pilot license, CAD, 3D printing, soldering, or flight experience. What we offer 1000 euro monthly compensation. 10 vacation days during internship period. (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week. Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products. The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected. Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build. The application procedure If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills. We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow. If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period). Welcome to the team! Mit mehr als 250 Mates in Berlin, Hamburg, Köln und Remote entwickeln wir Social-First-Strategien, produzieren Content in eigenen Studios, arbeiten eng mit Creator:innen zusammen und steuern Kampagnen datengetrieben über unsere eigene Technologie. Unsere Kund:innen sind einige der bekanntesten Marken der Welt – von Lifestyle über FMCG bis hin zu Tech. Als Teil von SAMY, einem globalen Agenturnetzwerk für Social Media und Creator Marketing, sind wir mit über 970 Expert:innen an 20 Standorten vernetzt. Das eröffnet internationale Perspektiven, Projekte in rund 55 Märkten und die Möglichkeit, dich weit über Ländergrenzen hinweg weiterzuentwickeln. 💡 👉 Hinweis: Unser Bewerbungsprozess wird teilweise von einem KI-gestützten Assistenten begleitet, der das erste Kennenlerngespräch führt. Weitere Informationen erhältst du im Verlauf deiner Bewerbung. DEINE ROLLE Wir bauen für einen unserer Hero Accounts eine Creative Unit auf – als Senior Creative Concept/Copy bist du ein elementarer Teil dieses Teams, das mit vollem Fokus die unterschiedlichsten Briefs löst. Du bist dabei nicht einfach nur Copywriter:in – du lässt Briefs zu Big Ideas und plattformübergreifenden Kampagnen werden und denkst nicht in einzelnen Postings, sondern in kreativen Welten. Social-First-Erfahrung ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss: Auch mit einem eher klassischen Kreativ-Background bist du bei uns richtig. WAS DU MACHST Von der ersten Idee bis zum finalen Feinkonzept entwickelst du eigenständig und in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Creative Lead Kampagnen für unseren Hero Account: durchdacht, plattformgerecht und im Idealfall mit Award-Potenzial Du schreibst starke Skripte und Copy für unterschiedlichste Themen und Formate – immer trennscharf innerhalb der jeweiligen Brand-Identity Du bringst deine Ideen eigenständig in überzeugende Präsentationsform und stellst sie sicher vor Kund:innen sowie internen Stakeholdern vor Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Junior- und Mid-Level-Creatives im Team und trägst mit deiner Arbeit aktiv zur kreativen Weiterentwicklung des Accounts und der Creative Unit bei Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Departments innerhalb der Agentur zusammen WAS DU BRAUCHST Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Copywriter:in oder Concept Creative – ob in einer Social-First-Agentur, einer klassischen Werbeagentur oder einem gemischten Umfeld Teamgeist und die Motivation, Ideen sowie Projekte eigenständig voranzutreiben Ein starkes Portfolio, das deine konzeptionelle Stärke, dein Gespür für Sprache und deine Fähigkeit, Big Ideas zu entwickeln, beweist Ein gutes Gespür dafür, wie man auf Social spricht und kommuniziert – oder die Bereitschaft, dir dieses Gespür bei uns anzueignen Ein weitreichendes Verständnis für Markenwelten und die Fähigkeit, innerhalb dieser Welten überzeugenden, konsistenten kreativen Output zu liefern WAS WIR DIR BIETEN Onboarding & Support No one likes to be the new kid. Mit strukturiertem Onboarding, einem persönlichen Mate und Zugang zu Lernmaterialien bist du ab Tag eine:r von uns. Erstklassige Ausstattung Can’t work without my iPhone. Mit MacBook, iPhone und aktueller Apple-Tech arbeitest du flexibel und effizient. Das gilt für unsere Altbau-Offices genauso wie zuhause oder unterwegs. Wachstum & Weiterentwicklung Rise & shine, darling! Dein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget gibt dir die Freiheit, in Workshops, Seminare, zertifizierte Kurse oder Coachings zu investieren. So entwickelst du dich genau in die Richtung, die zu deinen Zielen passt. Flexibel arbeiten „Ob das bei euch gerade genauso ist? I doubt it!” Bis zu sechs Wochen im Jahr kannst du innerhalb der EU remote arbeiten. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle machen es leicht, Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. Bei einem Umzug oder in besonderen Lebenssituationen wie einem Trauerfall erhältst du zusätzliche freie Tage. Mehr Freizeit „It’s my birthday, I’mma spend my money.“ An deinem Geburtstag heißt es: Laptop zu und genießen. Zusätzlich sind der 24. Dezember und der 31. Dezember frei. Jubiläen und Geburtstage feiern wir mit kleinen Überraschungen. Health & Wellbeing Hot girl walk or heavy lift? Über deinen Zugang können auch bis zu fünf Familienmitglieder mitmachen. Exklusive Deals & Extras It’s giving… perks! Profitiere von attraktiven Rabatten bei Partnern wie plantclub, FutureBens und vielen mehr. Zusätzlich kannst du eines dieser drei Benefits wählen: Givve Card – 50 € Guthaben pro Monat, frei einsetzbar für alles, was du liebst. title: Senior Manager, APJC Outreach
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available location: </strong>Singapore</p> <p>Cloudflare is one of the most dynamic and innovative companies providing services on the Internet. Regulation of the Internet is exploding -- across a number of subject areas and jurisdictions -- at a rate previously unseen in the history of the Internet. We’re looking for a new team member who can help foster and promote our corporate philosophy and approach, in which the security and privacy of our customers are paramount. </p> <p>We are looking for an exceptionally talented and energetic person to join our Public Policy team in Singapore, with a strong background in India policy. You will work on some of the most complicated and rapidly evolving policy issues in the world, such as content moderation, user privacy, and intermediary liability, and you’ll help us develop and communicate real-world solutions to addressing these challenges. You will also build and run programs that further Cloudflare’s reputation and standing in the region by partnering with governments, trade bodies, and civil society organisations. This person has a deep understanding of technology as well as regulatory environments. The ideal candidate can seamlessly go from a technical conversation with engineers to a high-level discussion with regulators and policymakers regarding where Cloudflare fits in the Internet stack. This person should be an expert at presenting technical topics at a level any audience will be able to understand.</p> <p>This role has non-standard working hours.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engage with policymakers, regulators, trade associations, industry partners, civil society groups and others in India and across the APJC region, to educate stakeholders on Cloudflare’s trust & safety processes and policy positions.</li> <li>Lead programs and advocacy campaigns that showcase our policy principles  to demonstrate what a better Internet looks like in practice.</li> <li>Develop talking points, policy narratives and presentation materials for use at external events and meetings and for other communication purposes (company blog, position papers, etc.).</li> <li>Coordinate with cross-functional teams to address government and law enforcement requests, as appropriate.</li> <li>Provide timely updates to colleagues from the Cloudflare Public Policy, Legal, Trust & Safety Teams and other internal stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualification</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree or preferably master's degree in public policy, law, economics </li> <li>8+ years of related experience handling law enforcement matters at a large technology company and experience handling public policy issues. </li> <li>Strong understanding of the Indian political, regulatory and legal system and protocols, particularly as they relate to digital services.</li> <li>Experience in designing, running, and managing stakeholder, community, or partnership programs and events (for example, workshops, hackathons, or training programs)</li> <li>Ability and willingness to work off hours, including weekends and holidays, to support emergency matters and interact with globally-based company employees</li> <li>Right to work in Singapore, or eligibility and willingness to relocate to Singapore</li> <li>Ability to analyze technical data and present to a less technical audience</li> <li>An ambitious mindset that enables you to successfully work independently with little guidance, but also to use good judgment and escalate / call out issues when needed.</li> <li>A sense of humor.</li> </ul> <p>Preferred Qualification</p> <ul> <li>Knowledge of Cloudflare products and the broader technology industry, including security, networking, Zero Trust, and AI services.</li> <li>Experience in reviewing, processing, and tracking legal documents, particularly in India (e.g., civil and criminal subpoenas, court orders, and search warrants, and legal notices under Indian law)</li> <li>Willingness to travel to India and elsewhere in the region.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Site Reliability Engineer, Cells Infrastructure
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>We're looking for an Intermediate Site Reliability Engineer to join the Cells Infrastructure team in GitLab's Scale & Architecture organization. In this role, you'll help build and operate Cells, the architecture that lets GitLab.com scale horizontally. Cells splits GitLab.com into many independent units, each with its own application and data stack, behind a shared routing layer.</p> <p>This is a build-it-and-run-it role. You'll provision cells, route traffic to them, deploy them safely, and keep them reliable in production. You'll also help move customer organizations onto Cells, one of GitLab's most important scaling initiatives.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Operate Cells in production: join the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, lead post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions to completion.</li> <li value="2">Define and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) for routing and cell health, and build the dashboards, alerts, and runbooks behind them.</li> <li value="3">Provision and operate cell infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Kubernetes, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage.</li> <li value="4">Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD.</li> <li value="5">Operate and extend the global routing layer, built on Cloudflare Workers, Envoy, and a Go service backed by Cloud Spanner, and expand routing to more protocols and services.</li> <li value="6">Improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines behind ring-based deployments, covering promotion, database migrations, quality assurance validation, and rollback.</li> <li value="7">Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers.</li> <li value="8">Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence.</li> <li value="8">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience running production infrastructure at scale on AWS, GCP, or both, including Kubernetes, along with strong Terraform and Helm skills.</li> <li value="2">Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily.</li> <li value="3">Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation.</li> <li value="4">Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li value="5">Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll them back.</li> <li value="6">A strong understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, such as request routing, proxies, consistency, and failure domains.</li> <li value="7">Experience working effectively in distributed, all-remote teams: you default to asynchronous, written-first communication, document decisions in issues and merge requests, hand off work cleanly across time zones, and stay transparent about progress and blockers.</li> <li value="8">Experience with Cloudflare, Spanner, Argo CD, TypeScript, or operating GitLab at scale is a plus, not a requirement.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Every team in our organization owns its services end to end, from design through on-call.We own the control plane that tracks cells and decides where each request belongs, and keep the fleet in step with GitLab's release cadence.We work closely with delivery, database, migration, and product teams across GitLab. Feature teams own how their services behave on the platform; we own the underlying infrastructure.We're an all-remote, asynchronous team. We make decisions in GitLab issues, use directly responsible individuals (DRIs) to own technical direction, demo our work weekly, and use AI-assisted workflows every day.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. title: Solution Architect (Prototyping)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.</p></div><h3>Role</h3> <p>We're looking for a hands-on Solution Architect to join our GovDev team. You are the technical counterpart to our customers in the public sector, defence and intelligence space: you run the technical dialogue with incoming leads, turn their requirements into<br>working prototypes on our platform, and hand what survives over to Product & Engineering in a state they can build on.</p> <p>This is not a pre-sales or slideware role. Roughly half of your time you build: integrating customer data sources into our platform, wiring up pipelines on our data fabric (ODFF), and shipping demo-grade frontends. The other half you spend with customers and our product teams, making sure what we promise is what the platform can do, and what the platform can't do yet lands on the roadmap.</p> <h3>What you'll do</h3> <ul> <li>Act as technical lead on incoming opportunities: run discovery calls, qualify technical fit against the platform's current state, answer architecture, integration and security<br>questions, and own the technical part of pitches, demos and workshops.</li> <li>Build prototypes yourself: ingest a customer's data (files, APIs, message exports, sensor feeds, geodata) through our ingest layer, model it into our universal record and<br>entity schema, and expose it in the platform frontend or a purpose-built demo UI.</li> <li>Design integration architectures for customer environments: on-premise and air-gapped Kubernetes deployments, identity (OIDC/Keycloak, Kerberos/Ranger), connections to legacy systems and interfaces common in government and military IT.</li> <li>Lead technical deep dives with customer architects and IT security: platform architecture, data flow, lineage, classification handling, deployment options.</li> <li>Hand over won opportunities to the owning Product & Engineering team: architecture decision records, integration docs, data model, open gaps, customer context. </li> <li>Feed platform gaps and friction found during prototyping back to the product teams as concrete tickets and RFC input.</li> <li>Represent the voice of the market to Product: cluster recurring requirements across leads and bring them into roadmap and OKR discussions.</li> <li>Maintain reusable demo assets: reference prototypes, scenario data sets, architecture diagrams, integration guides, technical FAQ.</li> </ul> <h3>About you</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years in software or data engineering, of which at least 1-2 in a customer-facing technical role (like solution architect, forward deployed engineer, technical consultant with delivery responsibility).</li> <li>You write production-quality code today, in Python and TypeScript or a comparable combination, and can show prototypes or systems you built end to end.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with distributed data pipelines (Spark, Kafka or equivalent) and with integrating heterogeneous data sources: files, APIs, databases, message streams.</li> <li>Experience deploying and operating software on Kubernetes, including on-premise or restricted environments.</li> <li>Comfortable leading technical discussions with customer architects, IT security and executives, in German and in English (C1+).</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 50% (national and international) </li> <li>Authorization to work in Germany</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Remote-first, Germany-wide: </strong>Work from wherever you do your best work, with regular team gatherings in Berlin and other off-site locations.</li> <li><strong>Flexibility by default: </strong>Flexible working hours help you make work fit your life.</li> <li><strong>Your setup, your way: </strong>Get a personal home-office equipment budget to create a workspace that works for you.</li> <li><strong>30 days of vacation: </strong>Take the time you need to recharge and come back with fresh energy.</li> <li><strong>Keep growing: </strong>We invest in your personal and professional development.</li> <li><strong>Get rewarded for impact: </strong>Performance bonuses are tied to agreed objectives and key results.</li> <li><strong>A warm welcome: </strong>Every new team member gets a welcome goodie bag.</li> <li><strong>Good people, good times: </strong>From summer and Christmas parties to regular team gatherings, we make time to celebrate together.</li> <li><strong>A mission that matters: </strong>Work on challenges with tangible impact on public safety and national security.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Territory Account Executive, Philippines
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Singapore</p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.</p> <p>The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p> <p><strong>About This Role</strong></p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of commercial accounts in the <strong>Philippines market</strong>. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.</p> <p>You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.</li> <li>Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.  </li> <li>Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.</li> <li>Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.</li> <li>Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).</li> <li>Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Fluent in English and Bisaya to engage with customers in Philippines</strong></li> <li><strong>Sales experience in cities outside of Manila (e.g. Antipolo, Cebu, Davao, Batangas) is a plus</strong></li> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.</li> <li>Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li>Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.</li> <li>Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).</li> <li>Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.</li> <li>Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.</li> <li>Ability to travel as required.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Lead Software Engineer, Integrations (TypeScript)
description: Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better. Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care. Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time. Want to shape the future of healthcare? Join us ! Discover our company culture and values Here is a product teaser Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest Articles on our A round ( techfundingnews , Maddyness , les echos , our blog ) Vocca in a few words Vocca is an AI voice agent that answers 100% of the calls of medical centres. The patient calls, the AI books the appointment or answers the question, and the medical secretaries keep their time for the cases where a human is really needed. $20M raised, with the founders of Alan and Datadog as investors Close to 1 million calls a month going through the platform Opening the US market The problem Every medical practice runs on software that holds its calendar and its patients. There are dozens of different ones. Most were built twenty years ago and some have no API at all. To book an appointment during a call, our AI agent has to read and write in that software in real time, while the patient waits on the line. On several of these systems, Vocca is the only integrator in the world. This is the work with the most direct impact on the business. A clinic whose software is connected to our agent does not switch. Retention, pricing power, our lead over competitors: it all depends on these integrations. Every software we cannot connect is a clinic we cannot sign. The next step is writing back. Today the agent reads and books. Tomorrow it updates records in EHR, PMS and RIS systems, which raises the reliability bar a lot. In the US, we are opening the dental software ecosystem, with the compliance work that comes with it (HIPAA, SOC2). There is no product manager on this scope. You would be the one deciding. What you will own The architecture of our booking layer. Today it is code written provider by provider, under pressure, partly in Python. It is becoming one unified layer in TypeScript that handles the rules of each medical centre, where adding a new software takes days, not weeks. Speed and reliability at close to 1M calls a month. A call to a clinic software can take several seconds, and the patient cannot wait. You decide how we detect a booking failure in a clinic within 24 hours and what a healthy integration looks like. The roadmap of your scope. You decide which software we connect first, with the sales, ops and support teams and the clinics themselves, and you prove it worked with a number: bookings that go through, failures caught, clinics signed. title: Executive Assistant - Developer Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX or New York</strong></p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a bright, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to support three leaders in our Developer GTM organization. We are looking for a dynamic and dedicated candidate who is comfortable with multi-tasking and prioritization in a fast-paced, product-first environment with close attention to detail, accuracy, and timeliness. </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Calendar & Conflict Management:</strong> Proactively manage complex calendars with a strong understanding of business priorities. Independently resolve scheduling conflicts and anticipate meeting requests and logistical needs before they are explicitly stated. </li> <li><strong>Travel & Logistics:</strong> Manage and coordinate complex international and domestic travel, including visa and passport needs, as well as end-to-end logistical arrangements for executives and teams.</li> <li><strong>Executive Support & Business Context:</strong> Develop a deeper understanding of the managers' roles, our products, and the broader market and context for Cloudflare. Serve as a trusted gatekeeper who can confidently answer routine questions on behalf of the executives.</li> <li><strong>Expenses Meeting Coordination:</strong> Prepare and manage expense reports..</li> <li><strong>Projects & Process Improvement:</strong> Contribute significantly to ad-hoc/special projects. Recognize where operational processes can be improved and actively suggest and implement those process improvements.</li> <li><strong>Meetings & Event Planning:</strong> Coordinate and assist with large meetings, external stakeholders, and event planning with precision.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Requirements</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>6+</strong> years experience as an Administrative Assistant, in Ops, or equivalent experience.</li> <li><strong>Scope & Judgment:</strong> A seasoned professional with proven experience handling problems of diverse scope and demonstrating excellent judgment in selecting administrative and operational methods.</li> <li><strong>Proactiveness & Autonomy:</strong> Strong sense of urgency, proactiveness, and the ability to manage your own time with limited or no supervision.</li> <li><strong>Communication & Networking:</strong> Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to network and build strong relationships with executives and team members.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Skills:</strong> Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.</li> <li><strong>Mindset:</strong> A "no task is too small" attitude combined with the strategic mindset needed to anticipate executive needs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Drive: Experience working in a tech and AI-native, product-led environment.</strong></h2> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.</p> <p>Estimated Salary for New York:  $114,000 - 157,000</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Stage Bouw
description: Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor! Dit wordt jouw stage Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is! Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer. Dat jij net zo trots bent op wat we maken als wij dat zijn. Dat iedereen die bij ons werkt gelukkig is. Dat je bij ons jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je kunt uitspreken. En dat je tot je recht komt. En het beste uit jezelf kunt halen. Hier zit je goed! Wij zijn Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo, een ontwikkelende bouwer in het werkgebied Noord-, Oost- en Midden-Nederland. Als onderdeel van de divisie Bouw & Vastgoed combineren we de kracht van een groot bedrijf, met de fijne sfeer en cultuur van een kleinere organisatie. Bij ons vind je echte doeners en waarmakers. We ontwikkelen en bouwen, samen met onze klanten, partners en collega’s. Wat ons ons maakt? Gewoon dóen en gewóón doen. Dat zit er nou eenmaal in, en zie je terug in alles wat we doen. Wil jij nou werken op een plek waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en heel veel plezier samenkomen? Mooi! Wij zoeken nieuwe collega’s binnen onze disciplines ontwikkeling, woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, renovatie & transformatie en beheer & exploitatie. Dit breng je mee Je volgt een MBO, HBO of WO opleiding (pre: opleiding Bouwkunde); Je bent proactief, nuchter en een harde werker, net als wij! Dit bieden wij jou Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week; Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven; De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer; Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan! Meer weten? Wij beantwoorden je vragen graag of denken graag met je mee voor het invullen van je stagewens. Schroom niet om contact op te nemen met Nikki Koehorst via 0628362285 of Hopelijk spreken we elkaar snel! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Ouvert à tous , femmes et hommes de talent, le Groupe Fondasol favorise l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Envie d’en savoir plus sur nos métiers? Consulter nos vidéos Alors, prêt à devenir Fondasolien? Nous sommes impatients de découvrir votre candidature. title: Senior Data Engineer (Databricks)
description: <p><strong>Who is Artefact?</strong><br>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm that transforms organizations through data and AI. With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. From our Lausanne and Zurich offices, we help leading Swiss and international companies turn data and AI into measurable results, working with the leading data platforms, including Databricks.</p> <p><strong>Main Responsibilities</strong><br>You will design and deliver the data platforms our clients run their business and their AI on, combining hands-on engineering with client advisory.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build modern data platforms:</strong> End-to-end lakehouse architectures, mainly on Databricks, built for reliability, observability, and cost.</li> <li><strong>Engineer pipelines:</strong> Batch and streaming pipelines with Python, Spark, and SQL, with data quality built in.</li> <li><strong>Migrate and modernize:</strong> Move legacy warehouses and ETL to the cloud, from assessment to cut-over.</li> <li><strong>Make data ready for AI:</strong> Governed data products and semantic layers that analytics and AI agents can rely on.</li> <li><strong>Run it properly:</strong> Data governance, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and cost control.</li> <li><strong>Advise and support:</strong> Translate business needs into roadmaps, coach junior engineers, and support proposals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Candidate Profile</strong><br>Engineer first, consultant second, with a track record of shipping to production.</p> <ul> <li>5+ years in data engineering, including hands-on Databricks experience in production.</li> <li>Expert Python and SQL, with strong Spark and data modeling skills.</li> <li>Databricks Data Engineer Professional certification, or a commitment to obtain it within 6 months (we support you).</li> <li>Experience on Azure, AWS, or GCP, plus DataOps (Git, CI/CD, Terraform, testing).</li> <li>Strong consulting skills: requirements gathering, documentation, stakeholder management.</li> <li>Fluent English plus French or German (both is a plus); eligible to work in Switzerland.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have:</strong> Experience with other data platforms (Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, BigQuery), dbt, MLOps, and industry experience (consumer goods, pharma, logistics, insurance, manufacturing).</p> <p><strong>Why Join Us</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy with a Data Edge:</strong> Build the platforms behind boardroom priorities.</li> <li><strong>Swiss Impact:</strong> High visibility from day one on flagship programs, working directly with senior leadership.</li> <li><strong>Strong Tech Ecosystem:</strong> Certified peers across Artefact and close partnerships with leading data and cloud platforms.</li> <li><strong>Growth and Culture:</strong> Certifications, training, international missions, and a team of doers who move fast and support each other.</li> </ul> <p>If you don’t meet 100% of the criteria, we still want to hear from you. Tell us about your passion, curiosity, and impact.</p> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

or Functional account management for software implementations for CPM/EPM platforms. </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Preferred Education and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Master’s degree in description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Integrated Marketing France connects global marketing strategy with local business priorities to deliver impactful marketing campaigns.</li> <li>As Senior Marketing Manager, Integrated Marketing, you will identify France’s priority marketing moments and translate global direction into a clear, integrated marketing plan. Using business performance, consumer insights and knowledge of the French market, you will recommend what to prioritise, what to adopt from global campaigns and what to adapt to maximise local impact.</li> <li>You will bring teams together around clear priorities, challenge recommendations constructively, simplify complex topics and ensure marketing initiatives deliver against France’s business objectives.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <h3><strong>1. Marketing Plan Consolidation & Executive Communication</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Consolidate the France marketing plan into a clear, executive-level overview of key priorities, campaign choices, local adaptations and expected business impact.</li> <li>Write concise, insight-led strategic memos articulating the rationale behind France’s marketing recommendations, key trade-offs and decisions requiring alignment or approval.</li> <li>Build a compelling, evidence-based narrative connecting France’s business priorities and market specificities with global marketing strategy.</li> <li>Present and defend France’s marketing recommendations to global executives, ensuring local choices are understood and enabling informed decision-making.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Key Skills & Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years of experience</strong> in integrated marketing, marketing strategy, campaign planning or marketing programme management.</li> <li>Strong business acumen, analytical thinking and the ability to translate data and consumer insights into actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Strong critical thinking and sound judgement: able to challenge balance global consistency with relevant local adaptation, using clear evidence and constructive influencing skills.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and align teams without direct authority.</li> <li>Strong organisational skills, pragmatism and ownership, with a focus on prioritisation and delivery.</li> <li>Fluent in French and English, with the confidence to challenge and influence stakeholders in an international environment.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h2><strong>Success Measures</strong></h2> <ul> insights.</li> <li>Strong alignment across stakeholders on priorities, decisions and delivery.</li> <li>Campaigns delivered on time and against agreed objectives.</li> <li>Clear, actionable performance insights and executive visibility on the France marketing plan.</li> </ul> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At title: Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing - alternance
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p><strong>Pourquoi Deliveroo ?</strong></p> <p>Lorsque l'on vous dit Deliveroo, vous imaginez sans doute d'abord les bons petits plats livrés chez vous en moins d'une demi-heure. Plutôt sympa non ? Mais c'est en coulisses que l'histoire est la plus intéressante. Nous opérons désormais à travers le monde et travaillons avec plus de 176 000 restaurants partenaires et commerces en tous genres en France. Nous collaborons avec des milliers de livreurs et de livreuses partenaires pour le plus grand bonheur de nos millions de personnes clientes.</p> <p>Nous recherchons un·e Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing Merchant en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à Paris, pour une durée de 12 mois. Aux côtés de l'équipe Merchant, vous contribuerez au développement de la croissance de nos partenaires, au déploiement de nos campagnes nationales 360° et en accompagnerez des projets à fort impact sur l'acquisition, la rétention et la fidélisation de nos restaurants partenaires.</p> <p><strong>Descriptif du poste :</strong></p> <p>En tant qu’Apprenti(e) dans l’équipe Marketing Merchant Restaurant, vous travaillerez au quotidien avec l'équipe marketing chargée de mettre en avant toute la sélection de restaurants et de partenaires de Deliveroo. Vous serez également amené(e) à <strong>interagir régulièrement avec les autres départements marketing </strong>tels que l’équipe média, l’équipe créative, le CRM ainsi qu’avec l’<strong>équipe commerciale. </strong></p> <p><strong>Vos missions consisteront à:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Mettre en avant sur l’application les restaurants et partenaires disponibles sur l’app.</li> <li>Soutenir l’équipe commerciale dans la création et l’exécution de plans marketing destinés à mettre en avant les partenaires présents sur Deliveroo.  </li> <li>Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe commerciale et les équipes marketing transversales (marque, réseaux sociaux, CRM et influenceurs) pour développer et exécuter des plans partenaires basés sur les priorités commerciales (par exemple, objectifs régionaux, accords d'exclusivité, renégociations).</li> <li>Préparer des présentations et des supports pour appuyer les discussions de l'équipe commerciale avec les partenaires, en veillant à l'alignement et à la clarté.</li> <li>Contribuer à l’exécution des points forts des partenaires en collaboration avec le CRM et le Commercial (communications mensuelles d'exclusivité / bannières dédiées sur l’application / notifications push...).</li> <li>Gérer le budget alloué pour le plan de chaque partenaire, en optimisant les ressources locales pour obtenir un impact maximal. </li> <li>Analyser l’impact de nos campagnes pour en tirer des recommandations pour les équipes commerciales</li> </ul> <p>Cette alternance vous permettra d'appréhender de nombreux sujets marketing (création de campagne, analyse, sensibilité client) et vous permettra d'acquérir une bonne connaissance des enjeux marketing et de la gestion de projets complexes grâce à la collaboration transverse que vous aurez avec les autres pôles. </p> <p><strong>Ce qui vous permettra de réussir</strong></p> <p>Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de commerce, université ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en marketing, communication ou digital et recherchez une alternance d'une durée d'un an à partir de Décembre 2026 / Janvier 2027.</p> <p><strong>Vous Vous Reconnaissez Dans Les Points Suivants</strong></p> <ul> <li>Vous êtes organisé·e, rigoureux·se et savez gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle en respectant les délais</li> <li>Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale en français ainsi qu'un bon niveau d'anglais.</li> <li>Vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres et aimez analyser les performances pour en tirer des recommandations.</li> <li>Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de nombreux interlocuteurs.</li> <li>Vous êtes curieux·se, proactif·ve et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance.</li> </ul> <p>Voici un<a href="https://sites.google.com/deliveroo.co.uk/biz-interview-guide/home?authuser=0"> lien</a> avec de la documentation pour vous préparer aux entretiens.</p> <p>Nous offrons un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant, où vous aurez l'opportunité de développer vos compétences et de contribuer activement à notre mission.
