Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Lisbon, Portugal</p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>We build products at the intersection of AI, search and retrieval, data insights, and product engineering.</p> <p>As AI agents change how people discover and interact with the Internet, new problems are emerging around how content is found, understood, retrieved, and kept current. Cloudflare is uniquely positioned to help website owners make their content discoverable and to help agents find relevant, trustworthy information across our network. Building these capabilities requires solving problems across distributed systems, crawling, content ingestion, indexing, retrieval quality, developer experience, and reliable product delivery.</p> <p>Cloudflare also has a unique perspective on how the Internet is changing. Our global network observes signals that can help us understand trends, identify when content changes, and measure the pulse of the Internet. Used responsibly, these signals could improve existing products, help customers and AI companies find fresher and more relevant information, and create entirely new capabilities and products. The opportunity is broad and still evolving. We need to deliver excellent products today while continuing to identify the problems Cloudflare is uniquely positioned to solve next.</p> <p>We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead engineering across some of our AI and Internet Data Insights portfolio.</p> <p>You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that help customers make their content discoverable and turn complex Internet signals into useful experiences. You will partner closely with Product Management and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible. You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions, ask the right questions when something is going wrong, and step into a technical problem when the situation calls for it.</p> <p>At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across AI-powered search, Internet data insights, and customer-facing products.</li> <li>Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.</li> <li>Lead the development of search and retrieval capabilities that help people and AI agents find relevant, trustworthy, and current content.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.</li> <li>Help identify how signals from Cloudflare's global network can produce useful and trustworthy insights for customers, partners, and other Cloudflare products.</li> <li>Explore where Cloudflare's unique view of Internet activity can improve content discovery, enable new product experiences, or support entirely new products.</li> <li>Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.</li> <li>Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, data and search quality, and long-term reliability.</li> <li>Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <p>We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:</p> <ul> <li>You have led and developed high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.</li> <li>You are technically credible with experienced engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in a distributed system or data platform, and recognize when a technical problem needs deeper investigation.</li> <li>You are comfortable managing a team working across several related technical areas and can create clarity without requiring every problem to fit neatly into a single box.</li> <li>You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system is data that people use to understand the Internet.</li> <li>You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.</li> <li>You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.</li> <li>You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, search systems, data-intensive systems, Internet infrastructure, or adjacent areas.</li> <li>Experience building or operating products involving crawling, content ingestion, indexing, retrieval, analytics, or large-scale data processing.</li> <li>Experience operating systems where correctness, reliability, and quality matter as much as feature delivery.</li> <li>A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.</li> <li>Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.</li> <li>Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), which combines information retrieval with generative AI to produce answers grounded in selected source material.</li> <li>Experience building products for AI developers, AI agents, publishers, or content-heavy websites.</li> <li>Experience working with large-scale telemetry or Internet-scale datasets.</li> <li>Experience turning complex underlying systems or data into useful products for a broad audience.</li> <li>Familiarity with Cloudflare Radar, Internet measurement research, or the broader ecosystem of tools used to understand Internet performance, availability and security.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <ul> <li><span description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Hiring Locations: <strong>Atlanta, GA, Austin, US, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Washington DC, US</strong></h3> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We're looking for an experienced Data Center Operations manager to build and run the team that brings these new sites online and keeps them running around the clock.</p> <p>You will build a distributed team of Data Center Engineers from the ground up. You'll own sites across their full lifecycle: delivering greenfield builds through third-party vendors and colocation partners, running them in production, and retiring hardware securely at end of life. You'll be accountable for production hardware availability, 24x7 on-site response, and the operating model that lets this footprint scale.</p> <p>The role means balancing competing demands every day: build deadlines against build quality, dependence on partners against high standards, and fast incident response against careful compliance. You need to keep both sides of each in view.</p> <p>This role covers the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. It works closely with network engineering and server provisioning teams but does not own them.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>Team Leadership</p> <ul> <li> <p>Hire, develop and manage Data Center Engineers based on-site at data centers across the US. Set clear expectations, career paths and a culture of ownership across a team spread over many sites.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and take part in a 24x7 on-call rotation with your team. Define coverage models, handover protocols and incident SLAs that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as the escalation point for on-site incidents. Coordinate engineers, colocation providers and vendors to restore service quickly, and lead root-cause analysis after major incidents so the same problem doesn't happen again.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Site Delivery</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own build timelines from site readiness through hardware delivery, rack-and-stack, cabling, validation and handoff to production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Run greenfield builds as multi-workstream programs. Coordinate third-party integrators, contractors and colocation providers to hit dates without cutting corners.</p> </li> <li> <p>Be on-site during key build phases to oversee vendor work, verify quality and make sure sites are production-ready.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Production Operations</p> <ul> <li> <p>Be accountable for availability targets for production hardware at your sites. Run break/fix, repairs, RMAs and spares strategy so that availability is measured, reported and improving.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage colocation providers and vendors day to day: escalations, remote-hands quality, power and cooling issues, and performance against contractual commitments.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Documentation and DCIM</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make sure every site is fully documented in DCIM from day one. That covers rack elevations, power and cabling, asset location, and lifecycle status, all recorded as hardware arrives rather than filled in later.</p> </li> <li> <p>Treat infrastructure records as a source of truth that both operations and dependent teams rely on, giving them accurate, current visibility into where hardware is and what state it's in.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with tooling teams to bring DCIM online at new sites, and define documentation standards that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Decommissioning and Hardware Lifecycle</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own on-site decommissioning end to end: unracking, physical collections, serial number verification, chain of custody, and handoff for secure destruction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with vendor management on IT asset disposition (ITAD) vendors. Make sure destruction certificates and compliance evidence are filed and audit-ready.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Security and Compliance</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make sure your sites and team meet Cloudflare's physical security, access control, chain-of-custody and compliance obligations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Follow established physical access procedures, and work with security and compliance teams to develop new ones where these sites need them.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support audits with accurate, timely evidence. Treat audit readiness as a continuous standard, not something you prepare for once per audit cycle.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Automation and Operational Efficiency</p> <ul> <li> <p>Find manual, repetitive work in build, break/fix, decommissioning and evidence collection. Influence tooling and automation teams to remove it.</p> </li> <li> <p>Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted workflows for incident triage, root-cause analysis, documentation and compliance evidence generation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Scale the operation through tooling, not just headcount.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Business Reporting</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own weekly business reviews and monthly and quarterly reporting on availability, build progress, incidents and operational health to the Director and peer leaders.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with network, systems, hardware, supply chain and infrastructure engineering teams to make sure physical operations support what runs on top of them.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <p><strong>A builder who stays to operate.</strong> You've stood up sites and teams, and you take ownership of what happens after go-live. Delivering a build is where your job starts. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.</p> <p><strong>A leader of distributed teams.</strong> You've hired and built trust with on-site engineers spread across many locations, most of whom you won't see day to day. You know how to create accountability, consistent standards and a shared culture across sites, both remotely and in person.</p> <p><strong>Firm with partners.</strong> You hold colocation providers and vendors to high standards without becoming adversarial. You know the contract, you track performance, and you escalate when it's warranted.</p> <p><strong>Compliance-minded without being a compliance specialist.</strong> You understand why access controls and decommissioning chain of custody are audit controls. You treat compliance as part of doing the work well, not as overhead.</p> <p><strong>Automation-first.</strong> When something hurts, your first instinct is to fix the process or the tooling, not add people. You can turn an operational pain point into requirements engineering teams can act on.</p> <h3>Required Experience</h3> <ul> <li> <p>6+ years in data center operations, including 3+ years directly managing on-site technical teams. At least part of that time should be leading geographically distributed teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of operating multi-site data center fleets at hyperscale or large-cloud scale.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with IT hardware, including servers, network devices, optics and cabling, not only facilities infrastructure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Enough hands-on depth to coach engineers on technical work and to judge the quality of vendor and contractor work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience owning sites across the full lifecycle: delivering greenfield data center or cage builds through third-party vendors, running them in steady state, and decommissioning hardware.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing providers in Tier III+ colocation facilities and holding them accountable to commitments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing 24x7 on-call operations and incident escalation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong Layer 1 and Layer 2 fundamentals: structured cabling, fiber and optics, patching standards, switching basics, and troubleshooting physical connectivity for network and server hardware.</p> </li> <li> <p>Solid knowledge of data center power and cooling, rack design, high-density deployments and hardware lifecycle management.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of DCIM and asset management systems. Your core tech stack will include <strong>NetSuite, Zuora RevPro, and Oracle Fusion Cloud (Financials - O2C and R2R modules)</strong>. Your primary customers will be the Revenue Accounting, Billing, Corporate Accounting, and broader Finance organizations, and you will partner closely with them to optimize how Cloudflare transacts, recognizes revenue, and reports financials at scale.</p> <p>If you are a builder at heart who enjoys solving complex financial system workflows, automating the month-end close, leveraging AI for financial insights, and designing seamless enterprise integrations from Quote-to-Cash through to the General Ledger, this role is for you.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Application Administration & Environment Management</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary subject-matter expert and developer for Cloudflare’s O2C and R2R technology stack (NetSuite, Zuora RevPro, Oracle Fusion).</li> <li>Manage user provisioning, complex role-based access control (RBAC), and security settings specific to billing approvals, journal entry (JE) limits, general ledger access, and revenue posting.</li> <li>Manage application environments (e.g., Production vs. Sandbox/Release Preview), ensuring alignment across all environments from both a data and release perspective to support safe testing of financial changes.</li> <li>Monitor ongoing application performance and reliability, managing incident workflows to ensure ticket SLAs for the Finance organization are consistently met, especially during critical month-end and quarter-end close periods.</li> <li>Provide Tier 3 support and end-user enablement, serving as the ultimate technical escalation point for financial system issues.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>System Development, Integrations & AI Initiatives</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the Subject-Matter Expert for integrations across the QTC, O2C, and R2R lifecycles. high-volume recurring billing, usage-based consumption models, and multi-entity global consolidations.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Security, Compliance, & Data Governance</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner general ledger operations.</li> <li>Ensure newly implemented AI features, custom scripts, and data-sharing protocols strictly adhere to SOX compliance, maintain data integrity, and ensure audit readiness for all financial records and ASC 606 reporting.</li> <li>Maintain comprehensive system architecture documentation, process maps, and business continuity/disaster recovery plans for critical financial systems.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Minimum Experience:</strong> Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, or a experience configuring, administrating, and developing in applications like <strong>NetSuite, Zuora RevPro, and Oracle Fusion Cloud (specifically O2C and R2R/GL modules)</strong>.</li> ecosystems. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations:</strong> San Francisco, CA; Austin, TX; New York, NY; Washington D.C.</p> <h4>About the Role</h4> <p>The Interconnection Manager for the Americas is the network strategy leader for one of Cloudflare's most important and most contrasted regions — a mature, high-volume United States market alongside a fast-growing, infrastructure-constrained South America. You will own the strategy that scales our connectivity with the largest ISPs and eyeball networks in the U.S. while solving the harder, less-charted problem of building resilient, cost-effective network reach across South America.</p> <p>This role operates on an AI-first model. AI is the force-multiplier that lets a single strategist see the whole region clearly and act on it quickly, shifting your time from reactive task processing to proactive architecture. The decisions you make will directly shape Cloudflare's standing as the network leader across the Americas.</p> <p>You will work in close partnership with the Regional Network Acquisition Manager, who executes high-volume sourcing, contract lifecycle, and vendor management under your strategic direction — freeing you to lead the complex, high-stakes work.</p> <h4>What You'll Do / of the U.S. and South American markets.</li> <li><strong>United States:</strong> Drive interconnection scale and depth with the largest U.S. ISPs and eyeball networks (e.g., Comcast, Charter, AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile), expanding private interconnect, peering, and capacity to keep pace with traffic growth.</li> <li><strong>South America:</strong> Solve the region's unique build challenges — a sparse and uneven IXP fabric, terrestrial and subsea transport economics, regulatory and market fragmentation, and heavy reliance on local partners — to establish durable, performant reach (with particular focus on Brazil, the region's largest market).</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI-First Operating Model</strong></p> <ul> <li>Use AI-driven analytics to interpret regional traffic patterns, peering opportunities, and performance/cost trade-offs, and to inform interconnection and capacity decisions.</li> <li>Leverage and help shape automated, agentic workflows for LOAs, ticketing, contract tracking, and data hygiene — partnering with the support layer to push routine execution to automation.</li> <li>Build models and scenario analyses (capacity, cost, resiliency) that let you make faster, better-evidenced strategic calls and clearly defend them to leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interconnection & Backbone Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Formulate and execute plans to optimize traffic flow across the region, balancing backbone, partner, transit, IX, and peer connections.</li> <li>Develop and execute strategies for the expansion, optimization, and maintenance of Manager</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the strategy and priorities the Network Acquisition Manager executes against; review and approve sourcing recommendations for new and existing transport services.</li> <li>Lead complex, high-value negotiations directly, while the Acquisition Manager runs high-volume requirements, contract lifecycle support, inventory, and first-level billing response.</li> <li>Ensure a clean handoff model so strategic intent translates into reliable, well-documented execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Relationship Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with ISPs, IXPs, carriers, and partners across the Americas.</li> <li>Act as the regional expert for interconnection relationships, focused on availability, capacity, effectiveness, and cost efficiency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Data Center Strategy, Network Engineering, Capacity Planning, and Infrastructure Operations to align on network strategy and implementation.</li> <li>Engage internal stakeholders to plan requirements and deliver cross-functional projects, communicating clearly throughout.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Industry Engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Represent Cloudflare in regional and global industry forums and conferences, contributing to best practices and standards.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in network infrastructure, ideally within a Telco, ISP, CDN, or cloud environment.</li> <li>Strong understanding of networking protocols and technologies, including BGP, DWDM, and IP networking.</li> <li>Proven experience negotiating and managing interconnection agreements.</li> <li>Working knowledge of the Americas connectivity landscape — the U.S. wholesale/peering market and the transport, IXP, and partner dynamics of South America (including subsea and terrestrial considerations).</li> <li>Fluency with AI tools in daily work, and a genuine appetite to use AI/agentic tooling to scale decision-making and eliminate manual toil.</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.</li> <li>Experience with capacity planning, cost modeling, and operations research.</li> </ul> operations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated Automation AI Agents & Continuous Innovation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leverage Autonomous AI Tools: Champion the use of Cloudflare OS and AI tools (Agent PAT and Agent Echo) to automate standard, repeatable technical tasks, optimizing operational efficiency and freeing up bandwidth for high-touch, strategic partner engagements.</li> <li>AI & CF1 Product Enhancement Feedback Loop: Engage partner champions in the Partner Technical Advisory Council (PTAC) to give them early access to beta software, capture raw product feedback, and drive joint co-innovation on CF1 features and emerging AI products.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Enablement: Participate in continuous cross-training programs to maintain peak proficiency in both pre-sales scoping and post-sales service deployment across the entire Cloudflare One and AI ecosystem.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of technical, partner-facing experience (e.g., Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Technical Account Manager) in cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or networking.</li> <li>Strong technical depth in Cloudflare One (CF1) or equivalent SASE/SSE architectures, Zero Trust, DNS, and application security, alongside hands-on familiarity with AI deployment, AI Gateway, LLM orchestration frameworks, or vector databases.</li> <li>Proven track record of developing technical talent or building "champion" programs within partner organizations, specifically driving adoption of complex cloud networks and AI technologies.</li> <li>Enterprise Architecture & Project Management: Deep understanding of enterprise IT, multi-cloud, and hybrid cloud environment while managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to manage the technical lifecycle of a deal from initial pre-sales discovery and CF1/AI PIO generation through post-sale service delivery.</li> <li>Strong communication skills with a track record of presenting complex CF1 architectures and AI-driven use cases to partner leadership and technical teams alike.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.</li> Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Sydney</strong>, <strong>Australia</strong></p> <hr> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. analytics-engineering (dbt) workflows.</li> <li>Background in SaaS or product-led growth (PLG) GTM motions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on They can move between strategy and execution, navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and work effectively with senior leaders across the organization.</p> <p>This is a high-visibility role that requires strong judgment, exceptional follow-through, and the ability to move quickly without sacrificing quality.</p> <p>You'll have a front-row seat to how a global revenue organization operates, with the opportunity to make a meaningful impact across the business.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>GTM Business Operations & Executive Priorities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner closely with the Revenue Chief of Staff to drive priorities across the Office of the President of Revenue.</li> <li>Act as an extension of the Revenue Chief of Staff, representing the office in cross-functional meetings and independently driving decisions and follow-through within agreed priorities.</li> <li>Anticipate upcoming needs, identify gaps, and proactively drive work forward.</li> <li>Prepare executive-ready updates, briefing materials, presentations, and communications.</li> <li>Track decisions, commitments, and dependencies, ensuring the right people are accountable and work moves forward.</li> <li>Help manage competing priorities, bringing recommendations and solutions rather than simply escalating problems.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>GTM Communications & Engagement</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the execution and quality of GTM-wide communications, including the weekly GTM Rollup, leadership updates, and organizational announcements.</li> <li>Work across functions to gather, validate, prioritize, and translate information into clear, actionable communications for the field.</li> <li>Drive planning and execution of GTM leadership engagement programs, including All Hands and Leadership Unplugged, from content development and stakeholder coordination through delivery and follow-up.</li> <li>Partner with executive stakeholders and content owners to ensure messaging is relevant, engaging, and aligned with GTM priorities.</li> <li>Ensure communications are accurate, timely, and appropriate for their intended audiences.</li> <li>Continuously improve how information reaches the field, reducing unnecessary noise while making important updates easier to find and act on.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Field Advisory Board (FAB) Program Leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own and continuously improve Cloudflare's global Field Advisory Board (FAB) program, ensuring it serves as a meaningful two-way feedback channel between field teams and GTM leadership.</li> <li>Manage the Americas and International boards, including member engagement, quarterly meetings, agendas, executive participation, and follow-through on commitments.</li> <li>Partner with Sales, Product, Enablement, Revenue Operations, and other teams to turn field feedback into actionable recommendations and improvements.</li> <li>Identify recurring themes, challenges, and opportunities from the field, and bring forward insights that help inform GTM priorities and decisions.</li> <li>Strengthen the program's effectiveness by improving how feedback is collected, prioritized, communicated, and acted upon.</li> <li>Ensure FAB members see tangible outcomes from their input, building trust and sustained engagement in the program.</li> <li>Establish clear measures of program impact and regularly assess what's working, what's not, and where the program needs to evolve.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Cross-Functional Execution</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Drive initiatives that span Sales, Revenue Operations, Marketing, Product, Enablement, and other functions.</li> <li>Translate FAB objectives into clear actions, owners, and timelines, and ensure commitments are delivered.</li> <li>Identify risks and dependencies early, recommend solutions, and escalate when necessary.</li> <li>Build strong relationships across the organization and influence outcomes without formal authority.</li> <li>Step into ambiguous or urgent situations and bring structure, clarity, and momentum.</li> <li>Balance the needs of multiple stakeholders while keeping the broader GTM organization's priorities in focus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Operational Excellence & Scale</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate unnecessary work, and improve how the GTM organization operates.</li> <li>Leverage AI, automation, and internal tools to reduce manual effort and improve execution.</li> <li>Create lightweight systems for tracking priorities, decisions, and follow-through.</li> <li>Establish practical quality-control processes to ensure work is accurate and complete before delivery.</li> <li>Continuously improve the quality, consistency, and efficiency of work coming out of the Office of the President of Revenue.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience in business operations, GTM strategy and operations, executive operations, Chief of Staff support, or similar roles in a fast-paced technology environment.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience working with senior executives and navigating complex, cross-functional organizations.</li> <li>Proven ability to independently own programs or initiatives from planning through execution, including driving stakeholder alignment and measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with a track record of managing multiple priorities without losing sight of the details.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex information into clear, concise, executive-ready materials.</li> <li>Excellent judgment and the confidence to make recommendations, challenge assumptions, and know when to escalate.</li> <li>A proactive mindset. You don't wait to be told what to do, and you're comfortable taking ownership of problems that don't have obvious answers.</li> <li>Strong execution skills. You follow through, close loops, and take responsibility for outcomes.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, changing priorities, and tight timelines.</li> <li>Experience using AI and automation to improve productivity and operational workflows.</li> <li>A low-ego, collaborative approach and willingness to roll up your sleeves, regardless of the task.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h2> <p>Within your first six months:</p> <ul> <li>You've become a trusted extension of the Revenue Chief of Staff, able to independently represent the office and move work forward.</li> <li>GTM communications and leadership engagement programs run smoothly, with strong quality control and minimal oversight.</li> <li>The Field Advisory Board operates as an effective, trusted feedback mechanism, with strong member engagement, actionable insights, and visible progress against field recommendations.</li> <li>You anticipate needs, identify potential issues, and bring solutions before problems escalate.</li> <li>Cross-functional stakeholders trust you to drive decisions, follow through on commitments, and keep work moving.</li> <li>You've identified and implemented meaningful improvements to how the team operates, including opportunities to use AI and automation.</li> <li>The Revenue Chief of Staff has more capacity to focus on strategic priorities because you're independently managing critical aspects of the business.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who Will Thrive Here</strong></h2> <p>You're naturally curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20 percent of global Internet request traffic and terminates TLS for millions of domains. Every day, our network handles certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel.</p> <p>That scale has taught us how the WebPKI ecosystem works from the consuming side.  As certificate lifetimes shorten, agentic activity increases, and post-quantum certificates move toward production, the number of certificates the Internet depends on will grow dramatically. </p> <p>Cloudflare is building a certificate authority for the whole Internet: a public, redundant, transparent CA that provides another trusted source of automated certificates and helps make the encrypted web more resilient. We intend to be ACME-first, automation-first, and transparent by design. We also intend to lead where the ecosystem is going, including post-quantum certificates and Merkle Tree Certificates, while continuing to support the classic WebPKI customers rely on today.</p> <p>As Principal Product Manager for Cloudflare's Certificate Authority business, you will define the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, and commercial model for this new venture. You will work across product, engineering, security, compliance, legal, operations, sales, marketing, and the WebPKI ecosystem to turn Cloudflare's CA from a major technical commitment into a product customers trust and adopt.</p> <p>This is an early-days role on a growing team. It is not a role for someone who only manages backlog. The right person will be comfortable with high-consequence infrastructure, deep customer discovery, ecosystem trust, compliance scrutiny, and zero-to-one product building. broader platform.</li> <li><strong>Build for the whole Internet</strong> by understanding the needs of developers, site owners, platform teams, SaaS providers, enterprise security teams, infrastructure operators, and partners who depend on certificates for availability, security, and compliance.</li> <li><strong>Make resilience a product principle.</strong> Help design product requirements that fail small, reduce customer blast radius, support automated recovery, and make certificate replacement fast enough to handle compliance issues, revocation events, or ecosystem incidents.</li> <li><strong>Drive an ACME-first customer experience</strong> that makes it easy for users of existing free or automated CAs to adopt Cloudflare with minimal tooling changes.</li> <li><strong>Partner closely with engineering</strong> on systems that manage certificate lifecycles, automate issuance and renewal, integrate with HSMs, protect keys, support auditability, and operate within strict reliability and correctness requirements.</li> <li><strong>Partner with compliance, legal, security, and operations</strong> to ensure product decisions align with CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements, WebTrust audits, root store program policies, Certificate Policy and Certification Practice Statement commitments, and public incident response expectations.</li> <li><strong>Own go-to-market strategy</strong> including packaging, pricing, launch sequencing, competitive positioning, customer segmentation, sales enablement, developer messaging, and adoption metrics.</li> <li><strong>Represent the customer and the ecosystem</strong> in product decisions where trust, transparency, uptime, security, and commercial adoption must all be balanced.</li> <li><strong>Work across Cloudflare product teams</strong> including SSL/TLS, Application Security, Zero Trust, Workers, Registrar, DNS, Load Balancing, SaaS products, and infrastructure teams that consume or expose certificate services.</li> <li><strong>Help make Cloudflare Customer Zero</strong> by ensuring our own usage of the CA exercises the product at Cloudflare scale and informs the roadmap before customers depend on it.</li> </ul> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-DesirableSkills,KnowledgeandExperience">Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience</h3> <ul> <li><strong>10+ years of product management experience</strong> building technical products for developers, security teams, infrastructure teams, enterprises, or cloud platforms.</li> <li><strong>Experience with security, identity, infrastructure, or developer platform products</strong> where correctness, reliability, compliance, and trust are core product requirements.</li> <li><strong>Working knowledge of PKI and certificate lifecycle management</strong> including TLS certificates, X.509, ACME, public and private CAs, revocation, Certificate Transparency, mTLS, HSMs, and enterprise certificate automation.</li> <li><strong>Strong business judgment</strong> with experience defining product strategy, pricing and packaging, customer segmentation, and go-to-market plans for technical B2B products.</li> <li><strong>Ability to operate in ambiguity</strong> and create structure around a new business, including market definition, customer discovery, roadmap tradeoffs, launch planning, and executive alignment.</li> <li><strong>Technical fluency with engineering teams</strong> and comfort discussing APIs, distributed systems, key management, audit trails, reliability, operational failure modes, and security tradeoffs.</li> <li><strong>Strong written communication</strong> for strategy documents, product requirements, launch narratives, customer-facing messaging, and high-stakes internal decisions.</li> <li><strong>Comfort with high-consequence work.</strong> A mis-issued, mis-revoked, or unavailable certificate can become a public, ecosystem-visible event. You need the judgment to move quickly and the discipline to be careful.</li> </ul> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-BonusPoints">Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Direct experience working on certificate authority, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, cloud security, identity, or trust services products.</li> <li>Experience with publicly trusted CAs, private PKI, managed certificate services, or platforms such as AWS Certificate Manager, AWS Private CA, Google Trust Services, DigiCert, Sectigo, Let's Encrypt / ISRG, Entrust, Microsoft PKI, HashiCorp Vault PKI, step-ca, or CFSSL.</li> <li>Familiarity with CA/Browser Forum requirements, browser root programs, WebTrust for CAs, WebTrust Baseline Requirements, or public CA incident reporting.</li> <li>Experience building API-first developer products, especially products involving ACME, SDKs, CLI workflows, Kubernetes, service mesh, mTLS, or infrastructure-as-code integrations.</li> lifetimes.</li> <li>Familiarity with post-quantum cryptography, crypto-agility, Merkle Tree Certificates, or customer migration planning for cryptographic transitions.</li> <li>Prior participation in WebPKI, IETF, browser trust, transparency, or security standards communities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations: Washington, D.C.</h3> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <p>As a Principal Public Sector Architect you understand your customer’s scope and mission. You are familiar with key regulatory guidelines and constraints and the unique nature of those factors on technology modernization.</p> <p>You can credibly engage across various technical domains. You have the capability to converse on risk management and have the ability to articulate the impact of risk to the organization in terms the government understands. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX</strong></p> <p><strong>Available Terms</strong></p> <ul> <li>Summer (May - September 2027)</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Every product decision we make directly impacts the millions of Internet properties (powering websites, remote teams, APIs, and mobile apps) running on our global network. Cloudflare's network is one of the largest in the world, spanning over 330 cities in more than 125 countries, and operating within 50 milliseconds of 95% of the Internet-connected population globally (for context, the blink of an eye is 300 to 400 milliseconds!). We are passionate about making the Internet more secure, reliable, and faster for everyone.</p> <p>Cloudflare’s Product Management team defines the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the features that power this massive global footprint. Product Managers bridge the gap between user needs, technical feasibility, and business impact by working directly with engineering, design, sales, and marketing to solve complex problems at scale. Whether defining APIs, shaping control plane workflows, or launching new security and performance features, our PMs turn ambitious ideas into intuitive products.</p> <p>The ideal Product Manager Intern is curious, user-focused, and passionate about making the Internet a better place. You won't just shadow team members; you will own product initiatives, gather customer insights, define requirements, and collaborate closely with experienced engineers and designers to ship real features that reach millions of people worldwide. This is a unique opportunity for aspiring PMs to learn how to manage and scale products at Internet scale.</p> <p>You can check out our <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/tag/internship-experience/">internship blogs</a> to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>As a Product Manager Intern, you will be the voice of the user. empathize with developer workflows.</li> <li>Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate hours/week) 12-week internship.</li> <li>In-office expectation of 3–5 days per week in Austin, TX.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with networking, security, or filled.</li> <li>We are not considering remote or part-time applicants. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span>&l

title: Professional Services Consultant, Zero Trust
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: </strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Austin, TX</strong></li> <li><strong>New York, NY</strong></li> <li><strong>Washington DC</strong></li> <li><strong>San Francisco Bay Area</strong></li> </ul> <hr> <h3><strong>About the role:</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare provides consultative and hands-on-keyboard implementation and migration services for enterprise customers. As a Senior Zero Trust Consultant within Professional Services, you are a senior individual contributor in the post-sales landscape, responsible for the technical execution of our most complex Zero Trust / SASE solutions and for guiding our customers to get the most value possible from their Cloudflare investment. You are a technical leader in the room — trusted to own the hardest engagements end to end, unblock escalations, and set the standard for how the practice delivers.</p> <p>You are a security and networking specialist with deep, hands-on experience across ZTNA, Secure Web Gateway, DNS filtering, Data Loss Prevention, CASB, Remote Browser Isolation, Cloud Email Security, and the identity and network on-ramps that tie a SASE architecture together. You are equally comfortable designing an architecture, configuring it hands-on-keyboard (including as code), troubleshooting a packet capture, and explaining the outcome to a customer's security leadership.</p> <p>This position has working hours Monday to Friday, 09:00–18:00. Occasionally we support customers over weekends for specific changes that must be done outside their business hours. Travel is expected around 30%. Work is performed in English; fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is a strong advantage.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="line-height: 2;">Plan and deliver timely and organized services for customers, ensure customers see the full value in Cloudflare’s products and advice on product best practices.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Gather business and technical requirements, use cases and any other information required to build, migrate and deliver a solution on behalf of the customer and transition the Cloudflare working environment to the customer. Produce a Solution Design, HLD, LLD, databuilds, procedures, scripts, test plans, drawings, deployment plan, migration plan, as-builts, and any other artifacts necessary to deliver the solution and transition smoothly into the customer’s technical teams.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Implement changes on behalf of the customer in the Cloudflare environment following the customer's change-management process. Provide guidance to the customer to configure their CPEs and integration points (identity providers, endpoints/MDM, DNS, network on-ramps, SIEM).</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Troubleshoot implementation issues and collaborate with Customer Support, Engineering, and other teams to drive technical escalations to resolution.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Contribute to the success of the organization through knowledge-sharing — internal and external documentation, technical Q&A, and iterating on best practices. Build operational assets such as templates, automation scripts, procedures, and workflows.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Lead multi-workstream engagements and act as the senior technical owner for complex deployments; support pre-sales scoping and solution design; and mentor junior consultants, helping scale the practice through reusable intellectual property.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience might include a combination of the skills below:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="line-height: 2;">3+ years in a customer-facing technical implementation or onboarding team, security engineering team, security operations center, or other highly technical team, including 3+ years focused on Zero Trust / SASE.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Strong command of the OSI model and core protocols: TCP/IP, TLS (including TLSv1.3 and mTLS), DNS, HTTP/2.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Deep understanding of Zero Trust technologies: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Remote Browser Isolation (RBI), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), CASB, and Cloud Email Security.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Deep understanding of internet and security technologies: forward and reverse proxies with content filtering & DLP, sandboxing, firewalls/NGFW, WAF, bot management, rate limiting, and SSL/IPsec & SSL/TLS VPN appliances and services.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Modern identity: SSO via SAML and OIDC, SCIM user/group provisioning and deprovisioning, LDAP/Active Directory, MFA/FIDO2, and the role of the IdP — with hands-on experience on Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">DNS in depth: DNS filtering, DoH/DoT, conditional forwarding / split-DNS, internal-zone resolution, and local domain fallback.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Endpoints: software distribution and deployment across Windows, macOS, and Linux; Windows and Linux server administration; and client-endpoint troubleshooting across all three platforms.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Networking troubleshooting: debugging network connectivity with standard tools (packet capture, DNS/HTTP tracing).</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Ability to manage a project, work to deadlines, and prioritize between competing demands.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Work performed in English; fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is a strong advantage.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Demonstrated technical experience (hands-on-keyboard) with:</strong></p> <p><em>At the senior level we expect these to be hands-on-keyboard — configured, deployed, migrated, or troubleshot in production — not just understood conceptually.</em></p> <ul> <li style="line-height: 2;">Experience working with Reverse & Forward proxies with Content Filtering & DLP technologies</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Software distribution & deployment in Microsoft, Mac and Linux environments</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Detailed working knowledge of web based security, network segmentation, security proxies,  Firewalls and NGFWs, SSL/IPSec and SSL/TLS VPN appliances & services, etc</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Integrating identity providers with enterprise applications end to end — SSO (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM provisioning, group/attribute mapping, and troubleshooting the IdP handshake.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Windows & Linux Server system administration</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Windows, MacOS and Linux client endpoints troubleshooting</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Experience debugging Network connectivity issues using Network Troubleshooting Tools</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred but not mandatory:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="line-height: 2;">Automation / Infrastructure-as-Code: Terraform (ideally the Cloudflare provider), REST APIs, Python/Bash scripting, Git, CI/CD, and policy-as-code.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Cloud platforms: AWS / Azure / GCP networking — VPC/VNet, Security Groups / NSG / NACL, cloud-native DNS resolvers (Route 53 Inbound Endpoints, Azure Private DNS), cloud IAM, and deploying connectors in IaaS.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">SASE on-ramp networking: IPsec/GRE tunnel configuration, BGP, Anycast, network segmentation for Zero Trust, and SD-WAN / MPLS / WAN-optimization background.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">MDM software distribution (Intune, Jamf).</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Identity & directory tooling: Microsoft Active Directory, GPO, Entra ID, and Intune.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Observability: log export (Logpush) and SIEM integration (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic, Chronicle); Digital Experience Monitoring (DEX).</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Frameworks & compliance: NIST Zero Trust Architecture; GDPR, DORA, NIS2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2 (FedRAMP if US-government work applies).</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Certifications: CISSP, CCSP, SC-300, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, CCNP/CCIE, CompTIA, or equivalent are a strong plus. Forensic certifications (GCFA, GCFE, GCIA, GCIH) are welcome but not central to this role.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Emerging: familiarity with AI security / shadow-AI governance — AI-tool discovery and gating, and AI Gateway concepts.</li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="1"><strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="0"><strong class="" data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Application Deadline:</strong> </strong><span class="">January 26,</span> 2027</h3> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="1"><strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> </li> <li> <p id="p-rc_453fd7ca19e0bd99-23" data-path-to-node="2,1,0"><span data-path-to-node="2,1,0,0">For SF, SJ, and Bay Area Metro based hires: Estimated annual salary of $163,000 - $224,000</span><span data-path-to-node="2,1,0,2">.</span></p> </li> <li> <p id="p-rc_453fd7ca19e0bd99-24" data-path-to-node="2,2,0"><span class="" data-path-to-node="2,2,0,0">For California - Remote, DC Metro, New York City, NY Metro: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - $215,000</span><span data-path-to-node="2,2,0,2">.</span></p> </li> <li> <p id="p-rc_453fd7ca19e0bd99-25" data-path-to-node="2,3,0"&gt

cross-functional teammates.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>AI Innovation & Process Automation</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Automate Operational Workflows:</strong> Identify manual, repetitive tasks across BOM reviews, reporting, and partner tracking, using AI tools and LLM prompt engineering to streamline processes.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Analyze Performance Data:</strong> Evaluate spend, build timelines, and quality trends using AI-assisted analysis tools to surface actionable operational insights.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Build Shared Tooling:</strong> Develop, document, and maintain sustainable, lightweight automation scripts and workflows for adoption across the broader team.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <h3><strong>Requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Vendor & Manufacturing Experience:</strong> Professional background managing hardware vendor or contract manufacturing (EMS/ODM) relationships, including BOM validation, quality tracking, and schedule management.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Hardware & BOM Proficiency:</strong> Practical ability to evaluate rack-level technical specifications (power distribution, networking, server hardware, firmware) to ensure manufacturing compliance.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Program Management Discipline:</strong> Hands-on experience managing operational workflows in Jira, with a track record of tracking and reporting on team KPIs and SLAs.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Applied AI & Automation Skills:</strong> Practical experience using AI tools or LLMs to automate concrete workflows, optimize reporting, or perform data analysis.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of working effectively across engineering, procurement, supply chain, and external partner teams.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desirable / Bonus Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Background in data center infrastructure hardware (servers, network switches, rPDUs, enterprise cabling).</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience writing lightweight scripts (Python, Google Apps Script, or similar) paired with AI developer tools.</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with global hardware supply chain and logistics operations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with Oracle ERP Cloud (e.g., SCM, Procurement, Inventory Management) or comparable ERP platforms such as SAP or NetSuite, particularly for BOM management, purchase orders, and materials tracking.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> We build and maintain managed rules that help protect millions of Internet properties from known vulnerabilities, emerging exploits, and new attack techniques.</p> <p>We work at the intersection of vulnerability research, large-scale traffic analysis, and detection engineering. Using threat intelligence and telemetry from Cloudflare’s global network, we identify exploitation patterns, develop mitigations, and measure how well they work against real traffic. We partner with Engineering, Product, and customer-facing teams to improve coverage while minimizing false positives and disruption to legitimate applications.</p> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <ul> <li>You have hands-on experience in web application security, vulnerability research, or detection engineering, including writing and improving WAF rules, exploit signatures, or comparable detection logic.</li> <li>You understand HTTP/HTTPS, how web applications and proxies process requests, and common vulnerability classes such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting, remote code execution, SSRF, and insecure deserialization.</li> <li>You can analyze a vulnerability advisory or proof of concept, reproduce the exploit in a controlled environment, and identify the request characteristics that distinguish exploitation from legitimate traffic.</li> <li>You use SQL to investigate large datasets and a language such as Python, Go, or Rust to build research tools, automate analysis, and validate detections.</li> <li>You make evidence-based tradeoffs between detection coverage, false positives, and performance. You do not need to know our exact stack, but you should be eager to go deep in the domain.</li> </ul> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>We are looking for a Security Research Analyst to research web application threats and develop the managed rules that protect Cloudflare customers. You will turn public CVEs, threat intelligence, customer reports, and internal telemetry into tested, effective mitigations.</p> <p>Your work will span the detection lifecycle: understanding an exploit, designing a rule, validating it against malicious and legitimate requests, and measuring its behavior in production. You will collaborate with engineering and research partners to close coverage gaps and continuously improve the quality of our WAF protections.</p> <h3>Key responsibilities:</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Research vulnerabilities and exploitation.</strong> Analyze public CVEs, proof-of-concept exploits, and observed attacks to understand root causes, exploit chains, and opportunities for WAF mitigation.</li> <li><strong>Develop and maintain managed rules.</strong> Design, test, and deploy WAF managed rules and exploit signatures, keeping protections effective as applications, exploits, and attacker techniques evolve.</li> <li><strong>Investigate false positives and missed attacks.</strong> Analyze customer reports and request telemetry, reproduce issues, and refine detections to improve protection without unnecessarily blocking legitimate traffic.</li> <li><strong>Validate coverage and resistance to bypasses.</strong> Use targeted penetration testing, exploit variants, and adversarial testing to identify detection gaps and evaluate proposed mitigations.</li> <li><strong>Automate research and validation.</strong> Build tools and reproducible test cases that accelerate exploit analysis, rule validation, regression testing, and traffic analysis.</li> <li><strong>Measure detection quality.</strong> Use SQL, dashboards, and production data to assess rule efficacy, track attack trends, and guide improvements to coverage, false-positive rates, and performance.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate across teams.</strong> Partner with Engineering, Product, and other detection teams to deliver reliable protections and resolve recurring customer problems at their roots.</li> <li><strong>Share actionable research.</strong> Document findings, explain mitigation decisions, and contribute to internal research reports and public-facing blogs on vulnerabilities and Internet-wide attack trends.</li> </ul> <h3>Additional Experience We Value</h3> <ul> <li>Experience developing WAF rules or contributing to open-source WAF projects, such as ModSecurity or the OWASP Core Rule Set.</li> <li>Experience finding WAF bypasses, analyzing request parsing and encoding differences, or researching novel exploitation techniques.</li> <li>Experience with large-scale security analytics, advanced SQL, columnar databases such as ClickHouse, and visualization tools such as Grafana.</li> <li>Experience building automated exploit-reproduction environments, detection test suites, or CI pipelines for security rules.</li> <li>Familiarity with Linux/UNIX systems, TCP/IP networking, reverse proxies, and the performance constraints of inspecting production traffic.</li> <li>Published security research, conference presentations, open-source security tools, or demonstrated work through bug bounty programs or CTFs.</li> <li>Experience partnering with data science or machine learning teams to combine rule-based detections with other security signals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $157,000 - $216,000</li> <li>For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $206,000</li> </ul> <h4><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h4> <p behavior observable and independently verifiable through transparency mechanisms, reproducible builds, cryptographic attestations, public operational telemetry, tamper-evident evidence, and audit controls.</li> <li>Design failure containment and recovery mechanisms that support safe certificate replacement, revocation, key rotation, and incident response without creating avoidable Internet availability failures.</li> <li>Translate CA/Browser Forum requirements, browser and operating-system root-program policies, audit criteria, and certification requirements into concrete technical and technical mentorship to engineers implementing and operating the CA platform.</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare in relevant standards and industry work, collaborating with browser vendors, root programs, researchers, auditors, CA operators, and the wider Web PKI community.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring</h2> <ul> <li>Substantial experience designing or operating security-critical systems, with deep large-scale distributed security systems.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of certificate trust chains, issuance and validation, revocation, key lifecycle management, and the security and availability
