Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX | London, UK | Lisbon, Portugal</p> <h4><strong>About the Department</strong></h4> <p>The Product Management team at Cloudflare steers the strategy, roadmap, and execution that powers a faster, more secure internet. As part of the Zero Trust Security organization, our Email Security team is redefining how the enterprise's most trusted — and most targeted — communication channel gets protected, evolving a platform already trusted by Fortune 500 and Global 2000 organizations into a fast, secure pillar natively integrated with Cloudflare's Zero Trust stack.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Email remains the most trusted, yet most targeted, communication channel in the enterprise. At Cloudflare, we have a proven email security solution which is trusted by Fortune 500 and Global 2000 organizations. We’re looking for an experienced, technical product manager to continue to differentiate our solution in the market, make difficult investment decisions, and own delivering an enterprise-grade email security platform that is fast, secure, and natively integrated with Cloudflare's Zero Trust stack.</p> <p>We are seeking an autonomous, determined, and pragmatic individual who possesses strong conviction, humility, and a decisive bias toward action.</p> <h4>What you'll do</h4> <p>In this role, you’ll be responsible for defining how some of the world's most sophisticated organizations protect their communication, leading the industry's shift away from legacy "boxes" toward an AI-first, cloud-native, and identity-aware security posture. </p> <p>Key responsibilities involve continuously investing in threat intelligence, sustaining current security detection capabilities, rapidly developing features, and expanding into new markets.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Own Email Security.</strong> Architect and own the strategic roadmap for our Email Security solution, ensuring Cloudflare remains the definitive answer to evolving threats like Business Email Compromise (BEC) and advanced phishing.</li> <li><strong>Shape Intelligence and Detections.</strong> Work alongside our Threat Intelligence and Detections teams to improve how customers consume, enforce, and understand Cloudflare One. Influence product direction, connect customer needs across the enterprise and own selected initiatives when dedicated leadership will accelerate an important outcome.</li> <li><strong>Support Zero Trust Security.</strong> Bolster the seamless integration of Email Security into the broader Cloudflare stack, architecting a "better together" experience that bridges Gateway, CASB, and DLP into a single, powerhouse defense layer.</li> <li><strong>Talk to Customers</strong>. Build trust with engineering and sales by rigorously documenting first-hand experiences with internal and external customers. </li> <li><strong>Drive new business.</strong> Act as the strategic engine for growth, building the features and competitive differentiators needed to displace legacy incumbents and win the hearts and minds of Global 2000 CISOs.</li> <li><strong>Evangelize the Platform.</strong> Use the product daily and serve as a technical and strategic leader, representing the Email Security vision to internal stakeholders, the sales field, and the broader security community.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>7+ years of experience</strong> as product manager, with a proven track record of owning and scaling complex enterprise security products in a high-growth environment.</li> <li><strong>Be customer obsessed.</strong> At Cloudflare, we serve the needs of customers large and small, and our product managers need to be comfortable understanding how to design for enterprises without compromising the experience for individuals and small businesses. </li> <li><strong>Write Persuasively.</strong> The best product managers at Cloudflare are exceptional storytellers. They distill complex ideas into simple ones by using context, empathy, transparency, and evidence. </li> <li><strong>Build with conviction.</strong> Demonstrated experience leading with conviction to build products designed to win in a highly competitive market, with a focus on feature differentiation and displacement strategy.</li> <li><strong>Maintain domain knowledge.</strong> Comfortable navigating architectural trade-offs with senior engineers regarding mail flow (M365/Google Workspace), cloud infrastructure, and API performance.</li> <li><strong>Have high ownership.</strong> Comfortable being accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from high-fidelity PRDs to collaborating with cross-functional teams for global launches.</li> <li><strong>Make data-driven decisions.</strong> Ability to leverage complex datasets to build intuitive conviction in your views and effectively persuade others</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Be an early adopter.</strong> You’ve enthusiastically adopted the latest generation of agentic coding tools, and you can use them effectively to navigate a codebase, dependency mapping, or prototype experiences for your feature area. </li> <li><strong>Fluent in Zero Trust security.</strong> A deep understanding of modern security architectures and the value of a unified platform approach (Identity, Device, and Data security).</li> <li><strong>Experience with detections.</strong> Familiarity with the mechanics of modern email threats and how machine learning can be used for detection.</li> <li><strong>Good design sense.</strong> You’re comfortable collaborating with design engineers to translate the requirements into lo-fi prototypes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <p>For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €68,000 - €94,000.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>We build the infrastructure that makes the web <strong>Payable</strong>, powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.</p> <p>Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/the-agentic-internet/">Agentic Internet</a>. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We build tools that make the new internet payable by giving our users the ability to monetize access to their content, data, services, products, and outcomes across the Internet, regardless of where they are hosted.</p> <p>Building these capabilities requires solving complex engineering problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, usage metering, outcome verification, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols (such as x402, WBA, ACP, and UCP). We bridge mainstream fiat commerce rails with decentralized protocols, enabling micro-payments at Internet scale.</p> <p>We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to serve as an expert and technical leader on our Agentic Commerce team. In this role, you will define the architecture, build core systems, and establish technical standards powering machine-to-machine payments, metering, and monetization across Cloudflare's network.</p> <p>As a Senior Engineer, your impact extends beyond individual features. You will shape product and engineering roadmaps by partnering directly with customers, product managers, and across Cloudflare teams. You will write architectural specs that guide engineers inside and outside the team, build systems that reduce complexity for others, and lead complex incident responses. You will be a prime reviewer for large systems, define core product KPIs, and mentor engineers across the organization to elevate our collective engineering practice.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <ul> <li>Design and build resilient, low-latency systems and core architectures that make web resources <strong>Payable</strong> for autonomous agents using emerging protocols (x402, WBA, ACP, UCP).</li> <li>Write technical specs (RFCs) and architecture designs that encompass deliverables for developers both within the team and across other Cloudflare engineering groups.</li> <li>Meet directly with customers and Product Management to clarify requirements, define actionable KPIs, and translate business needs into scalable architectural solutions.</li> <li>Architect services to reduce code complexity for the team, ensure seamless recovery from internal and external failures, and improve overall system health observability.</li> <li>Lead complex incident responses, retrospectives, and root-cause analyses while driving initiatives that proactively prevent customer escalations and reduce system alerts.</li> <li>Debug and resolve high-complexity issues spanning multiple teams, services, and protocols, using these opportunities to teach others how to handle similar challenges.</li> <li>Actively mentor engineers, improve engineering and interviewing processes, conduct high-impact spec and code reviews, and share knowledge through technical talks and writings.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Deep software engineering and distributed systems expertise with a track record of architecting, building, and operating high-throughput, low-latency production services.</li> <li>Broad experience with HTTP, API design, payment protocols/rails, web security, and cryptographic authorization mechanisms.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience defining product KPIs and translating complex customer and product requirements into clear architectural roadmaps.</li> <li>Proven track record of debugging complex distributed system failures that span multiple teams and systems, with a focus on systemic remediation.</li> <li>Strong history of technical mentorship, leading incident retrospectives, and driving process improvements inside and outside your immediate team.</li> <li>Ability to rapidly prototype, evaluate deep architectural trade-offs, and establish design patterns in an emerging technical domain.</li> <li>Excellent technical writing and communication skills, with experience drafting RFCs and specifications consumed by multiple engineering organizations.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Fluency in Rust (especially async Rust) or TypeScript/JavaScript edge runtimes (e.g., Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, KV) at system-architectural scale.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of emerging agentic payment protocols (x402, A2P, ACP, UCP, Web Bot Auth) or digital wallet architectures.</li> <li>Experience architecting high-precision event metering pipelines, usage-based billing engines, outcome verification systems, or revenue attribution tools.</li> Hyperdrive is a core piece of the Cloudflare Developer Platform that accelerates database queries from Cloudflare Workers by pooling connections and caching data at the edge. By eliminating the massive latency overhead of TCP, TLS, and database-specific handshakes, Hyperdrive allows developers to use the databases they already know and love—like PostgreSQL and MySQL—without the "cold start" performance penalties typically associated with serverless environments.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>Hyperdrive is integrated directly into the Cloudflare global network and features:</p> <ul> <li>Global Connection Pooling: Maintains "warm" connections to origin databases across the globe, reducing connection times by up to 90%.</li> <li>Intelligent Query Caching: Automatically caches frequently run read queries as close to the user as possible.</li> <li>Protocol-Aware Proxying: Features custom-built implementations of database wire protocols (PostgreSQL and MySQL) to parse and optimize traffic in real-time.</li> <li>Seamless Integration: Works with existing ORMs and drivers, providing a simple connection string that "just works" for developers.</li> <li>The team is geographically distributed across North America.</li> <li>You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. On any given day, you might write a design document that outlines how you plan to solve a specific problem, or fix a bug in how our user experience renders. You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies including, but not limited to Rust, Go, C++, Typescript.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of professional experience with Rust, Go, or C++. You know your way around TCP/IP, TLS, and WebSockets.</li> <li>You don’t just use databases; you understand how they work. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: <span class="collapsed-field-text">Austin - TX (Austin Only)</span></strong></p> <p>About Engineering at Cloudflare</p> <p>Cloudflare’s Engineers build and operate the software that helps power 25+ million Internet properties and millions of businesses around the world. Across our engineering organizations, we have opportunities for high caliber, curious and empathetic people to take on big challenges and build some of the best skills in the industry. We’re looking for talented team members to help build high-growth products, help scale our expanding network, build tools to improve availability, performance, uptime, and response times, and make systems failure-resistant and ready-to-scale.</p> <p>Cloudflare is a system spanning the globe, on a mission to make the Internet better, safer, and more powerful every day. As a Software Engineer at Cloudflare, you’ll work on the code that runs close to the end user, runs at a massive scale, and is deployed to <a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/network/">330+ cities</a> around the world.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary </strong></p> <p>We are looking for a talented Systems Engineer to join the Load Balancing team. You will work on a range of microservices written mainly in Go. Technologies we use include Docker, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, gRPC, Kafka, Clickhouse and the usual Unix/Linux tools and workflows. We strive to build reliable, fault-tolerant systems that can operate at Cloudflare’s scale. You will join a team of bright, hard-working, and supportive engineers who are passionate about their craft, and you will be comfortable operating in a fast-paced but sane work environment.</p> <p>You can learn more about our product and the work our engineers do on our blog:</p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/eliminating-hardware-with-load-balancing-and-cloudflare-one/">https://blog.cloudflare.com/eliminating-hardware-with-load-balancing-and-cloudflare-one/</a></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/extending-local-traffic-management-load-balancing-to-layer-4-with-spectrum/">https://blog.cloudflare.com/extending-local-traffic-management-load-balancing-to-layer-4-with-spectrum/</a></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/load-balancing-monitor-groups-multi-service-health-checks-for-resilient/">https://blog.cloudflare.com/load-balancing-monitor-groups-multi-service-health-checks-for-resilient/</a></p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities </strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, implement, and maintain the software systems that comprise Cloudflare’s Load Balancing product.</li> <li>Participate in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from designing and documenting systems to writing code, automated tests, and monitoring production deployments.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal teams, including security, network engineering, SRE, and product management, to design scalable solutions to difficult technical problems.</li> <li>Review work from your peers throughout all stages of the development lifecycle to ensure high-quality, maintainable code.</li> <li>Mentor team members and work with support teams to ensure customer delight and bring out the best in everyone.</li> <li>Debug issues in complex systems and contribute to the maintenance and improvement of operational health.</li> <li>Work with a wide range of technologies and programming languages, including Go, Rust, and Typescript, as well as various databases (SQL and No-SQL), Docker, and Kubernetes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Requirements </strong></p> <ul> <li>First and foremost curiosity and critical thinking</li> <li>3+ years of relevant professional experience with a technology company</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Go, Rust, C++, or a similar systems-level language</li> <li>Experience building and operating distributed systems</li> <li>Experience with modern Unix/Linux development and runtime environments</li> <li>Experience with monitoring, alerting and debugging high volume production systems</li> <li>Experience with databases (we use PostgreSQL and Clickhouse)</li> <li>Experience with monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li>Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal and communication skills, demonstrating empathy, teamwork and a sense of ownership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.</p> <p>(This role is aligned with an L3 level)</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX or London, UK (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>R2 is Cloudflare's object storage platform, offering developers durable, reliable storage with zero egress fees that integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare's global network and Developer Platform. The R2 Gateway team owns the request-facing layer of R2 — the S3-compatible API gateway that every object put, get, list, and delete flows through. Machine-level telemetry tells us how loaded a server is, but not which product, customer, or upstream service is responsible for that load.</p> <p><br>MAPS (Metrics and Analytics for Product Segmentation) is a newly formed team building the core instrumentation, collection, and data platform to solve this from the ground up. We are architecting a system to continuously measure CPU, network bandwidth, memory, and storage utilization across the entire global fleet without sampling—attributing resource consumption both to the underlying system service and to the specific product, account, and zone being served.</p> <p><br>The data MAPS produces serves two critical functions at Cloudflare:</p> <ol> <li>Real-Time Control Plane: MAPS is the primary telemetry input for Cloudflare’s next-generation global load balancer, shifting traffic management from open-loop heuristics to closed-loop routing driven by real-time, per-service resource capacity and consumption (within seconds).</li> <li>Fleet Economics & Capacity Planning: MAPS provides the long-term analytical dataset in ClickHouse used to map product demand forecasts to physical hardware requirements, calculate true cost-to-serve per product, and drive multi-year infrastructure investments.</li> </ol> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <p>You will work across the full lifecycle of a greenfield, high-throughput telemetry system running on every machine at the Cloudflare edge:</p> <ul> <li>Host-Level Instrumentation ("Outside View"): Build and maintain low-overhead Linux daemons (netacctd, maps_collector) in Rust and C that use eBPF (cgroup_skb) and cgroup v2 accounting to measure per-service resource consumption directly from the kernel.</li> <li>High-Performance Client Libraries ("Inside View"): Architect non-blocking, zero-allocation reporting SDKs in Rust and Go used by Cloudflare’s highest-throughput data-plane services to report per-request resource usage and product attribution over local Unix domain sockets.</li> <li>Edge Aggregation & Streaming: Build the per-machine collector daemon that ingests millions of events per second, performs bounded in-memory time-window aggregation, serves low-latency gRPC streams to the global load balancer, and flushes batch rollups to ClickHouse.</li> <li>Reconciliation & Correctness: Solve complex attribution problems—such as reconciling kernel-level cgroup measurements against application-reported metrics, and attributing resource usage when one multi-tenant service executes work on behalf of another.</li> <li>Cross-Team Architecture: Partner directly with the engineering teams behind Cloudflare’s core proxies, runtimes, and storage engines to instrument their critical paths without degrading tail latency.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <ul> <li>Strong systems programming experience in Rust, Go, or C, with a solid grasp of memory layout, concurrency, and performance-critical code paths.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating latency- and resource-sensitive server infrastructure or high-throughput data pipelines at scale.</li> <li>Strong fundamentals in Linux systems internals—processes, cgroups, sockets, and how the kernel accounts for compute, memory, and I/O.</li> <li>Proven ability to work across organizational boundaries: reading unfamiliar codebases, aligning with other infrastructure teams, and driving complex integrations to completion.</li> <li>A pragmatic approach to owning outcomes—from kernel-level data collection and wire protocols (protobuf/Cap'n Proto) all the way to the analytical tables consumers query.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience writing and verifying eBPF programs, or deep familiarity with the Linux networking stack and scheduler.</li> <li>Experience designing schemas and query patterns for distributed columnar databases (particularly ClickHouse) at high ingestion rates.</li> <li>Background in profiling, benchmarking, and debugging performance bottlenecks in production Linux environments (perf, PMU counters, flamegraphs).</li> </ul><div title: Kaufmännische Projektkoordination (m/w/d) – Operations & Steuerung
description: Du steuerst kaufmännische Prozesse, koordinierst Projekte in mehreren Unternehmen und bringst eigene Ideen ein? Dann komm zu uns nach Oldenburg. Über Uns Die Harms Holding vereint mehrere mittelständische Unternehmen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen in der Weser-Ems-Region. Unsere Geschäftsfelder reichen vom Handel über den Garten- und Landschaftsbau bis hin zu Gebäudedienstleistungen und der Betreuung von Außenanlagen. Was uns verbindet? Unternehmerisches Denken, kurze Entscheidungswege und der Anspruch, Dinge pragmatisch und effizient umzusetzen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Oldenburg suchen wir eine strukturierte und engagierte Persönlichkeit, die gerne Verantwortung übernimmt, kaufmännische Prozesse steuert und verschiedene Projekte innerhalb unserer Unternehmensgruppe koordiniert. Die Position ist als Vollzeitstelle ausgelegt, wobei der wöchentliche Stundenumfang zwischen 32 und 40 Stunden individuell vereinbart werden kann. Deine Aufgaben Projektkoordination & Steuerung: Du organisierst, koordinierst und überwachst operative Projekte und sorgst für strukturierte Abläufe. Buchhaltung & kaufmännische Verwaltung: Du unterstützt die laufende Buchhaltung unserer Gesellschaften, prüfst Geschäftsvorfälle und übernimmst deren Zuordnung und Kontierung. Zusammenarbeit mit Subunternehmen: Du koordinierst externe Dienstleister und Subunternehmen, überwachst Termine und Leistungen und stellst reibungslose Abläufe sicher. Unternehmensübergreifende Organisation: Du übernimmst kaufmännische und organisatorische Aufgaben für verschiedene Gesellschaften unserer Holding. Prozessoptimierung: Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale, entwickelst bestehende Abläufe weiter und setzt eigene Ideen um. Das bringst du mit Kaufmännische Ausbildung, BWL-Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation Erste Berufserfahrung in kaufmännischer Verwaltung, Projektkoordination oder operativem Geschäft Grundkenntnisse in der Buchhaltung und sicherer Umgang mit Zahlen Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise Erfahrung mit MS Office und Offenheit für neue Systeme Freude daran, Dinge zu verbessern und Verantwortung zu übernehmen Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Terminen in der Region (Oldenburg, Wiesmoor, Emden) Dein Arbeitsumfeld Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben: Du arbeitest mit Unternehmen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen zusammen. Eigenverantwortung: Du erhältst Gestaltungsspielraum und kannst eigene Ideen einbringen. Kurze Entscheidungswege: Direkte Kommunikation und pragmatische Lösungen statt langer Abstimmungsprozesse. Vielseitige Einblicke: Du verbindest kaufmännische Tätigkeiten mit operativer Projektsteuerung. Aktive Mitgestaltung: Du entwickelst Prozesse und Strukturen innerhalb unserer Unternehmensgruppe weiter. Langfristige Perspektive: Eine verantwortungsvolle Vollzeitposition in einem unternehmerisch geprägten Umfeld. Dein Arbeitsplatz Dein Hauptarbeitsplatz befindet sich in unserem Büro in Oldenburg. Gelegentlich bist du auch an unseren weiteren Standorten oder bei Projekten im Raum Oldenburg, Wiesmoor und Emden unterwegs. Klingt nach deinem nächsten Karriereschritt? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Bewirb dich jetzt bei der Harms Holding GmbH. Weitere Informationen: www.harms-holding.com Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Expression of Interest – Contractor Engagement – Bridge and Structures Inspectors
description: <p><strong>About BakerHicks</strong></p> <p>BakerHicks is a leading design, engineering and project delivery consultancy, delivering complex infrastructure, industrial and built environment projects across the UK and Europe.</p> <p>Our Infrastructure team supports a wide range of clients and frameworks, providing specialist engineering, inspection, surveying and asset management services. As our project portfolio continues to grow, we are expanding our network of trusted contractors to support current and future bridge inspection requirements across the UK.</p> <p>Our strength lies in our collaborative approach, technical excellence, and ability to mobilise the right expertise at pace to support our clients’ requirements.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Our Bridges Team</strong></p> <p>At BakerHicks, our Bridges Team delivers expert engineering solutions across the full lifecycle of bridge and structures projects, from inspection and assessment through to design, refurbishment, strengthening, and replacement works. Our engineers work on a diverse portfolio of assets including highway bridges, railway bridges, footbridges, retaining structures, culverts, and other critical infrastructure across the UK.</p> <p>We combine technical excellence with a practical, collaborative approach, working closely with clients, asset owners, local authorities, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams to develop safe, sustainable, and cost-effective solutions. Our experience spans inspections, structural assessments, repair schemes, asset management programmes, and the delivery of complex infrastructure projects in highly regulated environments.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p> <p>We are seeking Expressions of Interest from competent and experienced Bridge and Structural Inspectors to join our growing contractor talent pool.</p> <p>This is not a live vacancy tied to a specific project. Instead, we are building a network of pre-qualified professionals who can be considered for assignments as needs arise across our infrastructure portfolio.<br>Applications are welcomed from anywhere in the UK. Site travel will normally be required, there is no requirement to be based near a BakerHicks office.</p> <p>We are particularly keen to hear from inspectors based in Scotland, while welcoming applications from inspectors based in England.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></p> <p>We welcome inspectors with experience in one or more of the following activities and environments:</p> <ul> <li>General inspections</li> <li>Principal inspections, including close-up examination and access equipment</li> <li>Safety, special and reactive inspections</li> <li>Inspections for assessment and monitoring</li> <li>Condition surveys (defect investigations and condition scoring)</li> <li>Highway structures on trunk road and local authority networks</li> <li>Railway structures</li> <li>Inspection and access planning, and reporting</li> <li>Team leadership and technical review by appropriately qualified Senior Inspectors</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Relevant asset types and construction forms may include:</p> <ul> <li>Road and rail bridges, including footbridges</li> <li>Culverts and buried structures</li> <li>Retaining walls</li> <li>Tunnel structures</li> <li>Sign and signal gantries, masts and other ancillary highway structures</li> <li>Structures over or adjacent to watercourses, including scour-related inspections</li> <li>Concrete, steel, masonry, timber, composite and post-tensioned structures</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Knowledge & Experience</strong></p> <p>Applicants should be able to demonstrate the following, appropriate to the assignments sought:</p> <ul> <li>Relevant UK bridge or structures inspection experience, with a clear record of inspection roles and asset types</li> <li>Working knowledge of applicable standards and client procedures, including NR/L3/CIV/006 and/or DMRB CS 450 where relevant</li> <li>Ability to identify, photograph and classify defects; record severity and extent; recognise urgent safety issues; and produce accurate reports and recommendations</li> <li>Ability to plan and coordinate inspection works, including access arrangements and traffic or rail control measures.</li> <li>Knowledge of structural materials, deterioration mechanisms, structural behaviour and inspection limitations</li> <li>Experience with National Highways, Transport Scotland, Network Rail, local authorities or comparable asset owners and supply chains</li> <li>Experience producing inspection reports and condition assessments, including reporting using Bridge Condition Indicators</li> <li>IT Literacy – proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Depending on the assignment, the following will be required or advantageous:</p> <ul> <li>Current Bridge Inspector Certification Scheme (BICS) certification at Inspector or Senior Inspector level, appropriate to the work. Required where mandated by the client, including relevant Transport Scotland assignments</li> <li>Relevant BEng/MEng in civil or structural engineering qualification, or equivalent inspection experience</li> <li>Current working-at-height and confined-space competence, where applicable</li> <li>IPAF/MEWP, IRATA rope-access, PASMA mobile access towers, Ladder or other relevant access qualifications, where applicable</li> <li>Current Safe Working Near Water (SWNW) or other equivalent competence, where applicable</li> <li>Current Safe use of Trolley Equipment or Rail Trolley controller, where applicable</li> <li>Valid CSCS or other required site-access certification</li> <li>For rail work, current Personal Track Safety (PTS) and other role-specific competences; SSSTS or SMSTS for supervisory duties</li> <li>Network Rail Competencies STE2 – 7 as defined in NR/SP/CTM/017</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Why Register Your Interest?</strong></p> <p>By joining our contractor talent pool, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Be considered for assignments matching your competence, location and availability</li> <li>Build a working relationship with BakerHicks</li> <li>Work alongside experienced infrastructure professionals</li> <li>Support projects across a variety of sectors, clients and UK locations</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>How to Register Your Interest</strong></p> <p>Please submit your CV. Our Talent Acquisition team will review applications alongside our Infrastructure discipline leaders, and suitable candidates will be invited to an introductory discussion.<br><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Engagement Details</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contract opportunities (Inside IR35 / PAYE engagement)</li> <li>Flexible working depending on project requirements (office/site/hybrid)</li> <li>Locations across the UK</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><em>Many of the positions within our company are subject to security clearance or security assurance levels. The successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate level of security clearance or assurance level for this role, in line with client and sector requirements. In some cases, additional nationality or residency criteria may also apply due to specific client or national security obligations.</em></p> <p><em>Further information on National security clearance levels can be found on the UK Government website: (</em><a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels"><em>National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK</em></a><em>) </em></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>About BakerHicks </strong></p> <p>We’ve been innovating in design, engineering and project delivery since 1957 and operate from 14 locations for a truly European reach. For more about our company story, see: <a href="https://bakerhicks.com/en/about">About | BakerHicks</a>. </p> <p>BakerHicks. A <a href="https://www.morgansindall.com/">Morgan Sindall Group</a> company.  </p> <p><strong>  </strong></p> <p><strong>Benefits </strong></p> <p>Whatever your discipline, you’ll be alongside some of the most talented people in the industry. Our network of offices are appealing, friendly and comfortable spaces, easily accessible by car or public transport. And our salary and benefits packages are some of the best in the industry.  </p> <p>BakerHicks is an equal opportunity employer. We care about creating an inclusive atmosphere and are committed to promoting diversity and inclusion throughout.  <br>BakerHicks is an inclusive organisation welcoming talent from all backgrounds. Applicants are assessed on the basis of personal merit and qualifications. </p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description: <p>Application Modernization Platform (“AMP”) is a MongoDB offering that modernises our customer’s legacy relational applications to a modern architecture underpinned by MongoDB using a combination of software, processes, and engineers. In this offering, the people and software are inextricably linked and cannot be separated. The delivery happens in an accelerated timeframe wherein the team takes advantage of GenAI and algorithmic tooling to expedite the turnaround time for application delivery.  </p> <p>AMP team generally works with enterprise-grade customers, in all verticals on a variety of exciting use cases. This role solves technically sophisticated problems, gains incredible cross-stack experience, works with top-notch people in the business, addresses multiple customer-facing opportunities. The role also becomes the forefront of groundbreaking R&D that enables further acceleration for enterprises working across a variety of technologies.</p> <p>AMP exists to expedite time to value for customers who are looking forward to changing, modernising and updating their tech stack while keeping MongoDB the cornerstone of their system architecture.</p> <p>As the Senior Technical Project Manager, you will work in conjunction with the team’s Technical Lead to lead a small Agile team responsible for migrating a customer’s legacy Java application to a modern cloud-based architecture running on MongoDB. The team will use the latest genAI tools and approaches to accelerate the migration process. You will also be responsible for liaising with customers and internal stakeholders, managing concerns and potential resolutions, and guiding the team towards success. The Agile team will be required to be innovative in deriving solutions to unseen challenges, and you will foster a culture of innovation and collaboration within the team. </p> <p>We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Germany for our hybrid working model.</p> <h3>Position Expectations</h3> <ul> <li>Agile mindset with an understanding of SCRUM/Kanban processes</li> <li>Able to support a project team consisting of onsite, co-located and remote team members</li> <li>Be able to proactively identify and remove impediments</li> <li>Manage project risks and issues</li> <li>Define and refine project team’s “Way of Working”</li> <li>Streamline communications between the project team and project stakeholders</li> <li>Able to manage expectations of project stakeholders, where the majority are leaders within the organization</li> <li>Operate in a small, dynamic, fast-growing team, able to be self-sufficient with an ability to have a can-do attitude and make oneself accountable</li> <li>Act as a liaison between the customer, project team and the rest of MongoDB (sales, customer success, support, product and engineering) throughout an engagement</li> <li>Create plans and priorities for both project delivery and customer resources. Guide customer as well as project team members to a successful business outcome by managing the client relationship and setting and managing customer expectations during implementations </li> <li>Establish and lead recurring project status or governance meetings, including preparation of materials and working with customer project manager and key internal and external stakeholders to review key project information and maintain visibility and accountability</li> <li>Periodically report, in a concise and actionable manner, project status both internally as well as to the customer and document project progress as per established best practices (meeting minutes, project plan updates, weekly status reports)</li> <li>Manage escalations or critical situation</li> <li>Assist with scoping of solution and project scope definition</li> <li>Adopt a consultative and prescriptive approach that inspires trust and confidence</li> <li>Be intrigued by the possibilities of genAI to assist in accelerating the delivery of projects</li> </ul> <h3>Requirements</h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of project management experience with enterprise-scale software solutions, large-scale software engineering or consulting services delivery experience preferred</li> <li>Excellent customer interaction and presentation skills (ability to present to different audiences and bring the message across in a concise, professional manner) </li> <li>Demonstrated belief in the power of stakeholder management and communications; track record of affecting change through stakeholder engagement</li> <li>Services delivery experience with development or operation teams is a plus</li> <li>Ability to travel and work on customer sites for a number of continuous weeks</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>Experience as a SCRUM master</li> <li>Experience in managing projects with a high degree of uncertainty (research and innovation)</li> <li>Experience in delivering software development projects (ideally modernization of a legacy application)</li> <li>Experience with JIRA / Project tools</li> </ul> <p>Successful candidates will engage with customer systems and may be exposed to highly confidential customer data, including but not limited to non-public information. For this reason, and due to the nature of the highly regulated industry in which our customers operate, successful candidates may be subject to enhanced background checks, security screenings, and possible constraints around the trading of securities. Successful candidates will understand these requirements and be willing to participate in enhanced screenings and constraints as required by MongoDB and its customers in connection with this role. </p> <h3>About MongoDB</h3> <p>MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.</p> <p>With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.</p> <p>Our compass at MongoDB is our <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company">Leadership Commitment,</a> guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. </p> <p>To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/culture/employee-benefits-that-make-a-difference-at-mongodb">From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy</a>, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys.<a href="https://www.mongodb.com/blog/channel/culture"> Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB</a>, and help us make an impact on the world!</p> <p>MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.</p> <p>MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.</p> <p><em>Req ID: 4273611222</em></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Security Architect
description: <h4>Security Architect</h4> <p><strong>Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent</strong></p> <h4>Safeguard the digital future of financial services.</h4> <h4>The Role</h4> <p>We are looking for Security Architects to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable solutions for some of the world’s leading financial institutions. You’ll play a critical role in shaping security strategy, informing architectural decisions, and embedding best practices across cloud and hybrid environments.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role with opportunities to mentor others and influence major change initiatives, using approved AI tools, automation and AI-enabled workflows where appropriate to improve the speed, quality and insight of security architecture activities. You’ll apply human judgement and responsible AI guardrails to ensure outputs are appropriately reviewed and escalated.</p> <h4>What You’ll Do</h4> <ul> <li> <p>Develop enterprise security architecture strategies aligned with business and regulatory requirements, using approved AI-enabled tools where appropriate to accelerate research, analysis and insight</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead the design of secure systems, networks and applications across on-premise, cloud and hybrid environments</p> </li> <li> <p>Conduct threat modelling and risk assessments, define remediation strategies, and explore responsible AI and automation to improve the efficiency and quality of security analysis while maintaining human review</p> </li> <li> <p>Guide DevSecOps adoption by designing embedded security and controls within the SDLC, including appropriate guardrails, audit trails and escalation pathways for AI-enabled workflows</p> </li> <li> <p>Champion security awareness and mentor teams across engineering, architecture and delivery, encouraging responsible experimentation with approved AI tools where they can improve productivity and outcomes</p> </li> </ul> <h4>What We’re Looking For</h4> <ul> <li> <p>Extensive experience designing and implementing secure architectures across cloud and hybrid environments</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience designing solutions using Palo Alto, Microsoft or similar security ecosystems</p> </li> <li> <p>Deep knowledge of security frameworks and standards, such as NIST, ISO 27001, CAF and TOGAF, combined with experience designing Zero Trust Architecture solutions</p> </li> <li> <p>Expertise across IAM, endpoint protection, application and network security, with the ability to translate complex security concepts for technical and non-technical audiences</p> </li> <li> <p>A collaborative approach to working across multidisciplinary environments, with curiosity about AI-enabled ways of working and an understanding of the importance of responsible AI, human-in-the-loop judgement and appropriate review</p> </li> </ul> <h4>Bonus Points For</h4> <ul> <li> <p>Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, TOGAF or Cloud Security certifications</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience defining AI security architecture, responsible AI standards, guardrails or governance, including Generative AI or Agentic AI, within a regulated environment</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with security tooling such as SIEM, firewalls and IAM solutions</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with regulatory compliance such as GDPR or PCI-DSS within financial services</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, Java or C++, or experience supporting RFPs, mentoring colleagues or contributing to thought leadership</p> </li> </ul> <h4>Why Join Capco</h4> <ul> <li> <p>Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions</p> </li> <li> <p>Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture</p> </li> <li> <p>Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications</p> </li> <li> <p>Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services</p> </li> <li> <p>Help shape the future of digital transformation across FS & Energy.</p> </li> </ul> <p>We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:</p> <h4>Benefits</h4> <ul> <li> <p>Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.</p> </li> <li> <p>Mental Health & Healthcare: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, in-house first aiders and convenient online GP services.</p> </li> <li> <p>Family-Friendly & Family Care: Maternity, adoption and shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause and bereavement, alongside 8 complimentary backup care sessions for emergency childcare or elder care.</p> </li> <li> <p>Holiday Flexibility: 5 weeks of annual leave with the option to buy or sell holiday days based on your needs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Continuous Learning & Extra Perks: Minimum 40 hours of annual training across workshops, certifications and e-learning, plus a Business Coach from Day One. Additional benefits include Gympass (Wellhub), travel insurance, Tastecard, season ticket loans, Cycle to Work and dental insurance.</p> </li> </ul> <h4>Inclusion at Capco<br>We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know - we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration - a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.</h4> <p>#LI-DNI</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Scrum master
description: Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken. AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt. Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We bouwen aan moderne software, slimme dataplatformen en agentic oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd kijken we hoe AI onze eigen manier van werken verandert. Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen, wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking. Jouw rol Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties. Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor de organisatie, developers, product owners en stakeholders en weet wanneer je moet coachen, uitdagen of juist ruimte moet geven. Maar je kijkt ook vooruit. Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? En hoe zorg je dat teams nieuwe technologie omarmen zonder hun focus op mensen en resultaat te verliezen? Je hoeft niet zelf te programmeren, maar je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en begrijpt hoe veranderingen in software engineering invloed en impact hebben op de organisatie, teams en processen. Wat ga je doen? Coachen van Agile-teams op focus, samenwerking, communicatie en voorspelbaarheid Faciliteren van Scrum-events die daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan verbetering Signaleren en wegnemen van blokkades binnen teams en binnen de organisatie Versterken van de samenwerking tussen developers, product owners, business en stakeholders. Meedenken over de inzet van AI-tools om teamprocessen, kennisdeling, delivery en adoptie slimmer te organiseren. Continu verbeteren van flow, kwaliteit en de manier waarop teams waarde leveren. Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Agile-werkwijze binnen een AI First-organisatie. Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als Scrum Master binnen softwareontwikkeling. Ervaring met multidisciplinaire teams in complexe IT-omgevingen. Sterke kennis van Agile, Scrum en teamontwikkeling. PSM I en II, CSM- of vergelijkbare certificering. Interesse in AI, automatisering en de veranderende wereld van software engineering. Het vermogen om teams, product owners te coachen, stakeholders uit te dagen en verandering te begeleiden. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels. Ervaring met SAFe, LeSS of andere scaling frameworks is een pré. Je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn. We zoeken vooral iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar de impact van AI op samenwerking en softwareontwikkeling en teams daarin kan meenemen. Het team Je komt terecht in een team van zo’n 25 gedreven medior en senior developers. We zijn groot genoeg om serieuze projecten neer te zetten en klein genoeg om elkaar te kennen. Iedereen heeft invloed en goede ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd. We zetten onze development expertise in bij gerenommeerde bedrijven in Nederland. Daar bouwen we met Java en Kotlin aan oplossingen die ertoe doen, en we gebruiken AI om tot de best mogelijke resultaten te komen. We onderzoeken continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken. Ontwikkeling staat voorop. Tijdens onze kennisavonden delen we wat we leren en we bezoeken jaarlijks (inter)nationale conferenties om scherp te blijven. Daarnaast spreken we regelmatig af voor informele activiteiten, want goed samenwerken begint met elkaar écht kennen. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. title: Senior Partnership Manager Payments
description: Opleiding: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in bedrijfskunde, economie, finance, commerciële economie of vergelijkbaar. Ervaring: Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships of business development. Persoonlijkheid: Je bent communicatief sterk, organisatiesensitief, zelfstandig en overtuigend op senior niveau. Salaris: € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m. WAT GA JE DOEN? Elke dag checken 6,5 miljoen Nederlanders in om te reizen met het OV. Met de OV-chipkaart, OV-pas, betaalpas, creditcard of mobiel. En dat werkt simpel en soepel. Kaart voor de lezer en … ‘bliep’. Reizen maar! Maar achter die ‘bliep’ gaat een complexe wereld schuil. Welkom in de wereld van Translink! Met de introductie van nieuwe betaalmogelijkheden onder de vlag OVpay is Translink dichter komen te staan bij de bredere financiële sector. In- en uitchecken met de bankpas vereist goede afstemming met banken. Maar ook de bredere inzet van EMV-technologie met OVpay maakt dat we als bedrijf te maken hebben met bestaande card schemes. Als Senior Partnership Manager Payments - Card Schemes & Banken, ben jij het externe gezicht van Translink binnen het paymentecosysteem. Je onderhoudt strategische relaties met onder andere Visa, Mastercard, banken en andere belangrijke partijen in het betalingsverkeer. Je begrijpt hun belangen en ontwikkelingen en weet deze te verbinden met de ambities van Translink en OVpay. Je beweegt je gemakkelijk op senior niveau en voert gesprekken met zowel inhoudelijke experts als directies en bestuurders. Daarbij begrijp je niet alleen de commerciële kant van partnerships, maar ook hoe de paymentketen inhoudelijk werkt. Je weet wat ontwikkelingen binnen issuing, acquiring en card schemes betekenen voor Translink en kunt deze vertalen naar concrete keuzes en afspraken. Intern werk je nauw samen met onder andere Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations en IT. Daarnaast vorm je samen met collega’s die zich meer richten op ontwikkeling en data een sterk team: jij richt je primair op de externe relaties en strategische partnerships. Waar ga je dagelijks mee aan de slag: Je bouwt en onderhoudt strategische relaties met Visa, Mastercard, Nederlandse banken, issuers en andere relevante partijen binnen payments. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor externe stakeholders en vertegenwoordigt Translink in strategische en inhoudelijke gesprekken. Je ontwikkelt een duidelijke partnershipstrategie en meerjarige agenda voor de samenwerking met card schemes en banken. Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer, scheme rules en marktstandaarden en vertaalt deze naar impact en concrete acties voor Translink. Je voert inhoudelijke en commerciële onderhandelingen over voorwaarden, kosten, dienstverlening en gezamenlijke verbeterinitiatieven. Je verbindt externe marktontwikkelingen met interne technische, financiële en datagedreven inzichten. Je adviseert management en directie over kansen, risico’s, afhankelijkheden en ontwikkelingen binnen het paymentecosysteem. Je zorgt voor afstemming tussen Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, IT en externe partners bij complexe trajecten rondom payments en scheme compliance. Je draagt bij aan de verdere professionalisering en mogelijke organisatorische ontwikkeling van de paymentactiviteiten binnen Translink. WIE ZOEKEN WE? We zoeken een ervaren paymentprofessional die zijn of haar sporen in de sector heeft verdiend. Je begrijpt hoe banken, issuers, acquirers en card schemes met elkaar samenwerken en weet wat er nodig is om binnen dat complexe speelveld duurzame partnerships op te bouwen. Je voelt je comfortabel aan tafel met senior stakeholders en bestuurders. Je kunt complexe onderwerpen helder uitleggen en weet de vertaalslag te maken tussen de buitenwereld en de interne organisatie. Tegelijkertijd ben je pragmatisch. Je bouwt niet alleen relaties, maar zorgt ook dat afspraken daadwerkelijk leiden tot resultaat. Voor een ervaren professional biedt deze rol bovendien iets bijzonders: je werkt aan een maatschappelijk relevant betalingssysteem dat dagelijks door miljoenen reizigers wordt gebruikt. WAT ZIT ERIN JOUW TAS? Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships, business development of relatiemanagement. Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met partijen zoals card schemes, banken, issuers, acquirers, paymentnetwerken of andere organisaties binnen het betalingsverkeer. Je hebt kennis van onderwerpen zoals scheme rules, scheme economics, fees, incentives en ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer. Je bent gewend om complexe relaties en onderhandelingen op senior niveau te voeren. Je kunt marktontwikkelingen, financiële belangen en inhoudelijke vraagstukken vertalen naar heldere voorstellen en concrete resultaten. Je communiceert overtuigend met zowel inhoudelijke experts als senior management en externe bestuurders. Je bent organisatiesensitief, analytisch en zelfstandig en weet mensen mee te krijgen zonder formele hiërarchie. Je beheerst zowel het Nederlands als het Engels uitstekend. WAT BIEDT TRANSLINK JOU? Translink is een leuke, uitdagende werkplek. We werken in een dynamische, veelzijdige omgeving met een hoog ontwikkeltempo. Samenwerken, Wendbaarheid en Zelfregie zijn onze kernwaarden en dat proef je op de werkvloer. Translink biedt een prettige kantooromgeving met fijne werkplekken. Onze werksfeer is informeel, open en behulpzaam. Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn aantrekkelijk. Vrij bewegen is ons motto. Je kunt in goed overleg hybride werken en we bieden bewegingsruimte om balans aan te brengen tussen je werk- en privéleven. Zo kun je met onze thuiswerkregeling ook thuis een fijne werkplek inrichten. Voor je eigen ontwikkeling bieden wij de GoodHabitz online leeromgeving aan. Zo kun je jezelf continu blijven ontwikkelen. We hebben bij Translink ook de mogelijkheid om een (elektrische) fiets te leasen, dit kan zowel voor privé als woon-werkverkeer. Je ontvangt een salaris tussen € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m. Dit is afhankelijk van je ervaring en kwalificaties, op basis van een 40-urige werkweek. Daar bovenop ontvang je een keuzebudget van 6,94% van je salaris, dit is gemiddeld € 500,- p/m. Daarnaast krijg je 8% vakantiegeld, reiskosten en een goede pensioenregeling. Deze functie is voor minimaal 32 uur per week. IS DEZE VACATURE OP JOUW LIJF GESCHREVEN? Solliciteer dan snel! Vragen? Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. title: Vertrieb Industriewasseraufbereitung (m/w/d)
description: Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes und wachstumsstarkes Unternehmen in der Umweltbranche mit den Geschäftsbereichen Industriewassermanagement und Entsorgung & Verwertung. Als führender Anbieter für Betriebsführungs- und Betreiberlösungen in der industriellen Abwasseraufbereitung und Prozesswasserbehandlung bietet das Unternehmen ein breites Portfolio für das Wassermanagement in der produzierenden Industrie – von Betriebsführungskonzepten über Wartung und Instandhaltung bis hin zu eigenen Betriebschemikalien. Wir suchen keine Verwalter – wir suchen echte Macher mit Vertriebsgen. Menschen, die Chancen erkennen, Verantwortung übernehmen und den Anspruch haben, beim Kunden wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Das Unternehmen ist Teil einer international aufgestellten, vertikal integrierten Unternehmensgruppe mit rund 45 Gesellschaften und entsprechendem Zugang zu Infrastruktur, Technologie und Verwertungswegen sowie echten Wettbewerbsvorteilen im Markt. Am Standort München oder in der Filiale in Offenbach an der Queich arbeitest du nah am Markt und übernimmst eine aktive Rolle im Ausbau des Geschäfts. Du bist nicht nur Ansprechpartner, sondern Treiber: Du erkennst Potenziale, entwickelst Lösungen und bringst sie beim Kunden auf die Straße. Dabei kannst du dich auf ein erfahrenes Team im Hintergrund verlassen, das dich operativ unterstützt. Aufgaben Du gewinnst neue Industrie- und Gewerbekunden für unsere Lösungen im Bereich Industriewasser, Abwasserbehandlung und Entsorgung und betreust den bestehenden Kundenstamm; dabei berätst du zu wasserwirtschaftlichen und abfalltechnischen Fragestellungen. Du analysierst Kundenprozesse (z. B. Prozesswasser, Abwasserströme), bewertest Stoffströme und entwickelst passende Lösungen – von der Aufbereitung über Kreislaufführung bis zur Entsorgung. Du erstellst Kalkulationen sowie Angebote und bringst technische Lösungen wirtschaftlich sauber auf den Punkt; Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen gehören ebenfalls zu deinem Aufgabengebiet. Du verhandelst eigenverantwortlich Verträge, führst Preis- und Vertragsverhandlungen und schließt Verträge mit Neu- und Bestandskunden ab. Du begleitest Projekte und Großaufträge, koordinierst interne Schnittstellen (Technik, Betrieb, Logistik) und stellst eine reibungslose Umsetzung sicher. Du pflegst Kundendaten und Dokumentationen und stellst sicher, dass alle abfall- und wasserrechtlichen Vorschriften sowie Qualitätsrichtlinien eingehalten werden. Du beobachtest den Markt, erkennst Trends im Bereich Industriewasser und Kreislaufwirtschaft und repräsentierst das Unternehmen auf Fachmessen. Qualifikation Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in der Abfall-/Wasserwirtschaft, Verfahrenstechnik, Umwelttechnik, Chemie beziehungsweise eine vergleichbare kaufmännische oder technische Qualifikation. Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Entsorgungs-, Umwelt- oder wassertechnischen Dienstleistungen sowie in der Projektbegleitung; idealerweise auch Erfahrung in der Wasser- und Abwassertechnik oder der industriellen Prozesswasserbehandlung. Fundiertes Verständnis der Abfallwirtschaft, Kreislaufwirtschaft sowie grundlegender wasserwirtschaftlicher Prozesse; Fähigkeit, Stoffströme und Prozesszusammenhänge zu bewerten. Ausgeprägtes Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs- und Präsentationsgeschick. Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Teamfähigkeit und sicherer Umgang mit MS-Office-Anwendungen. Erfahrung mit der Bestimmung der Trockensubstanzkonzentration (CTS) und Umgang mit entsprechenden Analyseverfahren ist ein Plus. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und umgangssprachliche Englischkenntnisse. Führerschein der Klasse B und Reisebereitschaft. Benefits Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einer nachhaltigen Zukunftsbranche mit langfristiger Perspektive. Transparente Vergütung mit erfolgsabhängiger Leistungsvergütung, Spesen und Corporate Benefits. Dienstwagen zur privaten Nutzung inklusive Tankkarte. Flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit Home‑Office‑Möglichkeit und familienfreundlichen Arbeitszeiten. Intensive Einarbeitung und kontinuierliche Weiterbildungs‑ und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Flache Hierarchien, ein motiviertes Team und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe. Fragen zur Position und zum Unternehmen beantwortet dir gerne Felix Wilhelm telefonisch oder per WhatsApp unter 0176 954 220 94. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Gehaltsvorstellung, möglicher Eintrittstermin). Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Complaints Specialist
description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. About the team 👋 Hey, I'm James Tiltman , and I lead the Customer Escalations team here at Motorway. We're the team that tackles the trickiest customer journeys, keeps sales on track, and makes sure customers still love Motorway. We're key to spotting areas where we can improve, and we work closely with other teams to make the customer experience even better. If you're passionate about solving problems and making a real difference for our customers, you'll fit right in. About the role We're looking for a brilliant Customer Escalations Specialist to join our growing team. You'll be right there on the front line, resolving complex customer issues, giving amazing support, and helping us improve what we do. Here’s what you’ll be doing: Dealing with complex escalations and working with stakeholders to find customer-focused solutions. Handling internal escalations, formal complaints, and customer welfare concerns. Responding to reviews on platforms like Trustpilot, Google Reviews, and the app store. Resolving business-critical issues, including those escalated to the C-suite. Using compensation to help with service recovery. Managing GDPR requests and keeping an eye on compliance across operational teams. Supporting the generation of Voice of the Customer insights, which help improve operations and processes across Motorway. Helping different departments spot and prevent fraud, security breaches, and legal claims. About you You've got experience in a customer-facing role, including handling tough conversations. You're investigative, detail-oriented, and analytical. You're passionate about customer care and turning bad experiences into good ones. You're great at risk assessment, prioritisation, and managing your workload. You're adaptable and happy to contribute to a fast-paced environment. You're a whiz at verbal and written communication. You could be a great fit if You love taking ownership of complex issues and finding creative solutions. You're resilient and can stay calm under pressure. You're a strong communicator and can build rapport with customers and stakeholders. You're passionate about continuous improvement and making a positive impact. What you'll get Great work-life balance with standard shifts from 8:45am to 5:30pm Sea fronted office location with regular social events, office drinks, weekly massages and free snacks to keep you going Flexibility to work from home 1 day per week Stock options so you can share in Motorway’s growth and future success Pension scheme to plan for your future with our provider NEST Strong commitment to your personal development Opt-in comprehensive health insurance through BUPA including fitness discounts Cycle to work scheme Generous parental benefits including 6 months full paid maternity leave, 4 weeks paternity leave ... and much more! Deine Aufgaben Eigenständige Steuerung und Begleitung von Schadensfällen, insbesondere in der Gebäudeversicherung Koordination aller Beteiligten: Eigentümergemeinschaften, Verwalter, Versicherer und Sachverständige Beratung von Eigentümergemeinschaften in Versicherungs- und Schadenfragen Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung effizienter Prozesse im Schadenmanagement Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Insurance, WEG-Verwaltung und Property Management und Input zur Verbesserung unserer Prozesse und Software Das bringst du mit Berufserfahrung: mindestens 5 Jahre als Versicherungsmakler Ausbildung: eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Kaufmann / Kauffrau für Versicherungen und Finanzen Fundierte Erfahrung im Schadenmanagement Bereitschaft und Eignung, langfristig ein Team zu führen Bonus: Erfahrung im Startup- oder Insurtech-Umfeld Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, hohe Verbindlichkeit und Eigenverantwortung Starkes Kommunikationsvermögen & Offenheit für neue Herausforderungen und digitale Tools Deutsch: C2 & Englisch: B2 Das bieten wir Modernes Setup: MacBook, iPhone und moderne Tools von Tag eins Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten ohne Mikromanagement Hybrides Arbeiten mit klar geregelten Bürotagen (2 Tage im Büro) Urban Sports Club Zuschuss Regelmäßige Team-Events, Team-Lunches und Getränke im Büro Bewerbungsprozess Intro Call (ca. 30 Min.) mit Recruiting Fachgespräch (ca. 30 Min.) description: Ben jij een Manager of Senior Manager met een focus op Commercial Excellence en ben jij klaar voor de volgende stap? Ben je op zoek naar een club waar ondernemerschap en groei centraal staan? Mis je de ruimte om echt impact te maken in je huidige rol? Spreekt groei en het meewerken aan innovatieve ontwikkelingen je aan? Dan is dit dé vacature voor jou! Met meer dan 900 getalenteerde collega's die echt verandering en uitdagingen omarmen, hebben we een unieke "high-daring", "high-caring" cultuur gecreëerd, die buitengewone mensen aantrekt en hen inspireert om de grenzen voor zichzelf en onze klanten te verleggen. Wij geloven dat de optimale werkomgeving gelijkwaardig is en stellen duidelijke doelen om gendergelijkheid te versnellen. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Manager Retail & Products ben je dé gesprekspartner voor bestuurders in de retail, FMCG, (maak)industrie, logistiek en groothandel die hun commerciële organisatie naar een hoger niveau willen tillen: meer groei uit dezelfde markt, de juiste prijs per klant, kanaal en moment, en een salesorganisatie die structureel wint. Van uiteenlopende projecten gefocust op het aangescherpen van groeistrategieën tot Smart Pricing & Revenue Management en Sales Excellence met de bijbehorende capabilities: jij zet de koers uit en zorgt dat die landt. Daarvoor werk je met multidisciplinaire teams uit strategieconsulting, data & AI, technologie en organisatorische en digitale transformatie. Zo combineer je scherpe commerciële analyses met de data, tools en verandering die nodig zijn om de groei ook echt te realiseren. Als senior manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor grote klanttrajecten en een vertrouwde sparringpartner op C-level. Je bouwt accounts uit, ziet de volgende vraag van de klant al aankomen en zet die om in nieuwe opdrachten. Daarbij krijg je alle vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid, zowel voor het project als voor de accountontwikkeling. Daarnaast bouw je mee aan het Retail & Products-team zelf: je ontwikkelt onze Commercial Excellence-proposities, helpt collega’s groeien en bent een drijvende kracht achter onze verdere gezamenlijke groei. Wat betekent dit voor jou? Je komt te werken bij een Great Place to Work met zeer tevreden medewerkers en klanten (NPS > 65; ruim boven het marktgemiddelde). Bovendien realiseren we groei met dubbele cijfers en hebben we onze blik stevig gericht op verdere uitbreiding. We zitten met onze eigen succesvolle transformatie midden in een spannend avontuur! Waarom zou je er geen deel van uitmaken? Wat zeggen je toekomstige collega's? “ IG&H is echt anders dan andere strategieconsultants. Wij hebben een warme benadering en een zorgzame cultuur. Wat we jou bieden: · Werken bij een Great Place to Work met een prettige werksfeer en enthousiaste collega's die je ondersteunen. · Een mooie kans om een actieve bijdrage te leveren aan de verdere groei van de organisatie. · Direct een vast contract voor onbepaalde tijd. · Uitstekend salaris en arbeidsvoorwaarden. · Auto van de zaak / goede mobiliteitsregeling. · Een fulltime dienstverband, maar indien gewenst ook de mogelijkheid om (al dan niet tijdelijk) parttime te werken (80%), minimaal 4 dagen per week. · Wij ondersteunen incidenteel werken in het buitenland voor maximaal 4 weken per jaar. · 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er meer op te nemen. · De mogelijkheid om na 3 jaar dienstverband een sabbatical op te nemen. · IG&H faciliteert een Healthy Human-programma, waarbij je begeleiding krijgt bij alle aanpassingen in het leven, zoals het krijgen van een kind of het verzorgen van een ziek familielid. · Royale bonusregeling. · En nog veel meer, waar we je graag meer over vertellen. Waarom IG&H? IG&H helpt toonaangevende bedrijven in de sectoren Gezondheid, Retail & Products en Financial Services te transformeren. Samen met onze technologiepartners van wereldklasse helpen we onze klanten vooruit en blijven we relevant. Met inzichtelijk advies, mooie designs en ongeëvenaarde digitale platforms. Onze uitzonderlijke resultaten komen voort uit het succesvol op elkaar afstemmen van mensen, bedrijfsprocessen en technologie. Met meer dan 900 getalenteerde collega's in de verschillende teams, die verandering en uitdagingen oprecht omarmen, hebben we een unieke, zeer gedurfde en zorgzame cultuur gecreëerd. We trekken bijzondere mensen aan en inspireren hen om de grenzen te verleggen voor zichzelf en onze klanten. Ben je enthousiast? Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een baan, ongeacht hun afkomst, religie, geslacht, genderexpressie, seksuele geaardheid, handicap of leeftijd. We geven om individualiteit! Maar het allerbelangrijkste is dat we allemaal trots zijn op onze prestaties bij onze klanten en daarom zijn we niet voor niets een Great Place to Work . Acquisitie op basis van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Wij werken met preferred suppliers. Stuur ons alstublieft geen ongevraagde cv's.
