title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (OptiArray)
description: Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines. The Role As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiArray system. Your primary objective is to develop robust, structural, easy to manufacture solutions that ensure the array can be easily manufactured, deployed, and operated throughout their intended service life. You translate allocated product and system requirements into engineering solutions that provide structural integrity, mechanical robustness, corrosion resistance, manufacturability, and reliable offshore deployment. You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, offshore contractors, and specialized suppliers to ensure the array is successfully developed and realized as part of the overall product. Responsibilities Develop and realize the OptiArray subsystems throughout the product development lifecycle. Translate allocated product and system requirements into robust, easy to manufacture structural solutions for offshore deployment and long-term subsea operation. Integrate subsystem assemblies / design into a functioning, robust product. Adapt structural designs to accommodate varying sea conditions and deployment environments while maintaining product integrity and standardization where possible. Produce subsystem specifications, engineering drawings, interface documentation, calculations, and design records. Improve subsystem robustness, manufacturability, maintainability, and lifecycle performance throughout development. Develop prototypes and engineering models to evaluate structural performance and manufacturability. Perform engineering analyses and testing to evaluate structural integrity, lifting loads, fatigue performance, hydrodynamic behaviour, and environmental robustness. Join design reviews, DFMEA sessions of submodules. Give input to improve overall system performance / to meet system requirements. Support Verification & Validation by providing technical expertise during structural verification and qualification activities. Support fabrication suppliers and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) activities by providing technical expertise and assessing structural assemblies against engineering specifications. Share engineering knowledge, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen team capability and improve future engineering execution. Provide constructive feedback and support peers in solving technical challenges. Contribute to a collaborative and knowledge-sharing engineering culture. What we offer Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech scale-ups. Real impact: your work directly shapes our growth and success. A great team in an international organization with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities. A competitive salary and benefits package. 30 days of holiday per year. Fresh team lunches five times a week, plus regular team activities and company events. Requirements BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience developing mechanical systems that are used in harsh environments. Hands on design experience for systems / products that requires qualification against military (environmental) standards. Proficiency in working with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD systems to develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies, engineering drawings, and technical documentation. Experience designing marine products or subsea mechanical systems. Experience performing structural calculations, load analysis, fatigue assessment, and mechanical interface design. Experience working with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing partners. Experience working within multidisciplinary product development teams. Strong analytical and structured engineering problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance. Preferred Experience with corrosion protection, cathodic protection, offshore coatings, or subsea structural design. Hands-on experience with SolidWorks for mechanical design, assembly modelling, and detailed production drawings. Experience taking ownership of a system or significant technical workstream within multidisciplinary engineering projects. Familiarity with systems engineering, product lifecycle management, verification, and configuration management. Screening You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. title: Senior Structural Analysis Engineer
description: About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team! We are looking for a Structural Analysis Engineer in Toulouse. About the role: As a Structural Analysis Engineer, you will be a key technical contributor within Pangea Propulsion’s Structural Analysis team, operating with autonomy on thermomechanical, dynamic, and nonlinear structural problems. You will own analysis campaigns end-to-end: from problem framing, modelling, validation, to results interpretation and design recommendations - directly influencing the architecture, performance, and robustness of the next generation of propulsion systems. Within the team, you will serve as a technical reference point for advanced structural analysis methods , help shape internal best practices, and elevate the quality of analyses across projects. A core part of your role will be coaching and guiding junior and consolidated analysts, transferring knowledge, reviewing technical work, and contributing to a high-performance engineering culture. In this position, you will also take ownership of complex structural analysis problems and contribute to defining modelling strategies and analysis standards for the team. Familiarity with rocket propulsion hardware - or strong motivation to learn - will allow you to make an immediate impact. Key responsibilities · Perform and lead FEA campaigns including static, modal, thermo-mechanical, dynamic and transient analyses, dealing efficiently with non-linear problems (contacts, plasticity, large deformation etc.) · Plan, build, verify, document and maintain high-fidelity and robust FE models with traceability to loads, material properties, requirements, and assumptions. · Provide clear, high-impact design feedback to mechanical design and propulsion teams at both part and subsystem level. · Develop and improve analysis methodologies, scripts, subroutines, benchmarks, and guidelines. · Lead cross disciplinary interactions with mechanical design, fluidic analysis, and test teams to ensure coherent modelling strategies and proper load mapping. · Participate in design reviews, presenting methods, assumptions, results, and recommendations with clarity, conciseness and technical rigor. · Mentor junior and consolidated engineers, helping them develop modelling skills, physics intuition, validation strategies, and efficient workflows. · Review and challenge analysis approaches to ensure modelling robustness and consistency across projects. What you need to be successful · Experience in the aviation or space industry is strongly preferred. · Master’s degree (or higher) in Aerospace, Mechanical, or related engineering disciplines. · Minimum 5+ years of professional experience performing advanced structural analyses using commercial FEA tools (preferably Abaqus). · Proven ability to run non-linear, thermo-mechanical, and dynamic analyses with a high level of autonomy and technical ownership. · Strong understanding of structural mechanics, vibrations, fatigue, fracture, material behavior, and numerical methods. · Demonstrated experience framing analysis problems, defining assumptions, and ensuring consistency with loads and system requirements. · Ability to interpret results critically, identify anomalies, and propose sound engineering solutions. · Excellent communication skills—able to articulate assumptions, limitations, and design implications clearly to multidisciplinary teams. · Proactive mindset, ownership attitude, and passion for sharing knowledge and elevating team capability. · Fluent English. Other useful skills · Experience in any of the following topics: fatigue (high cycle and low cycle), fracture mechanics, rotodynamics, test-correlation, topology optimization or probabilistic structural methods. · Knowledge of rocket propulsion systems: injector heads, thrust chambers, turbomachinery, feed systems, thermal & dynamic environments, etc. · Proficiency with meshing tools (e.g., MeshWorks) and scripting languages (Python, MATLAB). · Experience writing Abaqus subroutines (UMAT, USDFLD, UEL, etc.). · Experience working with ECSS, AIAA and other aerospace structural verification standards. Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Aerospace, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization. More about us… We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values: Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals. Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions. Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement. Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values. Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals. If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you! Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Junior Product Manager:in
description: Über Valova Wir bauen die KI-Betriebsplattform für Europas Krankenhäuser, damit sich jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt auf die Patienten konzentrieren kann. Hinter jedem Fall steht eine Kette administrativer Aufgaben: Dokumentation, Kodierung, Abrechnung, Prüfungen, Planung. Sie läuft über getrennte Systeme und unzählige manuelle Übergaben, während die meisten deutschen Kliniken bereits rote Zahlen schreiben. Wir starten dort, wo der Effekt ab Tag eins messbar ist: vom Fall bis zum Geldeingang. Valova kodiert jeden Fall, verteidigt ihn in der Prüfung und sorgt dafür, dass das Geld ankommt. Von dort übernehmen wir jeden Workflow eines Krankenhauses, bis ein agentisches System die Routine erledigt und Menschen über Ausnahmen entscheiden. Erst Deutschland, dann Europa. Ein Team aus Ärzt:innen, Engineers, Strategieberater:innen und Start-up-Profis. Vor Ort in München und Berlin. Wir freuen uns auf dich! Warum diese Rolle wichtig ist Mit Valova kodieren Kliniken ihre Fälle schon heute deutlich schneller. Und das ist erst der Anfang: Wir bauen Valova Schritt für Schritt über die Kodierung hinaus aus, und jede Erweiterung muss im Klinikalltag funktionieren, nicht nur in der Demo. Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel. Du findest heraus, wo Kodierteams Zeit und Erlöse verlieren, entscheidest mit, was wir als Nächstes bauen, und bringst es mit unserem Engineeringteam live. Du bist die Brücke zwischen Klinik und Code und zwischen unserem Team und den Menschen, die täglich mit Valova arbeiten. Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in weniger Minuten pro Fall und in mehr Fällen, die Valova ohne Korrektur abrechnet. Deine Rolle im Team Du berichtest direkt an Malte, unseren Produkt Lead, und arbeitest täglich mit unseren Engineers zusammen. Fachlich arbeitest Du eng mit unseren Kodier- und Abrechnungsexpert:innen: Sie kennen die Regeln, Du machst daraus Produkt. In Klinikprojekten arbeitest Du Hand in Hand mit unserem Vertrieb und Customer Success und auf Klinikseite mit Medizincontrolling, Kodierfachkräften und Ärzt:innen. Deine Aufgaben Einen Produktbereich verantworten: Du übernimmst einen eigenen Bereich unseres Produkts, von der ersten Anforderung bis zum Einsatz in der Klinik. Vor Ort beobachten: Du bist regelmäßig in Kliniken, schaust Kodierteams und Medizincontrolling über die Schulter und findest heraus, wo Zeit und Erlöse verloren gehen. Anforderungen schreiben: Du übersetzt Deine Erkenntnisse in klare User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien und klärst offene Fragen, bevor sie die Entwicklung aufhalten. Regeln ins Produkt bringen: Mit unseren Fachexpert:innen sorgst Du dafür, dass Kodier- und Abrechnungsregeln richtig im Produkt ankommen. Unsere KI besser machen: Du arbeitest mit Engineering an Evaluationen und prüfst, ob die Vorschläge von Valova mit jedem Release besser werden. Releases begleiten: Du testest neue Versionen und begleitest mit Customer Success den Start in neuen Kliniken. Mit Daten arbeiten: Du verfolgst, wie Valova genutzt wird und wirkt, und leitest daraus ab, was wir als Nächstes bauen. Was Du mitbringst Medizinischer Hintergrund: Idealerweise ein Medizinstudium, eine Ausbildung in einem Gesundheitsfachberuf oder Erfahrung im Medizincontrolling. Du weißt, wie ein Fall durchs Krankenhaus läuft. Erste Produkterfahrung: Ein bis zwei Jahre im Produktmanagement, in einem Health-Tech-Startup oder in der Beratung. Du hast schon einmal ein Feature oder Projekt von der Idee bis zum Ergebnis verantwortet. Technisches Verständnis: Du musst nicht programmieren, kannst aber technische Dokumentation lesen und mit Engineers über Lösungen diskutieren. Präzises Denken: Du hinterfragst gern Prozesse und beschreibst Regeln so genau, dass Software sie umsetzen kann. Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist im Gespräch mit Ärzt:innen, Medizincontrolling und Technik gleichermaßen sicher. Reisebereitschaft: Du bist gern rund 20 bis 30 Prozent Deiner Zeit in Kliniken unterwegs. Sprachen: Du sprichst Deutsch fließend auf C1-Niveau und gutes Englisch. Ein Plus: Kenntnisse in Kodierung oder Abrechnung (z. B. DRG, OPS, GOÄ), Erfahrung mit KIS-Software (z. B. Orbis, SAP IS-H, i.s.h.med) oder Tools wie Jira und Figma sowie erste Erfahrung mit Datenanalyse (Excel, SQL) oder KI-Anwendungen. Dir fehlen ein oder zwei Punkte, aber Du bist überzeugt, die richtige Person für diese Rolle zu sein? Dann bewirb Dich trotzdem. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Was wir Dir bieten Ownership ab der ersten Woche. Du übernimmst echte Projekte mit klarem Ergebnis und deinem Namen darauf, keine Aufgabenliste, die sich jemand anderes ausgedacht hat. Direkter Draht zu den Gründern. Du arbeitest täglich mit Sophia, Ärztin und ehemalige McKinsey-Beraterin und Christian, der zwei Health-Tech-Startups gegründet und ein Jahrzehnt lang klinische Systeme gebaut hat. Keine Hierarchieebenen, kein wochenlanges Warten auf Freigaben. Lernen im Startup-Tempo. Du erlebst hier in einem Jahr mehr als anderswo in drei. Ein Team, mitten in der Stadt. Ein motiviertes Team. , mit Ärztinnen und Ärzten, Engineers und Operators, die sich hohe Ziele setzen und sich gegenseitig dabei unterstützen, sie zu erreichen. Team-Events, die München und Berlin zusammenbringen, denn die Menschen, mit denen du baust, sollten auch die sein, mit denen du feierst. Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, das deinen Impact widerspiegelt. title: Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing - alternance
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Lorsque l'on vous dit Deliveroo, vous imaginez sans doute d'abord les bons petits plats livrés chez vous en moins d'une demi-heure. Plutôt sympa non ? Mais c'est en coulisses que l'histoire est la plus intéressante. Nous opérons désormais à travers le monde et travaillons avec plus de 176 000 restaurants partenaires et commerces en tous genres en France. Nous collaborons avec des milliers de livreurs et de livreuses partenaires pour le plus grand bonheur de nos millions de personnes clientes. Aux côtés de l'équipe Merchant, vous contribuerez au développement de la croissance de nos partenaires, au déploiement de nos campagnes nationales 360° et en accompagnerez des projets à fort impact sur l'acquisition, la rétention et la fidélisation de nos restaurants partenaires. Descriptif du poste : En tant qu'Apprenti(e) dans l'équipe Marketing Merchant Restaurant, vous travaillerez au quotidien avec l'équipe marketing chargée de mettre en avant toute la sélection de restaurants et de partenaires de Deliveroo. Vous serez également amené(e) à interagir régulièrement avec les autres départements marketing tels que l'équipe média, l'équipe créative, le CRM ainsi qu'avec l' équipe commerciale. Vos missions consisteront à: Mettre en avant sur l'application les restaurants et partenaires disponibles sur l'app. Soutenir l'équipe commerciale dans la création et l'exécution de plans marketing destinés à mettre en avant les partenaires présents sur Deliveroo. Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe commerciale et les équipes marketing transversales (marque, réseaux sociaux, CRM et influenceurs) pour développer et exécuter des plans partenaires basés sur les priorités commerciales (par exemple, objectifs régionaux, accords d'exclusivité, renégociations). Préparer des présentations et des supports pour appuyer les discussions de l'équipe commerciale avec les partenaires, en veillant à l'alignement et à la clarté. Contribuer à l'exécution des points forts des partenaires en collaboration avec le CRM et le Commercial (communications mensuelles d'exclusivité / bannières dédiées sur l'application / notifications push...). Gérer le budget alloué pour le plan de chaque partenaire, en optimisant les ressources locales pour obtenir un impact maximal. Analyser l'impact de nos campagnes pour en tirer des recommandations pour les équipes commerciales Cette alternance vous permettra d'appréhender de nombreux sujets marketing (création de campagne, analyse, sensibilité client) et vous permettra d'acquérir une bonne connaissance des enjeux marketing et de la gestion de projets complexes grâce à la collaboration transverse que vous aurez avec les autres pôles. Ce qui vous permettra de réussir Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de commerce, université ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en marketing, communication ou digital et recherchez une alternance d'une durée d'un an à partir de Décembre 2026 / Janvier 2027. Vous Vous Reconnaissez Dans Les Points Suivants Vous êtes organisé·e, rigoureux·se et savez gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle en respectant les délais Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale en français ainsi qu'un bon niveau d'anglais. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres et aimez analyser les performances pour en tirer des recommandations. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de nombreux interlocuteurs. Vous êtes curieux·se, proactif·ve et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance. Voici un lien avec de la documentation pour vous préparer aux entretiens. Nous offrons un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant, où vous aurez l'opportunité de développer vos compétences et de contribuer activement à notre mission. Rejoignez notre équipe exceptionnelle dès maintenant et faites partie de cette aventure passionnante ! La vie chez Deliveroo : Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix. Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel. À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l'article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité professionnelle, l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. title: (Senior) B2G Manager: Public Sector & Research Funding (f/m/d)
description: “This is not your typical B2G role.” B2G sounds boring, until you realise it's money from the state and you own it. You'll be responsible for a big share of RIZM's funding sources, with real influence on RIZM's cash flow and on how fast we grow. You'll be tapping into new sources that most companies never even look at. Why this role exists RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're looking for someone to own B2G as a business line at RIZM, from public funding all the way to municipalities as paying customers. What you'll own Public funding as a growth channel. Forschungszulage (Germany's R&D tax allowance), EU grants, ERDF (EFRE) and other programmes: build the pipeline, actively own and track our running programmes, forge consortia and get applications approved. Connect research. Coordinate our research collaboration with Stanford and translate it into funded projects. Build the machine, AI-first. Set up your own systems, tracking and automation, so one person can run a funding pipeline that usually takes a whole team. You decide how the role works behind the scenes. Take over and scale ReNET-EV. Own our part of the ERDF project ReNET-EV (grid-friendly energy supply for business parks in the Münster/NRW region) and roll the model out to more municipalities. Turn municipalities into customers. Win cities, municipal utilities and economic development agencies that use RIZM for heat planning, climate strategy and business park development. Set up offers and procurement routes for the public sector. Orchestrate the ecosystem. Bring chambers of commerce (IHKs), economic development agencies, utilities and industry partners together in joint projects. Build the data foundation. Tap into public and municipal data that makes our models more precise at regional level. Create visibility. References with municipalities and mayors that show publicly what's happening in their region. Leadership. Over time, build a small B2G team, including working students. You're a fit if you Have several years of experience in the public sector, politics, municipal utilities, economic development agencies, associations or funding management. Have successfully won funding (EU, federal, state) or led consortia. Know how municipalities make decisions and buy, and have a strong network in NRW or beyond. Understand energy transition topics such as municipal heat planning, grid congestion and flexibility. Think like an entrepreneur and see public funding as a path to a business case. Are curious about AI and enjoy building your own tools and workflows. Speak business-fluent German and bring good English for EU programmes. What we offer A business line you build from scratch, with a direct line to the management team. Real financial leverage: what you win shows up directly in RIZM's cash flow. A product already running at industrial customers like BMW and BSH. Salary plus equity. How to apply No cover letter needed. We'd rather hear how you think. Two questions, a few honest sentences each: A mayor gives you 5 minutes in an elevator. What do you tell them about RIZM? What's the most absurd hurdle you've hit in public funding or procurement, and how did you get around it? Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

AI-native arbeiten AI ist bei uns das Werkzeug, mit dem wir Analytics bauen. Wir arbeiten täglich mit AI-Tools wie Claude und Claude Code, direkt auf unserem Snowflake Data Warehouse. Du nutzt AI, um Daten zu explorieren und zu analysieren sowie für die Automatisierung von wiederkehrenden Tasks. Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, auch die zugrunde liegenden Abfragen, bevor sie in eine Entscheidung gehen, und befähigst andere Teams, selbst mit Daten und AI zu arbeiten. DAS BRINGST DU MIT 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung in FP&A, Controlling, Corporate Finance, Beratung oder Investment Banking, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen. Ein sehr gutes Studium in Wirtschaft, Finance, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach. Sehr gute Modellierungsskills in Excel und Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Tableau. Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Tools für Analytics, z.B. Claude Code, Claude oder vergleichbaren Tools. Zeig uns, was du damit gebaut hast. Tempo und Ownership: Du wartest nicht auf Aufträge, siehst die nächste Frage, bevor sie gestellt wird, und bringst Dinge zu Ende. Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Zahlen, Operations und Go-to-Market zusammenhängen. Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Ein Plus: Erfahrung in einem Startup oder Scale-up und ein Hintergrund in Food, Retail, Logistik oder einem anderen operativ geprägten Geschäftsmodell sowie Erfahrung mit einem Data Warehouse (z. B. Snowflake), SQL oder einem Semantic Layer. Noch Fragen? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Echte Wirkung: Deine Analysen fließen direkt in Entscheidungen von Geschäftsführung und Fachbereichen. Kurze Wege und enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern. Einen modernen Stack (Snowflake, Tableau, NetSuite, AI-Tools) und den Freiraum, ihn weiterzuentwickeln. Ein Team, das gerade neu aufstellt, wie FP&A mit AI und Semantic Layer arbeitet, und dich dabei mitgestalten lässt. Ein Unternehmen, das Hardware, Food und Software verbindet, mit Büro in München. UNSERE BENEFITS Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Flexibilität: Teile dir selbst deine Arbeitszeiten ein - bei uns im Office, zu Hause oder remote aus dem EU Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! ÜBER UNS Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. title: Rust Software Engineer - Rust / C++ (m/f/d)
description: Quantum Systems develops autonomous, multi-domain systems that operate in the air, on the ground and on the water. Behind every platform is software that has to work reliably in the real world, with limited resources, unreliable connectivity and no second chances. We are looking for software engineers who like to build exactly that kind of software in Rust and C++. You will join our engineering organization and work on production code that runs on real vehicles and sensors, across a broad range of challenges from low-level systems to scalable services. What is your Day to Day Mission: Build and maintain production-grade software in Rust and C++ for autonomous platforms and the systems around them. Design performant, fault-tolerant components that run on embedded Linux, edge hardware and in the cloud. Develop communication layers, data pipelines and real-time processing for sensor-driven, distributed systems. Work with hardware and robotics engineers to get software from simulation and test benches onto real vehicles. Use AI agents as part of your daily engineering workflow: break down problems, run several agents in parallel, review their output critically and make sure it meets our quality and safety standards. Own your code end to end: design, review, testing, deployment and troubleshooting of systems in the field. Shape architecture decisions and help raise engineering standards in a growing team. A strong foundation in systems programming: concurrency, memory and resource management, networking and performance tuning. The ability to understand a complex system and its domain quickly, and to translate that understanding into clear architecture and well-scoped tasks. Hands-on experience working with AI coding agents, or the curiosity and drive to build that skill fast, including the judgment to verify and correct what they produce. Day-to-day experience with Linux as a development and target environment. Experience with distributed, real-time or performance-critical systems. A solid testing mindset, from unit tests to hardware-in-the-loop or simulation. Clear communication and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving, interdisciplinary environment. Nice to have Experience with robotics, autonomy or sensor integration. Experience setting up agent-based workflows, such as parallel agents, automated test and review loops or custom tooling around coding agents. Embedded or real-time experience (RTOS, bare metal, firmware). Familiarity with ROS 2 or simulation frameworks. Knowledge of communication protocols and low-latency data transport. Experience with containers, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. title: Senior Specialist (m/w/d) EDI / B2B Integration
description: Wie lassen sich komplexe Geschäftsprozesse über Unternehmensgrenzen hinweg zuverlässig, automatisiert und effizient digital abbilden? Als Senior Specialist (m/w/d) EDI / B2B Integration übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung einer modernen B2B-Integrationsplattform. Sie gestalten digitale Schnittstellen, entwickeln EDI- und API-Integrationen, optimieren Datenflüsse und sorgen dafür, dass Geschäftspartner weltweit zuverlässig miteinander kommunizieren können. Dabei verbinden Sie IT, Logistik und Supply Chain und tragen dazu bei, eine zukunftsfähige Integrationsarchitektur weiter auszubauen. Ihre Mission Sie gestalten und entwickeln unsere B2B-Integrationsplattform für die Anbindung nationaler und internationaler Geschäftspartner weiter. Sie konzipieren und implementieren Datenintegrationen, EDI-Schnittstellen und API-basierte Integrationen. Sie analysieren Anforderungen aus Logistik-, Transport- und Supply-Chain-Prozessen und übersetzen diese in technische Integrationslösungen. Sie entwickeln, optimieren und betreiben Mappings, Schnittstellen und Datenflüsse. Sie übernehmen das Partner-Onboarding und stellen eine zuverlässige technische Anbindung neuer B2B-Partner sicher. Sie analysieren und beheben komplexe Störungen im 3rd-Level-Support und gewährleisten einen stabilen elektronischen Datenaustausch. Sie überwachen und optimieren bestehende EDI-Integrationen und B2B-Schnittstellen. Sie arbeiten eng mit internen Fachbereichen, IT-Teams sowie externen Business- und Integrationspartnern zusammen. Sie dokumentieren Integrationsprozesse, technische Lösungen und Best Practices und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter. Ihre technische Basis Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich EDI, B2B Integration, Schnittstellenmanagement oder Datenintegration. Sie haben ein gutes Verständnis für Integrationsarchitekturen, Datenflüsse und digitale Schnittstellen. Sie bringen praktische Erfahrung mit EDI-Standards wie EDIFACT und ANSI X12 mit. Sie verfügen über Kenntnisse in XML und JSON und haben idealerweise Erfahrung mit API-Integration bzw. REST APIs. Sie haben Erfahrung mit Mapping-Tools bzw. EDI-/Integrationsplattformen, idealerweise mit der Lobster Data Platform oder einer vergleichbaren Lösung. Sie verstehen komplexe Logistik- und Supply-Chain-Prozesse oder bringen die Bereitschaft mit, sich intensiv in diese einzuarbeiten. Sie arbeiten analytisch, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und behalten auch bei komplexen Integrationsprozessen den Überblick. Sie kommunizieren sicher mit Fachbereichen, IT, Kunden und externen B2B-Partnern. Gute Englischkenntnisse und sichere Deutschkenntnisse (C1 Niveau). Was Sie erwartet Technischer Impact: Arbeiten Sie an geschäftskritischen Systemen, die weltweit eingesetzt werden, und gestalten Sie Engineering-Standards und technologische Entwicklungen aktiv mit. Moderne Technologien: Java, Spring, Kafka, Kubernetes, Cloud-native Development, moderne APIs, verteilte Systeme sowie KI-gestützte und agentenbasierte Entwicklung. Gestaltungsspielraum: Bringen Sie eigene Ideen ein, initiieren Sie Verbesserungen und gestalten Sie die technologische Zukunft aktiv mit. Entwicklung & Austausch: Profitieren Sie von strukturiertem Onboarding, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und einem großen Netzwerk erfahrener IT-Spezialist:innen. Flexibilität: 38,5-Stunden-Woche, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Gleitzeitkonto und mobiles Arbeiten. Sicherheit & Perspektive: Ein nachhaltig wachsendes, familiengeführtes Unternehmen mit langfristiger Perspektive in einer zukunftsrelevanten Branche. Weitere Vorteile: Gesundheitsangebote, Sport- und Fitnessprogramme, Corporate Benefits sowie die Möglichkeit eines Dienstfahrrads über Company Bike. Bereit, Softwareentwicklung neu zu denken? Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam herausfinden, ob diese Position zu Ihnen und Ihren nächsten beruflichen Zielen passt. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>This role owns Product and Engineering for Back of House, one of the most complex, multi-service domains on the Mews platform. Back of House covers the operational core that hotel teams rely on every day, and it needs someone who can set the product direction and run the engineering behind it, together. That combined mandate, product and engineering under one person at VP level, is rare, and the scale of hospitality technology right now makes it worth doing well.</p> <p>You'll own the full domain: strategy, roadmap, and the engineering org that builds it, working closely and collaboratively with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones, and reporting into senior leadership. This isn't a narrow platform mandate. It spans product and engineering together, with the scope to make real calls on both, and the trust to run it as one connected domain.</p> <p>Back of House software has to stay reliable at all times and keep improving, without ever pausing customer delivery to get there. The next phase of this role is about applying AI directly to the systems that support hotel teams, not just internal tooling, at a scale most engineering leaders never get to work at.</p> <p><strong>What You Would Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own product and engineering strategy for Back of House end to end, across a genuinely multi-service architecture.</li> <li>Run globally distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones, building the structures that let them ship together.</li> <li>Build out a management team and develop senior ICs, growing a culture that holds up at scale.</li> <li>Improve reliability, performance and technical debt as ongoing disciplines, without stopping delivery to do it.</li> <li>Decide where AI genuinely belongs in the Back of House product, and ship AI-driven improvements that change how hotel teams work day to day.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Fluency Level 4:</strong> in this role that means going beyond using AI to move faster yourself. something where AI was a core part of the product, not a feature added on afterwards.</p> <p><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to <a href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XQOskg">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a> on Confluence.</em></p> <p><strong>What You Would Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Combined Product and Engineering ownership at VP level, with clear, end-to-end ownership of a complex, multi-service product domain.</li> <li>A track record running globally distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones.</li> <li>Experience operating inside a scaling SaaS business, ideally Series C through pre-IPO or recently public, as an operator rather than an adviser.</li> <li>Effective people leadership: managing managers, developing senior ICs, and building healthy team cultures at scale, plus a track record of improving reliability, performance and technical debt without stopping delivery.</li> <li>AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on experience: you've shipped AI as a genuine part of a product, not just used it to speed up your own workflow.</li> </ul> title: Senior Account Executive - Healthcare PR
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.</p> <p>Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.</p></div><p></p> <p>Real Chemistry is looking for driven, savvy game changers who are ready to dive into the trenches and make an immediate impact. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: <a href="https://www.realchemistrybenefits.com">www.realchemistrybenefits.com</a>.</p> <p><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. title: Marketing Specialist Cybersecurity
description: Ben jij een creatieve marketing specialist met ervaring in de IT en toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging? Bij Nomios ontwikkel je samen met toonaangevende vendoren en partners campagnes die er echt toe doen, in de snelgroeiende wereld van cybersecurity. Bij Nomios werken we aan cybersecurity- en netwerkoplossingen voor organisaties in Nederland en ver daarbuiten. We groeien hard en zoeken een medior marketing specialist die ons team versterkt en onze zichtbaarheid vergroot. Je werkt veel samen met onze strategische vendoren, partners en de partner manager van Nomios. Samen bedenk je campagnes, rol je ze uit en laat je zien wat ze opleveren. Zo speel je een belangrijke rol in het aantrekken van nieuwe klanten en het versterken van ons partnerecosysteem. Kennis van cybersecurity is geen must; die bouw je bij ons snel op. Wat ga je doen? Als medior marketing specialist ga jij aan de slag met: Vendor- en partnermarketing Samen met onze strategische vendoren, partners en de partner manager van Nomios bedenk, ontwikkel en voer je gezamenlijke campagnes uit. Je beheert de marketingactiviteiten met onze vendoren op strategisch, tactisch en operationeel niveau, inclusief planning, marketingfondsen (MDF) en de bijbehorende administratie. Je rapporteert de resultaten van campagnes aan vendoren, partners en het managementteam en vertaalt die naar verbeteringen. Campagnes en performance marketing Je bedenkt en ontwikkelt digitale (ABM-)campagnes die onze doelgroep raken. Je beheert en optimaliseert onze Google Ads- en LinkedIn-campagnes. Content marketing Je bedenkt, creëert en publiceert artikelen, video's en andere content, samen met onze experts. Je optimaliseert bestaande content om vindbaarheid en relevantie te verbeteren. Social media Je werkt mee aan de langetermijnstrategie voor LinkedIn en nieuwe kanalen waar onze doelgroep te vinden is, met als doel meer awareness en groei van ons bereik. Event marketing Je bedenkt, organiseert en voert professionele evenementen uit samen met onze vendoren en partners, waar klanten graag naartoe komen. Marketing support Je ondersteunt het marketingteam bij digitale campagnes binnen de Nomios Groep en draagt bij aan de verbetering van onze website. Je werkt met tools zoals HubSpot, Canva, Craft CMS, Google Analytics en Google Ads. Wat breng je mee? Minimaal hbo werk- en denkniveau. 3 tot 5 jaar werkervaring in (digitale) B2B-marketing. Ervaring in de IT-branche is zeer wenselijk; ervaring in cybersecurity is een pré, geen must. Ervaring met vendor- of partnermarketing, bijvoorbeeld met gezamenlijke campagnes en marketingfondsen, is een pré. Je bouwt makkelijk relaties op met vendoren, partners en collega's. Je bent initiatiefrijk, creatief en resultaatgericht. Je werkt zelfstandig en nauwkeurig en houdt overzicht over meerdere campagnes tegelijk. Nederlands is je moedertaal en je beheerst het Engels uitstekend, in woord en geschrift. Hybride rol: bij voorkeur 3 dagen op kantoor in Zoeterwoude en 2 dagen thuis. Top, duidelijk. Vertel, waarom Nomios? Bij Nomios krijg je de vrijheid om je creativiteit en kennis toe te passen binnen een snelgroeiende internationale organisatie. Je werkt met grote, toonaangevende klanten en met de belangrijkste vendoren in cybersecurity en networking. Je zit niet in een uitvoerende rol aan de zijlijn: je bepaalt mee welke campagnes we draaien en ziet direct wat ze opleveren. En er is volop ruimte om te groeien in je rol. title: Backend Engineer - Payments Team
description: Join a fast-growing, listed company with a purpose! Fastned owns and operates a network of 400+ fast charging stations across 10 European countries, allowing electric vehicle drivers to charge their car with 100% green energy in just 15 minutes. Our goal is a European network of 1000 fast charging stations in prime locations, where all electric vehicles can charge with renewable energy from the sun and wind. We have recently been voted best charging network in the UK, France and the Netherlands. If you want to make a difference and work in an informal, international scale-up environment with future prospects, then read on! Your role Fastned aims to accelerate the transition towards sustainable mobility by giving fast charging to electric drivers. Part of that mission is making car charging as simple as charging your phone, and paying for it should be just as effortless. As a Backend Engineer in the Payments team, you will help make paying for a charge frictionless, secure and reliable. Drivers can pay through the Fastned app, by QR code or with a contactless card at the charger. The team owns Fastned’s payments domain end to end. That covers integrations with payment service providers and payment terminals. It also covers the services behind payment methods, wallets, pre-authorisation and session payments, billing, invoicing and dunning. The stakes are high: Fastned handles 23,000+ charging sessions a day, and every one of those payments goes through our systems. We’re now moving towards real-time payments, where each session is paid instantly instead of invoiced later. As we are growing and adding roaming features as a Mobility Service Provider, there are many scale relevant challenges to solve. We have no legacy systems. You’ll work with Kotlin 2.x, Java 21+, and Spring Boot 4 on most services, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, SQL (Postgres), Terraform, GitLab CI/CD and REST APIs to build scalable, fault-tolerant services that drivers and our Finance team rely on every day. We encourage responsible AI usage and provide tooling like Claude Code, Codex, Dust . You’ll work closely with the other product teams, alongside fellow Backend Engineers, Data, Design, an Engineering Manager and a Product Manager in a Scrum setup. This role suits an engineer who enjoys a complex domain, cares about getting the details right, and wants to grow by taking real ownership of business-critical systems. Your overall responsibilities include Designing, developing, testing and reviewing reusable, maintainable and scalable code Working AI-first: using AI-augmented engineering, agentic workflows and AI tooling as a natural part of how you design, build, test and review, with judgement for where AI is a multiplier and where humans stay in the loop; Taking ownership from discovery to post-production; Taking operational responsibility for what you build, including monitoring, alerting and incident analysis; Helping improve engineering methodologies and best practices Who we are looking for In order to be successful in this role, you bring a strong sense of ownership and a pragmatic, proactive mindset. You enjoy working in a collaborative scale-up environment where things can change quickly and where taking initiative matters. Additionally, you tick the following boxes: You have 3+ years of professional backend experience, with strong hands-on Kotlin and/or Java experience. You have previous experience in the payments domain. You have experience working in agile teams within an international, multicultural environment. You have experience building and operating microservices in production, using REST APIs, cloud platforms and relational databases. You are familiar with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka. You care about reliability, maintainability and the operational impact of the software you build. You spot opportunities and problems and pick them up yourself instead of waiting for a ticket. You use AI tooling as part of your engineering workflow, with sound engineering judgement. You are fluent in English and have an affinity with Fastned’s mission. Nice to have Experience in e-mobility, energy, charging infrastructure or another operationally complex domain. Join us in building a better future We work hard to change the world, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. We focus on work-life balance, provide genuine work flexibility, and have family-friendly policies in place. Electric mobility is new territory for you? Don’t worry! As part of your onboarding, you will participate in a series of exciting workshops where you will learn everything about our industry and fast-charging infrastructure. Our benefits package includes: Stock option plan - we believe in shared value creation. Pension plan (fully covered by Fastned). A training and development budget of €3,000 per year per employee, because development and training are important to us and our sector offers endless opportunities. In order to experience and enjoy the EV life, you get access to our fully electric vehicle fleet (all charging expenses covered), which is also for private use. 29 holidays. Additionally, we give you two mission days you can use to contribute to Fastned’s mission or to support a cause that is important to you. Going the extra mile for parents: We provide you with personalised coaching support before, during, and after parental leave, facilitated by Foundree. Understanding women's health is beneficial for all of us, fostering empathy, improving communication, and creating a more inclusive workplace. That's why we teamed up with Flouria, providing you with quick access to a broad range of women's health professionals. Daily lunches, snacks & drinks are provided at our office locations. Next to fun events year-round, we throw notorious Christmas parties and organise an amazing yearly trip abroad with all employees. Other perks include flexible working hours, full travel compensation and the working gear of your choice. Interested in making an impact? We would love to have a conversation with you! Apply now, send us your CV and explain in your motivation letter why you’re excited about joining Fastned. Here’s the next steps of the hiring process: Screening call with Recruiter Codility assignment and technical interview with our Engineers Culture-fit conversation with the team Closing Coffee Chat with our Head of Engineering / Director of Product & Engineering Then, it’s time to welcome you on board to Fastned! Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, religions, neurodiversity, disabilities, parental status or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique. If you have questions or need further information regarding your application, please contact our recruitment team via fastned.nl Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Development Representative | Veiligheidssoftware
description: Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden. Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Er komen meer leads binnen dan we nu kunnen opvolgen. Daarom zoeken we een Sales Development Representative die het eerste gesprek opent. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT Jij bent de eerste stem die potentiële klanten van Toxic horen. Je pakt de leads op die marketing binnenhaalt, wekt interesse bij nieuwe organisaties en kwalificeert kansen. Zo zorg je dat onze Account Managers aan tafel komen bij de mensen die ertoe doen. Je volgt inbound leads op uit campagnes, webinars en onze website, snel en consequent. Geen kans blijft liggen. Je genereert nieuwe leads via telefoon, e-mail, LinkedIn en andere digitale kanalen. Je brengt markten en organisaties in kaart en bepaalt snel waar de kans het grootst is. Je achterhaalt waar een organisatie staat met gevaarlijke stoffen en laat zien hoe Toxic helpt. Je kwalificeert leads op product fit, budget, beslissingsbevoegdheid en timing en draagt ze warm over aan onze Accountmanagers. Je werkt nauw samen met marketing en geeft scherpe feedback op campagnes en leadkwaliteit. Je registreert alles zorgvuldig in Salesforce en deelt wat je hoort in de markt met het commerciële team. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent nieuwsgierig, energiek en laat je niet snel afwijzen. Je krijgt energie van nieuwe contacten en een volle pipeline. Je vertelt een verhaal waar je zelf in gelooft. Je hebt hbo werk- en denkniveau en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands. Je hebt maximaal 1 à 2 jaar commerciële ervaring, bijvoorbeeld in sales, business development of leadgeneratie. Je hebt een commerciële blik en ziet snel welke leads interessant zijn. Interesse in veiligheid of chemie is mooi meegenomen. De kennis leer je bij ons. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je tekent voor een rol waarin je de groei van Toxic aanjaagt. Jij opent deuren en zet interesse om in concrete kansen. Dit krijg je ervoor terug: Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting. Een team dat de markt kent en collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert. Basissalaris vanaf €3.457 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur. Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris. 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris. Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering. Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer of een ov-vergoeding, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling. Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag. Ruimte om te groeien. title: Research and Development Engineer in Artificial Intelligence - 12 months contract
description: Who we are ? Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools. The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment. Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise. The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes. A central objective of VITAMIN-C is to integrate AI techniques into the verification workflow. On the computational side, AI models will be investigated to guide the exploration of large state spaces and prioritise promising verification strategies. By learning from previously verified models and their associated results, these components can help identify relevant search directions and reduce the computational effort required by verification algorithms. On the usability side, the project explores AI-assisted interfaces that support engineers in constructing formal models and specifying security properties. These interfaces may exploit natural-language processing and large language models to interpret engineering descriptions, suggest formal representations, and assist users throughout the verification process. In both cases, the correctness of verification results remains the responsibility of the underlying formal methods, which validate the outcomes produced or suggested by AI components. Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of AI techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on developing AI components for verification guidance, investigating natural-language and LLM-based assistance for formal modelling, and integrating these capabilities into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in the preparation of training and evaluation datasets, the development of experimental benchmarks, and the assessment of the proposed approaches in terms of effectiveness, computational efficiency, and reliability. The overall objective is to make formal verification more scalable and accessible while preserving the rigorous guarantees provided by the verification framework. Your main responsibilities will include : Carry out R&D work in artificial intelligence for formal verification Contribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom The candidate must have a solid understanding of artificial intelligence, Python programming, data processing and analysis, and software engineering. They must also be fluent in English and able to develop, train, evaluate, test and document AI components within a collaborative environment. Experience in deep learning, natural language processing (NLP/LLM), graph learning, learning-guided search or the deployment of machine learning models would be an advantage. An interest in formal verification, cybersecurity, trustworthy AI, Docker and teaching activities would also be appreciated. The role also requires strong organisational, analytical and problem-solving skills, as well as a good team spirit. The candidate must be able to communicate clearly, explain technical concepts in layman’s terms, draft documentation and contribute to teaching activities. Required qualifications and experience : the candidate must hold a five-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+5) or equivalent. Applications from candidates with a four-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+4) and at least four years’ professional experience, a three-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+3) and at least six years’ experience, or a two-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+2) and at least ten years’ experience will also be considered. Why join us? You'll be working in a fast-growing, pleasant, green and accessible environment (especially for people with disabilities) just 20 km from Paris (RER B and C suburban train lines, close to major roads). You will benefit from : 49 days annual leave (CA + RTT) flexible working hours (depending on department activity) telecommuting 1 to 3 days/week possible 75% public transport pass reimbursement Proximity to numerous sports facilities, concierge service, underground parking, in-house catering, etc. Good to know: our social security contributions are lower than in the private sector Remuneration details: Indicative remuneration range (excluding the variable annual bonus): €33,614 – €43,000 gross per annum, depending on profile and experience, as defined by our legal framework. Please note: our social security contributions are lower than in the private sector. Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing both potential attacks and the strategies that defenders can adopt in response. Attackers may exploit sequences of vulnerabilities to compromise a system, while defenders may react through countermeasures such as access restrictions, system reconfigurations, or Moving Target Defense mechanisms. Traditional cybersecurity analysis techniques often focus on identifying vulnerabilities and possible attack paths, with limited support for reasoning about the strategic interactions between attackers and defenders. The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges through formal verification. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for modelling and verifying cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. This approach allows the verification of security properties, such as the preservation of confidentiality and integrity, as well as the synthesis of defensive strategies against known attack scenarios. A central challenge of the project concerns the scalability of formal verification when applied to realistic cybersecurity scenarios. To address this issue, VITAMIN-C investigates symbolic and abstract model-checking techniques, together with a modular architecture supporting the integration of different verification engines. Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of formal verification techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on formal modelling of cybersecurity scenarios, strategic model checking, development and optimisation of verification algorithms, and their integration into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in experimental evaluations using cybersecurity benchmarks and industrial use cases, contributing to the development of a practical verification tool. title: Forward Deployed Engineer – AI Agents & Enterprise Software
description: You love building something people can actually use: the moment an integration works, an agent takes a tedious task off someone’s hands, or an idea becomes a useful tool. At XALT, you work closely with the people you build for, taking their solution from the first conversation into production. Your customers will be enterprises and public-sector organisations. Your focus will be AI agents with XALT Northstar or development platforms in the Atlassian ecosystem. We will work out together which area fits your experience and interests; working across both is possible. What you learn in customer projects will feed back into our own products. What we are working towards We want to help companies use AI to improve the work people rely on every day. We combine consulting, software development and our own products to make that happen. What excites us is seeing a technical idea become something people can count on. What you will do Turn business problems into practical technical solutions together with the customer. Write production code and integrate agents into existing systems and workflows. With a Northstar focus, build and operate personal and operational agents using MCP servers, Agent Skills, evals, guardrails and observability. With an Atlassian focus, develop platforms and workflows using Forge, Rovo and CI/CD so development teams can use agents reliably. Take solutions into production, evaluate their quality and improve them based on actual use. Bring insights from customer projects into our products. What you bring Experience writing and reviewing production code, for example in TypeScript or Python, across both backend and frontend Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers and CI/CD, for example AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform or GitLab Practical experience with LLMs and agentic systems, including evals that detect errors and regressions At least one agent or AI workflow you have built yourself and put into production , which you can demonstrate live during the application process (see “Your AI example”) Enjoyment of working directly with customers and the ability to make reasoned technical decisions with incomplete information Business-fluent German and English What we offer Unlimited tokens for Claude, OpenAI and the latest, most advanced AI tools €70,000–100,000 gross per year , depending on experience; we are open to going beyond this range for exceptional senior candidates with a proven record of running agents in production The opportunity to follow your solutions from the first conversation into customers’ daily work and see the difference they make Professional exchange within the team, across the Atlassian ecosystem as a Platinum Partner, and through the XALT AI Circle and IT Revolution Your working arrangements We value working together in the office: developing ideas, learning from one another and talking things through in person. Living in or around Munich or Leipzig is therefore a plus. Remote work is also possible. If you live further away, we would still love to hear from you. Together, we will discuss an arrangement that works for you, your team and the role. Full-time Work within an international company with teams in Munich, Leipzig, Manila and New York Our professional community Exchanging ideas with others is part of what we enjoy about this work. For our XALT AI Circle in Munich in autumn 2026, we have invited Peter Steinberger of the OpenClaw Foundation to discuss personal agents. In October 2026, Philipp Göllner spoke at the Enterprise AI Summit in Charlotte about how our team built a Chief of Staff agent. We plan to represent XALT again at the summit in Portland in May 2027. For a closer look at our work, see Philipp’s talk from Charlotte. Your AI example We would like to understand how you approach problems and what you have learned along the way. Bring a process you have automated yourself with AI and show it to us live. Walk us through your contribution, whether the workflow works consistently, and what has measurably improved. We are also interested in its limitations and how you check the results. One example is enough; you can recreate it with test data. Please do not share confidential information or protected code. Your application Does this sound like work you would enjoy? We would love to hear from you. Send your CV to ----- and tell us what you would like to work on. The conversation should also give you room to ask about the team, your responsibilities and what you need to do good work. We will discuss the interview arrangements and your AI demonstration with you personally. You can also send any questions beforehand to ----- Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Marketing Manager Performance & Growth
description: The Company Seit über zehn Jahren begeistert unser Kunde Millionen Menschen mit seinen Social Games und verbindet dabei als Teil einer großen europäischen Digital-Entertainment-Gruppe die Stabilität eines etablierten Players mit der Geschwindigkeit eines Start-ups. Dahinter steht ein internationales Team aus über 50 Gamer:innen, Developer:innen und Marketing-Profis, die für ihre Spiele brennen. Das Marketing arbeitet datengetrieben, schnell und eng verzahnt mit Product, CRM und BI. Für den nächsten Wachstumsschritt sucht unser Kunde eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit für User Acquisition. Du hast UA bereits verantwortet und weißt, wie man Budgets profitabel skaliert. Deine Aufgabe ist es, neue Spieler:innen in den bestehenden Märkten zu gewinnen und die Expansion in neue Länder voranzutreiben. Ein fertiges Playbook gibt es dafür nicht, du entwickelst es selbst. Your Tasks UA-Strategie: Du verantwortest User Acquisition für Web und Mobile end-to-end, von der Kanal- und Budgetplanung bis zur Skalierung. Budget: Du steuerst dein Budget nach Kohorten-ROAS, Payback und LTV und entscheidest, wo jeder Euro am meisten bringt. Kernmärkte: Wenn die bekannten Hebel ausgereizt sind, legst du erst richtig los und findest neue Zielgruppen, Kanäle und Ideen. Neue Märkte: Du bewertest neue Länder, testest sie und gibst eine klare Go/No-Go-Empfehlung. Channel-Mix: Von Google, Meta und Apple Search Ads über Ad Networks und Programmatic bis TikTok und Affiliate: Du stellst den Mix zusammen und verhandelst direkt mit Partnern und Agenturen. Setup: Du baust skalierbares Tracking, Attribution, Tooling und Testing auf und entscheidest, was inhouse läuft und wo Partner sinnvoll sind. Creatives: Mit Design und Content treibst du schnelle Tests für Creatives, Store Listings und Landingpages voran. Reporting: Du machst Ergebnisse transparent, bringst eigene Ideen ein und vertrittst deine Zahlen auch gegenüber dem Management. Teamplay: Gemeinsam mit Product, CRM und BI machst du aus neuen Spieler:innen langfristig aktive. Your Profile 3+ Jahre in Performance Marketing oder User Acquisition in einem datengetriebenen B2C-Umfeld. Messbare Erfolge: Du hast nachweislich größere Budgets profitabel skaliert. Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Web- und App-Kampagnen: Google, Meta, Apple Search Ads sowie Networks wie AppLovin, Unity oder Moloco. Du denkst in Kohorten, LTV und Payback , nicht in Klicks. Tracking-Know-how: Du kennst MMPs wie AppsFlyer oder Adjust, GA4 und Server-Side-Tracking aus der Praxis und weißt, was DSGVO, Consent und ATT/SKAdNetwork für dein Measurement bedeuten. KI gehört zu deinem Alltag: Du baust dir eigene Workflows mit ChatGPT, Claude & Co., etwa für Creative-Varianten, Analysen und Reportings. Du entscheidest auch ohne perfekte Datenlage , arbeitest eigenständig und kommunizierst klar, auch gegenüber dem Management. Sprachen: fließendes Englisch und sehr gutes Deutsch. Your Benefits Dynamisches Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien, schnellen Entscheidungen und viel Raum für eigene Ideen Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote-Option, an zwei Tagen pro Woche im Office Regelmäßige Team-Events Kostenloses Obst und Getränke sowie Essenszuschuss Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/d)
description: About Valova We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients. Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs , while most German hospitals already operate at a loss . We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash . Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital , until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe. Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin . Join us! Why this role matters Valova only works as well as it fits into the hospital. Our product creates the most value when it’s deeply connected to a hospital’s systems and built around how coders and medical controlling actually work. Today, connecting to a hospital information system can take months. That’s time hospitals keep losing revenue and coders keep working by hand. That’s where you come in. As Forward Deployed Engineer, you own technical go-lives from start to finish : from the first sandbox to production, from the interface to the workflow on the ward. You’re the bridge between hospital IT, the people who use Valova and our engineering team . Your impact is easy to see: in hospitals that go live faster, in integrations that run reliably, and in a product that gets better with every deployment because you bring back what you learn. This is a hands-on engineering role with real code in production and direct influence on our roadmap. It’s not a support desk, not a pre-sales role and not project management where others do the building. And it’s not a desk job: you’ll regularly be on site in hospitals How the role sits in the team You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on connectors, deployments and internal tooling. With Malte and our product team, you turn what you see in hospitals into clear requirements. In hospital projects, you work hand in hand with our customer success and sales team and on the hospital side with IT leads, KIS vendors, coders and medical controlling. What you will do Bring hospitals live: You take hospitals from sandbox to production, deploy Valova on hospital VMs and connect it to KIS systems such as SAP i.s.h.med, Orbis or Dedalus. Build the connections: You build and maintain interfaces (HL7, FHIR, archive and document exports) together with hospital IT and their partners. Set up Valova for each customer: You configure document types, case filtering, department rules and coding workflows. Learn from the ward: You work on site with coders and medical controlling and turn their friction into clear product requirements. Make deployments repeatable: You write the code that makes the next go-live faster: connectors, scripts, monitoring and internal tooling. Earn the hospital’s trust: You answer technical questions in security and data protection reviews (BSI C5, GDPR). What we are looking for: Engineering experience: At least two years in software engineering, and you’re comfortable with Linux, Docker and basic networking. Integration know-how: You’ve worked on system integrations. Experience with HL7/FHIR or SAP environments is a big plus. Customer focus: You enjoy working with customers and explain technical topics clearly to IT leads and coders alike. High ownership: You move things forward, even when three parties are involved. Travel: You’re happy to spend around 30 percent of your time at hospitals across Germany. Languages: You speak fluent German and English, since our customers work in German. Location: You work from our office in Munich or Berlin. Missing one or two points, but convinced you’re the right person for this role? Apply anyway. We’re looking forward to meeting you! What you get Work that means something, every day. Your agents are the core of our product and directly help improve the German healthcare system. Ownership from week one. You take over real projects with a clear outcome and your name on it, not a list of tasks someone else defined. Direct access to the founders. You work day to day with our founders Sophia, a physician and ex-McKinsey consultant, and Christian, who has founded two health tech startups and spent a decade building clinical systems. No layers, no waiting weeks for approvals. Trust and freedom. We trust you to solve problems your way, and the team has your back 100%. Learning at startup speed. You will see more in one year here than in three years elsewhere, across models, infrastructure, product and customers, with a team that has a proven track record of deploying AI in healthcare. One team, in the heart of the city. We work together on-site at WeWork Odeonsplatz in Munich and WeWork in central Berlin. Fully serviced offices with coffee, meeting rooms and phone booths mean zero admin, and the city-center location means short commutes, easy access to customers and investors, and lunch spots around every corner. Team events that bring Munich and Berlin together, because the people you build with should also be the people you celebrate with. What success looks like After 3 months, you know Valova’s stack inside out and have taken a hospital through its first technical setup together with our team. After 6 months, you’ve taken at least two hospitals live, and a new KIS connection takes weeks instead of months. After 12 months, our deployments are largely repeatable: connectors, scripts and monitoring you built make every go-live faster. Throughout, what you learn in hospitals shapes our roadmap, and hospital IT teams see you as their trusted contact at Valova. How it works Just upload your CV with your application. We’ll get in touch with you for the next steps: Intro call (30 min): We get to know each other, talk about your background and answer your first questions. Technical interview with Christian (CTO) (60 min): We dive into your engineering experience and the integrations you’ve built. Case: You work through a realistic hospital integration scenario and present it to the team. References: We speak with two or three people you’ve worked with, such as former managers or colleagues. Meet the team: You spend a day with us on-site in Munich or Berlin, meet our founders Sophia and Christian and see how we work day to day. Offer: If it’s a match for both sides, you’ll hear from us quickly. We look forward to your application, regardless of gender, background, religion, disability, age or sexual identity.
