title: Field CTO, London
description: <p>Location: London, UK</p> <p>Travel: Frequent travel across EMEA required</p> <p>ABOUT WEKA</p> <p>WEKA is architecting a new approach to the enterprise data stack, built for the AI era. The WEKA Data Platform sets the standard for AI infrastructure with a cloud and AI-native software solution that can be deployed anywhere. It transforms legacy data silos into data pipelines that make GPUs, AI, and other performance-intensive workloads run faster, work more efficiently, and consume less energy.</p> <p>WEKA is a pre-IPO, growth-stage company on a hyper-growth trajectory. We've raised $375M in capital from dozens of world-class venture capital and strategic investors. We help the world's most innovative enterprises and research organizations (including 12 of the Fortune 50), reach discoveries, insights, and outcomes faster and more sustainably.</p> <p>We're passionate about helping our customers overcome complex data challenges to accelerate their innovation and grow their businesses. If you share our passion, we would love for you to join us on this exciting journey.</p> <p>WHAT'S COOL ABOUT THIS JOB</p> <p>As WEKA's Field CTO for EDA and AI, based in London and covering the broader EMEA region, you'll sit at the intersection of two of the most demanding compute domains in the industry: semiconductor design (EDA) and AI infrastructure. You'll work directly with chip designers, foundries, and AI teams across EMEA to architect solutions on the WEKA Data Platform, investigate new innovations across both fields, and champion WEKA as the platform of choice for design and AI workloads. You'll collaborate with the wider CTO Office to translate customer requirements into solutions and architectures, and act as the region's technical evangelist for WEKA in EDA and AI.</p> <p>RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE</p> <ul> <li>Connect WEKA's EDA and AI customers across EMEA to the broader WEKA team, alongside other members of the CTO Office.</li> <li>Partner with the GTM team to develop and deliver compelling technical presentations, demonstrations, and customer workshops that showcase WEKA's value proposition in semiconductor design and AI workloads.</li> <li>Act as a trusted advisor to GTM teams and customers, providing deep technical expertise on how WEKA's technology solves EDA and AI-specific technical and business challenges.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal stakeholders across product, engineering, and marketing to align customer needs, technology strategy, and product roadmap.</li> <li>Deliver advisory services to the field, working with WEKA's presales and post-sales organizations to drive successful outcomes on both types of engagements.</li> <li>Provide oversight on large, complex EDA and AI customer engagements across the region where appropriate.</li> <li>Champion technical innovation across functions inside and outside GTM, staying current on emerging EDA and AI technologies and assessing their impact on the business.</li> <li>Cultivate partnerships with technology providers (EDA vendors, foundries, hyperscalers, GPU vendors) to address customer requirements and expand WEKA's reach and influence across EMEA.</li> <li>Represent WEKA at industry events, conferences, and workshops across the region, establishing thought leadership in EDA and AI infrastructure.</li> <li>Identify emerging market trends and technologies across EDA and AI to inform product development and go-to-market strategy.</li> </ul> <p>DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS</p> <ul> <li>15+ years of technical experience in relevant industries</li> <li>Proven experience architecting AI infrastructure environments; hands-on experience with EDA (Electronic Design Automation) workflows and semiconductor design compute environments.</li> <li>Proven track record deploying and utilizing multiple AI frameworks and technologies.</li> <li>Excellent English communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences across a diverse regional customer base.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience and proven skills as a technical evangelist, including designing and running customer workshops.</li> <li>Comfortable with frequent travel across EMEA.</li> <li>Ability to translate technical terms into business value for varied audiences, specifically across traditional enterprises adopting AI, foundational model builders, neocloud providers and semiconductor design houses. </li> <li>Experience building and maintaining strong relationships with customers and partners.</li> <li>A collaborative, results-oriented mindset with a strong work ethic and genuine passion for staying ahead of the technology curve.</li> </ul> <p>Concerned you don't meet every qualification? Don't let it stop you from applying.</p> <p>WEKA is committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this position but don't meet every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or other positions at WEKA.</p> <p>WEKA is an equal-opportunity employer that prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. description: <p><strong>Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company!  </strong></p> <p>The France Enterprise Advertiser team is looking for an eager, results-driven Sales Manager to pursue, negotiate and close deals, bringing in high-profile clients and expanding our footprint in one of the region's most exciting and fast-moving markets. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. We build effective, proportionate controls to protect against financial crime while delivering great customer outcomes.</p> <p>Our Analytics Engineering discipline works in the intersection between data, engineering and our collectives - Core, Money, Borrowing, Operations and Financial Crime and beyond. </p> <p>The AE teams are responsible for building downstream data models from backend services with the desire to make our Data Warehouse a genuine competitive advantage for Monzo. We want a discipline capable of building a reliable and scalable Data Warehouse to support decision making in a cost effective and performant manner. </p> <p>Managers within Data have two primary responsibilities; people and technical products. Your focus will be on helping engineers with their personal and professional development, listening and guiding them through hard times and celebrating their successes. You will also be leading and participating directly in technical initiatives and helping Monzo shape its Data organisation, ensuring the team focuses on valuable work, shipping things with a level of care and attention to detail.</p> <p>There will be a strong focus on delivering best practice across our data discipline and helping bring a new level of maturity around Data Governance principles, working in collaboration with others to deliver this.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>Working in a multi-disciplinary team, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Be a hands-on leader in building a discipline of exceptional analytics engineers working to make Data at Monzo the gold standard within the industry</li> <li>Nurture between 5 to 6 analytics engineers, supporting, coaching and developing high performing engineers through regular 1:1s, continuous feedback and relationships with others</li> <li>Aid prioritisation of initiatives and projects, working closely with other leads for each of our Monzo collectives</li> <li>Be hands on through participating in the review cycle, architecture and design leadership and development of your own changes to the pipelines</li> <li>Be part of the hiring team within Analytics Engineering</li> <li>Work closely with other leads to deliver a scalable, consistent approach to governance and best practices</li> <li>Drive effective project management of central Analytics Engineering projects, ensuring they’re well scoped and delivered to deadlines</li> <li>Establish yourself as a trusted partner to various collectives and the leadership team, with the capacity for getting things done, be it either hands-on or by leading others</li> <li>We all own and support the pipelines we contribute to, and on call support out of hours will be expected from time to time as part of this role</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <p>You have experience managing or mentoring the performance and development of high-performing engineers.</p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience in data warehousing architecture at scale</li> <li>You have experience and a passion for leading data warehousing, data visualisation, big data or ETL projects as an analyst, developer, designer or architect</li> <li>You know what it takes to hire great engineers within the data space</li> <li>You’re equally comfortable working hands on and leading a team</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice To Haves:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Any experience working within a finance or banking environment</li> <li>Experience working in a highly regulated environment (e.g. finance, insurance, gaming, food, health care)</li> <li>Experience with any of our stack of dbt, BigQuery and Looker</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that’s listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£97,800-£125,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance and<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> benefits</a></p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK. </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor your visa. </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Recruiter Screening Call</li> <li>Initial Call</li> <li>Take Home Task</li> <li>Final Loop (3 sessions - case study, collaboration and people  leadership)</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 2-3 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>For more insight into the AE team at Monzo, check out our <a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/6Eg1mNXROTiEXBUVmIQSil?si=jo5cymfpQNWbMJ5DGdLJHQ">podcast</a> with John Azzopardi one of our Senior Leaders in AE</p> <p>#LI-AS1 #LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action. Many foundations are still being defined, giving you meaningful influence beyond the features you directly own. Made a major ingestion or calculation path more observable, recoverable and reproducible. Helped ship risk results that users can trace back to the evidence that produced them. Contributed to the open-source release and to engineering practices the growing squad can build on. 🌐 Open source, like the rest of Filigran OpenCRQ is about to become Open source, alongside OpenCTI and OpenAEV. You will contribute visibly to a product whose risk calculations can be inspected, challenged and improved by the organizations running it. 👥 The squad You will join two senior engineers and a staff engineer, reporting to OpenCRQ’s Engineering Manager. The squad is small enough for you to influence its direction, without working in isolation. You will collaborate with the VP of Technology, CTO and Principal Engineers on technical standards, and with the OpenCTI, OpenAEV and XTM One teams on cross-product contracts and integrations. These relationships bring domain knowledge and broader technical context into the squad’s decisions as it grows. ✨ What will help you succeed We do not expect you to arrive with expertise in cyber risk or every standard named below. We are looking for a strong software engineer who can learn quickly, work autonomously and use the squad to challenge and improve decisions. A track record of taking complex product problems from an ambiguous idea to a validated outcome: framing the problem, making technical decisions, implementing the solution, testing it end to end and checking that it solves the user’s need. Strong experience with a modern TypeScript stack and practical knowledge of PostgreSQL beyond the ORM. You treat failure modes and observability as part of the design. The ability to reason about complex relationships across systems and design interconnected data models that remain coherent as concepts and integrations evolve. Comfort turning quantitative concepts into maintainable software. Formal training in statistics is not required, but you should be willing to work with probability distributions, orders of magnitude and models whose assumptions evolve over time. Thoughtful use of coding agents: you know where they accelerate engineering and where their output needs careful verification. Fluent English is required. 💡 Useful, but not required Any of the following would help, but none is expected: Experience in cybersecurity, GRC or risk quantification. Familiarity with STIX/TAXII, OCSF, MITRE ATT&CK or other open cybersecurity standards and frameworks. Experience shipping features involving LLM agents, RAG or MCP. ⚙️ The stack TypeScript end to end: React, Vite and TanStack Router on the frontend; Node.js, Fastify and tRPC on the backend; PostgreSQL with a code-first schema and Drizzle, all in one monorepo. title: Product Frontend Engineer
description: quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where this is going Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either. That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience. One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy. Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled. Why this role exists Today , quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with. What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards. That is the opening. How we work We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing. We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high. Tasks What you will own Everything on the screen: The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account. The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components. The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device. Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native. The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished. Where design ends, engineering begins. We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you. Requirements Who we are looking for You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed. You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building. You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels. You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does. Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works. The Team We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action. This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally. Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für Dich sein. Unser Kunde ist eine Organisation mit einem gesellschaftlich relevanten Auftrag im Bereich der digitalen Transformation. In einem dynamischen und technologieorientierten Umfeld werden digitale Lösungen entwickelt und betrieben, die einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Modernisierung zentraler gesellschaftlicher Strukturen leisten. Im Mittelpunkt Deiner neuen Aufgabe stehen zwei zentrale Business-Applikationen: Oracle NetSuite und Personio . Beide Systeme sind bereits etabliert und sollen nun weiter stabilisiert, intelligent miteinander vernetzt und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. Darüber hinaus spielen Automatisierung und der Einsatz künstlicher Intelligenz eine zunehmend wichtige Rolle. Zur Verstärkung des IT-Teams suchen wir eine technisch versierte Persönlichkeit, die Geschäftsprozesse versteht, gerne hands-on arbeitet und die Weiterentwicklung der Systemlandschaft aktiv mitgestalten möchte.. Deine Aufgaben Systemverantwortung & Weiterentwicklung: Du übernimmst die Konfiguration, Administration und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Oracle NetSuite und Personio. Dazu gehören unter anderem Workflows, Formulare, Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepte, Saved Searches sowie Reports. Business Process Management: Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen Finance, Controlling, Einkauf und HR analysierst Du bestehende Prozesse und Anforderungen und entwickelst passende technische Lösungen – von der Konzeption über die Umsetzung bis zum Go-live. Technische Verantwortung: Gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Teammitglied stellst Du den zuverlässigen Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung beider Applikationen sicher. Ihr arbeitet eng zusammen, vertretet Euch gegenseitig und gestaltet die Aufgabenverteilung eigenverantwortlich. Steuerung externer Dienstleister: Bei komplexeren Entwicklungen und Schnittstellen arbeitest Du mit externen Implementierungspartnern zusammen. Du hinterfragst technische Konzepte, bewertest Ergebnisse und sorgst dafür, dass das Know-how langfristig intern aufgebaut und gesichert wird. Integration & Automatisierung: Du entwickelst die Anbindung der Systeme an weitere Anwendungen weiter und identifizierst Potenziale für Automatisierung und den Einsatz von KI, insbesondere in Finanz- und HR-Prozessen. Application Management: Du analysierst und behebst Störungen, begleitest Changes und Releases und unterstützt den Betrieb weiterer Business Applications. Das bringst du mit Qualifikation: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre mit IT-Schwerpunkt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Konfiguration, Administration und Weiterentwicklung von ERP- oder HR-Systemen mit. Idealerweise hast Du bereits mit Oracle NetSuite gearbeitet. Kenntnisse in Personio oder vergleichbaren HR-Systemen sind ebenfalls willkommen. Technisches Know-how: Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis von Skripting, beispielsweise JavaScript oder SuiteScript, SQL-Datenbanken und REST-APIs. Du kannst technische Anforderungen beurteilen und Dich souverän mit Entwicklern und externen Dienstleistern austauschen. Prozessverständnis: Du kennst Geschäftsprozesse aus den Bereichen Finance, Controlling, Einkauf oder HR und verstehst es, fachliche Anforderungen in praktikable technische Lösungen zu übersetzen. Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und pragmatisch. Auch bei komplexen Fragestellungen behältst Du den Überblick und findest lösungsorientierte Ansätze. Persönlichkeit: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und hast Freude daran, gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und IT-Kolleg etwas zu bewegen. Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden Dein Profil ab. Deine Vorteile Sinnstiftende Aufgabe: Du arbeitest in einer Organisation, deren digitale Lösungen einen gesellschaftlich relevanten Beitrag leisten. Langfristige Perspektive: Dich erwartet eine unbefristete Festanstellung mit langfristigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen: Neben einem attraktiven Gehalt profitierst Du von 30 Urlaubstagen sowie zusätzlichen freien Tagen an Heiligabend und Silvester. Flexibles Arbeiten: Deine Arbeitszeit kannst Du flexibel gestalten. Mobiles Arbeiten innerhalb Deutschlands ist nach Absprache möglich. Für die Position ist eine Präsenz im Büro an etwa zwei bis drei Tagen pro Woche vorgesehen. Arbeiten aus dem europäischen Ausland: Zusätzlich besteht die Möglichkeit, bis zu 30 Tage jährlich aus EU, EWR oder der Schweiz zu arbeiten. Weiterentwicklung: Individuelle Weiterbildungsangebote, Workshops, Fachveranstaltungen und Konferenzen unterstützen Deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung. Gesundheit & Mobilität: Du profitierst unter anderem von Gesundheits- und Sportangeboten sowie einem Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket. Team & Kultur: Dich erwartet ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit und einem starken Fokus auf gemeinsames Lernen. Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit einer Beschäftigung in Teilzeit unterstützen die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben. Interesse geweckt? title: Senior Lead Claims Operations (m/f/x)
description: Who We Are At Progyny Global, part of the Progyny, Inc. family, we're on a mission to make fertility, pregnancy, and family-forming care accessible worldwide. By combining world-class clinical expertise with innovative technology, we deliver inclusive, culturally competent support that helps individuals and families navigate some of life's most important journeys. With Progyny's support and global reach, we're expanding access to care and breaking down barriers so that more people can build the families they want, wherever they are in the world. Role Overview We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Lead Claims Operations to lead our small claims team, strengthen our global claims operations, and drive the development of the tools that support our members and team. Our members come to us during one of the hardest phases of their lives. A fertility journey is physically and emotionally exhausting, and a slow reimbursement or an unclear answer adds stress nobody should have to carry. That is why member experience sits at the heart of every claims process we run: we respond fast, we explain decisions clearly, and we treat every piece of member feedback as important. We want our members to feel the difference to a traditional insurer at every step. This is a player-coach role combining team leadership, operational oversight, and product improvement. You’ll guide and develop the team, manage quality and workload, and continuously improve our processes. You’ll also stay close to daily operations by handling complex or escalated cases, reviewing selected claims, and stepping in during periods of increased demand. Your routine caseload will be significantly smaller than that of a Claims Processor, allowing you to focus where your experience and judgement have the greatest impact. Working closely with the VP Member Experience, Legal, Clinical Operations, and Finance, you’ll help maintain a fair, consistent, and compliant claims framework across our markets. You’ll bring practical judgement to reviewing contracts, invoices, and claims documentation, recognising country-specific requirements and knowing when specialist input is needed. You’ll also drive the continuous development of our internal claims processing tool, member-facing claims submission experience, and wallet in partnership with Product and Engineering. You’ll translate operational and member needs into clear requirements, help prioritise improvements, and ensure new features meet those requirements before launch. We’re looking for a collaborative, pragmatic leader who combines strong analytical skills with precision and attention to detail. You’ll enjoy being close to the work, use data to guide decisions, take ownership of improvements, and understand the impact every claim can have on a member’s journey. What you will do Team leadership and daily operations Lead and develop our claims team through coaching, feedback, and regular quality reviews. Coordinate workloads, priorities, and coverage to meet service levels and maintain a sustainable workload. Handle complex or escalated cases, review selected claims, and support processing during periods of increased demand. Define clear targets and SLAs for the team, such as turnaround times, processing accuracy, and member satisfaction. Track them continuously, report on progress to the VP Member Experience, and drive measurable improvements quarter over quarter. Process improvement and member experience Use operational data and team insights to identify recurring issues and improve workflows across markets and product lines. Maintain consistent claims decisions, clear documentation, and effective escalation and quality-assurance processes. Ensure members receive accurate, timely, and empathetic communication throughout the claims journey. Claims products, wallet, automation and AI Drive improvements to our internal claims processing tool, member-facing claims submission experience, and wallet with Product and Engineering, and identify where AI can make claims work faster and more accurate. Define product requirements and acceptance criteria, including where AI may support a decision and where human review remains mandatory, and help prioritise enhancements based on member needs, operational impact, data protection, and risk. Coordinate user acceptance testing, validate features before launch, and prepare the team through updated workflows and training. Monitor results after launch, including the quality and accuracy of AI outputs, and drive further improvements. Claims framework, regulatory requirements, and controls Review provider contracts, invoices, and claims documentation for market-specific contractual and regulatory requirements, involving Legal, Clinical Operations, or Finance where needed. Maintain the claims framework and translate agreed requirements into practical workflows, controls, and guidance. Partner with Finance on payment accuracy and reconciliation, support audits, and address control or compliance gaps. Requirements At least 5 years of experience in claims, healthcare benefits, reimbursement, insurance operations, or a related field, including three years coordinating or leading a team. Hands-on expertise in complex claims, quality assurance, operational controls, and financial reconciliation. Hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work, ideally in operational workflows such as document processing or case handling, with a clear sense of where human judgement and data protection require oversight. Experience reviewing contracts, invoices, and claims documentation against market-specific contractual and regulatory requirements, recognising when specialist input is needed. Experience defining product requirements with Product and Engineering, testing new features, and supporting operational rollouts. Experience improving processes and managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment, ideally within a technology company or scale-up. Strong analytical skills, precision, and attention to detail, using operational KPIs to guide decisions and improvements. Clear communication, sound judgement, and a collaborative, empathetic leadership style focused on the member experience. Professional fluency in English. title: Trading Manager
description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. What You Will Do Make deals: negotiate prices, contracts and work closely with our Sales team to identify and seize market opportunities. Establish and maintain international supplier relationships as part of our strategic procurement, purchasing a seven-figure trading volume per month. Find new partners internationally, for example via trade shows or cold calls, and build these up into long-lasting relationships. Resolve issues with internal and external stakeholders that block revenue. Follow spot market trades, price dynamics and trends, and act on them at high speed. Work with advanced AI tools that keep you a step ahead of the market. Who You Are You think like a trader. You like buying and selling and ideally have made money before, for example through trading, your own business, a side hustle or a sales role. You want to win. You chase deals and results without waiting to be pushed. You act fast. You decide and follow up. You have a natural curiosity. You always ask how and why, and you learn fast from every conversation. You are comfortable interacting with internal stakeholders and external parties in real-life meetings or (video) calls. Background You are fresh out of university, or you have a couple of years of work experience in a commercial role, for example sales or trading. Any industry works. Self-employment, your own business or a side hustle is very welcome. We look for people who drive commercial value, understand trade and know how to create revenue. Required Qualifications You have a university degree. You have strong analytical and negotiation skills , and can clearly articulate complex subjects with confidence and precision. You bring a hands-on mentality : you take ownership, solve problems independently, and thrive in dynamic settings. You are curious about AI and how it changes the way we trade. German post: You speak German at C2 level (mandatory) and English fluently. English post: you speak English fluently. Italian is a plus, and so is any other European business-fluent language. What’s In It for You Real ownership from day one - shape operational processes in a fast-scaling, AI-first company. Learn from the best - work directly with senior operators, interact with skilled industry leaders and CEOs on a daily basis Competitive compensation - attractive base salary and performance-based bonus program. Personal growth & visibility - rapid learning opportunities, cross-functional exposure, and early leadership potential in a growing global team. Vibrant company culture – modern Berlin office, monthly All-Hands, team events, and regular offsites. Why Join You’ll be joining a company that’s not only transforming a global industry but doing so with the speed, precision, and intelligence of AI . Here, you won’t just manage supply chains - you’ll help redefine how global commerce operates. We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength. Compensation: €70K – €90K • Yearly On Target Earnings (Fixed+ Bonus) €70K – €90K Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer - Simulation Platform
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent YOUR IMPACT Shape the future of Proxima’s simulation platform : we design and develop the platform; stellarator researchers and engineers use it to mature the design of Alpha and Stellaris; you will imagine and build with us novel solutions for simulation tools that spark joy and reduce time-to-insight Accelerate Stellarator R&D, at the company at its forefront : we work side by side with researchers and engineers to ensure what we build immediately boosts the speed Proxima Fusion’s Stellarator design program WHAT YOU WILL DO You will join the Simulation Platform Team, a software platform team that balances development of core products with direct support to researchers, adapting to the Stellarator design program’s strategy and priorities. In your first six months you will e.g. add features to our in-house simulation pipeline automation system and ensure that AI agents can work with it efficiently. On the platform engineering side you will design, develop and maintain next-generation software solutions for stellarator simulation and design , targeted to human and agentic use; for example: Python libraries enabling automation of large-scale simulation workflows cloud-based data storage that keeps everyone in sync web applications that foster cross-domain collaboration and knowledge discovery integration of AI tools where they actually provide leverage You will also work together with our researchers to apply our tools to specific use cases , working as an internally-deployed Research Software Engineer: you will guide users to make the most of the available simulation tooling and proactively co-develop applications that unblock their R&D program, while gathering precious feedback and ideas for the next platform improvements WHO YOU ARE We are looking for a software practitioner with a user-first mindset, interested in tackling a diverse mix of challenges: from the optimization of scientific computing workflows to building cloud- and web-based systems for data management, sharing and exploration Proficient in Python You enjoy staying up to date with current software development best practices and tools, e.g. agentic development or modern data pipelines and scheduling solutions You enjoy diving into new problems with a continuous learning attitude, absorbing relevant domain knowledge in a dynamic start-up environment; no fusion background needed, familiarity with scientific software use cases is a plus Familiarity with one or more of the following is desirable but not required: full-stack web development (React, TypeScript, FastAPI), Pydantic, JAX, cloud services and cloud-based applications; data management systems You don't need to tick every box. If this role excites you, please apply INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-60 min) Technical Screening (30-45 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) CEO call (30 min) *This role sits at "L2" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information. At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Integration Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Shape the architecture of a fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. YOUR IMPACT Alpha will be the first stellarator to demonstrate net energy. Achieving this milestone requires building a deeply coupled machine, where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, and heating work at the edge of each discipline’s capability. As part of the integrated stellarator design team you will work in between plasma physics and technology and make sure that all stellarator systems are designed according to clear and optimal design criteria. You will ensure that modelling uncertainties are quantified and used appropriately. You will drive projects where overarching design solutions with multi-system trades need to be found. WHAT YOU WILL DO Ensure interfaces, design criteria, load cases and uncertainties are correctly defined: so that engineering design can iterate quickly and with clear assumptions. Understand systems interactions: in order to minimize unintended consequences of the main architectural decisions. Solve integration challenges: Identify, track, and solve the hardest integration challenges and risks of a machine not achieving its mission requirements. Harness simplification opportunities: Identify, track, and address the most promising opportunities that affect the Alpha architecture. WHO YOU ARE You've earned your engineering judgment on complex machines. You hold a PhD or Master's in physics, engineering, or an adjacent field, and you have years of experience in industries where integration challenges are at the heart of the design, such as aerospace or Formula 1. You are not afraid of different physics domains. You feel comfortable navigating the different physics regimes of a Stellarator - from waves propagating in a plasma to cryogenic properties of steel. You reach for whatever tool fits. Being a pen-and-paper calculation, a simulator you coded last night, or a commercial multiphysics package, the method serves the question, never the reverse. You build consensus. You are a low-ego high-clarity communicator who works effectively with multiple technical leads, to bring integration challenges and system-level tradeoffs to a clear decision. You commit to a concrete outcome. Every study, tool, and memo you produce ends in an actionable insight and a clear next step, otherwise it didn't happen. INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-60 min) Technical Screening (30 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) *This role sits at L3 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information. title: (Senior) Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle Unsere Kunden lernen uns meist persönlich kennen: auf sechs bis neun eigenen Events im Jahr, die meisten davon in München. Dazu gehört das Commerce Impact Forum, bei dem Geschäftsführer und CIOs aus Handel und Industrie zusammenkommen. Außerdem Webinare, Messen und unsere Inhalte auf LinkedIn und im Blog. Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und hast viel Raum, Prozesse und Formate selbst aufzubauen. Deine Aufgaben Du planst mit der Geschäftsführung, welche Events, Webinare und Messen wir im Jahr machen, und setzt sie um, bei Bedarf mit Unterstützung aus dem Team. Du bist am Puls der Zeit: Du verfolgst, was in der Branche passiert, und bekommst Input aus dem Team, der Geschäftsführung und Projektleitung. Daraus machst du Inhalte und verantwortest dafür alle unsere Kanäle, etwa LinkedIn für das Unternehmen und die Geschäftsführung, Blog, Newsletter und Website, und alles, was künftig dazukommt. Du verantwortest unsere Marketing- und Outreach-Prozesse: wie wir Kontakte gewinnen, im Blick behalten und an den Vertrieb übergeben, einschließlich der Automatisierung dahinter. Du wertest aus, was funktioniert, und entwickelst unser Marketing mit neuen Formaten und Ideen weiter. Du steuerst Agenturen und Freelancer, wenn wir sie für Design oder Produktion einsetzen. Dein Profil Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder Beratung im Commerce- und Datenumfeld. Du schreibst sicher auf Deutsch für Entscheider und kannst in der Stimme anderer Personen schreiben. Dasselbe auf Englisch ist ein Plus. Du hast Events oder Messeauftritte geplant und durchgeführt. title: (Senior) Consultant & Project Manager (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle Du berätst unsere Kunden dabei, was ein Projekt erreichen soll, und verantwortest, dass es dort ankommt. title: (Senior) Product Owner | Full Time (m/w/d)
description: Who Are We ? 🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless. Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO. At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital. Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow. We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy. 💼 About This Role As a (Senior) Product Owner at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It's a role with real ownership in the sense that what you decide matters, and you'll see it show up in the product. 🎖 What Success Looks Like In your first month You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects. You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities. You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed. You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work. By 3 months You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands. You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives. You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements. You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination. You ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements. You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders. You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements. You will have full ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy. By 6 months You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation. You have full ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams. You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement. You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation. You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed. You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed. You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams. 🚀 What You Need to Be Successful You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Technology, or a related field. title: Product Lead - AI Neobank App

B. Zapier/Mirror/ähnliche Tools) Anwenderschulung und -betreuung (First/Second Level), Erstellung von Leitfäden Fehleranalyse und Störungsbeseitigung über Ticketsystem DATEV-Support-Themen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und Dienstleistern Zusätzliche Aufgaben (je nach Erfahrung) System- und Rechteverwaltung, Basis-Administration (Benutzer, Endgeräte) Mitarbeit an IT-Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards (Richtlinien, Backups) Auswahl und Steuerung externer Dienstleister; Lizenz- und Asset-Management Ausbau von Low-Code/No-Code-Automationen mit n8n, Zapier, Make Prozessoptimierung und Projektmanagement in enger Abstimmung mit Fachabteilungen Vorteile, auf die du dich freuen kannst: Klare Strukturen und Prozesse: Bei uns findest du eine eindeutige Aufgabenverteilung, standardisierte Abläufe und dokumentierte Prozesse. Professionelle Mandate: Du arbeitest in einer der führenden Kanzleien in Düsseldorf und hilfst bei der Betreuung von renommierten Mandanten. Du arbeitest mit strukturierten und professionellen Mandanten aus dem Mittelstand und aus etablierten Branchen. Dadurch hast du ein stabiles, planbares Umfeld in deiner täglichen Arbeit. Sicherer Arbeitsplatz Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Wir haben nur unbefristete Arbeitsverträge in Vollzeit. Durch unser kontinuierliches Wachstum und die stabile Auftragslage bieten wir dir eine langfristige Perspektive mit hoher Arbeitsplatzsicherheit. Hochmodernes Büro: Du arbeitest bei uns in einem voll verglasten Büro mit atemberaubender Aussicht über Düsseldorf und mit den neuesten Geräten. Unser Büro ist klar strukturiert, technisch auf dem neuesten Stand und bietet dir eine ruhige, professionelle Arbeitsatmosphäre mit Blick über den Rhein und Medienhafen. Digitale Arbeitswelt: Wir arbeiten vollständig digital, sind von DATEV als Digitale Kanzlei ausgezeichnet und nutzen automatisierte Prozesse, damit du dich auf deine Kernaufgaben konzentrieren kannst. title: Manager I, Applied AI - Distilled Models
description: <p>Applied AI is where Datadog's ambitious AI bets get built and shipped (<a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/dash-2026-new-feature-roundup-ai/#search-analyze-and-take-action-across-datadog-faster-with-bits-chat">Bits Chat</a>, <a href="https://updog.ai/">updog</a>). We sit at the intersection of research and product: turning promising capabilities from Datadog AI Research lab and the research community into production systems that reach real customers. The team builds specialized models that replace frontier models where they are not necessary, making AI capabilities faster, cheaper, and more secure. The mandate is to move fast from idea to customer impact, and when a product finds its footing, to set it up for growth.</p> <p> </p> <p>As a Manager I in Applied AI, you will lead a team of engineers and applied scientists working on one of these challenges. You will define technical direction, run short feedback loops, make deliberate decisions about what to pursue or stop, and work closely with product managers, research teams, and cross-functional partners to ship AI capabilities that matter.</p> <p> </p> <p>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture, the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings. description: Our Mission ⚖️ At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform. Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard. Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform. Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that. Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities. Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting. And we're just getting started. We grow fast. Really fast. Organically (new products, new countries) and through acquisitions: 5 companies snapped up in 3 years, including a fresh one in Spain. The result in 2026: close to 30,000 customers across 5 countries. The German market? It just blew out its first birthday candle. Doctrine is the European leader in legal AI. But a German lawyer doesn't work like a French one, and in-house counsel in Berlin don't have quite the same needs as their Paris counterparts. Every market has its own playbook. That's where you come in: putting Doctrine's growth in Germany into overdrive. The team you're joining A Growth team of 4: your future manager, one Growth on Italy, two on France. We're hunting for the 5th avenger to complete the squad and take full ownership of the German market. On the other side of the table, a team of full-funnel Account Executives ready to turn the leads you generate into wins. The starting point (pretty sweet, honestly 👀) A high-growth SaaS model, and a profitable one (yes, both) Rock-solid product-market fit with real momentum: close to 30,000 lawyers and legal professionals already on board A top-tier Go-to-Market team (Marketing, RevenueOps & Sales) to help you uncover new pockets of growth An established spot as the European leader of a category we helped invent: legal AI A cutting-edge tooling stack and a loaded content library to fire on the right levers and shut down objections Your missions Inside the Growth team, hand in hand with Sales, PMM and Product, you spend your days sharpening the German funnel, a mix of inbound and outbound. And the best part: everything is open to challenge. Got a better idea? We're all ears. Internationalization : design and roll out local campaigns built for the codes and expectations of the German market (no copy-paste from France). Inbound Lead Gen : team up with our agency to build campaigns that hit hard on Meta, LinkedIn and Google, and pull in as many qualified leads as possible. Outbound Lead Gen : pinpoint the right contacts for the sales teams and fire up activation campaigns (enrichment, automation, sequences, performance tracking). Nurturing : build and run nurturing campaigns on our leads, plus product-usage campaigns with existing customers, to max out conversion and retention. Field Marketing & Product Growth : back the PMM team on product launches and be field marketing's right hand on our events, webinars and product launches. The profile we're looking for You're our 5th avenger if you're not afraid to build campaigns day in, day out and copywriting is your thing (better yet, you love it). Hard skills AI is your copilot : this role runs 100% with AI, campaign production, copywriting, analysis, automation. A daily reflex, not a gimmick. Hands-on experience with marketing automation, sales engagement and CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Intercom, Lemlist…). A solid grasp of how data flows between tools, to build, challenge and optimize customer and prospect journeys. A real appetite for copywriting and for understanding what makes our audience tick. A drive to build strategies that last, not just quick & dirty wins. Analytical skills (SQL is a nice bonus). Soft skills Fluency in English is required to communicate with the team. Fluency in German, it's a plus. Strong communicator who lets the data do the talking when it's time to decide. Creative and curious about user psychology, to design programs that leave a mark. A real team player: you move through cross-functional teams and get everyone's stakes to land the best action plans. Our stack 🛠️ Salesforce · HubSpot · Outreach · Intercom · Lemlist · Mixpanel · Google Analytics · Metabase · Zapier/Make What's in it for you ☀️ 🏡 A flexible remote work policy, allowing up to three days of remote work per week (depending on your team). 🌴 A flexible leave policy 🌱 Real internal mobility opportunities 🏄‍♂️ Regular team events 📚 A genuine focus on individual and collective learning, with a €750 annual budget for any training related to your role, plus team-wide and company-wide training sessions 🏋️‍♀️ A Gymlib subscription for sports and wellness activities 🧘 Free access to the Moka.care mental health support platform, including up to 6 individual sessions per year 👩‍⚕️ Health insurance with Alan 🍱🚲 A Swile card for meal vouchers and sustainable mobility allowance (€66.60/month) 💡 Discounts and perks via our Works Council (CSE) on the Happypal platform 🍏 Brand new Apple equipment Our values 🤝 At Doctrine, our 4 values guide us every day as we work to move things forward. Challenge the status quo: we champion bold ideas that drive change across an entire industry. Liberty and responsibility: we encourage autonomy, individual impact and ownership. Knowledge is power: information is at the heart of Doctrine's mission, and we constantly strive to grow. Release early, release often and listen to your customers: we believe in the power of iteration and in constantly listening to our market, our customers and their challenges. Our hiring process 🚀 A 30-min intro call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers to understand your career goals and walk you through what we're building at Doctrine. A 1-hour conversation with your future manager to dive into the role, team scope and answer all your questions. One or two technical assessments to evaluate your skills in practice. An office visit including: lunch with 3 people from different teams to give you a feel for your future colleagues; a values conversation to share our vision; and a meeting with our CEO, Guillaume. (The process can be adapted to fit your personal and professional constraints if needed.) Ladies, go ahead and apply! title: Design System Manager - Consultant.e
description: Mindset Chez Thiga, nous considérons qu’un Design System n’est pas seulement un ensemble de composants ou de règles : c’est un produit à part entière . Un produit pensé pour évoluer, répondre aux besoins des équipes, et accompagner la croissance de l’entreprise. Créer et faire vivre un Design System demande une vision , une stratégie claire , et une gouvernance solide . Il faut piloter son adoption, anticiper ses usages à grande échelle, et s’assurer qu’il réponde aux enjeux à la fois du Design et de la Tech. C’est un levier puissant pour faire monter en maturité les organisations, structurer la collaboration entre les équipes, et diffuser une culture produit forte. Aujourd'hui, un Design System bien structuré est aussi la condition sine qua non pour tirer pleinement parti de l'IA dans les workflows design et prototypage. Tokens cohérents, composants documentés, nomenclature rigoureuse autant de fondations qui permettent d'exploiter les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Lovable, v0...) de manière fiable et scalable. Le.la Design System Manager de demain est celui.celle qui anticipe ces usages et structure son système en conséquence. Les Design System Managers que nous recherchons pensent leur système comme un produit vivant, automatisé au maximum, et conçu pour connecter Design et Ingénierie dans un workflow sans friction . How we work together 🤝 Mettre en place des rituels d'adoption et d'amélioration continue :offices hours, sessions de feedback, contribution guidelines pour que le DS soit co-construit et adopté par toutes les équipes. Aligner Design et Engineering en continu : organiser des syncs réguliers avec les équipes dev pour garantir la cohérence entre les composants Figma et leur implémentation code. Le DS ne vit pas dans Figma seul; il vit dans la production. Piloter l'alignement stratégique multi-équipes : s'assurer que Produit, Tech, Design et business partagent la même vision et roadmap du DS, intégrée au même niveau que les autres produits. Répondre aux besoins des utilisateurs et contributeurs : centraliser les demandes, prioriser les évolutions, et faciliter la contribution fluide de designers, développeurs et PMs. Fédérer autour d'une culture DS partagée : faire du DS un produit vivant et co-créé, en favorisant des échanges transparents et en embarquant les équipes dans sa vision long terme How we get work done 🚀 Définir et piloter la roadmap du DS : feuille de route alignée sur les priorités produit et business, avec des objectifs mesurables à court et long terme. Automatiser les workflows du DS au maximum : pipelines de tokens, synchronisation design to code en temps réel, scripts de génération de documentation, réduire au minimum les tâches manuelles et les risques de désynchronisation. Structurer le DS pour l'IA et le prototypage rapide : concevoir une architecture de composants et de tokens qui rende le DS exploitable par les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable...). Cela implique : nomenclature stricte,variantes bien définies, props documentées, et une logique de composants qui s'aligne avec les patterns du code. Garantir la cohérence design-code : mettre en place des outils de vérification automatique pour s'assurer que ce qui est designé est bien ce qui est développé sans avoir à le vérifier manuellement. Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques à grande échelle : formations, ateliers, documentation vivante pour que le DS soit utilisé de manière fluide et scalable par toutes les équipes. Mesurer l'impact et itérer : KPIs d'adoption, indicateurs de qualité, retours qualitatifs pour évaluer l'impact du DS et ajuster les priorités How our work creates impact 🎯 Accélérer le delivery produit : composants prêts à l'emploi, pipelines automatisés et prompts IA calibrés sur le DS. Les équipes conçoivent et développent plus vite, avec moins de friction Rendre le prototypage IA fiable et scalable : un DS bien structuré devient le langage commun entre les designers et les outils d'IA les prototypes générés sont cohérents avec la prod, pas jetables Garantir la qualité et la cohérence design à l'échelle : expérience utilisateur homogène, identité de marque renforcée, dette design et technique réduite Réduire la dette et simplifier la maintenance : moins de doublons, moins de variantes inutiles, un code plus accessible et plus performant Faire monter l'organisation en maturité design : culture de collaboration Design × Tech structurée, vision stratégique du design renforcée, documentation vivante comme levier de montée en compétence Compétences 💼 Vision système et stratégie DS : u sais définir une stratégie de DS et la décliner en roadmap concrète, en alignement avec les priorités produit, tech et business. Tu fais preuve de leadership pour porter cette vision et embarquer les équipes. Alignement Design-Engineering : tu as une solide compréhension des enjeux front-end (tokens, design-to-code, systèmes de composants) et tu dialogues en égal avec les développeurs pas seulement pour les convaincre, mais pour co-construire les bonnes solutions. Automatisation et tooling DS : tu maîtrises les pipelines de tokens, les outils de documentation (Storybook, Zeroheight) et tu as une appétence pour l'automatisation des workflows DS. IA et prototypage avancé : tu comprends comment un DS structuré permet de tirer parti des outils d'IA générative pour le design et le prototypage. Tu anticipes ces usages dans les décisions d'architecture du DS. Gestion de produit interne : tu pilotes le DS comme un vrai produit : besoins utilisateurs, priorisation, KPIs, itération continue. Communication et influence : tu sais formuler des livrables synthétiques et stratégiques (vision, roadmap, modèles de gouvernance, dashboards) pour aligner des interlocuteurs variés équipes opérationnelles, direction produit, stakeholders. Outils : figma (Variables, Dev Mode, Make), Storybook, Zeroheight, Notion, Jira/Linear, Style Dictionary, et une bonne aisance avec les environnements no-code/low-code et outils IA de prototypage. Anglais courant : à l'écrit comme à l'oral Qualités 🌟 Tu penses en systèmes : tu comprends les logiques systémiques et sais structurer un DS cohérent, extensible, et exploitable par l'IA Tu automatises par réflexe : tu cherches à réduire les tâches manuelles et à construire des workflows robustes qui s'auto-maintiennent. Tu es le pont entre Design et Tech : tu parles les deux langages et tu sais créer les conditions d'un alignement durable entre les équipes. Tu portes une vision : tu es capable de convaincre, d'aligner et d'embarquer des designers comme des ingénieurs, des opérationnels comme des dirigeants. Tu pilotes ton DS comme un produit : besoins utilisateurs internes, KPIs, roadmap priorisée tu traites le DS avec la même rigueur qu'un produit client. Tu restes curieux·se et en veille : sur les outils, les pratiques et l'évolution rapide des Design Systems et des usages IA dans le design Expérience 📇 Tu as au moins 5 ans d'expérience en Product Design, Design System Management ou un rôle similaire, avec une trajectoire confirmée ou senior Tu as déjà créé ou fortement structuré un Design System de zéro ou à grande échelle , pas seulement contribué à l'un Tu as mis en place des pipelines de tokens, des processus d'automatisation et des intégrations design to code Tu as expérimenté avec des outils d'IA générative , dans un contexte design ou DS (Figma Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable, ou équivalent) Tu as travaillé aussi bien en scale-up qu'en grand groupe, ce qui te donne une bonne lecture des modèles d'organisation et des leviers pour faire évoluer la maturité design. Tu as travaillé en méthodologie agile et sais comment intégrer le DS dans ces processus de delivery. Ce que nous offrons 🎊 Un on-boarding pour rencontrer tes collègues De l’apprentissage avec minimum 5 jours de formations à l’année, des sessions de partage hebdomadaires et du contenu pour te faire monter en compétences Du mentoring sur ta mission par un pair plus confirmé Du confort avec deux jours de télétravail par semaine (selon ton client) complétés par un accès à un catalogue de matériels, ainsi qu’un Macbook Air ou un PC selon ta préférence. Du fun avec des Thigapéros, des Team building et un séminaire (en prêtant attention à notre empreinte carbone). Et pleins d’autres avantages comme une carte Swile, le remboursement de ton abonnement de transport à 50%/forfait mobilité durable, etc. Les étapes du process 🎢 Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec une membre de l’équipe Recrutement L'évaluation de ton portfolio par nos Designers Une rencontre avec un.e Principal, un.e Manager de la Tribe ou un Partner pour s’assurer que nous partageons les mêmes valeurs et ambitions Un entretien plus opérationnel avec un ou deux membres senior de notre équipe pour évaluer ta compréhension du rôle de Design System Manager, ta capacité à résoudre des problèmes liés au Design System, tes convictions, tes attentes, etc. Une dernière rencontre pour finaliser le process, s’accorder sur une ambition commune, des objectifs et un périmètre d’intervention 🤝 Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse ! title: Product Engineer, Shop
description: ABOUT INSIFY We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets. Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild. Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance. About the role You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers. The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people. Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows. As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together. You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth. What you'll be doing Owning end-to-end the discovery and delivery of crucial platform features that enable our ability to scale as an insurance business Continuously and relentlessly seeking opportunities to turn new product demands into platform capabilities and features that scale across countries and insurance product lines Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others What you'll need 3+ years building complex web applications and services, with real production ownership Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your direct stack to get to results, be that data / backend / frontend You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt Strong fundamentals in domain-driven design & service oriented architecture Not all of the above are hard requirements. If you're strong on most of these and eager to grow into the rest, we'd still love to hear from you. Nice to have Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets Strong observability instincts. You know where things will break, and can help others learn that too Our stack TypeScript across the board, running on AWS (IaaC), in a single monorepo. If you have not worked with all of it, that is fine. We care more about how you reason about systems than about which tools you have used before. We offer Competitive compensation that reflects responsibility and impact. For this role the range is €65,000 to €85,000. Trust and autonomy. You'll have real ownership, room to make decisions, and space to shape your role as Insify evolves. Hybrid working. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year working from abroad, and 25 holiday days. Pension. We contribute 6% for you. Alleo budget. €50 net a month to spend on whatever you want, from the gym to takeaway. It rolls over if you don't use it. Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs, and coaching to go with them. A central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, whiteboards, and Friday drinks. Hardware & setup. A high-spec MacBook Pro, high-res monitors at the office, and comfortable ergonomic seating. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

et du réseau WPP</li> </ul> <p>Cette hybridation est la clé du succès : être à la fois moteur du business généré via l’écosystème partenaires et garant de la capacité des équipes à délivrer avec ces technologies.</p> <p><em>Dimension Business :</em></p> <ul> <li>Définit et déploie la stratégie de go-to-market et de marketing partenaires de VML Consulting avec ses partenaires technologiques stratégiques, afin de maximiser la valeur, la différenciation et le pipeline générés par l’écosystème,</li> <li>Construit et anime les plans d’affaires conjoints (joint business plans) avec chaque partenaire clé (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), en pilotant objectifs, jalons et indicateurs de performance partagés,</li> <li>Orchestre le co-selling et le co-marketing : aligne partenaires, équipes commerciales et Business Units pour transformer les opportunités de l’écosystème en deals, du sourcing à la conversion,</li> <li>Conçoit et orchestre le plan d’événements dédiés ou co-construits avec les partenaires (webinaires, ateliers, salons, temps forts commerciaux), afin de générer visibilité, demande et pipeline,</li> <li>Met en œuvre, en continu, l’excellence de la démarche partenaires via les processus et outils internes ainsi que les portails partenaires, à des fins de visibilité, de pilotage et d’animation globale en interne,</li> <li>Sécurise et défend les intérêts économique et contractuel de VML Consulting dans le cadre des accords de partenariat (referral, reselling, MDF, niveaux de partenariat),</li> <li>Pilote le niveau de préférence et de
