priorités business et des engagements pris auprès des partenaires,</li> <li>Veille à la disponibilité et à la capitalisation des assets conjoints (cas clients, références, supports de co-vente) et au partage des retours d’expérience.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong><strong>Profil recherché</strong></p> <p>Vous justifiez de 5 à 10 ans d’expérience, dont une expérience significative en alliances / partenariats technologiques, channel ou business development – idéalement acquise en cabinet de conseil, ESN, agence ou chez un éditeur / hyperscaler.</p> <p>Notre croissance reposant sur un écosystème de partenaires technologiques (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), vous maîtrisez les mécaniques de co-selling, de co-marketing et de joint business planning.</p> <p>Vous pouvez justifier de contributions ou de succès significatifs dans le cadre d’initiatives partenaires ou de développement business, au-delà d’en comprendre la logique ou les bonnes pratiques.</p> <p>Votre capacité à nouer des relations de grande qualité, tant avec les équipes partenaires (alliance managers, channel, avant-vente) qu’avec les décideurs internes (Directions commerciales, Business Units, Marketing), fait de vous un orchestrateur d’écosystème performant, du sourcing d’opportunités à la conclusion de deals conjoints équilibrant les intérêts du partenaire, du client et de VML Consulting.</p> <p>Les enjeux des plateformes technologiques et de l’écosystème IA / data / commerce vous passionnent, et vous savez vous appuyer sur vos expériences pour bâtir un discours solide en interne comme auprès des partenaires.</p> <p>Votre rigueur et votre curiosité font de vous un acteur à la fois à l’aise dans la logique de développement business sur des clients <li>Soirées et team building réguliers</li> </ul> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</strong></p> <p>Intégrer VML Consulting, c’est choisir d’évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, humain et title: Care Expert – Medizincontrolling & Pflegedokumentation Krankenhaus (m/w/d)
description: 🎤 WARUM voize? WEIL ES UM MEHR GEHT ALS EINEN JOB. Bei voize glauben wir: Das Wertvollste, was wir Menschen in der Pflege geben können, ist Zeit. Zeit für Zuwendung, für Gespräche, fürs Dasein. Heute geht genau diese Zeit in Verwaltungsarbeit und komplexen Systemen verloren. Das wollen wir ändern: mit KI-Begleitern, die digitale Abläufe im Hintergrund übernehmen. Wir ersetzen keine Menschen durch Technik, wir verstärken ihre Wirkung. Hinter unserer Mission steht eine Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar unter Führung von Balderton Capital, gemeinsam mit HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Über 2.000 Einrichtungen vertrauen heute auf voize, mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen entlastet unser KI-Begleiter im Alltag. Wir verbinden erstklassige Technologie mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Nutzen. Und jetzt suchen wir dich. 💡 DEINE MISSION Im Krankenhaus dokumentieren Pflegekräfte mit voize direkt am Bett. Die freigegebenen Einträge landen strukturiert im KIS, über unsere Integration mit ORBIS U von Dedalus. Damit ist Pflegedokumentation nicht nur Grundlage guter Pflege, sondern auch Grundlage für Kodierung, Abrechnung und MD-Prüfungen. Abgerechnet werden kann nur, was belegt ist. Genau hier brauchen wir deinen Blick aus dem Medizincontrolling. Als Care Expert berätst du Kliniken, wie ihre Pflegedokumentation aufgebaut sein muss, damit erbrachte Leistungen vollständig und prüfsicher in der Akte stehen. Mit den strengeren MD-Prüfquoten ab 2027 wird das für viele Häuser zur wirtschaftlichen Frage. Du arbeitest auf Augenhöhe mit Medizincontrolling, Pflegedirektion, Stationsleitungen und Klinik-IT. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich darin, dass Pflegekräfte Zeit gewinnen und die Dokumentation zugleich den Anforderungen von Kodierung und Prüfung standhält. 🚀 DEIN ALLTAG Dokumentation verstehen, bevor es zählt: Vor dem Go-live analysierst du mit Medizincontrolling, Pflege und Klinik-IT, wie die Pflegedokumentation im KIS aufgebaut ist, von Assessments wie ePA-AC und Barthel über LEP-Maßnahmen bis zu Vitalwerten, Bilanzierung und Wunddokumentation. Die Erlös- und Prüfperspektive einbringen: Du zeigst, welche pflegerischen Inhalte für die Rechtfertigung der Verweildauer, Nebendiagnosen, Komplexbehandlungen wie die geriatrische frührehabilitative Komplexbehandlung und die MD-Prüfung relevant sind, und wo heute Informationen auf dem Weg in die Akte verloren gehen. Zwischen Pflege, Medizincontrolling und System übersetzen: Anforderungen aus Kodierrichtlinien und Prüfverfahren machst du für Pflegeteams greifbar, und Pflegealltag für das Medizincontrolling. Wirkung sichtbar machen: Gemeinsam mit den Kliniken legst du fest, woran sich Dokumentationsqualität messen lässt, und unterstützt bei ROI-Workshops mit Geschäftsführung und Medizincontrolling. Sauber einordnen: Läuft etwas nicht wie erwartet, findest du heraus, ob es an der KIS-Konfiguration, am Prozess auf Station oder am Produkt liegt. Deine Einschätzung geht klar an Customer Success, Support und Product, und du bringst die Sicht des Medizincontrollings in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Krankenhaus-Produkts ein. Kliniken begleiten: Remote und bei Bedarf vor Ort begleitest du Einführungen über den Go-live hinaus, eng abgestimmt mit dem zuständigen Customer Success Manager. Wissen aufbauen, das skaliert: Gemeinsam mit dem Team entwickelst du Playbooks, Checklisten und interne Enablements für den Krankenhausbereich, etwa zu DRG-Grundlagen und MD-Prüfungen für unsere Kolleg:innen. 🤝 DEIN PROFIL Du hast mindestens eine Weiterbildung zur Medizinischen Kodierfachkraft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und Praxis im Medizincontrolling eines Krankenhauses. Erfahrung als Medizincontroller:in ist ein großes Plus. Du bist sicher im aG-DRG-System, in ICD-10-GM, OPS und den Deutschen Kodierrichtlinien und kennst die Abläufe rund um MD-Prüfungen und die Prüfverfahrensvereinbarung aus eigener Fallbearbeitung. Idealerweise bringst du einen pflegerischen Grundberuf mit, etwa in der Gesundheits- und Krankenpflege, und weißt, wie Dokumentation auf Station wirklich entsteht. Du hast mit einem KIS gearbeitet, am liebsten mit ORBIS von Dedalus. Pflegerische Assessments und Leistungserfassung wie ePA-AC oder LEP sind dir vertraut oder du arbeitest dich schnell ein. Systeme sind für dich Werkzeug, kein Hindernis. Du denkst in Abhängigkeiten und Ursachen und bleibst dran, bis du verstehst, warum etwas so ist. Du erklärst Komplexes einfach, einer Pflegedirektion genauso wie einer Pflegekraft im Spätdienst oder der Geschäftsführung einer Klinik. Du arbeitest gern beratend und strukturiert. Du gibst klare Empfehlungen und vertrittst sie auch. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Auf Englisch solltest du dich sicher verständigen können, weil ein Teil der internen Zusammenarbeit auf Englisch läuft. Du bist gern bei unseren Kunden. Termine vor Ort gehören regelmäßig dazu, der Großteil deiner Arbeit läuft remote. 🌱 GEMEINSAM WACHSEN – DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI voize Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Startup. Du übernimmst neue Themen, wächst schnell und bewirkst etwas, das Pflegekräften mehr Zeit für die Menschen gibt. Du gestaltest mit: Unser Krankenhausbereich wächst gerade, und du prägst, wie wir Kliniken fachlich begleiten. Wir leben eine offene, kollaborative Kultur mit regelmäßigen Team-Events, ob du aus unserem Berliner Office arbeitest oder remote aus Deutschland. Mit Stock Options wirst du Teil unseres Erfolgs. 30 Urlaubstage plus dein Geburtstag frei, Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club, regelmäßige Company-Offsites sowie Zugang zu Lernplattformen wie Blinkist und Audible. Du entscheidest, wann du am besten arbeitest: flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein gutes Hybrid-Setup. ✨ LUST AUF EIN GESPRÄCH? JETZT BEWERBEN. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen, ganz gleich, wer du bist und welchen Hintergrund du mitbringst. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. Job Description 🎯 You will be a trusted legal partner to our Product and R&D leadership and teams, as our privacy and product counsel. As such you will specifically be supporting our Product and R&D teams, developing further our readiness for AI regulation and advising on wider digital regulatory requirements, to allow n8n to keep building and be early. You will also help shape a modern, AI-first legal strategy as part of a growing Legal team, and bring your product insight to the technology and commercial deals where it makes the difference. You will report to the General Counsel. What success looks like after 6 months: you are the go-to legal partner in Product and R&D roadmap, you design and launch reviews, our AI regulation readiness plan is in place with clear owners, and templates and playbooks are updated so the wider Legal team can run standard deals without R&D and Product related escalation. title: Senior Security Engineer
description: About Kestra Kestra is the universal orchestration platform : open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems. Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide , including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole , Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community. About the role Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise. You would be our first dedicated security hire. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem. This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one. What you would do Your first six months would focus on the first three points below. The rest is where the role grows. Conduct hands-on penetration testing and threat modeling across our web application, APIs, control plane, and cloud environments. Manage end-to-end vulnerability tracking across our codebases, software dependencies (SCA), container images, and cloud infrastructure. Proactively fix security flaws by writing patches, submitting Pull Requests (PRs), or collaborating directly with product teams to guide remediation. Audit and harden our cloud infrastructure (GCP, Kubernetes clusters, and networking configurations) against external and internal threats. Automate security tooling into our CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, dependency scanners) to catch CVEs before code reaches production. Perform security code reviews and evaluate third-party dependencies, open-source integrations, and supply-chain risks. Lead incident response efforts and establish continuous monitoring, detection, and mitigation strategies. Own our public security posture as an open-source project: vulnerability disclosure process, CVE handling, security advisories, and the trust model of our plugin ecosystem. Our Tech Stack Security & Vulnerability Tools : Trivy, GitHub Security / Dependabot, Elastic Security Infrastructure : Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform Cloud : GCP Programming language : Java, Typescript, Javascript Datastore : PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch Queuing : Redis, Kafka, AMQP Monitoring & Logs : ELK, Prometheus, Grafana Deployment & Repository : GitHub Actions, ArgoCD What we are looking for 5+ years of experience in Security Engineering, Product Security, DevSecOps, or a combined Offensive/Defensive role. Strong hands-on penetration testing background , with proven ability to discover application, API, and network-level vulnerabilities. A builder/fixer mindset : You don't just export scanner PDFs; you can read code, understand exploits, write fixes, or provide clear remediation steps to engineers. Deep familiarity with cloud security (AWS or GCP) and containerized environments ( Kubernetes , Docker). Experience with dependency and supply-chain security (CVE management, open-source licensing, SCA tools). Fluent in English and comfortable working autonomously in a fully remote environment. Adaptability to a fast-paced open-source startup environment where pragmatism and execution speed matter. Perks & Benefits Work from anywhere : We’re a remote-first company, so you can work from wherever feels like home. Plus, you’ll have access to coworking spaces worldwide if you ever need a change of scenery. Health coverage : From medical support, dental, and vision, we've got you covered. Home office setup on us : We’ll provide all the equipment you need to work comfortably. Our Hiring Process We aim to move quickly (2-3 weeks), but we can adjust the timeline if needed. Intro call with the hiring manager (30 min) Technical scenario / Practical assessment (2 hours, asynchronous homework focusing on threat assessment and remediation) Team chat with one of your future colleagues (30 min) Final discussion with one of our co-founders (30 min) Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>Location Details:</strong><strong> </strong></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW17650590 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW17650590 BCX0" data-ccp-charstyle="fontsizemedium" data-ccp-charstyle-defn="{"ObjectId":"a03eff66-18a4-42f1-a043-7a850b78d3ba|148","ClassId":1073872969,"Properties":[469775450,"fontsizemedium",201340122,"1",134233614,"true",469778129,"fontsizemedium",335572020,"1",469778324,"Default Paragraph Font"]}">At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.​</span></span></p> <p>This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.  </p> <p><strong>Join Our Team…</strong></p> <p>GoDaddy's Global Storage Engineering team operates one of the largest Ceph environments in the industry, powering the object, block, and file storage platforms that underpin hosting, applications, internal infrastructure, and next-generation AI/HPC workloads. If you're passionate about distributed systems, large-scale storage architecture, and solving complex reliability challenges, you'll work on infrastructure that few engineers ever experience. </p> <p>At GoDaddy, Ceph isn't a side project — it's a critical platform. Our environment spans 80+ production clusters, 20,000+ OSDs, and approximately 300 PB of raw storage capacity, supporting tens of billions of objects across multiple continents. The scale demands deep technical expertise in storage architecture, automation, observability, and performance engineering. </p> <p>As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you'll be a key technical owner of the platform, responsible for maintaining reliability, driving operational excellence, and influencing the future evolution of our storage ecosystem. You'll tackle challenging production problems, develop automation that operates at massive scale, contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with some of the industry's most experienced Ceph engineers. This is an opportunity to have direct impact on a storage platform that serves millions of customers worldwide. </p> <p><strong>What You'll Get to Do…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the reliability, performance, scalability, and capacity of large-scale production Ceph environments supporting object, block, and file storage workloads (RADOS, RGW, RBD, CephFS). </li> <li>Diagnose and resolve complex distributed systems issues including recovery/backfill events, OSD instability, PG imbalance, storage latency, and RGW performance bottlenecks. </li> <li>Design and build automation using Python, Shell, SaltStack, and Ansible to reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience at scale. </li> <li>Define and improve observability for the storage platform through SLIs, SLOs, PromQL, LogQL, Grafana dashboards, and proactive alerting strategies. </li> <li>Lead storage lifecycle initiatives including cluster expansions, hardware refreshes, software upgrades, OpenStack integrations, and large-scale migration projects. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Experience Should Include…</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years operating large-scale Linux infrastructure with significant experience supporting distributed storage systems in production environments. </li> <li>2+ years hands-on Ceph administration including OSD, MON, MDS, and RGW operations, CRUSH map management, pool design, placement groups, and performance troubleshooting. </li> <li>Strong understanding of Linux internals, storage architecture, networking, filesystems, block devices, and performance analysis under production workloads. </li> <li>Experience developing operational automation and tooling with Python, Shell, and configuration management platforms such as Ansible, SaltStack, Puppet, or Chef. </li> <li>Proven incident response expertise, including production troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, postmortem creation, and implementation of durable corrective actions. </li> </ul> <p><strong>You Might Also Have…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced Ceph expertise across RGW Multisite, CephFS, RBD Mirroring, erasure coding, and large-scale cluster design. </li> <li>Experience integrating storage platforms with OpenStack (Cinder, Nova, Neutron, Swift) or Kubernetes storage technologies (CSI, StorageClasses, Rook). </li> <li>Familiarity with modern observability platforms including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Grafana, and enterprise monitoring architectures. </li> <li>Experience planning and executing petabyte-scale storage migrations, capacity expansion programs, and title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
description: <h2>The role</h2> <p>As a <strong>Senior Marketing Data Analyst</strong> on our <strong>Pricing Analytics</strong> team within the Global <strong>Marketing Analytics</strong> organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.</p> <p>Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader <strong>Market Insights</strong> work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own price and discount experiments end to end</strong> — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.</li> <li><strong>Model how customers respond to price and promotions</strong> — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.</li> <li><strong>Apply causal inference</strong> — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.</li> <li><strong>Ship analysis as data products</strong> — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.</li> <li><strong>Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets</strong> that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.</li> <li><strong>Communicate complex technical findings</strong> as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing</strong> to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with and mentor analysts</strong> within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.</li> <li><strong>As scope grows</strong>, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring</h2> <ul> <li>A <strong>motivated, collaborative mindset</strong> with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.</li> <li><strong>4+ years of experience</strong> in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.</li> <li><strong>Strong SQL and Python</strong> (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.</li> <li>A foundation in <strong>experimental design and A/B testing</strong>, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.</li> <li>Working knowledge of <strong>causal inference and econometrics</strong> — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.</li> <li>Solid <strong>applied statistics</strong>, and familiarity with common <strong>machine-learning</strong> methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach German is a bonus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h2> <p><strong>3 months — </strong>You have mapped GMA's critical architectural dependencies and GenAI opportunities, conducted design reviews across multiple pillars, and established a point of view on the highest-leverage technical bets for the year.</p> <p><strong>6 months — </strong>Your architectural direction is reflected in roadmaps. You are the person leaders across HelloTech bring their hardest growth-engineering problems to.</p> <h2><strong>Why Work With Us</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Make an Impact: </strong>GMA's platforms touch every customer HelloFresh acquires and every euro it collects. description: <p>Scopely is looking for a QA Director to join our Stumble Guys team in our Barcelona or Dundee hubs, working in a hybrid mode 3 days from the hub.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. </p> <p>Stumble Guys is a global sensation, with millions of fans joining the party every single day and with the ambition of becoming nothing less than a beloved franchise to be played for many years to come.</p> <p><strong>What You Will Do </strong></p> <p>You will collaborate and coordinate with peers, senior management and external partners, to ensure operations are aligned with the departmental mission, values, and long-term strategic goals as well as ensuring continued service improvements are implemented throughout the world on behalf of Scopely QA & Deployment. </p> <p>You will help shape the future on how we continue to iterate and evolve our products at a high level, while ensuring our products delight our players release after release. Day to day responsibilities may include:</p> <ul> <li>Lead an ambitious Mobile and Console QA & Deployment Program involving multiple disciplines, including Functionality QA, Dev QA, Live-Ops QA, Build Distribution and Submissions across all platforms</li> <li>Manage and provide leadership, technical expertise and career development for multiple QA & Deployment Project Owners; support the skillset growth across the QA & Deployment crafts, leading to higher value individual contributors and managers</li> <li>Build on existing team metrics for measurement of quality and operational excellence and a consistent, regular process for assessment and improvements</li> <li>Manage day-to-day relationships with external QA vendors, aligning priorities, capacity and deliverables with project needs; assess vendor performance against agreed quality and delivery targets and drive improvement actions</li> <li>Be an advocate and spokesperson for Automation Engineering efforts and AI implementation into QA pipelines. the ability to view situations from a business perspective</li> <li>Proficient with setting up and navigating through bug database management, test case management tools, Google Docs, Google Sheets/Excel, and a build distribution management system (AppLivery), JIRA</li> <li>Mobile Freemium/F2P gaming experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Console and PC deployment & compliance.</li> <li>Any experience with Localization, LQA, build distribution and submissions </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. title: Director of Field Operations (f/m/d)
description: We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you. Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter. Help us see what's possible. Join us. Your Role You will own how Orbem shows up at customer sites — installing, servicing, and maintaining multi-million-euro imaging systems that sit at the heart of our customers’ production lines. When our systems run, our customers run. When they don’t, the cost is measured in lost production days. Field Operations is where our technology meets reality, and you own that interface. Field Operations spans Europe and the US, with regional teams on both sides of the Atlantic. A lot has already been built: dedicated Field Engineers and Project Managers, regional leadership, and real investment in SOPs, planning, and tooling. The next step is maturity — turning what exists into an operation that runs consistently across every site, every partner, and every geography, and that scales without depending on individual heroics. You inherit that and the mandate to shape what comes next. We are expanding fast into new verticals and geographies, and installation and service quality is one of the few things that can either unlock or throttle that growth. This is a role for someone equally at home setting the operating model and being close to the work itself — credible with a customer's engineers and with our executive team on the same day — and who is unwilling to let the same problem happen twice. Your Day to Day Running Operations (≈ 40%) Own end-to-end delivery of installations, on-site service, and scheduled maintenance across Europe and the US — on time, on budget, and at a quality level appropriate to assets worth more than €1M each. Empower and enable Regional Leaders and Project Managers to flawlessly orchestrate complex site deliveries involving customers, MRI suppliers, and automation partners. Be the escalation point that actually resolves things — including on site, out of hours, when a go-live is at risk. Own the operational KPIs and the commitments we make to customers, and keep Technical Customer Support, Business Development, and the executive team informed. Building the Operating System (≈ 35%) Raise SOP maturity — across our own team, our partners, and our customers’ contractors. Implement a continuous improvement engine together with the Operational Excellence team. Leverage and drive the tooling and data we need to run this at scale — field service management, installation and service documentation, spare parts and capacity planning — and make sure people actually use it. Build the quality and safety standards our engineers work to, and hold the line on them under schedule pressure. Leading and Scaling the Team (≈ 25%) Lead and develop the whole team — Field Engineers, Project Managers, and regional leads alike — building the depth and ownership that lets each region run well without you in the detail. Design the organisation ahead of the growth curve: hire, structure, and re-structure as we add verticals and geographies, and find the right mix of own team, partner networks, and variable capacity models to absorb fluctuating demand. Define and operationalize the Field Operations roadmap, and translate it into a capacity and hiring plan the business can commit to. Build the culture: high standards, low ego, no blame, and a bias toward fixing things properly. How You Fit In You report to the Chief Operating Officer and lead Field Operations through two regional team leads, with Field Engineers delivering installation, on-site service, and maintenance work and Project Managers coordinating customers, partners, and internal teams. The team will keep growing as we roll out new geographies and products. You work closely with Technical Customer Support, Operational Excellence, Supply Chain, Hardware, Product, and Business Development, and you own our operational relationship with our equipment and automation partners. You are part of the wider operations leadership team and contribute to decisions well beyond your own function. Your Experiences and Skills 10+ years in field or service operations. You have led installation, on-site service, and maintenance operations for complex technical products. Hardware plus service business models. You understand a business where the machine is only half the promise and installation, uptime, and maintenance are the other half. Experience at operational scale. You have worked inside an organisation that had already solved this properly — mature SOPs, field service tooling, quality processes, clear team structures — and you know what “good” actually looks like, not just in theory. Multi-region leadership. You have built and led geographically distributed teams and developed team leads into strong operational leaders. Hands-on and strategic. You can design the operating model and the roadmap, and you will also get on a plane and stand on a site on short notice when the situation calls for it. Continuous improvement as a reflex. You see every error as an opportunity and an obligation to be better next time, and you have the methods to back that up. Technical fluency. You can engage credibly on site planning, requirement specifications, and installation and commissioning detail, and hold your own with engineers, suppliers, and customers’ technical teams. Drive and proactiveness. You move before being asked, chase ambiguity down rather than escalating it up, and you are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information. Senior communicator. You build trust with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, and you can deliver difficult messages without damaging the relationship. Practicalities. Willingness to travel to European and US sites, and an EU Class B driver’s licence. Fluent in English; additional languages (German, Spanish, Italian, French) are a plus. What Makes You Stand Out Experience in a venture-capital-backed, private-equity-backed or similarly execution-driven environment, where operational discipline, cost, and delivery commitments were tracked seriously. You have taken a field operations function through a step change in scale — doubling geographies, product lines, or installed base — and can describe what broke and what you did about it. Formal continuous improvement or quality credentials (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent) that you have actually applied to a service organisation. Hands-on experience implementing field service management or service data tooling, including getting a team to adopt it. Experience in a high-growth deep-tech or capital-equipment company, where the product was still changing underneath the operation. You are obsessed with customer experience and can point to the operational choices you made to protect it. What We Offer International Environment: Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges. Comprehensive Benefits: Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success. Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany. Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth. Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club, Wellhub or Wellpass. Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees. Deutschland Ticket: Full coverage of public transportation. Work-Life Integration: Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you. WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us! 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge. Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments. Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year. Make a Difference: Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you. Your Team: You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/ At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway! We have PMF and are doubling revenue every month. We have far more demand than we can handle. About the role I'm Sacha, Chief of Staff at Dataleap. I own our existing customers, and I need someone alongside me to make our current accounts win with Dataleap. This isn't a sales role. Your job is to make the customers we already have wildly successful, to walk into their organizations, find the people who want to build agents, and help them actually do it. You'll run adoption on the ground: sit with teams, understand their work, build agents alongside them, unblock them, and turn curious users into daily believers. When a customer succeeds, it's because you made it happen. We're building out our German office, and this is the moment to get in. You'll work directly with me and our team on the ground: real customers, real AI deployments, real ownership from week one. We're hiring for a full-time role in our Growth team, and we're flexible on how you start. Already have a few years under your belt? Join full-time. Still studying or just graduating? Start as a working student or intern and grow into the full-time role, with more ownership, bigger accounts and deeper work as you prove yourself. Either way, we're looking for someone who wants to stay and grow with us. This is your chance to show what you've got, and I'll make sure it's the fastest growth of your career. What you'll own Customer adoption. Drive real usage inside our existing accounts. Find the champions, enable them, and help them pay it forward across their org. Building agents alongside customers. Sit with their teams, understand the messy details of their work, and build agents in Dataleap that solve real problems. You prove the value by shipping it. Being the trusted partner. Become the person our customers love to have in the room, the one who gets their world, makes them better, and makes them feel taken care of. Training and enablement. Run workshops, hackathons, and hands-on sessions that turn non-technical teams into confident agent builders. Being the voice of the customer. Feed what you learn back to me, product, and engineering. Push hard for what our customers need. Automate your own role with Dataleap. We build AI employees for a living, and you'll live in the product you're helping customers adopt. Build agents that eliminate the manual parts of your own job instead of doing them by hand. Who you are Hungry and proactive. You don't wait to be told. You see what needs doing and you're already on it. Great with people. You're warm, confident, and easy to trust. You can walk into a room of people you've never met and have them rooting for you by the end. Someone customers fall for. The bar is simple: I want customers coming back to me saying "I love this person, what a great hire." You make people feel understood and supported. Super AI-native. You breathe AI. You build agents for everything and you're already living in these tools, not just exploring them. A culture carrier. You embody how we work and represent Dataleap brilliantly out in the world. High agency, low ego. There's unsexy work and you'll do it without flinching. You want to work hard and be part of something ambitious. You speak German at a native level and are fluent in English. Based in Munich or ready to move here. Final-year students and recent graduates welcome. How we work This is your life's work right now, and mine too. We operate like athletes: we take care of ourselves and our bodies, and we work hard and win. High standards, high output, no excuses, and we enjoy the ride together. What this is not Not a coffee-and-shadowing internship, you'll own real customer relationships from week one. Not a back-office role, you're in front of customers, in their offices, in the work. Not for someone who needs rigid structure or waits to be told what to do. What you get A front-row seat to how AI gets deployed inside real companies, at the absolute frontier. Direct work with me and exposure to our network at YC, Founders Inc, and CDTM. A real path to full-time: grow into a full-time role in the Growth team at Dataleap as we scale. Unlimited AI budget. We practice what we preach. Frequent proof that your work matters, straight from the customers you win over. How we hire (fast, ~2 weeks start to finish) Get to know me and our Chief of Staff (Sacha) A take-home on a real problem we're facing. Meet the team. Offer, and you're in. If this resonates, reach out. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Security Engineer
description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel. About the Role You'll be Vibe's founding security hire. Security has been part of how we build since day one and we're already SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, but nobody has owned it full-time. Ad spend and headcount have both roughly doubled every year since 2022, enterprise partnerships keep expanding, and the more visible Vibe becomes, the more scrutiny comes with it. Now it needs an owner. You'll define the risk model, set the roadmap, decide what we harden and what we accept, and turn policies into running procedures in code on the paths engineers and AI already use. That work happens in a cloud native ecosystem across AWS and GCP, with most of our services running on Kubernetes, everything as code and a GitOps deployment model. Reporting to our, Head of Infrastructure, and joining a lean six-person Infrastructure and IT team. You won't do it alone, but you'll be the main contributor, and the person every team turns to on security. Since we joined forces with Walmart, you'll also coordinate directly with their cloud security teams. What You'll Do Risk & Governance Map Vibe's risk model across every major system. Set the security roadmap with clear priorities. Security Engineering Pave the road with guardrails and secure defaults enforced across the engineering tool set. Ship the golden paths so the safe way is the easy one. Harden security across our cloud native ecosystem (AWS and GCP) and third-party providers. Own access management from onboarding to offboarding, and get it to the point where it runs without you. Detection & Response Prioritize vulnerability findings by real exposure, assign them to the team that owns the code, and follow remediation through to closure. Own security incident response from detection through resolution. Turn manual processes into pipelines that run on their own. Launch and run Vibe's private bug bounty program. Trust & Compliance Own SOC 2 compliance end to end and maintain current certification. Drive Vibe's future compliance initiatives and requirements. Define Vibe's security posture and make it self-serve so enterprise deals clear security without routing through you. Security Culture Set clear, practical rules for safe AI use, built into the tools themselves, covering both the AI we ship in our products and the AI our teams work with every day. Run security awareness training and measure behavior changes so the whole company raises its bar. What You Need Built a security function as a company's first security hire. Write code comfortably and bring deep cloud-native security experience. Managed a compliance framework at scale, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 or HIPAA. Managed AI security risk hands on, both in what a company ships with AI and in how its employees use it day to day. Nice to Haves Ran a private bug bounty program. Ad tech security background, including exposure to US privacy law (CCPA/CPRA, VPPA) in a data-heavy environment. Navigated security through a company acquisition. Our Values At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions. You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort. This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast. If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you. What We Offer The pay range for this role is €127,000-€171,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates. At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up: Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals. Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week! Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan. Meal vouchers — Via Swile. Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip. Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide. Our Interview Process We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, technical background, and approach to the role. Technical Assessment — 90 minutes. A deeper technical conversation covering core engineering skills, problem-solving, and a technical use case relevant to the role. Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions. Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit. Equal Opportunity Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know. Referral Instructions Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Mechanical Forward Deployed Engineer - Switzerland
description: <h3><strong>About CoLab</strong></h3> <p>At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.</p> <p>We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.</p> <p>Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a<a href="https://financialpost.com/pmn/business-wire-news-releases-pmn/ai-is-changing-engineering-colab-just-raised-72m-to-lead-the-transformation"> $72M Series C</a>, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (<a href="https://financialpost.com/pmn/business-wire-news-releases-pmn/colab-ranked-number-57-fastest-growing-company-in-north-america-on-the-2025-deloitte-technology-fast-500">Fast 500™</a>), signed multi-year<a href="https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-bombardier-signs-contract-colab-ai-software/"> AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier</a>, and grown to a team of 250+.</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>This is a high-impact role that helps define how CoLab delivers technical value to its most strategic customers in Aerospace and Defence. CoLab is a category-creating product, which means adoption isn't just a rollout. It's a change in how the organization works.</p> <p>In this role, you'd act as a trusted advisor, leveraging people, process, and technology to help teams rethink how they manage feedback, data, and decision-making across design and PLM. That means getting deep into customer workflows, testing new ways of working, and building repeatable methods the rest of the team can scale.</p> <p>You'll work alongside a Customer Success Manager, and use what you learn on the front line to help shape product direction. This role isn't about selling or pitching. It's about deeply understanding engineering problems and solving them alongside the customer.</p> <p>We are looking for a candidate in Switzerland to work regularly on-site with local CoLab customers.</p> <h2>Our Ideal Candidate</h2> <p>You’re a mechanical engineer by trade and have worked as a designer in an A&D company. You also understand the full product development life cycle: how design, manufacturing, quality, and engineering leadership depend on each other, and where collaboration breaks down. You can coach those teams toward working together better.</p> <p>You know how to improve that life cycle with technology. Maybe you’ve championed internal tools or created automation or scripts.</p> <p>You also know a process that makes sense on paper won’t get adopted on its own. You can meet people where they are, including the stakeholders who don’t want to change.</p> <p>You don’t need to be the loudest voice in the room, but you can run a sprint and lead a cross-functional project. If the average person might find this job too undefined or complex, that probably excites you.</p> <h2>Job Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Mapping a customer's current-state design review and title: Stage M2 : Recherche en optique non linéaire appliquée à la caractérisation de dispositifs électroniques neuromorphiques - 6 mois
description: Mines Saint-Etienne est une Ecole de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe public d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France. L’IMT est un EPSCP (grand établissement) sous la tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté Industrielle et Numérique. L’École Nationale Supérieure des Mines de Saint-Étienne (Mines Saint-Etienne) est chargée de missions de formation, de recherche et d’innovation, de transfert vers l’industrie et de culture scientifique, technique et industrielle. Mines Saint-Etienne représente: 2 400 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation, 480 personnels (150 Chercheurs et Enseignants-chercheurs), un budget consolidé de 46 M€, 3 campus dédiés à l’industrie à Saint-Etienne et Lyon (région AURA), à la microélectronique et aux objets connectés à Gardanne (Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence, région SUD) et à l’ingénierie pour la santé à Saint-Etienne ; 6 unités de recherche ; 5 centres de formation et de recherche ; un centre de culture scientifique technique et industrielle leader en France « La Rotonde » (> 50 000 visiteurs / an). Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage : Des dispositifs d’électronique organique ultra-flexibles, conformables et implantables incorporant une intelligence artificielle promettent de révolutionner la surveillance et le traitement en temps réel de maladies chroniques [1]. De tels systèmes pourraient être basés sur des transistors organiques électrochimiques (OECTs), exploitant des conducteurs polymères mixtes ion-électron (PMIECs) comme couches actives. En effet, les PMIECs sont apparus comme une excellente plateforme matérielle pour interfacer la biologie avec l’électronique conventionnelle ; identifié comme le domaine de la « bioélectronique organique ou plastique ». L’OECT est considéré comme l’éléments clé pour réaliser une telle interface [2]. Son efficacité est évaluée suivant des figures de mérite (FoMs) telles que i) la transconductance (gm), et/ou ii) les temps de commutation (ionique vs. électronique) dans le dispositif. Au-delà des applications de transduction, à court terme, l’OECT est aussi intéressant pour créer des applications émergentes en matière de circuits neuromorphiques bioélectroniques [3]. La réalisation de tels circuits est freinée par un manque de compréhension et d’optimisation des processus de conduction mixte dans ces matériaux polymériques ; notamment une asymétrie des temps de commutation des transistors lors des séquences de dopage (i.e « ON ») vs dédopage (i.e « OFF ») dans le canal de l’OECT. Des outils de caractérisation in-situ & operando permettant de quantifier et cartographier les paramètres de transduction électronique et électrochimique dans le canal de l’OECT se révèlent être indispensables pour comprendre les limitations actuelles en performances des PMIECs et/ou pour construire des PMIECs optimums dans de tels circuits neuromorphiques. Dans ce contexte scientifique, le.la stagiaire développera une nouvelle mesure de spectroscopie et instrumentation d’optique non linéaire, appelée microscopie par génération de second harmonique résolue en temps, afin d’enregistrer le mouvement spatio-temporel des espèces chargées, ion et électrons (ou trous), et ainsi donc cartographier les mobilités électroniques in-situ & operando le canal de l’OECT. La.le stagiaire fabriquera ces dispositifs OECTs en salle blanche de microélectronique, et bénéficiera d’un accompagnement technique pour leur réalisation. Il.elle enregistrera et analysera les FoMs clés grâce à l'expérimentation d’optique non linéaire développée et aux caractérisations électriques et électrochimiques afin d’établir, de manière plus globale, des règles d’ingénierie dans ces PMIECs qui serviront de socle de connaissances incontournables à l’avenir, pour mettre en œuvre et appliquer des circuits neuromorphiques à base d'OECTs, comme première brique d’une intelligence artificielle d’électronique organique. Pour aller plus loin : [1] https://iconic.mines-stetienne.fr/ [2] https://doi.org/10.1038/ s43586-021-00065-8 [3] https://www.nature.com/articles/s41578-023-00622-5 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous La candidate ou le candidat devra être en cours de formation et d’apprentissage d’un diplôme de Master 2 ou de 3ème année de diplôme d’ingénieurs en Techniques Optiques et Instrumentations. La candidate ou le candidat devra disposer d’une culture solide en Physique/ Science des Matériaux/ (Opto)Électronique par sa formation initiale et/ou son expérience professionnelle. Ce sujet de stage M2 Recherche a vocation d’être poursuivi en cycle de doctorat. Seul.e un.e étudiant.e intéressé.e pour continuer en doctorat sera donc retenu.e pour ce stage. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Les principaux critères d’évaluation du candidat seront les suivants (liste non exhaustive) : Maitrise technique et scientifique en Optique. Des expériences lors de précédents stages en optique non linéaire et/ou microscopie, analyse d’images par caméra scientifique sera considéré comme avantageuses, Maitrise d’instrumentation électronique (caméra sCMOS, oscilloscope, générateur de signaux et à délai, SMU,…) et d’analyse d’images sous ordinateur (Python, …), Aptitudes pour le travail interdisciplinaire et les collaborations pluridisciplinaires. The department has a strong knowledge in the field of material and interface electrical and mechanical characterization. The activities of the department are regrouped in the 660m2-area platform. title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
description: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability. Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain. This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing. The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains. A major aspect of the PhD will be the development of system-level evaluation and benchmarking methodologies within a design-technology co-optimization (DTCO/SDTCO) framework. The objective is to provide quantitative and objective metrics for decision-making, including scalability analysis, computational throughput, and energy efficiency for target AI workloads. These evaluations will support both intermediate design exploration and the potential experimental validation of fabricated demonstrators within the broader program. In addition, the PhD will address electronic circuit design challenges associated with photonic accelerators, including interface circuits for control, programming of PCM elements, optical-to-electrical readout, and signal conversion. These aspects are critical for ensuring the practical integration of photonic computing units within heterogeneous AI hardware systems. The expected outcome is a set of novel architectures, models, and evaluation tools that will clarify the potential and limitations of silicon photonics for next-generation AI accelerators, and provide guidelines for scalable and energy-efficient implementations. Background: The candidate should hold or be about to obtain an MSc in Electronics Engineering, Photonics, or Computer Engineering. A strong background in computer architecture, integrated circuits, or photonic systems is expected. Knowledge of AI hardware accelerators, in-memory computing, or silicon photonics will be appreciated. Environment: The PhD will be carried out at the INL laboratory, within the CAMELIA program, as part of the LEAF project, in collaboration between leading academic and institutional partners in AI hardware and photonics. title: Security Engineer
description: ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”. In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”. 85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz. Seit über einem Vierteljahrhundert arbeiten wir für das „Who’s Who“ der deutschen und europäischen Industrie- und Handelsunternehmen. Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr. Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz. Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”. Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat. Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein. Technology never rests. Neither do we. ÜBER DEINEN JOB Wir sind der festen Überzeugung, dass Sicherheit ein technisches Thema ist. Deshalb glauben wir, dass nur ein echter Engineer für die Sicherheit bei freiheit.com verantwortlich sein kann. Nur wenn Du weißt, wie die Dinge funktionieren, kannst Du Prozesse und Richtlinien entwerfen, um uns und unsere Daten sicher und geschützt zu halten. Du entwirfst und implementierst die Infrastruktur, damit Du einfache, aber dennoch zuverlässige und sichere Prozesse sowie Richtlinien einführen kannst. Da Du von Herzen Engineer bist, schreibst Du Code, um manuelle Aufgaben zu automatisieren. Du weißt sowieso, dass es der einzige Weg ist. Du bist aber auch für unser ISMS (Information Security Management System) verantwortlich und sorgst dafür, dass dieses stets auf dem neuesten Stand ist und die Regeln und Vorschriften im ISMS sinnvoll und hilfreich sind. Ebenso arbeitest Du mit unserem Datenschutzbeauftragten zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass wir die DSGVO einhalten. Du stärkst unsere Mitglieder auch, indem Du ihnen Sicherheit beibringst. Sowohl durch die Gestaltung von Schulungen als auch durch die Unterstützung bei der Schaffung einer sicheren Infrastruktur in ihren Projekten. Das Jobprofil ist eine tolle Chance für Software Engineers, die ihr Spektrum in Richtung Sicherheit und Compliance erweitern und zudem strategisch arbeiten möchten. Wir glauben auch, dass eine kleine Dosis Zwangsstörung hilfreich sein könnte ;-). Zumindest solltest Du den starken Willen haben, die Dinge richtig zu machen, und sehr sorgfältig bei Deiner Arbeit sein. ÜBER DICH Qualifikationen: Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik oder verwandten Bereichen wie Mathematik, Physik oder Elektrotechnik Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes Erfahrung in der UNIX-Systemadministration und Networking Programmiererfahrung – idealerweise in Go Hoher Einfluss auf den technischen Erfolg Deiner vergangenen Projekte Die Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mind. C1) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. Bonus Skills and Interessen: Master oder Doktortitel in Informatik oder verwandten Bereichen wie Mathematik oder Physik Erfahrung in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS) oder Microsoft Azure Erfahrung mit Observability (Protokollierung, Überwachung, Alarmierung, Rückverfolgung) Erfahrung mit Security Erfahrung im Umgang mit verteilten Systemen in der Cloud (Terraform) Erfahrung im Einrichten von CI/CD-Pipelines ÜBER UNSERE COMMUNITY Auf die Frage, warum jemand hier arbeitet, lautet die Antwort oft: „wegen der Menschen“ und „weil ich in meinem Leben noch nie so viel gelernt habe“. Wir glauben, dass produktive Menschen glückliche Menschen sind. In unseren Engineering Hubs in Hamburg und Lissabon triffst du auf Menschen aus der ganzen Welt. Hier hast du die Möglichkeit, mit intelligenten Menschen an spannenden Aufgaben zu arbeiten und Projekte von der Idee bis zur Auslieferung umzusetzen – end-to-end. Ein wahrer Experte in seinem Fachgebiet wird man nicht über Nacht – dazu braucht es Jahre harter Arbeit und kontinuierliches Lernen. Als ein Member unserer Community wird viel von dir verlangt, und niemand kann die Arbeit für dich übernehmen. Unser Unternehmen ist ein Ort, an dem du die beste Version deiner selbst werden kannst. ***Wir bieten keine reinen Remote-Stellen an. Wir arbeiten fünf Tage pro Woche im Büro. DAZUGEHÖREN? Dann schicke uns Deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse) über unser Bewerberportal. Und bei Fragen zu Deiner Bewerbung oder dem Bewerbungsprozess steht Dir Bianca Mioc unter +49 40/890584-0 persönlich zur Verfügung. title: Account Executive DACH - SMB (m/f/d)
description: About Agicap Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France. Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies. We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024. These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world. We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure! Home page Customer Stories Our Values About the Account Executive - SMB role: We are growing our team in Düsseldorf! Working closely with the Business Development team, Outbound SDRs, Inbound SDRs and Partnership Managers on a daily basis, your mission will be to generate new business by acquiring new clients. As an SMB Account Executive at Agicap, you will drive sales and expand our customer base within the SMB segment. You will play a crucial role in identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with potential clients and closing deals in order to achieve your sales targets. You will be responsible for: Defining and implementing a sectoral development strategy with your SDRs. Identifying and targeting SMB companies that could benefit from Agicap’s financial management solutions. Conducting product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value of Agicap’s offerings. Developing and maintaining a robust sales pipeline through prospecting, networking, and referrals. Building and nurturing relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within target organizations. Negotiating contracts and closing sales to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets. Staying informed about industry developments, competitor activities, and market trends. Regularly monitoring and analyzing your performance with Management to identify areas for improvement. Providing feedback to the Marketing, Business Development, and Product teams to improve processes and the product. Sharing your commercial expertise and good ideas to enhance the team’s performance. What we are looking for: Native/Bilingual level of German 2-4 years of experience in B2B Sales, preferably in the SaaS industry and with mid-market space, and with some experience working in a finance department/audit/consulting/TS. Studies background in a top business or Engineering school. A passion for sales and a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets. A tenacious, resilient salesperson who never gives up and is driven by results. Someone who can put themselves in the shoes of business leaders to understand their current and future cash flow needs. Strong analytical and synthesis skills, excellent verbal communication, and a high level of intellectual curiosity. Great ambition, with the drive to meet and even exceed objectives. A strong business acumen and above-average interpersonal skills. A team spirit and a desire to share knowledge, helping colleagues grow. 7 Reasons to Join Agicap as an AE: Exceptional product-market fit, confirmed by our latest funding round: Crucial need → cash = the lifeblood of business, top priority for CFOs (PwC) Strongly differentiated solution, leader in Europe (G2) Gigantic market: over 350k companies in DACH alone Unique company culture: meritocracy, high standards, continuous learning, European scale-up (>50% revenue outside France) Opportunities for functional and geographical growth Strong financial situation Team of rockstars, friendly and skilled A growth engine of a large Outbound SDR team, Inbound & Partner leads to help you scale fast! Competitive package - with uncapped commissions! Our benefits: - Competitive Compensation: Attractive package including both fixed and variable components. - Professional Development: Access a “Mini-MBA” with a focus on Finance & Treasury via the Agicap Academy. - Global Collaboration: Join a diverse international team with occasional trips to our headquarters in France. - Meal & Grocery Allowance: Receive up to €108/month tax-free for lunch or groceries, easily managed via the Hrmony app. - Tenure Rewards: Enjoy a €30 monthly shopping voucher after one year and up to two additional vacation days based on your length of service. - Team culture: Join us and be part of a dynamic environment, enjoying global offsites such as our recent annual seminar on a French island, as well as local team events. AGICAP is committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone, and we foster an inclusive work environment that values diversity! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager - Surveying & Mapping Drone
description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. Now we need someone to help decide what we build next. You’ll own the priorities for our data capture platform, from the aircraft to the sensors they carry. You’ll work side by side with customers in the field, Wingtra engineers and Wingtranauts across all business functions. Your job is to find the problems that matter most to our customers and turn good ideas into products people love. Inside Wingtra you’re the voice of the user. Outside you’re the voice of the product. Responsibilities Know your customers. You spend time with survey and mapping teams in the field. You learn how they work, how they buy, what else they could use and what they still can’t do. Set the priorities. You weigh customer value, market opportunity, development effort, price and margin. Then you make a clear call on what comes next. Test ideas early. You try them with customers and engineers, learn fast and adjust. Shape the product development. You steer the capture platform: aircraft, sensors, workflows and data deliverables. You make the performance, reliability and usability trade-offs together with engineering. Take it to market. You launch with Product Marketing, Sales, Support and partners and explain why the product matters. After launch you stay close to field results and keep supporting the product through its lifecycle. Follow the outcomes. You track customer outcomes, usage and commercial results. You use what you learn to pick the next problem to solve with the team. Requirements You have a taste for great products and a relentless drive to understand what makes users love them. You make things happen. You act like an owner and hold yourself accountable to outcomes not output. You care primarily about happy customers and a successful business. You bring people with you. You listen closely, speak clearly and earn trust with customers and engineers, including when you disagree. You find a way forward. You are very comfortable with ambiguity. You work constructively with people and constraints, know when to push and when to adapt. You’ve spent 3+ years developing or deploying hardware products and their software workflows, with clear ownership of product, operational or commercial results. You have a technical background in engineering, geospatial or another technical field. You’re commercially fluent. You read a pricing model, channel margin or renewal term and see why the business cares. You’re fluent in English and happy to travel regularly to customers and partners in the US and Europe. Plus You’ve founded a relevant business of your own, led surveying or drone operations, or built products for geospatial customers. You have hands-on experience with photogrammetry, LiDAR or bringing a commercial robotics product to market. If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. title: Senior Product Designer
description: At Deliverect, our API-first platform is revolutionizing commerce by providing a connected suite of on and off-premise solutions. We empower both the food and retail industries to expand their revenue and simplify their operations, creating seamless experiences for businesses to sell anywhere and deliver everywhere. Join us in this exciting journey, where your contributions will directly impact how businesses connect with their customers in a rapidly evolving global market. Department Focus: The Product Department at Deliverect is at the forefront of the digital ordering revolution, dedicated to consistently delivering groundbreaking solutions to the global marketplace . Our team of passionate and innovative engineers, designers, and product managers architect tools that empower businesses to thrive in the evolving digital landscape, streamlining digital ordering for delivery and on-premise services . We are committed to creating user-friendly, dependable, and scalable technology that simplifies operations and enhances customer experiences, playing an integral role in the success of businesses worldwide . In our department, innovation is not just a concept; it's the driving force behind everything we do . Your Impact: As a Senior Product Designer for Kiosk, you will end-to-end own and elevate the guest-facing ordering experience across thousands of global restaurant locations . By combining exceptional interaction craft with strong product sense, you will define the product roadmap, design intuitive interfaces, and directly drive key guest funnel outcomes like completion rates, average ticket size, and ordering speed . This is a contract, hybrid role with a flexible work schedule, offering 3 days in our Paris office and 2 days from the comfort of your home . What you will do: Set the multi-quarter design vision and end-to-end guest experience (approx. 30%): Own every guest-facing touchpoint—attract screen, menu browsing, item customization, upsell, checkout, payment hand-off, confirmation, and edge states—ensuring consumer-grade polish under fixed hardware and fluorescent lighting conditions . Define and own the Kiosk guest product roadmap (approx. 25%): Drive measurable guest-funnel metrics (order completion rate, time-to-order, attach rate, average ticket size, abandonment points) by synthesizing behavioral data, restaurant visits, support insights, and competitive teardowns into prioritized product briefs and sequencing decisions . Prototype, validate, and deliver design-to-code specs (approx. 15%): Build high-fidelity interactive and code-based prototypes to validate flows with real guests before development, delivering detailed specs (tokens, states, motion, accessibility) and conducting design QA on staging builds to enforce the design-code contract . Architect and govern the Kiosk white-label design system (approx. 15%): Design and evolve a multi-tenant system that maintains visual integrity across hundreds of distinct restaurant brand identities, varied hardware types, poor assets, and internationalization standards (European Accessibility Act / WCAG 2.2 and multi-language/RTL layouts) . Leverage AI workflows and drive cross-functional leadership (approx. 15%): Supercharge research, spec writing, and ideation using AI tools to accelerate delivery from discovery to ship in weeks; bring engineers, PMs, and commercial leads across global regions to clear decisions; and mentor peer designers through pairing and critique . What you will bring: 5+ years of experience in product design with an outstanding portfolio demonstrating visual craft, interaction design, and product thinking (experience in Kiosk, POS, in-store ordering, checkout, or payments is strongly preferred) . Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, or equivalent practical work experience . Demonstrated product sense with experience writing briefs, establishing roadmap priorities, running experiments, and driving funnel metrics when operating with or without a dedicated PM . Hands-on experience architecting and scaling complex white-label or multi-brand design systems, including working knowledge of EAA/WCAG accessibility and multi-language/RTL support . Code-aware background with a strong understanding of frontend capabilities, technical logic, and performance constraints to effectively partner with engineers on technical implementation . AI-native mindset, leveraging AI tools as a daily productivity lever for research, ideation, spec creation, and high-fidelity prototyping .
