title: AI Software Engineer (Forward Deployment Engineer)
description: About Agicap Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France. Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire. Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024. Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde. Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse ! Agicap est en train de devenir une AI-first company . Nous formons l'ensemble de nos employés à travailler avec l'IA et à automatiser eux-mêmes une partie de leurs tâches. Certains projets sont trop longs, trop transverses ou trop techniques pour être portés par une équipe métier seule. C'est le rôle de l'AI Lab. C'est l'équipe pivot qui construit les outils internes qui changent la façon dont Agicap travaille au quotidien. Notre boussole : impact opérationnel rapide , itérations courtes, travail à 360° avec toutes les équipes (Sales, CS, Finance, Produit, Marketing, Data, C-level). C'est une création de poste : l'accélération de l'IA change nos process et notre manière de bosser. On a besoin d'un renfort senior pour accompagner cette transition et l'inscrire dans des pratiques qui tiennent sur le long terme. L'équipe que tu vas rejoindre : 4 personnes , toi inclus : un ingénieur IA junior , un Tech Lead à mi-temps (qui sera ton manager), un Product Manager . Ton rôle : apporter le recul technique qui manque aujourd'hui dans l'équipe (infra, architecture, maintenabilité, scalabilité) — construire vite, mais sans creuser de dette pour demain. Tu es en interaction directe avec toutes les équipes métier d'Agicap : c'est un poste très transverse, très exposé. ⚡️ Responsabilités : Tu alternes entre cadrage rapide, build et itération : Comprendre le besoin d'une équipe métier en direct, cadrer ce qui a réellement de l'impact vs. ce qui est du confort, prioriser. Construire les outils internes de bout en bout : cadrage → dev → mise en prod → itération avec les utilisateurs. Faire évoluer la plateforme IA commune : serveurs MCP, intégrations, outillage transverse mis à disposition de toute l'entreprise. Prendre les décisions techniques qui structurent le Lab : infra, choix de stack, architecture. Il n'y a pas d'existant lourd auquel te conformer, tu construis pour scaler. Élever le niveau technique de l'équipe : mentoring de l'IA Engineer junior, transmission des bonnes pratiques, revue de code utile. Identifier proactivement les process où l'IA apporte un vrai gain — et construire la solution. Exemples de chantiers sur tes 6 premiers mois : Feedback loop produit : construire un système qui digère l'ensemble des logs de feedback client (calls, RFP, remontées CS) et produit des recommandations priorisées pour les Product Managers. Aujourd'hui la donnée existe mais on ne la digère pas. Chantier infra MCP : mettre à disposition des collaborateurs Agicap des serveurs MCP connectés à leurs outils du quotidien, à l'échelle. ⚡️Comment on travaille : Autonomie totale : équipe de 3, tu décides, tu assumes tes choix. Ship rate élevé : on livre quotidiennement, on mesure, on itère. IA au quotidien dans le delivery : on utilise Claude, OpenAI, Mistral au quotidien pour construire — on n'observe pas la vague IA, on est dedans. Anglais requis : beaucoup de collaborateurs sont anglophones. Ton binôme est francophone. 👀 Le profil recherché: On vise un profil senior avec expérience de Tech Lead — quelqu'un qui a déjà pris des décisions impactantes, poussé des sujets techniques exigeants, et exploré activement le terrain IA : ~4-5 ans d'expérience minimum en dev, sur des projets réellement mis en production. Expérience de Tech Lead ou équivalent : tu as déjà drivé des décisions d'architecture et d'infra, tu sais arbitrer entre vélocité et dette. Pratique concrète et récente des LLMs : tu as essayé des choses, poussé des expérimentations, testé Claude / OpenAI / Mistral. Tu es moteur sur ces sujets, pas suiveur. Python et TypeScript dans ta boîte à outils. Le langage compte moins que ta capacité à choisir le bon outil pour le bon problème. Bases techniques solides : tu maîtrises et comprends ce que tu livres. Capacité à livrer vite et à prioriser ce qui a réellement de l'impact — mode Doer, pas mode powerpoint. Proactivité et curiosité : tu identifies des opportunités que personne n'a formulées, tu vas chercher. Anglais professionnel courant. Autonomie assumée : dans une équipe de 3, tu ne peux pas te cacher. ⭐ Stack et outillage LLMs : Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI, Mistral — l'équipe n'est pas mono-provider, tu choisis le bon modèle pour le bon usage. Langages : majoritairement Python et TypeScript . Infra : à toi de la construire, avec un vrai droit de décision — pas d'existant lourd. Outillage IA en interne : serveurs MCP, plateforme IA commune, agents connectés aux outils métier. Cycle : Continuous Delivery, mise en prod quotidienne, feedback utilisateur direct. 🎁 Ce qu'on offre Un poste à impact direct et visible dans une AI-first company de 600 personnes. Un cadre ultra-responsabilisant : autonomie, ownership, décisions techniques à ton niveau. Rémunération : 55K€ - 70K€ selon expertise + prime vacances SYNTEC. CDI , forfait en heures, 39h dont 4h supplémentaires payées. 25 jours de congés payés + 10 jours de congés flexibles (utilisables dès l'arrivée). Localisation : Notre siège de Lyon ou possibilité de Full-Remote. Mutuelle Alan (extension famille possible), titres restaurant Swile (11€/jour dont 6,50€ pris en charge). Avantages CSE : carte KDO annuelle, Gymlib/EGYM wellpass, etc. Démarrage ASAP . ⏳ Process de recrutement : Screening avec l'équipe Talent Acquisition — présentation du poste et validation du fit (30-45 min). Deux entretiens techniques avec l'équipe AI Lab (formats et sujets communiqués en amont). Feedback sous 24-48h à chaque étape. Process rapide, transparent. Agicap s'engage à garantir l'égalité des chances pour tous et favorise un environnement de travail inclusif qui valorise la diversité ! Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need. As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn. Summary of Position: The Senior Manager, Medical Information, EMEA will be responsible for developing, managing, and delivering high-quality, accurate, and compliant medical information content to support unsolicited requests from healthcare professionals. Based in Europe and operating within a global matrix, this individual will ensure timely and accurate responses are being provided to healthcare professionals in response to their inquiries. This role necessitates a comprehensive understanding of medical information with a strong emphasis on project management, medical writing, and strategic thinking. Ensure call center agents are equipped with up-to-date scientific content and trained to respond accurately and professionally to HCP inquiries. title: Staff Software Engineer - OpenTelemetry Python instrumentation | UK | Remote
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><p></p> <p><strong>This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from Germany, UK, Ireland and Spain.</strong></p> <p><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p>Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack</p> <p>The Observability department is focused on enabling developers to understand the health and performance of their applications and infrastructure in any environment by providing tools to instrument their code, ingest observability data into Grafana Cloud and visualize and explore it.</p> <p>The OpenTelemetry SDKs team's mission is to make sure our users succeed in instrumenting their software with OpenTelemetry. We work closely with the <a href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/community#special-interest-groups">OpenTelemetry SIGs</a> to make OpenTelemetry SDKs and instrumentation libraries a success. Members of this team are experts in at least one programming language and have a broad knowledge of various other programming languages.</p> <p>In this role, you will focus on a language-specific implementation of <a href="https://opentelemetry.io/docs/languages/python/">OpenTelemetry in Python</a>, with an emphasis on <a href="https://opentelemetry.io/blog/2024/otel-generative-ai/">OpenTelemetry for Generative AI</a>. You will get to work in an upstream-first approach, helping accelerate the OpenTelemetry project while bringing the innovations to Grafana labs products and offerings. </p> <p>As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. We are looking for Engineers that are passionate about communicating with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Engineers at Grafana also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities.</p> <p>At Grafana Labs, ICs have a dedicated career path and do not have to become managers to progress in their career. Staff Software Engineers at Grafana have a large amount of experience across multiple areas.  They are able to estimate, plan, coordinate and deliver large tasks spanning multiple systems.  They actively coach and mentor other team members in their team and are able to identify and resolve issues with technology and product processes. </p> <p><strong>What You’ll Be Doing:</strong></p> <p>You will bring your software engineering expertise to develop improvements to the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, with a strong focus on AI applications and agent workflows. This is a hands-on role for someone with deep Python expertise and an interest in AI.</p> <ul> <li>Collaborate in open-source communities. You will develop and maintain the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, working with maintainers and other vendors on specifications, APIs, and implementation decisions.</li> <li>Build Python instrumentation for AI agents. Build instrumentation that connects agent runs, model calls, and tool execution, including across asynchronous code. Contribute to evolving OpenTelemetry conventions for generative AI, with care for sensitive data and metric cardinality.</li> <li>Improve Python SDK performance. Use profiling and benchmarks to evaluate implementation approaches with the upstream community. Make sound tradeoffs around runtime overhead, compatibility, and maintainability.</li> <li>Be visible as an OpenTelemetry expert. Teach others, promote best practices around OpenTelemetry, semantic conventions, and various technologies and frameworks. Both within Grafana Labs and in the broader OpenTelemetry community.</li> <li>Support the technical direction and vision of the team, and contribute to business conversations on the OpenTelemetry strategy at Grafana Labs. Own projects from an ambiguous problem through design, implementation, testing, documentation, and release.</li> <li>Partner in an open and respectful way. Lend your knowledge and skills to our GTM, Product and Support teams. Join customer conversations, investigate instrumentation issues, and turn what you learn into fixes and practical guidance.</li> </ul> <p>As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so high agency and good communication skills are a must.</p> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit:</strong></p> <p>At Grafana Labs, Staff Engineers are defined by the impact they have and the people they enable. You take ownership of complex problems, set technical direction, and help others deliver improvements that matter to customers and the OpenTelemetry community.</p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in software development, with strong proficiency in Python and experience debugging production software, language internals, libraries, and asynchronous code.</li> <li>An interest in AI applications and agent systems, and curiosity about how to instrument and troubleshoot them. Prior experience building AI systems is helpful, but not required.</li> <li>Experience working in open-source communities. You are eager to become an active member of the OpenTelemetry community, collaborate with maintainers and users, and keep learning across languages, frameworks, and the wider observability ecosystem.</li> <li>Familiarity with observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry, alongside experience with cloud-based software or systems engineering. You understand production environments and can assess operational risks.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have experience working on open source observability projects, ideally in OpenTelemetry or Prometheus.</li> <li>Experience in Python instrumentation techniques, profiling, runtime diagnostics, or asynchronous context propagation</li> <li>Experience in a hands-on technical leadership role, setting technical direction and leading project teams</li> <li>Experience instrumenting AI frameworks or agent workflows, or working with OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for generative AI</li> <li>Experience contributing to or maintaining Open Source projects, with evidence of successful pull requests and community collaboration</li> <li>Rust experience is a plus for exploring potential Python SDK performance improvements, including Rust-backed implementations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation & Rewards:</strong></p> <p>In the UK, the compensation range for this role is <span data-sheets-root="1">GBP 107,000 </span><span data-sheets-root="1">- GBP 134,000</span>. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.</em></p> <p><strong>Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong data-stringify-type="bold">100% Remote, Global Culture - </strong>As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.</li> <li><strong>Scaling Organization</strong> – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.</li> <li><strong>Transparent Communication</strong> – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.</li> <li><strong>Innovation-Driven</strong> – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.</li> <li><strong>Open Source Roots</strong> – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Teams</strong> – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.</li> <li><strong>Career Growth Pathways</strong> – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.</li> <li><strong>Approachable Leadership</strong> – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.</li> <li><strong>Passionate People</strong> – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.</li> <li><strong>In-Person onboarding </strong>- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. </li> <li><strong>Balance is Key</strong> - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. <em>*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</str

Members of this team are experts in at least one programming language and have a broad knowledge of various other programming languages.</p> <p>In this role, you will focus on a language-specific implementation of <a href="https://opentelemetry.io/docs/languages/python/">OpenTelemetry in Python</a>, with an emphasis on <a href="https://opentelemetry.io/blog/2024/otel-generative-ai/">OpenTelemetry for Generative AI</a>. Engineers at Grafana also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities.</p> <p>At Grafana Labs, ICs have a dedicated career path and do not have to become managers to progress in their career. This is a hands-on role for someone with deep Python expertise and an interest in AI.</p> <ul> <li>Collaborate in open-source communities. Build instrumentation that connects agent runs, model calls, and tool execution, including across asynchronous code. Contribute to evolving OpenTelemetry conventions for generative AI, with care for sensitive data and metric cardinality.</li> <li>Improve Python SDK performance. Use profiling and benchmarks to evaluate implementation approaches with the upstream community. Make sound tradeoffs around runtime overhead, compatibility, and maintainability.</li> <li>Be visible as an OpenTelemetry expert. Teach others, promote best practices around OpenTelemetry, semantic conventions, and various technologies and frameworks. Join customer conversations, investigate instrumentation issues, and turn what you learn into fixes and practical guidance.</li> </ul> <p>As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so high agency and good communication skills are a must.</p> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit:</strong></p> <p>At Grafana Labs, Staff Engineers are defined by the impact they have and the people they enable. You take ownership of complex problems, set technical direction, and help others deliver improvements that matter to customers and the OpenTelemetry community.</p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in software development, with strong proficiency in Python and experience debugging production software, language internals, libraries, and asynchronous code.</li> <li>An interest in AI applications and agent systems, and curiosity about how to instrument and troubleshoot them. Prior experience building AI systems is helpful, but not required.</li> <li>Experience working in open-source communities. You understand production environments and can assess operational risks.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have experience working on open source observability projects, ideally in OpenTelemetry or Prometheus.</li> <li>Experience in Python instrumentation techniques, profiling, runtime diagnostics, or asynchronous context propagation</li> <li>Experience in a hands-on technical leadership role, setting technical direction and leading project teams</li> <li>Experience instrumenting AI frameworks or agent workflows, or working with OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for generative AI</li> <li>Experience contributing to or maintaining Open Source projects, with evidence of successful pull requests and community collaboration</li> <li>Rust experience is a plus for exploring potential Python SDK performance improvements, including Rust-backed implementations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation & Rewards:</strong></p> <p>In Germany, the compensation range for this role is <span data-sheets-root="1">EUR 113,000</span><span data-sheets-root="1"> - EUR 141,000</span>. title: Partner Account Manager - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2>À propos du poste</h2> <p>Ce poste de direction est essentiel : il consiste à construire et à faire passer à l’échelle les partenariats d’Anthropic avec les cabinets de conseil, les intégrateurs de systèmes mondiaux (GSI) et les boutiques partenaires nativement IA en France.</p> <p>Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe commerciale pour que les clients adoptent l’IA grâce à nos partenaires.</p> <p>Ce poste est un poste de construction, et non de gestion. Compte tenu du stade de développement d’Anthropic, nous recherchons un profil qui a déjà fait ses preuves en faisant passer des partenariats de zéro à des moteurs de revenus à grande échelle, un profil qui a bâti ces relations de A à Z, et non simplement hérité de relations existantes pour les gérer.</p> <h2><strong>Responsabilités</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Partenariats et exécution</li> <ul> <li>Vous collaborerez étroitement avec l’équipe commerciale pour comprendre comment les partenaires peuvent soutenir l’adoption de Claude par les clients.</li> <li>Vous accompagnerez les partenaires dans la création de solutions clients reproductibles, répondant à des cas d’usage précis dans de nombreux secteurs : services financiers, santé, distribution, industrie, secteur public et services professionnels.</li> </ul> <li>Performance et pilotage des indicateurs clés (KPI)</li> <ul> <li>Vous portez la responsabilité des indicateurs clés de performance et vous les pilotez : revenus influencés par les partenaires, livraison réalisée par les partenaires, nombre de personnes consultantes formées et certifiées.</li> <li>Chaque deal influencé par votre portefeuille de partenaires doit être conçu pour la réussite du client et la croissance de sa valeur à long terme. Vous définirez des critères de réussite pour les comptes communs, veillerez à la qualité de la mise en œuvre et de l’accompagnement à l’adoption, et mettrez en place des boucles de retour d’expérience favorisant l’amélioration continue.</li> <li>Vous rendrez compte de la santé des partenariats, de leur avancement et de leurs résultats commerciaux, en vous appuyant sur des analyses fondées sur les données.</li> </ul> <li>Développement du marché et construction de la marque</li> <ul> <li>Vous renforcerez la notoriété de la marque Anthropic en France grâce à des relations stratégiques avec les partenaires.</li> <li>Vous élaborerez et déploierez des stratégies de mise sur le marché (GTM) propres à chaque marché, adaptées aux pratiques commerciales et aux nuances culturelles locales.</li> <li>Vous composerez avec les enjeux locaux de réglementation, de conformité et de souveraineté des données.</li> <li>Vous créerez un avantage concurrentiel grâce aux capacités singulières des partenaires et à des propositions de valeur élaborées en commun.</li> </ul> </ul> <h2><strong>Votre profil</strong></h2> <p>Ce poste pourrait vous convenir si vous réunissez les atouts suivants :</p> <ul> <li>Vous avez l’esprit d’initiative et le goût de construire : vous êtes à l’aise pour partir de zéro et créer des partenariats d’envergure.</li> <li>Vous maîtrisez l’anglais et le français.</li> <li>Vous comptez au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans les partenariats technologiques à destination des entreprises, idéalement dans le cloud, l’IA/ML ou les activités de plateforme.</li> <li>Vous avez une culture de la donnée, tournée vers les résultats mesurables et l’atteinte des KPI, et un historique avéré de revenus additionnels générés grâce aux partenariats dans la région.</li> <li>Vous avez démontré votre capacité à assurer la réussite des clients et la protection de la marque via les canaux partenaires.</li> <li>Vous avez l’esprit de compétition : la victoire et la différenciation sont votre moteur.</li> <li>Vous avez une approche collaborative et savez travailler de façon transversale avec les équipes commerciales, produit, marketing et régionales.</li> <li>Vous nourrissez une vraie passion pour l’IA et vous vous reconnaissez dans la mission d’Anthropic : développer une IA bénéfique.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Relations de travail</strong></p> <p>Votre rattachement hiérarchique se fera auprès de la direction des partenariats internationaux, tandis que votre activité quotidienne sera pilotée par la personne responsable des partenariats EMEA Sud. Vous travaillerez également en étroite collaboration avec la direction commerciale régionale d’Anthropic et ses Account Executives, ainsi qu’avec les équipes Customer Success et Applied AI de la région.</p> <p><strong>Lieu et déplacements</strong></p> <p>Ce poste est basé à Paris, en France, avec des déplacements à prévoir pour rencontrer les partenaires et les clients.</p> <h2> </h2> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>This is a critical leadership role responsible for building and scaling Anthropic's consulting, GSIs and AI-native boutique partners in France.<br>You will be working closely with the sales team to make sure customers are adopting AI through our partners.</p> <p><strong><br></strong><strong>This is a builder role, not a manager role.</strong> Given Anthropic's stage, we need someone who has proven they can take partnerships from zero to scaled revenue engines — someone who has built these relationships from the ground up, not just inherited and managed existing ones.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Partnerships and execution: </li> <ul> <li>You will engage closely with the sales team to understand how partners can support customer Claude adoption</li> <li>You will guide partners in creating repeatable customer solutions that address specific use cases across industries including financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, public sector, and professional services.</li> </ul> <li>Performance and KPI ownership:</li> <ul> <li>Own and drive key performance indicators, partner-influenced revenue, partner delivery, consultants trained and certified</li> <li>Every deal influenced through your partner portfolio must be architected for customer success and long-term value expansion. You will establish success criteria for joint accounts, ensure proper implementation and adoption support, and create feedback loops that drive continuous improvement.</li> <li>Report on partnership health, progress, and commercial outcomes with data-driven insights</li> </ul> </ul> <ul> <li>Market Development & Brand Building</li> <ul> <li>Amplify the Anthropic brand in France strategic partner relationships</li> <li>Develop and execute market-specific GTM strategies adapted to local business practices and cultural nuances</li> <li>Navigate local regulatory, compliance, and data sovereignty considerations</li> <li>Create competitive differentiation through unique partner capabilities and joint value propositions</li> </ul> </ul> <h2><strong>You may be a good fit if you have:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Builder mentality — comfortable starting from zero and creating scaled partnerships</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Fluent in English and French</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in enterprise technology partnerships, ideally within cloud, AI/ML, or platform businesses</li> <li>Data-driven mindset with focus on measurable outcomes and KPI attainment. Track record of driving incremental revenues through partnerships in the region</li> <li>History of delivering exceptional customer success and brand protection through partner channels</li> <li>Competitive drive — obsessed with winning and creating differentiation</li> <li>Collaborative approach with ability to work cross-functionally across sales, product, marketing, and regional teams</li> <li>Passion for AI and alignment with Anthropic's mission of beneficial AI development</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working Relationships</strong></h2> <p>You will formally report to the International Partnerships leader, while your day-to-day work will be led by our South EMEA Partnerships lead. You will also partner closely with Anthropic's regional sales leader and their Account Executives, as well as the in-region Customer Success and Applied AI teams.</p> <h2><strong>Location and Travel</strong></h2> <p>This role will be based in Paris, France with travel expected to engage with partners and customers externally.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. </p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€220.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€260.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study: </strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong> We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>For roles performing work in California: </strong>We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles Co

description: <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Onsite Role - Office First</span></p> <h2><strong>Team description</strong></h2> <p>As part of the Platform tribe, we're building a self-service, AI-ready <strong>Data Platform</strong> that powers SumUp's next big bets: data, AI, and real-time analytics. Our team designs and runs the infrastructure that lets data engineers, analysts, and ML teams across the business ship reliable pipelines and products without reinventing the wheel each time. This role sits at the centre of that work, giving you a genuine chance to shape how thousands of SumUppers build with data every day.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build and evolve the data platform's infrastructure (Terraform, Kubernetes, GCP), so every environment is reproducible, version-controlled, and auditable</li> <li>Take end-to-end ownership of the reliability, performance, and scalability of the Data and AI platforms</li> <li>Develop self-service features, including for ETL and orchestration, so teams can move faster without bespoke integrations</li> <li>Automate operations to keep the platform highly available and cost-efficient as demand grows</li> <li>Evaluate emerging technologies and shape adoption strategies that improve platform capabilities and business outcomes</li> <li>Partner with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than one-off integrations</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You'll be great for this role if…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>More than 4 years of experience building <strong>internal platforms</strong> consumed by other teams, in a Data, Platform, or Software Engineering role</li> <li>Strong software engineering background in<strong> Python or Go</strong>, along with solid SQL skills</li> <li>Hands-on knowledge of infrastructure and containerisation, such as<strong> Terraform,</strong> Helm, Docker, and <strong>Kubernetes</strong></li> <li>Comfort working with observability, monitoring, alerting, and platform reliability engineering practices</li> <li>Experience in modern data stack (dbt, Snowflake, Trino, Airflow, etc.) </li> <li>Track record of setting up SDLC practices for analytics teams, including Git workflows, CI/CD, testing, and documentation standards</li> </ul> <p><em>It's OK if you don't meet 100% of these criteria. If you're missing a few, it just means you'll have room to learn and grow with us.</em></p> <p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Real-time streaming experience (e.g. Kafka, Flink, StarRocks, Pinot, Druid, ClickHouse)</li> <li>Experience working with systems at petabyte scale</li> <li>Experience implementing AI-enabled systems, such as agentic SRE or AI automation</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why you should join SumUp</strong></h2> <p>🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup</p> <p>🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced </p> <p>🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success </p> <p>📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education </p> <p>💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions </p> <p>🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches </p> <p>🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team</p> <h2><strong>About SumUp</strong></h2> <p>Be empowered to do more that matters.</p> <p>At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&index=8&md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=and&index=9&md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=AstraZeneca&index=10&md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><h2>Role Overview</h2> <h2>Role:</h2> <p>IonQ is hiring a Senior Quantum Sales Director to drive new and expansion revenue for Capella Data as a Service (DaaS) and satellite systems across EMEA. You will own a portfolio of strategic enterprise, defence and government accounts, selling SAR imagery and analytics subscriptions, tasking capacity and complete satellite systems, and you will report to Garrick Ballantine.</p> <p>This is a quota carrying, hunter oriented role for a seller who can run long cycle capital programmes alongside faster moving data subscriptions, and who can translate space based sensing into mission and business outcomes. The role is remote, employed through an IonQ entity in the UK (Oxford) or Switzerland, with travel of up to 20%.</p> <h2>Responsibilities:</h2> <p>You will own an annual new business and expansion quota across Capella DaaS subscriptions, tasking capacity and satellite system sales within an assigned enterprise, defence and civil government territory in EMEA. You will build and execute account plans for a named portfolio, mapping stakeholders across mission, programme, procurement and technical functions and building executive relationships at several levels in each account.</p> <p>You will sell the full value chain, from SAR data and analytics subscriptions and recurring tasking commitments to ground segment integration and dedicated or jointly owned satellite systems. Working with product, engineering and mission solutions teams, you will bring customer requirements back into the roadmap and represent IonQ at industry, defence and geospatial conferences.</p> <h2>Key responsibilities include:</h2> <ul> <li>Run complex, consultative sales cycles from prospecting through to close, including discovery, technical validation with solutions engineering, pricing, contracting and negotiation of subscription and system purchase agreements.</li> <li>Respond to RFIs, RFPs and government tenders in partnership with capture, proposal and contracts teams, and support prime and subcontractor teaming strategies.</li> <li>Forecast accurately in CRM, keep disciplined pipeline hygiene and deliver reliable monthly and quarterly commits.</li> <li>Develop executive relationships across mission, programme, procurement and technical stakeholders in each account.</li> <li>Represent IonQ at industry, defence and geospatial events across EMEA, and feed customer requirements back to product and engineering.</li> </ul> <h2>Requirements:</h2> <p>You will bring substantial enterprise sales experience in geospatial data, earth observation, satellite systems, defence technology or adjacent data and SaaS markets, with a consistent record of exceeding quota. You will have closed both recurring data or subscription contracts and large capital or programme based hardware sales, and you will have sold to EMEA and allied government, defence and security customers, with a working knowledge of their procurement frameworks and contracting cycles.</p> <p>You will have command of a structured sales methodology such as MEDDICC or Challenger, with disciplined CRM and forecasting rigour, and the ability to engage credibly with technical and mission stakeholders on remote sensing, SAR, tasking and data delivery workflows. A bachelor's degree in business, engineering or a related field, and willingness to travel up to 20%, are also required.</p> <h2>You’d be a great fit with:</h2> <ul> <li>Direct experience selling SAR, optical imagery or RF sensing data and analytics.</li> <li>A background in satellite systems, ground segment or space mission integration.</li> <li>Experience in early market development or category creation for an emerging technology.</li> <li>The ability to obtain the relevant national security clearance in your country of employment, such as UK SC or NATO clearance.</li> <li>Established relationships with EMEA government, defence or security customers, including NATO and allied programmes.</li> </ul> <p>The total compensation package includes base salary, bonus, equity, and a range of benefits available on our career site.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br> <br>We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs. </strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.  </p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs. </strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.</p> <p> </p> <p>If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply! </p></div> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Quantum Sales Director - DaaS & Satellite Sales, EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&index=8&md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=and&index=9&md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=AstraZeneca&index=10&md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><h2>Role Overview</h2> <h2>Role:</h2> <p>IonQ is hiring a Senior Quantum Sales Director to drive new and expansion revenue for Capella Data as a Service (DaaS) and satellite systems across EMEA. You will own a portfolio of strategic enterprise, defence and government accounts, selling SAR imagery and analytics subscriptions, tasking capacity and complete satellite systems, and you will report to Garrick Ballantine.</p> <p>This is a quota carrying, hunter oriented role for a seller who can run long cycle capital programmes alongside faster moving data subscriptions, and who can translate space based sensing into mission and business outcomes. The role is remote, employed through an IonQ entity in the UK (Oxford) or Switzerland, with travel of up to 20%.</p> <h2>Responsibilities:</h2> <p>You will own an annual new business and expansion quota across Capella DaaS subscriptions, tasking capacity and satellite system sales within an assigned enterprise, defence and civil government territory in EMEA. You will build and execute account plans for a named portfolio, mapping stakeholders across mission, programme, procurement and technical functions and building executive relationships at several levels in each account.</p> <p>You will sell the full value chain, from SAR data and analytics subscriptions and recurring tasking commitments to ground segment integration and dedicated or jointly owned satellite systems. title: Product Engineer
description: Akur8 is one of the leading providers of insurance pricing and rating technology. Our mission is to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk. Our SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and rating technology to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems. Insurers use it to model and rate risk up to 10x faster while keeping transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust. As the product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform for pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions. Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in: CB Insights' Insurtech 50 (2025) CNBC's InsurTech Top 150 (2025) InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025) Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025) Akur8 has 50+ nationalities across 8 global offices and serves 420+ clients across 4 continents. We’re an equal opportunities employer, and we value the different perspectives that help shape better products and decisions. Insurance companies use Akur8 to decide the price of millions of policies. We are looking for a talented Product Engineer to build the features they rely on to do it. You will join the Pricing team, which builds the part of the Akur8 platform that Actuaries, Underwriters and Product Owners use to design, test and deploy their rates. Your mission is to scope, design and implement features that automate the rating process at insurance companies, from the first discussion of a client need to the feature running in production. Much of the work is deciding what to build, not only building it. You will work with Product Managers, Designers, Actuaries and other Engineers to understand how insurers price risk, why they work the way they do, and where software can make them faster and more accurate. A good understanding of modelling, maths and logic is needed for this. At its core, this is a hands-on software engineering role. You will spend significant time writing code, designing data models, building backend and frontend services, and ensuring the systems you ship are scalable, tested, and maintainable. With AI being a reliable support for implementation, your main value will come from understanding the business context, the architecture and the data models as these will determine the quality of your deliveries. Our platform runs on AWS with Rust, Java, Python, and Angular. Prior experience with them is a plus. You will work on the core of the platform from your first weeks and see the impact of your work on real clients. In this role, you will: Own product features end to end: clarify the need with the product team, scope it, design the solution, build it and follow it in production. Turn requests from Actuaries, Underwriters and Product Owners into a clear scope, and challenge a requirement when a simpler solution meets the need. Work in an AI native-engineering team: delegate implementation to deliver quickly, reviewing, test and own responsibility for everything you ship. Balance delivery speed and robustness according to the client’s priorities. Your work will help insurers price risk faster and more accurately, and will expand what Akur8 can offer its clients. We’re looking for someone driven by outcomes: things done fast, done well, and useful to our clients. You have completed or are finishing a PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or another quantitative field. No professional experience is required. You have written code during your research and want to grow in software engineering practices such as testing, code review and system design, using AI coding assistants as part of your daily work. You are comfortable with ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, structure it and move it forward without waiting for a step-by-step brief. You take a pragmatic approach to writing code: you care about solving the actual problem rather than chasing perfection, and you can explain the trade-offs behind your technical choices. You care about results more than about technology: you want to understand why a feature matters to the end user before deciding how to build it. Prior experience with our tech stack (Rust, Java, Python, Angular, AWS) or the insurance space is welcome, but not required. We invest heavily in onboarding; what matters most is your curiosity and appetite to learn. We are equally open to the visa sponsorship of non-EU candidates as long as they are already in possession of their final diploma / attestation of their final academic results. title: Expert Solution Architect, AI & Enterprise (all genders)
description: About the Role You'll own the path from a corporate client's business problem to a target architecture the CIO signs and the CFO funds. Not one platform, the whole picture: CRM, data, integrations, custom software, and the agentic AI layer on top. This is an Expert seat: the architecture benchmark of our Consulting Practice, no people management. Own the architecture through delivery, so what you design in pre-sales is what gets built, without structural redesigns after signature Scope six-figure engagements with estimates that hold, phasing that corporate procurement can sign, and risks named up front Build the team's Solution Design Toolkit: discovery framework, architecture decision template, and an honest agentic-fit assessment that says where agents add value and where they don't Present and defend architectures in front of CIOs, CFOs, and business unit heads, in German and English Create reusable solution patterns (master data ownership between CRM and ERP, agent orchestration on HubSpot, data remediation before AI) that consultants and engineers actually use Partner with our AI & Engineering Practice as the architecture counterpart: you own the solution design, they own the technical blueprint and the build What You Bring Must-haves 6+ years in consulting or solution architecture, with at least 2 years personally owning solution design for enterprise clients on the advisory or vendor side, from discovery to signature A track record of structuring ambiguous business problems into architecture options, scope, and risk, with artefacts you produced yourself and can walk us through Architecture-level fluency across at least one enterprise CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Dynamics), one ERP (SAP or Dynamics), data platforms (warehouse, CDP, or MDM), and integration patterns (event-driven, API, iPaaS or middleware) At least one AI or agentic solution you designed or delivered that ran in production for a client, with business outcomes you can name and failures you can explain Experience leading conversations with CIO, CFO, procurement, IT security, and business stakeholders inside corporate groups, including telling an executive no with a case behind it Commercial judgment on scoping and estimating engagements, and ownership when estimates miss German and English at full business fluency, with the ability to present the same architecture to a CFO and to a delivery team Nice-to-haves Hands-on HubSpot enterprise experience or HubSpot Solutions Architect certification (we fund it if you don't have it) Direct experience with EU AI Act and DSGVO as design constraints in regulated industries (manufacturing, financial services, healthcare) A background in one of our core client sectors: industrial manufacturing, building products, or B2B distribution Talks, articles, or teaching on enterprise architecture or applied AI Your Team You'll join the Strategy Consulting team within Thorit's Consulting Practice, which owns the strategy layer of our engagements. title: Senior Partner Growth Manager
description: <p><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p><strong>We are Ocado Commercial,</strong> and we are revolutionising online grocery. We partner with the world's leading retailers, providing our innovative Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) – a powerful blend of automation and software – to elevate their e-commerce capabilities. Join us and be part of a team that's shaping the future of retail, working with global giants from Kroger to AEON. </p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>The Senior Partner Growth Manager role is an exciting opportunity in our Partner Success Team to directly influence the commercial success of our partners, some of the largest retailers in EMEA. This position will require reasonable travel to Saudi Arabia and/or Europe. </p> <p>Businesses that partner with Ocado come in all shapes and sizes, and leverage our technology in different ways.  In this role, you will combine your knowledge of ecommerce, grocery retail, and online marketing with communication skills and analytical abilities to shape and influence how our partners grow online. </p> <p>The Partner Growth Manager will work with the Ocado Partner Account team to drive the growth agenda in our partner’s business, enabling our partners to improve commercial outcomes, grow their customer base, order volume, and overall profitability. </p> <p>You will build effective relationships with key commercial, marketing, and ecommerce stakeholders in our partners’ businesses. You will leverage knowledge of customer objectives, strategic know-how, knowledge of the Ocado Smart Platform (OSP), as well as the expertise of our central growth subject matter experts to create and implement successful growth strategies. You will become a first line of e-commerce growth support, leveraging our team of central subject matter experts for more in-depth support. You will support your internal stakeholders in the region with insights and reporting on growth topics, as well as be a source of information and support for your partners. </p> <p>As part of the Partner Success Team you will be responsible for<strong> </strong>supporting our partners in their day to day use of OSP, ensuring that their webshop is configured optimally, using the most impactful OSP features, to drive maximum customer acquisition, retention and basket size.</p> <p>You will consult with partners through both in-depth projects in close collaboration with our Central Growth and/or Technology teams, as well as ongoing optimisation forums aimed at improving their commercial performance. You will leverage data to drive recommendations that improve overall performance. </p> <ul> <li>The Partner Growth Manager is accountable for shaping and delivering growth strategy for their assigned Partner(s), supporting improved commercial outcomes including customer acquisition, retention, order growth and profitability.</li> <li>Works closely with the Partner’s ecommerce, marketing and technology teams and cross-functional Ocado stakeholders to align growth priorities and execution.</li> <li>Uses growth, trading and customer data and analytics to understand commercial performance, identify trends and opportunities, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations to Partners and internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Accountable for translating Partner growth objectives into clear, prioritised growth initiatives and optimisation opportunities that support long-term commercial success, maximising the potential of the OSP platform.</li> <li>Acts as Ocado’s primary growth and ecommerce subject matter expert for the Partner, using deep knowledge of OSP capabilities and growth / go-to-market expertise to shape recommendations on ecommerce configuration, trading, monetisation and customer experience, as well as sustainable marketing and communications adapted to the local competitive landscape</li> <li>Owns the Partner relationship for e-commerce and growth OSP roadmap engagement, acting as the named point of contact for, trading, monetisation, customer experience roadmap topic, and, in general, any non-operational topic.</li> <li>Represents Partner growth and ecommerce requirements and priorities into Ocado’s roadmap governance processes, supporting feature discovery with clear problem definition, context and Partner business case and value articulation.</li> <li>Monitors delivery and adoption of growth-critical features and capabilities, working with internal teams and Partners to maximise realised commercial value and improve utilisation of growth-enabling functionality.</li> <li>Identifies and escalates risks, dependencies or delivery issues that may impact the Partner’s ability to realise growth from OSP capabilities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Languages: Fluency in English is essential. title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations - Remote
description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. The Role As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems: Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio. Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech. Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”. Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio. Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives. Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations. The Challenge We are seeking researchers who: See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative. It's Important to Us That You Have Strong mathematical foundation in statistical learning theory, particularly in areas relevant to self-supervised and multimodal learning Deep expertise in foundation model architectures, with an understanding of how to scale training across multiple modalities Proven ability to bridge theory and practice—someone who can both derive novel mathematical formulations and implement them efficiently Demonstrated ability to build data pipelines that can process and curate massive datasets while maintaining quality and diversity Track record of designing controlled experiments that isolate the impact of architectural innovations and validate theoretical insights Experience optimizing models for real-world deployment, including knowledge of hardware constraints and efficiency techniques History of open-source contributions or research publications that have advanced the state of the art in speech/language AI Ideal Researcher Profile An ideal researcher, as evidenced by the recurring themes across these foundational papers, excels in five key areas: (1) Statistical & Mathematical Foundations, (2) Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation, (3) Data-Driven & Scalable Systems, (4) Hardware & Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models. 1. Statistical & Mathematical Foundations Mastery of Core Concepts Many papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse. Combining Existing Theories in Novel Ways Papers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights. Logical Reasoning and Assumption Testing Across all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses. 2. Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation Creative Solutions to Known Bottlenecks Each paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts. Turning Theory into Practice Whether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential. Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-Source Many references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress. 3. Data-Driven & Scalable Systems Emphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient Pipelines Papers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models. Strategic Use of Data for Staged Training A recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance. 4. Hardware & Systems Understanding Efficient Implementations at Scale Many works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices. Real-Time & On-Device Constraints SoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness. Architectural & Optimization Details Papers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency. 5. Rigorous Experimental Design Controlled Comparisons & Ablations Nearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter. Multifold Evaluation Metrics From MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics. Stress Tests & Edge Cases Whisper's out-of-distribution speech benchmarks, SoundStream's evaluation on speech + music, or Mamba-2's performance on multi-query associative recall demonstrate the importance of specialized challenge sets. Researchers who craft or adopt rigorous benchmarks and "red-team" their models (as in phi-3 safety alignment) are better prepared to address real-world
