title: Legal Engineer - Tax & Audit, Munich
description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. What you’ll be doing Let's get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn't fit neatly into a traditional box. It's part legal ops, part product specialist, part solutions architect, and part client whisperer. If you enjoy roles that stay static, this probably isn't it. Your mission is to help our clients, some of the most sophisticated tax and legal advisory teams in the world, get the absolute most out of our platform. We are hiring for two of our teams. Our DACH team is focussed on working with Tax & Audit teams across the DACH market and our Benelux team is focussed on Tax & Audit teams across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg. Both are based out of our Munich office. Acting as a thought partner to tax partners, legal advisory leaders, and consulting teams - building trusted relationships, addressing tricky pain points, and identifying high-value opportunities for them to scale their use of Legora across service lines and jurisdictions. Working together with Go To Market and Customer Success in taking full ownership of client relationships - from running pilots with key practice areas, to onboarding new team members across tax, legal and consulting functions, and ultimately guiding firm-wide adoption across Big 4 and professional services firms. Be the voice of tax and legal advisory users inside Legora - sharing insights from tax structuring teams, regulatory advisory practices, and legal consulting functions that directly inform product development, roadmap priorities, and strategic direction. Delivering clear, confident product demos and training that bring the power of our platform to life - whether you're presenting to a tax partner, rolling out to a global advisory team, or training legal consulting professionals. Documenting best practices from leading professional services firms, contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, and help shape how we grow this function globally. Confidently helping tax and legal advisory teams navigate one of the biggest shifts in how professional services operate - from evaluating the ROI and competitive advantage of AI to clearly mapping how AI will impact different service lines, from tax compliance to regulatory advisory. What you bring You come from the world of tax and legal advisory; but you've never been content with how things have always been done. You may have trained at a Big 4 firm, working across tax structuring, legal advisory, or consulting. Perhaps you've specialised in legal operations, innovation, or technology implementation within a professional services environment. Maybe you've even moved into legal tech or consultancy, helping advisory teams modernise and scale. Either way, you know how tax and legal advisory teams think, work, and (sometimes) struggle and you're ready to help them level up with technology. You'll thrive in this role if you: Have a background in law or tax, with experience at a Big 4 firm or leading professional services practice gained in the DACH or Benelux market - ideally with exposure to multiple service lines, jurisdictions, or innovation initiatives. Bring a fluent language skill relevant to the DACH or Benelux market (either German, Dutch/Flemish or French). Are tech-curious and product-savvy. Not necessarily a coder, but passionate about navigating technical conversations, especially around things like generative AI, technology implementation, innovation and productivity. Communicate clearly and confidently with diverse stakeholders, from tax partners to consulting leaders, and from lawyers to engineers. I.e. translating across disciplines is second nature to you. Bring structure to ambiguity and energy to complexity; and enjoy being the calm, credible presence in a fast-moving environment. Understand how to evaluate and improve existing processes as a direct result of new and emerging technologies - whether that's streamlining tax compliance workflows, enhancing regulatory analysis, or improving multi-jurisdictional advisory work. Are proactive, self-directed, and comfortable juggling multiple client relationships at once. Care deeply about quality, but don't get stuck in perfectionism - you get things done, and you make them better over time. Understand the commercial realities of professional services: leveraging teams efficiently, demonstrating value to clients, managing complex multi-jurisdictional matters, and balancing technical excellence with commercial delivery. title: Account Executive (German Speaking)
description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. Note: this role is based out of the EMEA territory, specifically Switzerland/Zurich/Geneva. Regional Expectations Based in an EMEA time zone with strong overlap to customer business hours. Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a strong plus. German Language Expectations Native-level or full professional fluency in German (written and spoken), with the ability to conduct complex sales conversations and negotiations. Opportunity Deepgram is looking for an Account Executive to drive new customers and revenue to our rapidly growing company, specifically in the German markets. You will have the opportunity to sell a patented world-class voice AI platform that has been enabling our customers to achieve things previously not attainable. We are looking for hungry and talented sales professionals to help us take our top-line revenue to new heights! What You'll Do Self-prospecting to build a strong sales pipeline of new logos, striving to exceed quarterly and annual sales targets, as well as partnering with the Marketing and SDR teams to generate meetings Work closely with cross-functional teams (especially Sales Ops and Sales Engineers) to ensure sales effectiveness Have a depth of understanding regarding customer needs in the voice AI space, competition, and Deepgram products to be able to articulate Deepgram’s value proposition fully to highly technical buyers Establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, work with CSMs to drive upsell opportunities and manage existing accounts ongoing You’ll Love This Role If You Value having leadership that has tenure and a track record of success Thrive working with A Players as cross-functional partners across GTM Understand the importance of selling a product that is market validated and can deliver on its technical promise Believe there should be no cap to upside and want control of account up-sell potential Are passionate about what Deepgram is building and how we are changing what is possible with speech It’s Important to Us That You Have Proven experience in a technical full-cycle sales role Experience building your own pipeline from scratch and closing accounts Consistent overachievement against sales targets in past experiences Strong written and verbal communication skills Empathy and a unique ability to understand customer needs Highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills due to managing multiple opportunities at any given time Ability to drive a consistent and repeatable sales process with a coachable/adaptable mindset based on other rep success. It Would Be Great If You Had Familiarity with Challenger or Triangle sales methodology Experience selling to a technical audience in a similar space Experience selling developer tools, infrastructure, or AI/ML technologies. Fluency in German, French, Dutch, or other major regional languages. Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3> </h3> <p data-start="0" data-end="44"><strong>We are hiring across multiple locations</strong></p> <p data-start="46" data-end="145"><strong data-start="46" data-end="56">India:</strong> Hyderabad, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru<br data-start="88" data-end="91"><strong data-start="91" data-end="102" data-is-only-node="">Europe:</strong> London, Serbia, Sofia, Lithuania, Berlin</p> <h3>ABOUT THE ROLE</h3> <p>Be at the forefront of the AI revolution, working on cutting-edge projects that shape the future of financial services. You’ll join a passionate team focused on building high-quality, scalable products with real-world impact.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Staff-level Backend Engineer (AI) to bridge robust backend systems with Generative AI. You’ll design the frameworks, standards, and platforms that allow AI capabilities to scale securely, reliably, and efficiently across the enterprise, going beyond feature delivery to influence long-term technical direction.</p> <p><strong>As a Staff Engineer you’ll:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build core services for Tide’s agentic platform, including APIs, workflow orchestration, and tool integration </li> <li>Integrate bought components where they accelerate delivery, and build where control, trust, and reuse matter most</li> <li>Work with product, data, platform, and security teams to productionise shared AI capabilities</li> <li>Design services that are reliable, secure, observable, and easy for other teams to adopt</li> <li>Help shape reusable engineering patterns for AI-enabled workflows</li> </ul> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:</h3> <ul> <li>Strong backend or platform engineering experience in production environments.</li> <li>Good judgement across APIs, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and service design.</li> <li>Experience integrating internal and third-party platforms.</li> <li>Comfort working in ambiguity and turning emerging needs into robust platform components.</li> <li>Strong focus on quality, reliability, and developer usability.</li> <li>Experience with AI infrastructure or orchestration is helpful, but not essential.</li> <li>Experience in highly regulated industries (Fintech, Healthtech, etc.) where safety and compliance are core to the product is valuable, but not essential.</li> <li>Design and build automated evaluation pipelines to measure agent reasoning accuracy and safety trajectories</li> </ul> <h3>Our Tech Stack:</h3> <ul> <li>Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!)</li> <li>Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable</li> <li>Primary datastores are MySQL and PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)</li> <li>Docker, Terraform, EKS used by the Cloud team to run the platform</li> <li>DataDog and Rollbar to keep it running</li> <li>GitHub with Sonarcloud, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines - new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first 2 weeks</li> <li>Angular 2+ with ngrx on Web, Flutter for the Mobile App</li> <li>Fivetran/Snowflake/Looker for the BI insights and Python/Faust/Flask/Tecton + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. </p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. long-term platform leverage.</p> <p><strong>As a Senior Staff Engineer you’ll: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Define the architecture for Tide’s agentic platform</li> <li>Drive the design of shared services (Fintech, Healthtech, etc.) where safety and compliance are core to the product is highly desirable </li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3>Our Tech Stack:</h3> <ul> <li>Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the to production in their first 2 weeks</li> <li>Angular 2+ with ngrx on Web, Flutter for the Mobile App</li> <li>Fivetran/Snowflake/Looker for the BI insights and Python/Faust/Flask/Tecton + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management</li> </ul> </div> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed Operations.<br>- A hands-on and proactive working style, with the ability to operate effectively in an ambiguous and technically complex environment.</p> <h4>Nice to have:</h4> <p>- Familiarity with description: <h3 data-section-id="1l4u08w" data-start="957" data-end="977">About Constructor</h3> <p data-start="979" data-end="1260"><a href="https://constructor.org/">Constructor</a> is an international ecosystem spanning education, research, and technology. It includes <a href="https://constructor.university/">Constructor University Bremen</a>, <a>Constructor Tech</a>, <a href="https://constructor.org/knowledge">Constructor Knowledge</a>, and partner entities such as EBAC, working together to advance how knowledge is created, taught, and applied.</p> <p data-start="1262" data-end="1417"><a href="https://constructor.org/knowledge">Constructor Knowledge</a> sits at the heart of this ecosystem — connecting students, faculty, partners, media, and industry across our entities and programmes.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We're looking for a hands on Senior Marketing Manager to own campaign strategy and execution across our multi channel, multi platform marketing operations. This is not a strategy only or purely managerial role; we need someone who can plan a campaign from scratch, build the tracking and data infrastructure behind it, and execute alongside the team. Strong technical fluency, structured thinking, and a bias toward doing over discussing are essential, along with the confidence to present campaign strategies and budgets to stakeholders and defend them.</p> <h3>Key Responsibilities</h3> <p><strong>Campaign Strategy & Execution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build multi channel, multi platform campaign and marketing plans from the ground up: audience, budget, channel mix, creative direction</li> <li>Execute hands on across performance channels (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.), not just oversee execution</li> <li>Run and interpret A/B tests, budget allocation, and continuous optimization</li> <li>Plan and adapt campaigns across international markets, different countries, audiences, and budgets, spanning both B2B and B2C contexts</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical & Data Infrastructure</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set up and maintain campaign tracking (pixels, UTMs, attribution) across platforms</li> <li>Contribute to building data warehouse / reporting infrastructure for campaign and budget analytics across channels</li> <li>Own reporting dashboards and translate data into clear, actionable recommendations</li> </ul> <p><strong>Creative & Brand</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bring a strong eye for design; able to produce basic ad creatives independently, not just brief a designer</li> <li>Ensure creative and messaging consistency across campaigns and channels</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Ownership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Propose and take ownership of campaign plans and marketing initiatives with minimal oversight</li> <li>Collaborate with a wide range of requesters and stakeholders: management, design, CRM, website, PR, events, and student recruitment teams, among others</li> <li>Adapt quickly to shifting priorities typical of a startup or scale up environment</li> </ul> <h3>Requirements</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years in performance marketing / campaign management, ideally with agency experience</li> <li>Demonstrated hands on technical skill: platforms management (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.), tracking setup, analytics, data infrastructure for campaign reporting</li> <li>Experience working in startups or small, fast-moving teams; comfortable with ambiguity and multitasking</li> <li>Experience running international campaigns across multiple countries/continents simultaneously, and working in a multicultural, cross-country team environment</li> <li>Strong structured, analytical mindset; execution oriented over purely conceptual</li> <li>Basic creative production skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, or similar)</li> <li>Self-driven learner who stays current on marketing technology and industry trends independently.</li> </ul> <h3 data-section-id="moji85" data-start="5656" data-end="5672">What we offer</h3> <ul data-start="5674" data-end="5985"> <li data-section-id="s0didp" data-start="5734" data-end="5835">A central role in a growing international ecosystem connecting education, research, and technology.</li> <li data-section-id="17wt33h" data-start="5836" data-end="5926">Direct exposure to senior leadership, world-class academics, and international partners.</li> </ul> <p> </p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: (2027 PhD/ABD graduates) Senior Associate (Antitrust & Competition Economics) - European Union
description: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p><a href="http://www.crai.com/">Charles River Associates</a> is a leading global consulting firm that offers economic, financial, and strategic expertise to major law firms, corporations, and governments around the world. Since 1965, CRA experts have combined rigorous cutting-edge research, state-of-the-art methodology, and proven experience to address our clients’ most complex challenges.</p> <p>CRA's <a href="https://ecp.crai.com/">European Competition practice</a> specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings before competition authorities and courts: mergers and acquisitions, abuse of dominance allegations, cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, market investigations, litigation and disputes, intellectual property or state aid. We also provide advice to regulatory authorities in similar matters.</p> <p><em>Learn more about our work by reviewing our Services and Industries on our <a href="https://www.crai.com/">website</a>.</em></p> <p>The <a href="https://www.crai.com/antitrust-competition-economics-practice/">Antitrust & Competition Economics</a> is hiring for the following European Union offices in Brussels, Belgium; Dusseldorf and Munich, Germany; Paris, France.</p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif;"> </span></p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>Senior Associates work closely with senior consultants on project teams and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high profile and most significant competition cases in Europe, playing a key role in shaping the economic analysis and thinking of these cases. Successful candidates have a strong knowledge of economic concepts and a range of research and quantitative skills. A typical Senior Associate would:</p> <ul> <li>Identify and conceptualise issues, specifying rigorous economic models to analyse market issues and data, undertaking statistical and econometric estimation, and managing the work of research associate staff and colleagues;</li> <li>Supervise, train and mentor research associate staff;</li> <li>Assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers summarising opinions, conclusions, and recommendations using market, industry or client-proprietary data;</li> <li>Act as a primary point of contact for lawyers and other industry or government clients on a variety of practice-relevant issues;</li> <li>Program, build models and/or perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R, SAS, Matlab, and Mathematica), including large data projects requiring use of cloud computing;</li> <li>Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions; and</li> <li>Contribute to practice-building activities (training, recruiting, publication, expertise sharing, etc.).</li> </ul> <p>Explore how CRA can help you <a href="http://www.crai.com/careers/accelerate">launch your career</a> and learn <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UJXu817TIZw">why PhDs choose CRA</a>.</p> <p><strong>Desired Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>PhD degree in economics with a completion date of December 2026/Summer 2027 and an academic focus on Applied Microeconomics or Applied Microeconometrics, with specializations like industrial organization, labor, health, behavioural and public economics, or other quantitative areas;</li> <li>Experience in Excel, Stata, Python, R, SQL, SAS, ArcGIS/ArcPy, or Cloud computing (Databricks/Spark, Google Cloud, Azure, AWS);</li> <li>Demonstrated understanding of, and ability to explain, economic, financial and/or accounting concepts, and quantitative and qualitative analysis methods;</li> <li>Curious and analytical thinkers who bring creative approaches to non-standard problems;</li> <li>Effective written and oral communication skills;</li> <li>Eagerness to learn new skills and programming languages;</li> <li>Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership;</li> <li>Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities;</li> <li>Excellent time management and task prioritization skills; and</li> <li>Clear and demonstrated interest in consulting through coursework, work experience, activities, or attendance at CRA recruiting events.</li> </ul> <p><em>As much of our work occurs in our offices, minimal travel is required.</em></p> <p><strong>To Apply</strong></p> <p>To be considered for a <strong>position in Europe, submit through this posting</strong>:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Resume/CV</strong> – please include current address, email and telephone number;</li> <li><strong>Covering letter</strong> – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals. Also, please note if you have a location preference;</li> <li><strong>Research/Job market paper</strong> – please submit your original research or dissertation;</li> <li><strong>Letters of Recommendation</strong> – please have three (3) LORs submitted directly to ----- </ul> <p>To apply for one of our <strong>other global locations</strong>, please visit our <a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/">Careers Site</a> to view available jobs.</p> <p>Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. Candidates focusing their search on industry and consulting who need to be considered early should indicate that in the CRA online application and submit all materials as early as possible.</p> <p><strong>Career Growth and Benefits </strong></p> <ul> <li>CRA’s robust <a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/talent-development/">skills development programs</a>, including both formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with project management skills, training continues with team management/development, client presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.</li> <li>We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a competitive salary and superior benefits package (plus a sizeable performance bonus), <a href="https://www.crai.com/benefits/">wellness programming</a> to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house <a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/immigration-global-mobility/">immigration support</a> for foreign nationals and international business travelers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Location Flexibility</strong></p> <p>CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.</p> <p><strong>Responsible AI Use in Recruiting</strong></p> <p>We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA <a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/ai-recruiting/">on our website</a>.  </p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity</strong></p> <p>Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.</p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Facilities Coordinator
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As Facilities Coordinator, you keep Harmattan AI’s Paris sites safe, compliant and running for our teams. You follow technical and soft service providers day to day, and you detect issues early before they affect the business. You are involved from the opening of our new buildings and take ownership of their daily operations. This role suits someone with solid technical knowledge of building systems who is comfortable in a fast-moving, high-trust environment. Responsibilities Manage technical and soft service providers day to day, including maintenance, cleaning, reception and security. Walk the buildings regularly to check that everything is in order and detect issues early. Coordinate maintenance providers and works on site, and follow up ongoing works through to completion. Support the opening of our new buildings alongside the Workplace, Facilities and Operations teams. Run the daily operations of our Paris sites as they grow. Handle employee requests and incidents through the ticketing system, with clear follow-up. Support QHSE (Quality, Health, Safety, Environment) topics in cross-functional work. Candidate Requirements Good technical knowledge of building systems, including HVAC, water and electricity. Experience coordinating technical and soft service providers. Basic knowledge of QHSE and health and safety topics. Well organised, with a rigorous approach to ticket management and daily follow-up. Clear communication with internal teams and external providers. Hands-on, reactive and agile, and comfortable changing priorities quickly. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

ATE Integration — Specify and integrate custom solutions from external vendors for testing equipment/instrumentation (RF housings, GNSS, optical systems…). Cross-Team Collaboration – Work closely with product development, manufacturing, and the Infrastructure & Deployment engineer to deliver robust, maintainable, and scalable automation solutions for the factory and field. Candidate Requirements MSc in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related engineering field. Excellent CAD skills with experience in rapid prototyping and robust solution implementation (SolidWorks, Catia or similar). Experience working with external vendors and machine shops for part fabrication and test equipment selection. Comfortable performing soldering, wiring, and small-scale electrical circuit work for test system integration. Experience working with electronic assemblies (PCBAs); familiarity with pogo-pin / bed-of-nails fixturing is a strong plus. Knowledge of RF housing design and specifications is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to design practical, robust engineering solutions. Excellent communication skills and proven ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams. Location and Commitments Contract Type: CDI Work Schedule: Full-time Availability: ASAP Location: Paris We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. title: Technicien de Maintenance Multi-technique
description: A Propos Harmattan AI est un acteur de nouvelle génération dans le secteur de la défense, spécialisé dans la conception de systèmes autonomes et évolutifs. En combinant ingénierie avancée, robotique et intelligence artificielle, nous développons des capacités opérationnelles pensées pour le terrain. Notre croissance rapide reflète une ambition claire : équiper les forces armées avec des systèmes à la hauteur des enjeux actuels. Nous recherchons des profils prêts à s’engager dans un environnement technique exigeant, avec un fort sens de la mission et de l’impact. À propos du poste En tant que Technicien de Maintenance Multi-technique au sein de l'équipe HSE & Facility, vous garantissez la sécurité, la conformité et la disponibilité des bâtiments, des équipements techniques et des installations du site. Vous gérez la maintenance préventive et corrective, coordonnez les prestataires externes et soutenez les visites du site ainsi que les événements durant la phase de montée en puissance. Il s'agit d'un contrat à durée indéterminée (CDI) à temps plein, basé sur le site de Wissous. Missions & Responsabilités Effectuer la maintenance préventive et corrective de niveaux 1 et 2 dans les domaines de l'électricité, de la plomberie, du CVC, de la serrurerie, de la menuiserie et du second œuvre. Entretenir les équipements techniques et les utilités (air comprimé, éclairage, sécurité incendie, portes automatiques, groupes électrogènes de secours) et tracer chaque intervention dans la GMAO. Gérer les prestataires de maintenance, du chiffrage et de la planification jusqu'à la supervision et l'élaboration des plans de prévention. Planifier et suivre les contrôles réglementaires périodiques, tenir à jour le registre de sécurité et présenter les indicateurs de maintenance, les risques ainsi que les besoins budgétaires via un tableau de bord mensuel. Appliquer et faire respecter les consignes HSE lors de chaque intervention (consignation/déconsignation, permis de feu, travail en hauteur, EPI), et participer aux accueils sécurité, aux évaluations des risques, aux inspections et aux exercices d'évacuation. Gérer le stock de pièces détachées, de consommables et d'EPI. Assurer le déroulement des visites du site et des événements exceptionnels, incluant la préparation technique et sécuritaire ainsi que la coordination sur place. Gérer le système de contrôle d'accès et la gestion des badges (création, modification, désactivation et attribution des droits d'accès). Contribuer à la gestion quotidienne des services généraux : courrier et colis, services généraux, aménagement des postes de travail pour les nouveaux arrivants, accueil des visiteurs et logistique événementielle. Profil recherché Formation : Bac professionnel à BTS, DUT ou BUT en maintenance du bâtiment, génie électrique, CVC ou maintenance industrielle. Expérience : Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en tant que technicien de maintenance polyvalent, idéalement sur un site industriel ou logistique. Habilitations : Habilitation électrique BR / B2V requise. CACES, travail en hauteur, SSIAP 1 ou attestation d'aptitude à la manipulation des fluides frigorigènes (F-Gas) souhaités. Compétences techniques : Polyvalence en électricité, plomberie et CVC, avec la capacité de lire des schémas techniques, d'utiliser une GMAO et d'appliquer la réglementation des sites industriels. Adaptabilité & Mobilité : Autonomie, capacité à prioriser les urgences et démarche d'amélioration continue. Communication & Relationnel : Maîtrise du français indispensable. Nous sommes certifiés ISO 27001 et en cours de qualification PASSI. Avec l'IA, notre métier a changé. Trouver une vulnérabilité n'a jamais été aussi accessible : les outils et la technique ne suffisent plus à faire la différence. Ce qui compte aujourd'hui, c'est de comprendre l'entreprise qu'on attaque : son métier, ses actifs critiques, ce qui la mettrait vraiment à genoux. C'est pour ça que le Red Team est au cœur de ce qu'on fait : un attaquant réaliste, avec de vrais objectifs, face à une organisation et ses vrais enjeux. Notre raison d'être : faire progresser durablement le niveau de sécurité de nos clients, pas seulement leur lister des failles. Nous cherchons donc notre Responsable Pentest / Red Team : la personne qui construira notre pôle Red Team et fera grandir l'équipe. Nos valeurs Chez Ballpoint, on accompagne nos clients dans la durée : Red Team, pentest continu, retests. Nos consultants connaissent leur SI autant que leurs enjeux métier, et c’est ce qui guide notre façon de travailler. 1. Curiosité : l'art de creuser au-delà des outils Nous cultivons la curiosité insatiable pour explorer des technologies inconnues et décortiquer les métiers de nos cibles, car c’est dans cette compréhension fine que se révèlent les chemins d’attaque les plus pertinents. 2. Chacun fait la différence Chez nous, une bonne idée n’a pas de grade. Un script qui fait gagner une demi-journée sur chaque mission, une meilleure façon de présenter un finding au COMEX, une idée d’offre : chacun peut faire évoluer nos méthodes, nos outils et nos offres. Et on attend de chacun qu’il le fasse. Le poste Tu prends la responsabilité technique de toutes nos missions offensives, en restant sur le terrain. Rattaché directement au fondateur, tu travailles avec l'équipe pentest / Red Team. Porter la qualité des missions : cadrage technique, méthodologie, relecture et validation des rapports avant livraison. Mener les opérations Red Team de bout en bout : scénario, infrastructure d'attaque, évasion, débrief au COMEX. Rester un pentester actif : web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel, sur une partie significative de ton temps. Faire grandir l'équipe : montée en compétence des juniors, parcours de certification, partage des techniques. Faire évoluer nos offres et nos outils : pentest continu, templates de rapport, outillage interne, veille. Appuyer l'avant-vente : calls techniques avec les prospects et chiffrage des périmètres. Ton profil Tu as au moins 5 ans de pentest derrière toi, dont de vraies opérations Red Team, et l'envie de faire progresser une équipe. Indispensable Solide expérience en compromission Active Directory et en pentest web. Opérations Red Team menées en conditions réelles : C2, contournement d'EDR, ingénierie sociale. Un français écrit impeccable. La capacité à expliquer une chaîne d'attaque à un RSSI comme à un directeur général. Modalités de télétravail flexibles mais présence à Paris nécessaire. Un bon feeling avec l'équipe : on passe beaucoup de temps ensemble, en mission comme au bureau, et l'ambiance compte autant que le niveau technique. Un plus Certifications offensives (OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, OSWE ou équivalent). Expérience d'un cadre PASSI ou d'environnements sensibles. CVE, articles, talks, outils open source. Avantages Tu rejoins une équipe de 7 consultants où tes choix techniques deviennent la norme, avec un accès direct au fondateur et une mission claire : faire évoluer notre pôle Red Team. Les missions sont variées (web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel…), et comme on suit nos clients dans la durée, tu vois l'impact réel de ton travail d'une année sur l'autre. Ballpoint évolue vite, et tu en es un acteur direct. Tes idées ont un effet visible dès la semaine suivante, pas après six mois de comités. Temps de R&D : du temps dédié à tes outils, à la recherche de vulnérabilités ou à la préparation d'un talk. Formations et certifications : un budget annuel (OSEP, CRTO, OSWE…), passées sur ton temps de travail. Télétravail : possible, avec 2 à 3 jours par semaine dans nos bureaux à Paris. Les classiques : CDI cadre, mutuelle, prévoyance, transport, tickets restaurant. Le process C'est le fondateur qui gère ce recrutement de bout en bout. Pas de cabinet, pas de tri automatique : chaque candidature est lue et étudiée avec attention. Ça peut prendre un peu de temps, alors n'hésite pas à relancer. title: Enterprise Demand Generation Marketing Manager
description: We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science. We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached. Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you. *Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers. About the role This role is based in our San Francisco office and is also open to remote candidates in the US. We're hiring an Enterprise Demand Generation Marketing Manager to build and run the programs that fill our pipeline. You'll own campaigns across paid media, webinars, account-based marketing, and social, from strategy through launch and optimization. This is a builder role. You'll stand up programs that don't exist yet, ship them quickly, and scale what works. You'll partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content, Design and RevOps to turn target accounts into qualified pipeline. title: Staff Product Engineer - AI Native
description: Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution? Vision: As a leading software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust is a global company dedicated to offering an integrated suite of legal and governance products. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world's leading Legal Tech company, aiming for a valuation exceeding $1 billion by 2026. Our Impact: From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East. Our Recognition: DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the "Happy at Work" and "Tech at Work" labels every year since 2019. The Role: Lini is DiliTrust's proprietary AI engine, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite. We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for a strong Software / Product Engineer, with a focus our platform architecture, to help us bring it to the next level. As a Software Engineer work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering. You will contribute to building, improving, and scaling the features that make Lini a reliable and powerful AI layer across the entire DiliTrust suite. We are looking for an engineer who writes clean, production-ready code and is comfortable taking ownership of features end-to-end, from technical design to deployment. We also care about how you think about AI: whether you bring genuine curiosity to the product, and whether you can translate a model capability into a great user experience. Missions Write specifications as the durable asset of the project. Executable acceptance criteria, and — crucially — the non-functional requirements that specs almost never carry: data classification, endpoint × role authorization matrix, volumetry assumptions, latency and throughput budgets. These are the requirements whose later correction is superlinear, so they get decided before generation, not after. Freeze the contracts before any fan-out. API schemas, types, module boundaries, invariants. Agents do not negotiate an interface in the hallway: each will make a plausible and incompatible assumption, discovered at integration. Pilot coding agents with a tight brief and a bounded context — narrow tasks, defined input and output artifacts, explicit stop conditions and budgets, full traceability of what produced each change. Keep producer and verifier separate. You do not sign off alone on generation you piloted, and you act as independent verifier on your peers' slices — with an adversarial brief ("find what breaks against this spec"), never "confirm this looks fine". Build the asymmetric gates that make the slice safe at volume — expensive to satisfy, cheap to check: property tests, contract tests, query-count and allocation budgets, execution-plan checks, policy-as-code, backward-compatibility proofs. Written before the implementation exists, so the agent closes the feedback loop itself without consuming human attention. Use code reading as a calibration instrument, not as a gate. Sample deliberately, by risk zone, to measure the real defect rate of the generator-plus-gates pair and to keep the team's mental model of its own system alive. Keep work-in-progress low. Capped PR size, thin vertical slices, trunk-based with very short branches, feature flags over long-lived branches, CI as the agent's first task rather than its last. More features in flight does not mean faster delivery when the bottleneck is verification. Design for blast radius. Reversibility, progressive delivery, structured logs, traces, metrics and instrumentation generated as a matter of course. On many paths, detecting in five minutes beats three days of review that prevents nothing. Requirements Being based in France with full working rights. Fluent in French and English. Experience & Seniority: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production Proven ownership of features across their full lifecycle — design, delivery, iteration, maintenance — on long-lived, multi-year products Strong background in complex, scalable web architectures, including real modularity: you have seen where coupling stops parallel work dead AI-Native Practice: Demonstrated, sustained use of coding agents in production work — not autocomplete, but delegated implementation with review and accountability A concrete, articulated view of where generated code fails: correlated defects rather than idiosyncratic ones, uniform surface quality that destroys the usual "look here" review signals, plausibility with no author to interrogate Comfort being accountable for code you did not author, and the discipline to refuse a change you cannot explain Verification & Quality: Real fluency in property-based testing, contract testing, and deriving tests from the specification rather than from the code Test-data strategy, including maintaining a volumetrically representative dataset as part of the verification apparatus — not a nice-to-have Instinct for the difference between a rigorous check and a scalable one: does the cost of checking grow with the volume produced? Security & Performance (non-negotiable on this role): Authorization modelling in multi-tenant systems, and why declarative, centrally enforced authorization beats reviewing each endpoint. Generated code reliably checks who you are and regularly forgets whether you are allowed Awareness of the attack surface specific to an agent-assisted pipeline: prompt injection through ticket descriptions, code comments and dependency READMEs; supply-chain risk on hallucinated package names; least privilege for non-human identities; and the most frequent risk of all — production data or proprietary code leaking into the development loop Performance as a measured number rather than a code-reading opinion: query budgets per HTTP request, N+1, unbounded result sets, missing indexes on new query paths, network calls in loops, execution-plan review. These are invisible at test-data scale and expensive in production Product & Team Collaboration: Excellent written communication — specification writing is now a core engineering skill on this role, not documentation overhead Extensive experience working directly with product managers, designers and stakeholders in a product-oriented setup Strong sense of ownership and sound judgment on risk: what to build, what not to build, what residual risk is acceptable and why Education: Master's degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience in senior SaaS environments What this role is not We would rather say it up front: It is not a prompt-engineering role, and it is not an ML/LLM research role. It is not a role where green tests are sufficient evidence. On security and performance, "the spec is met and the tests pass" is not a weak signal — it is a null one. It is not a ticket queue. The profile that shrinks in an AI-native team is the one whose value was implementing assigned tickets between two boundaries. Our Tech Stack Backend: Node.js / TypeScript Frontend: Vue.js 3 Database: PostgreSQL, MariaDB DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform Cloud: GCP Engineering apparatus you will use and help build: coding agents orchestrated deterministically in CI, aspect-scoped verification agents (authorization, performance, spec conformance, dependencies), policy-as-code, property-based and contract testing, volumetric test datasets, load and endurance gates on critical paths, feature flags, progressive delivery and end-to-end tracing. What we offer Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment — engineering primarily in Paris, with further engineering presence in Berlin, Montreal and Wilmington (DE), and offices across France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Canada, the USA, Mexico and Dubai; Our "Remote Policy" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote"; Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, luncheon vouchers, profit sharing bonuses, etc... Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function. Practical experience building and deploying AI or agentic systems that have operated in production environments. Demonstrated understanding of real-world AI engineering challenges, including reliability, latency, context management, failure modes, evaluation, and observability. Strong knowledge of agent architectures, tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops. Advanced practical experience with modern LLMs and the ability to build reliable workflows around probabilistic AI systems. Hands-on experience using coding agents and agentic development workflows as part of everyday software engineering. Ability to break down complex engineering tasks across multiple agents or specialized subagents and implement mechanisms for validating and improving their outputs. Strong architectural judgment and the ability to select the right combination of AI models, deterministic software, and human intervention for different challenges. Experience with TypeScript and Node.js, or strong experience developing AI systems in Python combined with the willingness and ability to work in a TypeScript-first environment. Strong product mindset and the ability to connect engineering decisions with operational efficiency and business outcomes. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English. We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to build and deploy production-grade AI systems that address complex challenges across heavy industries, including utilities, manufacturing, logistics, and energy. You will play a key role in developing a next-generation industrial operating system, taking innovative products from concept to production. The role combines agentic AI, multimodal machine learning, industrial data integration, and full-stack engineering. You will work with real-world data from sensors, machines, and operational systems to deliver intelligent solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and decision-making. This is a high-ownership opportunity in a fast-moving, zero-to-one product environment. You will help establish the foundations of an ambitious platform designed to transform industrial operations. Accountabilities You will design, build, and ship the core AI capabilities of an industrial intelligence platform, connecting advanced models with operational data, enterprise systems, and practical decision-making tools. Develop and deploy agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tool use, state management, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Build agent runtimes and orchestration frameworks supporting specialized agents for vision quality, predictive maintenance, and operations planning. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do. We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. The Role Reporting to the Regional Manager of Customer Success, the Customer Success Manager (CSM) will serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of high-value, strategic customers. This is a Sales role with a quota to achieve each quarter, focused on high-touch post-sales engagement, with particular emphasis on driving customer success, enabling upsell and cross-sell opportunities, managing renewals, supporting service performance, and enhancing the overall customer experience. The CSM will be responsible for maintaining and expanding revenue by developing strong customer relationships, understanding strategic priorities, introducing new product developments and commercial initiatives, and showcasing the full value of the Megaport proposition. This is a quota-carrying role, with defined revenue targets and performance measured against attainment. Success will be evaluated based on your ability to grow and retain revenue within your customer base, contributing to both individual and team objectives. This position is part of the wider Integrated Accounts Team, working closely with a Direct Sales Executive and Solutions Architect. The CSM will take a leading role in commercial engagement for existing strategic customers within the France portfolio, focused on growth, retention, adoption, and long-term customer satisfaction. You will champion Megaport’s value proposition and help drive adoption across our ever-evolving portfolio of services, strengthening Megaport’s position as a trusted infrastructure partner. What You’ll Be Doing Collaborate with Direct Sales Executives and Solution Architects to manage, grow, and retain revenue across a defined portfolio of strategic customers. Build strong relationships across multiple levels of the customer organisation, including senior and executive stakeholders. Develop and maintain account plans that capture customer objectives, priorities, risks, stakeholders, and growth opportunities. Lead regular strategic customer engagements, including business reviews and success planning sessions. Drive adoption and awareness of Megaport’s products, services, and broader partner ecosystem through proactive, tailored engagement. Proactively manage the renewal process, identifying risk early and working to maximise retention and customer lifetime value. Act as a trusted advisor from onboarding through to renewal and expansion, ensuring customers realise ongoing value from Megaport. Identify upsell, cross-sell, and whitespace opportunities based on customer priorities, use cases, and future plans. Represent the customer internally, coordinating commercial resolution of issues and identifying where Megaport can deliver greater value. Track customer sentiment, account health, risks, and pipeline activity in Salesforce (SFDC) to support planning and forecasting. Maintain strong product knowledge across Megaport’s solutions, confidently positioning their value within the customer’s broader technology environment. Support revenue growth campaigns by partnering with Sales and Marketing on focused strategies. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Finance and Operations, to help resolve service-impacting challenges. Continuously seek ways to improve customer experience and internal processes through customer feedback and commercial insight. What We Are Looking For 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, Account Management, or equivalent roles within the enterprise software, internet, cloud, or telecommunications sectors. Experience managing high-value or strategically important customers in a high-touch environment. Strong commercial acumen and the ability to influence revenue outcomes through a consultative, value-driven sales approach. Proven experience driving retention, adoption, upsell, and cross-sell within existing customer accounts. Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior and executive stakeholders. Demonstrated strength in identifying customer pain points and proposing relevant solutions that drive tangible value. Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, technical environments with shifting priorities. Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams and customers. Confident using CRM platforms such as Salesforce (SFDC) to maintain account records, opportunity pipelines, forecasting, and reporting. Understanding of cloud, networking, and virtualised compute environments in the enterprise space is highly desirable. title: Growth Marketing Manager (F/H)
description: Chez Younited, nous pensons que le crédit et les services bancaires devraient être aussi simples, rapides et transparents que tout ce qui fait partie de votre vie numérique. C’est pourquoi nous concevons nos services financiers de cette manière. Nous combinons technologie, données et automatisation pour repenser la façon dont les gens empruntent, paient, épargnent et gèrent leur argent. Aujourd'hui, plus de 1,5 million de clients nous font confiance et près de 500 collaborateurs contribuent à notre développement dans 4 pays européens . Ce que nous construisons Younited Credit : un crédit à la consommation instantané, directement accessible aux clients. Younited Pay : des solutions de paiement en plusieurs fois et de financement intégrées aux parcours clients de nos partenaires. Younited Cashback : du cashback et des offres personnalisées, enrichis par les données de l’open banking. Younited Bank : notre offre bancaire du quotidien, actuellement disponible via helios by Younited et en cours de déploiement. Notre ambition est de devenir un partenaire financier auquel les gens font véritablement confiance, en combinant simplicité, transparence et finance responsable. En tant qu’entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous intégrons les enjeux sociaux et environnementaux dans la manière dont nous développons notre activité. Les 5 valeurs qui nous guident Make it simple : privilégier la simplicité dans les produits, l’expérience client et notre organisation. Faire preuve de transparence. Act as an entrepreneur : prendre ses responsabilités, jouer collectif, oser essayer et accepter l’échec. Innovate or die : remettre en question le statu quo, aussi impossible que cela puisse paraître. Faster is better : privilégier la rapidité à la perfection, et l’alignement au débat. No limit : viser la lune tout en restant humble. Nous offrons à des personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes l’espace nécessaire pour donner le meilleur d’elles-mêmes, au sein d’équipes diverses et inclusives réparties à travers l’Europe. Contexte 📃 Rattaché.e à la Directrice Marketing Partenariats et en lien avec les équipes Commerciales, Product et Data, tu contribues à construire et à déployer une stratégie marketing efficace, génératrice de visibilité, d’opportunités business et de valeur pour nos partenaires. Ce poste est fait pour toi si tu aimes piloter des dispositifs marketing orientés performance, avec un focus fort sur HubSpot (segmentation, nurturing, automatisation) et la génération de revenues. Tu évolues avec aisance dans un environnement exigeant, en lien étroit avec les équipes Sales, où l’impact business, la structuration et l’efficacité opérationnelle sont au cœur des priorités. Missions 🚀 1. Structuration et pilotage de la stratégie outbound Piloter les campagnes inbound et outbound (digital et événements) Structurer la segmentation, le lead scoring et le nurturing dans HubSpot Mettre en place et optimiser les workflows et suivre la contribution au pipeline 2. Pilotage des canaux d’acquisition Coordonner les campagnes avec les partenaires médias (SEA, SMO) Contribuer aux projets SEO, SEA et refonte du site web Suivre la performance des actions et optimiser les dispositifs dans une logique ROI 3. Contenus et activation marketing Produire et piloter les contenus (WordPress, newsletters, articles, livres blancs) Contribuer à la visibilité SEO et aux actions événementielles Collaborer avec les équipes Marketing, Product, Brand et Account Management À propos de toi 👇 Tu es diplômé.e d'un Master 2 en marketing opérationnel ou digital avec minimum 3 ans d’expérience (hors stage ou alternance) Tu as une première expérience en environnement SaaS BtoB (idéalement en fintech) Tu as une très bonne maîtrise d'Hubspot : mise en place de workflows, lead scoring et nurturing segmentation de base de données et gestion du cycle de vie des leads pilotage des campagnes inbound / outbound et suivi de la performance via dashboards Tu as une bonne compréhension des enjeux SEA & SEO et une première expérience sur des logiciels CMS Tu es à l'aise sur la rédaction de contenus BtoB et tu as une bonne compréhension de la chaîne graphique, capacité à rédiger des briefs design (Figma est un plus) Processus de recrutement 📅 Premier entretien en visio avec Arthur, Talent Acquisition Manager pour discuter autour du poste, de tes motivations et de ton adéquation avec les valeurs et la culture Younited (30 min) Deuxième entretien en visio avec Anne-Gaëlle, ta future N+1 Directrice Marketing Partenariats pour approfondir les missions du poste, les facteurs clés de succès, la présentation de la stratégie Younited et de l’équipe (1h) Etude de cas à restituer en physique pour tester tes compétences appliquées à une problématique marketing BtoB (1h) Dernier entretien avec Pauline ta future N+2 Directrice Commerciale & Marketing pour valider l’alignement global sur le poste et les évolutions (30 min) 🎁 Les avantages à rejoindre Younited ? Des bureaux situés au cœur de Paris (9ème arrondissement) Un environnement de travail international et l’opportunité de partir en mission dans nos bureaux à l’étranger (Barcelone, Lisbonne, Rome) Un état d’esprit entrepreneurial et un fort esprit d’équipe Un accompagnement managérial et RH individualisé pendant l’onboarding et tout au long de l’aventure Younited Un environnement d’apprentissage continu avec la possibilité de bénéficier de formations externes et internes, plateforme de e-learning et des « Friday workshops » au sein de l'équipe Tech, pour accompagner le développement de chacun Une attention particulière à l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso Une charte de la parentalité pour soutenir tous les projets de famille à travers des mesures clés Pour t’accompagner dans les moments clés de ta vie personnelle, des congés exceptionnels souvent bien plus favorables que les dispositions légales Une politique de télétravail hybride 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine selon les équipes et la possibilité d’une semaine de full remote deux fois par an 33 jours de congés payés soit 8 de plus que les 25 jours légaux (à la place des traditionnelles RTT) Un abonnement à la plateforme Wellpass, ex Gymlib (+4000 activités sport et bien-être partout en France) à un tarif préférentiel Carte tickets restaurant à hauteur de 10€ pris en charge à 60% par l'employeur Des team buildings en France (Summer Party et Winter Party), à l’international et en équipe Younited is an Equal Opportunity Employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation. title: Support Specialist - Italian speaking
description: About Us Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in-service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the Role You'll be the first person a merchant contacts when something's not working. This role sits at the center of Tebi's promise to hospitality: when a restaurant reaches out, you turn a stressful moment into a solved one. title: Onderzoeksstage Water en Ruimte
description: 24-40 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,- stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot Waterbeheer heeft wonen, werken en leven in Nederland mogelijk gemaakt. Dat systeem is over honderden jaren opgebouwd en ingericht op een gematigd klimaat. Met zeespiegelstijging, droogte en zware neerslag lopen we nu tegen de grenzen aan. Drinkwaterbedrijven luiden de noodklok over leveringszekerheid en piekbuien wisselen af met extreme droogte. Water is bepalend voor waar we kunnen bouwen, werken en leven. Om weerbaar te worden moeten we andere keuzes maken over de inrichting en het gebruik van onze leefomgeving, waarbij functies beter aansluiten op de draagkracht van het water- en bodemsysteem. Elke dag worden er nieuwe ruimtelijke keuzes gemaakt, bijvoorbeeld over woningbouw, bedrijfsuitbreiding of het energiesysteem. Om daarin meer rekening te houden met water en bodem moeten de wereld van water en bodem en de wereld van ruimtelijke ordening beter samenwerken en elkaars taal leren spreken. Daarvoor bestaan al instrumenten, methoden en werkwijzen, zoals Omgevingstafels, de Watertoets, blauwe omgevingsvisies en water- en bodemsysteemanalyses. Maar werken die instrumenten ook echt, en wat is er nodig om ze beter te laten aansluiten op de praktijk? Dat zoeken wij uit. Wil jij aan het begin van jouw loopbaan direct meewerken aan onderzoek dat bijdraagt aan de koers van Nederland? Bij Berenschot werk je in een dynamisch team van adviseurs op het gebied van water en ruimte. Je krijgt de kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen én tegelijkertijd maatschappelijke impact te maken. Dit ga je doen Jouw onderzoek: Je maakt een inventarisatie van bestaande en nieuwe, innovatieve instrumenten en methoden, en/of je formuleert succesfactoren voor één specifiek instrument (een best practice). Samen met jou en je begeleiders bepalen we de precieze afbakening. Je onderzoek is onderdeel van het project Kwartiermaker water- en bodemsysteemanalyses (Interprovinciaal Overleg en het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat). Mogelijke resultaten zijn een bijdrage aan de analyse en toolbox van het kwartiermakerschap, een publicatie over best practices, of een instrumentenkoffer voor waterschappen, provincies en het ministerie van IenW. Je bent daarmee onderdeel van het kwartiermakerverhaal, maar blijft niet bij één project. Voor je onderzoek kun je ook putten uit andere lopende trajecten van ons team, zoals het Deltaprogramma Ruimtelijke Adaptatie (DPRA). Daar spelen vergelijkbare vragen over hoe je samenwerking tussen overheden en regio’s echt werkend krijgt. Zo haal je extra inzichten en praktijkvoorbeelden op en zie je hoe verschillende dossiers elkaar versterken. Naast je eigen onderzoek werk samen met een team van ervaren adviseurs aan maatschappelijke dossiers voor ministeries, provincies, waterschappen en drinkwaterbedrijven: Aansluiten bij werksessies en de reflectiekring: je ziet hoe bijeenkomsten met bestuurders, beleidsmakers en wetenschappers worden gestructureerd en werkt de uitkomsten uit tot heldere syntheses. Analyseren en schrijven: je voert interviews uit, analyseert beleidsdocumenten en schrijft mee aan rapportages en publicaties. Initiatief nemen: je werkt mee aan inhoudelijke kennissessies en netwerkevenementen om het watercluster van Berenschot op de kaart te zetten. Hier kom je terecht Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen. Dit zijn je directe collega’s Je maakt deel uit van het team Duurzame Leefomgeving; een groep van 22 bevlogen adviseurs met specialisaties in ruimtelijke ordening, planologie en bestuurskunde. title: Medior/Senior R&D Engineer Interoperability in Battle Labs & Experimentation (m/v/x/)
description: Ben jij een specialist op het gebied van computernetwerken en protocollen en heb je affiniteit met het toepassen van simulatie- en trainingssystemen in een R&D context? Wil jij werken in een innovatieve onderzoeksomgeving waar geavanceerde simulatoren en interoperabiliteit centraal staan? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Wat ga je doen? Als netwerk-expert binnen onze afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor onderzoek en ontwikkeling gericht op netwerken en systemen die verschillende simulatoren en operationele systemen veilig en efficiënt met elkaar verbinden. Je werkt aan vraagstukken met betrekking tot netwerkarchitecturen, (simulatie)protocollen zoals DIS en HLA, netwerkbeveiliging en schaalbaarheid van complexe simulatieomgevingen. Je levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan het mogelijk maken van interoperabiliteit tussen simulatoren, operationele systemen en autonome platforms, en bent betrokken bij de (door)ontwikkeling van zowel bestaande als nieuwe simulatienetwerken. In multidisciplinaire teams werk je samen met onder andere softwareontwikkelaars, domeinexperts en toekomstige eindgebruikers aan innovatieve oplossingen voor nationale en internationale stakeholders. Je bent hiervoor bereid om te reizen naar verschillende locaties, voornamelijk binnen Nederland. Wat breng je mee? Je bent iemand die in kansen denkt en nieuwsgierig is om bij te dragen aan oplossingen die werken in de praktijk. Je hebt heel makkelijk contact met eindgebruikers en kan hun wensen en ideeën snel in creatieve implementaties omzetten. Met je creatieve instelling maak je nieuwe technieken snel eigen en weet je deze te vertalen naar concrete resultaten! Daarnaast: Heb je een afgeronde bachelor of master opleiding in ICT, Computer Science, Informatica, Informatiekunde, of vergelijkbaar; Heb je minstens 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minstens 5 jaar ervaring op het gebied van netwerktechnologie, TCP/UDP, netwerkprotocollen, routering, switching en netwerkbeveiliging; Beheers je meerdere programmeertalen zoals C, C++, C#, Java en ervaring in scripting om experimenteeromgevingen snel op te zetten of aan te passen; Heb je interesse in experimenteren, wargaming en simulatie in een R&D-context; Heb je ervaring met het ontwerpen en beheren van robuuste, schaalbare netwerkomgevingen; Ben je bereid om je te verdiepen in (militaire) luchtvaartoperaties; Werk je graag samen, durft je te experimenteren en kan je technische keuzes uitleggen aan niet-technische collega’s; Kan jij je in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal zowel mondeling als schriftelijk uitstekend uitdrukken. Nice to have: Ervaring met of interesse in simulatie- en interoperabiliteitsprotocollen (DIS/HLA/FOMs); Ervaring met het opzetten van tijdelijke of experimentele infrastructuren; Kennis van netwerkbeveiliging of VPN-oplossingen; Ervaring met monitoring- of observabilitytools; Interesse in nieuwe technologieën zoals autonome systemen, AI in simulatie of digitale twins. Wat bieden wij jou? Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten. Naast dit alles bieden wij jou: De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken; Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4330,- en € 7000,- (bij fulltime dienstverband), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring; 45 verlofdagen (bij fulltime dienstverband); 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer; Een zorgtoelage via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; Een goede pensioenregeling Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving Bij de afdeling Training & Simulatie werken op dit moment rond de 100 deskundigen op het gebied van simulatie, informatica, training, luchtvaart en psychologie. Binnen onze projecten wordt multidisciplinair samengewerkt, zowel binnen als buiten het NLR. De afdeling beschikt over allerlei onderzoeksfaciliteiten zoals een battlelab en simulatoren voor gevechtsvliegtuig- en onbemande systemen en een laboratorium dat zich richt op AR/VR innovaties. Een plezierige werkomgeving vinden we essentieel. De sfeer binnen de afdeling is informeel en collegiaal en we vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zich thuis kan voelen bij ons. Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties. Bij ons werken bijna 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt. Wil jij meer weten?
