title: DevOps Engineer
description: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. DevOps at SkinVision As a DevOps Engineer at SkinVision, you will play a key role in building, scaling, and securing the infrastructure that powers our AI-driven health platform. You’ll design and maintain our cloud-based systems in AWS, implement CI/CD pipelines, enhance observability using Datadog, and drive operational excellence through automation and monitoring. Your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of a medical-grade system that serves users globally. You’ll collaborate closely with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure smooth delivery, rapid deployments, and resilient operations — ultimately enabling us to deliver life-saving technology with confidence. Beyond hands-on expertise with AWS and modern DevOps tooling, we’re looking for someone who thinks architecturally. You’ll get to know our current setup, form your own view of how it should evolve, and help define a target vision for our infrastructure, then drive its implementation. Day-to-day operational work is part of the role, but we value someone who thinks before building and takes ownership of where our infrastructure goes next. What you will do Cloud Infrastructure & Automation Design, build, and manage AWS-based infrastructure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and cost efficiency. Implement and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation. Automate environment provisioning, configuration, and deployments using CI/CD pipelines. Ensure system resilience, security, and performance through automated monitoring and alerting. CI/CD & Deployment Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines to support rapid, reliable, and safe deployments across environments. Manage deployment workflows using Argo CD and Kubernetes. Collaborate with developers and ML engineers to streamline build, test, and release processes. Integrate automated testing, rollback strategies, and version control into the deployment lifecycle. Observability & Monitoring Build a comprehensive observability stack using Datadog for metrics, logs, traces, and alerts. Define service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and dashboards for system performance. Proactively detect and resolve performance bottlenecks, capacity issues, and reliability risks. Create automated health checks and ensure visibility across production systems. Security & Compliance Implement security best practices for AWS, containers, and CI/CD pipelines. Manage identity, access, and secret handling (IAM, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store). Ensure compliance with medical device standards and data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA). Partner with the Information Security Officer to embed security controls across infrastructure and deployments. Reliability & Incident Management Lead incident response and root cause analysis for infrastructure or deployment-related issues. Establish SLAs and operational runbooks for production environments. Continuously improve system reliability through chaos testing, redundancy, and fault tolerance. Mentor engineers on DevOps principles, observability practices, and infrastructure automation. Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture Assess the current infrastructure and deployment setup, and form a well-reasoned view of how it should evolve. Define and maintain a target architecture for our cloud platform, balancing reliability, scalability, security, and cost. Translate the target vision into a practical roadmap and drive its implementation incrementally, alongside day-to-day operations. Document and communicate architectural decisions, aligning with engineering and leadership on technical direction. Essential skills Minimum of 6 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure roles. Strong expertise with AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Lambda, etc.). Expert in Kubernetes and Argo CD, deploying and managing production-grade custom Helm charts with secure, automated GitOps workflows in EKS Advanced knowledge of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar). Proficiency in Datadog for observability, monitoring, and alerting. Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, or Go. Experience managing infrastructure with Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible. Familiarity with networking fundamentals, load balancing, and API gateway configuration. Excellent problem-solving and incident management skills. Desirable skills Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, MedTech, or FinTech. Familiarity with multi-environment architecture (staging, pre-prod, production) and blue-green deployments. Exposure to event-driven systems, message queues, and data streaming (Kafka, SNS/SQS). Understanding of Zero Trust networking and cloud security best practices. Experience in cost optimization and performance tuning in AWS. Qualifications A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or Terraform Associate are a plus. title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
description: Are you an ambitious growth marketer with an entrepreneurial spirit and a track record of scaling customer acquisition? AIHR is looking for an experienced Senior Growth Marketing Manager to help accelerate growth across our B2C and B2B businesses. You'll work across the entire acquisition funnel, from scaling paid media and improving conversion to launching new growth initiatives that drive MQLs and revenue. You'll join an ambitious, results-driven Growth Marketing team, working closely with our specialists to challenge existing approaches, experiment with new ideas, and deliver results. You'll have the autonomy to lead initiatives, the support of an experienced team, and the opportunity to make a direct impact on a global e-learning business. About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals. We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players. Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and the potential to craft your own role. Role and Responsibilities As our Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you'll play a key role in accelerating customer acquisition across our B2C and B2B businesses. Working closely with the Head of Growth Marketing and VP of Marketing, you'll help us achieve our ambitious growth targets, improve acquisition efficiency, and identify new opportunities to scale. A core part of your role will be diving into performance data to understand what's working, what's not, and where our biggest growth opportunities lie. You'll work closely with our Performance Marketing Specialist to scale paid acquisition, challenge existing strategies, test new approaches, and support campaign execution where needed. You'll also collaborate with our CRO Specialist to identify opportunities across landing pages, website journeys, and conversion funnels, turning insights into experiments that drive more leads and revenue. You'll bring a strong growth perspective to our email marketing efforts, working with the team to analyze nurture flows, promotional campaigns, and audience segments, and identify opportunities to improve performance. Beyond optimizing existing channels, you'll explore, launch, and scale new acquisition opportunities, including those emerging from the changing AI- and LLM-driven marketing landscape. Most importantly, this is a hands-on role where you'll do more than develop strategies and bring ideas to the table. You'll actively execute initiatives yourself or work closely with the wider team to bring them to life. Whether you're launching a new campaign, testing an acquisition channel, or improving conversion, you'll take ownership of turning opportunities into measurable business results. On a typical week It's Monday morning, and you start the week with a coffee and a look at last week's acquisition performance. You open GA4, HubSpot, and your marketing dashboards to see how we're tracking against our B2C and B2B MQL targets. While digging into the data, you notice that one of our paid campaigns is generating plenty of traffic, but conversions have dropped. You investigate further, identify a few potential causes, and head into the Growth Marketing stand-up with some ideas to improve performance. After the stand-up, you catch up with our Performance Marketing Specialist to review campaign performance and discuss opportunities to scale. You identify a promising new audience and agree to test a different creative approach. Rather than just handing over your ideas, you jump into the advertising platform to help set up the campaign and work with the team to get the new creatives ready for launch. On Tuesday, you're focused on improving our B2B acquisition funnel. You've spotted an opportunity to increase conversions on the AI for HR Boot Camp landing page. You meet with our B2B Marketer and CRO Specialist to review the data, discuss your hypothesis, and agree on an experiment. You brief the team, align with sales on the proposed changes, and help move the experiment towards launch. Wednesday is a work-from-home day, giving you time to dive deeper into our acquisition strategy. You've been exploring how AI and LLMs are changing the way HR professionals discover training providers. You identify a potential new acquisition opportunity, research the market, and put together a practical plan to test it. Later, you meet with the Head of Growth Marketing to challenge your assumptions, refine the approach, and agree on the next steps. On Thursday, you review the performance of our B2C email nurture flows with the Email Marketing team. You notice an opportunity to improve conversions from leads to MQLs and propose a change to the messaging and sequence. After lunch with colleagues in the office, you turn your attention to an upcoming quarterly campaign, working with the wider Marketing team to finalize the messaging and coordinate the launch. You also start investigating new channels that could help expand the campaign's reach and attract new audiences. Friday starts with reviewing the results of a recent landing page experiment. The changes have improved conversion, so you work with the CRO Specialist to roll them out more broadly. You also catch up with our BizOps team to improve HubSpot reporting, ensuring we have better visibility into acquisition performance and opportunities for growth. Before wrapping up the week, you review progress against our growth priorities, share your findings with the team, and identify the next opportunities worth pursuing. After a productive week of analyzing, experimenting, and driving initiatives forward, you close your laptop and join your colleagues for Friday drinks. title: wo-stage onderzoek milieukosten m.b.v. bestaande afval- en emissiestatistieken
description: wo- afstudeerstage/praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die nieuwsgierige onderzoeker die energie krijgt van data, duurzaamheid en nieuwe inzichten? Wil jij een inhoudelijke bijdrage leveren aan de statistieken van het CBS? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het kabinet wil dat Nederland in 2050 volledig circulair is. Om te kunnen volgen of we die doelstelling halen, is betrouwbare informatie nodig over onder andere afval en emissies naar water. Het CBS verzamelt en publiceert deze gegevens voor bedrijven. Daarbij maken we vooral gebruik van gegevens uit het elektronisch Milieujaarverslag (e-MJV), aangevuld met enquêtes. Naast de hoeveelheid afval en wateremissies brengen we ook de milieukosten van bedrijven in kaart, bijvoorbeeld de kosten voor afvalverwerking en voor het lozen van afvalwater. Hiervoor wordt nu een aparte enquête gebruikt. Maar is dat eigenlijk wel nodig? Tijdens je stage onderzoek je of we de milieukosten voor afval en wateremissies kunnen berekenen met gegevens die al beschikbaar zijn. Je combineert bijvoorbeeld gegevens over de hoeveelheid afval en geloosd water met bestaande indicatoren, zoals gemiddelde kosten per ton afval en sectorspecifieke kosten per kubieke meter geloosd water. Je gaat onder andere: bestaande data en indicatoren analyseren en beoordelen op bruikbaarheid; onderzoeken welke methode het meest geschikt is om de milieukosten te schatten; een berekening of model ontwikkelen waarmee de kosten kunnen worden afgeleid; de uitkomsten vergelijken met de beschikbare gegevens uit de huidige enquête; onderzoeken hoe betrouwbaar en bruikbaar de schattingen zijn; je bevindingen vertalen naar een concreet advies voor het CBS. Met jouw onderzoek willen we bepalen of we meer uit bestaande data kunnen halen en minder hoeven uit te vragen bij bedrijven. title: System Identification Engineer
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the role Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles. As a System Identification Engineer, working out of Lausanne, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust. Responsibilities Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the . Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller. Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects. Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting. Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C. New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles. Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree. System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data. Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for. Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs. Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun. Nice to have Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven. Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code. Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality. Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Electrical Distribution Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion. YOUR IMPACT In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the electrical architecture of a first-of-a-kind power plant and define how it interacts with both internal consumers and the wider electrical grid. You will drive the modernization of power system monitoring, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance strategies, leveraging data and digital technologies to improve reliability and operational performance. Beyond the plant itself, you will help develop innovative grid-facing capabilities and online services, exploring new ways for power generation assets to create value through advanced connectivity, flexibility, and participation in the evolving energy ecosystem. WHAT YOU WILL DO Define and develop the plant's electrical architecture, ensuring reliable and efficient operation across diverse electrical loads and systems. Lead grid integration studies and analyses, including load flow, fault, stability, power quality, and protection coordination assessments. Specify and oversee the integration of electrical equipment, including transformers, switchgear, protection systems, and power conversion technologies. Establish monitoring, diagnostics, and condition-based maintenance approaches to improve asset reliability and reduce unplanned downtime. Develop predictive maintenance frameworks using operational and equipment health data. Evaluate and develop opportunities for advanced grid services, including flexibility, ancillary services, demand response, and other emerging market offerings. Explore innovative digital and online services that can enhance plant performance, operational visibility, and value creation within future energy systems. WHO YOU ARE You have a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Science or equivalent You have a strong background in electrical engineering, control systems, or a related field, with hands-on experience in industrial environments You are adaptable and motivated to grow with evolving technologies and increasing system complexity Experience in grid integration, or electrical infrastructure for industrial, utility-scale, or energy-related facilities is a plus Knowledge of reactive power compensation is a plus INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-60 min) Technical Screening (30 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table. title: Senior Fleet Manager

Voor de rol van Senior Fleet Manager zoeken we iemand die stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat. Je overziet het grote geheel, maar snapt de details die de data beïnvloeden. Verder zien wij graag het volgende terug: Denkniveau: Je beschikt over HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau; Sterk analytisch: Je bent een kei in het analyseren van data en haalt hier moeiteloos de juiste conclusies en actiepunten uit; Proactieve mindset: Je wacht niet af, maar signaleert kansen en knelpunten voordat ze een probleem vormen; Kennis & Ervaring: Je snapt hoe onderhoudsprocessen (triage, MTTR, MTBF) werken. Je kunt draagvlak creëren en complexe technische of data-gerelateerde zaken begrijpelijk uitleggen aan directie, klanten en leveranciers. Ben jij klaar voor deze stap als Senior Fleet Manager en wil je bouwen aan de toekomst van ons wagenparkbeheer op Schiphol? Druk dan snel op de sollicitatieknop en laat jouw cv en motivatie achter! Wat bieden wij Een leuke en uitdagende baan met veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Je komt te werken in een professionele en stabiele kantooromgeving. Orion is een sterk groeiend bedrijf binnen de Pon-onderneming en biedt doorgroeimogelijkheden in de toekomst. Van bootcamp tot golfclinic; Korting op eigen producten van Pon (bijv. een nieuwe Gazelle fiets of privé lease auto), €500 per jaar; Lease-a-bike regeling voor het leasen van een Pon-fiets. Over de organisatie Orion ontzorgt bedrijven met grote complexe wagenparken door het reparatie- en onderhoudsproces optimaal te structureren. Onze werkplaatsen zijn gevestigd in: Almere, Amersfoort, Badhoevedorp-Schiphol (2 locaties), Ede, Emmeloord, Helmond, Leeuwarden, Leiden, Lichtenvoorde, Middelburg, Montfoort, Oosterwolde, Utrecht en Zwolle. title: Data Analyst
description: Help launch our new temping product and drive commercial impact! At YoungOnes, data is at the start of every decision. Our Data & RevOps team has a seat at every table and takes a leading role in where the company goes next. Two years ago we rebuilt our data environment in Databricks from scratch, and it is fully ready for the future. There are few better environments to work in. We are looking for a Data Analyst with a focus on product, who also supports our marketing and commercial teams with deeper analyses. Someone with experience who is ready to take responsibility, and who does not stop at a report but actively steers on the outcome. What will you do? Your main focus is product. Next to that, you support marketing and the commercial teams, which keeps your work varied. Product In the flexible work market, companies used to choose between temping (uitzenden) and freelancers. Since last year we have been bringing a new proposition to market that sits in between: non-service temping. It combines the legal certainty of temping with the flexibility and personal control of freelancing, all through our platform. This is an important step in our strategy towards one app for work. Take the lead in tracking the progress of this new proposition; Define the KPIs and funnel that show whether the proposition is working; Analyse the full journey of workers and clients, from onboarding to repeat shifts; Spot problems early and actively steer where you see them; Translate insights into concrete improvements together with product and development; Work in a select team that operates as a startup within the company. Commercial & marketing support Next to product, you are the analytical sparring partner for our commercial teams and marketing. You go beyond the standard reports and dive deeper when questions get complex. Deliver deeper analyses for the commercial teams, for example on client potential, retention and growth opportunities; Support marketing with insight into campaign results and ROAS. This role is diverse, but above all it gives you a lot of freedom to take initiative and make an impact. Your team You will join an effective Data & RevOps team with 3 Analysts, 2 Engineers, a Performance Manager and 2 Process aAnalysts. You report to the Head of Data. The data itself is interesting: we support a two sided marketplace with workers on one side and clients on the other. AI is built into the design of how we work and makes the technical side of your job more simple. We use Genie within Databricks, which fully understands our data environment, Claude to connect multiple systems, and Gemini for quick support on smaller tasks. What are we looking for? We are looking for someone who: Has at least 3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst or Commercial Analyst; Has experience tracking and steering product performance, and/or with commercial or marketing analytics; Is strong in SQL and familiar with Python/PySpark and a visualisation tool such as Power BI or Amplitude; Has experience with Databricks, or is eager to work in it; Uses AI tooling naturally to work faster and smarter; Takes ownership and dares to make choices and influence stakeholders; Communicates clearly with both technical and non technical colleagues; Is already residing in the Netherlands and is allowed to work in the country and speaks fluent English (Dutch is a plus); We are not looking for someone who only delivers reports. We want someone who takes the lead, sees problems before others do and makes sure something is done about them. What do we offer? A gross salary between €4,300 and €6,100 based on full-time employment; 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek; 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance; We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp; Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, biweekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months, sport tournaments, and much more; A leading role in a new proposition that is key to our strategy; One of the best data environments to work in, with Databricks and AI built in; A company that is truly data driven, where your insights shape decisions; A high level of autonomy, freedom and responsibility. YoungOnes is a place where you learn fast, build fast and see results fast. Ready to take the lead? Then we would love to hear from you. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: QA Engineer
description: About the role At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams. What you'll do Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building; Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why; Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable; Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses; Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority; Advise on releases. You map out risks and give clear advice on the quality of a release; Provide insight. You collect test data and show how our software quality is doing; Keep the balance. You help teams weigh fixing bugs against building new features. What you bring A bachelor's level of working and thinking, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field; At least 2 years of work experience, including at least 1 year as a QA Engineer, Software Tester or Test Automation Engineer; Experience setting up and carrying out a test approach and test plans; Experience with test automation and test frameworks; You're comfortable working with AI tools and use them purposefully: to test faster and better, and to set up automated tests; Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team and with a bug tracking system, preferably Jira. You work independently, make decisions in your own work and give advice, whether asked or not; You're critical and analytical, take initiative and work well with developers, product and business. Nice to have Knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and you're comfortable working with code; You look beyond "does it work?": also at accessibility, speed, security and multilingual support. Experience with tests that run automatically on every code change, and you know how to deal with unreliable tests; You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues test better; Experience testing mobile apps. We're looking for someone who sees quality as something the whole team owns. You don't just perfect your own testing work; you ask yourself what needs to change structurally so the whole team tests better. Our own values guide the way: Own it , Say it , Make it . title: Head of Compliance
description: About Doit We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one. You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area. What You’ll Own Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures. Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite. Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients. Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity. Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments. File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR. Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board. Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest. Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters. Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027. Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution. Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale. Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes. Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections. Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast. Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools. Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues. Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators. A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder. Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania. Nice to Have Lithuanian language ability. An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT. Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions. Experience with clients across several EEA countries. CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification. This Role Is Not For People who only want to attend meetings. Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business. People who say no without offering a compliant way forward. People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions. Location This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week. You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: Online assessment or practical task Role-specific interview CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Business Development Manager
description: Do you want to contribute to Western resilience? Do you want to protect people and critical infrastructure – ultimately saving lives? title: Account Executive, Strategic Deals - Attribute™, EMEA
description: <p><strong>Account Executive, Strategic Deals - Attribute™</strong></p> <p><strong>Location</strong><strong><br></strong>This is a <strong>fully remote</strong> opportunity based out of any of the following with travel as needed: UK, Ireland, Netherlands, Sweden, Estonia.</p> <p><strong>Who We Are</strong><br>Become part of the team behind <strong><a href="https://www.doit.com/blog/why-we-are-launching-attribute?_gl=1*j8dlue*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTUwMzU2OTc0NS4xNzgzNDEzMDIx*_ga_Y90QRD61TR*czE3ODM0MTMwMjAkbzEkZzEkdDE3ODM0MTMwMzMkajQ3JGwwJGg2MjkyMjk4OTAkZDN4YlFHcnJpZVVJUzJiV2JORC02QXZmOGtLLWJzczczelE" target="_blank">Attribute™</a></strong>. Following our recent acquisition, we're bringing together visionary engineers and go-to-market leaders to disrupt cloud management with real-time, tagless cost visibility across cloud and AI workloads. As an Account Executive focused on Strategic Deals, you'll join a founding GTM movement inside an established market leader trusted by over 4,500 global customers, unlocking high-impact opportunities through top-tier strategic partnerships.</p> <p>DoiT empowers cloud-native organizations to scale faster and innovate with confidence. By combining our Cloud Intelligence technology with Forward Deployed Engineers and deep specialization across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, we help tech-forward companies navigate their toughest infrastructure and cost governance challenges end to end.</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity</strong><br>As an Account Executive, Strategic Deals for <strong>Attribute™</strong>, you will be at the forefront of building a brand-new region from scratch and introducing a groundbreaking solution to a fundamental business problem in modern FinOps. You will work on Strategic Deals, leveraging strategic partnerships with AWS, OpenAI, Top Private Equity firms, and our global current install base. A strong focus will be placed on co-selling and unlocking strategic deal opportunities with AWS, ISVs, and channel partners. Traditional cloud cost allocation methods rely heavily on static tagging—an approach that becomes obsolete in modern, shared cloud and AI infrastructure. When multi-tenant clusters, shared GPUs, microservices, and dynamic AI workloads dominate, organizations face severe blind spots: they cannot accurately determine the true cost-to-serve for specific applications, autonomous agents, or business teams, making it impossible to calculate true gross margins at a granular customer level.</p> <p>Attribute™ solves this by taking a completely different approach. Leveraging runtime eBPF technology, Attribute™ captures real-time network traffic signals and kernel-level observability without requiring engineering teams to manually tag or instrument code. By analyzing actual runtime consumption across CPU, GPU, memory, network, and AI model API requests, it provides accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) and unit economics based on real usage. Organizations finally get precise cost governance and gross margin visibility across complex cloud and AI environments with zero developer overhead.</p> <p>As an Account Executive building this region from scratch, you will establish a high-potential greenfield territory. You will drive sales end-to-end with a heavy emphasis on net-new logo acquisition, defining the regional go-to-market strategy and creating the foundational customer success stories that define this category.</p> <p>You will own full-cycle deal execution across Startup, Digital Native, and Enterprise segments—prospecting new accounts, running compelling solution pitches, navigating complex technical evaluations alongside engineering partners, and closing strategic partnerships end to end.</p> <p>You'll have the rest of the Cloud Intelligence portfolio behind you: 4,500 customers, AWS/Google Cloud/Azure partnerships, and Forward Deployed Engineers who solve problems other vendors walk away from. But the product you'll carry every day is Attribute™, and the market is only just learning it exists. That's the opportunity.</p> <p>Expect to travel 10–15% of the time to meet customers, engage with hyperscale teams, and show up at industry events that matter.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to closed deal, consistently hitting and exceeding quota and pipeline targets</li> <li>Build a high-volume pipeline and establish the region from scratch with a hunter mindset, driving outbound prospecting and net-new logo acquisition across EMEA</li> <li>Build the first wave of reference customers and case studies the rest of the GTM org will run on</li> <li>Develop and execute a regional strategy that identifies high-growth opportunities and untapped markets across EMEA</li> <li>Build deep, mutually valuable relationships with AWS Sales Leaders and Partner Managers to co-sell and expand market share</li> <li>Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and Solutions Architects to solve the toughest technical challenges prospects face</li> <li>Maintain rigorous forecast accuracy in Salesforce and ensure every proposal reflects the quality of what we actually deliver</li> <li>Guide customers from initial curiosity through contract execution, setting them up for a world-class onboarding experience</li> <li>Feed real customer signal back to product and marketing every week — in a founding team, that loop is the job</li> <li>Generate your own pipeline through prospecting, networking, and creative outreach — not just working what's handed to you</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven track record of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience with a strong emphasis on net-new logo acquisition and building a regional territory from scratch</li> <li>A track record of selling cloud services and understanding how consumption-based models work</li> <li>Hunting mentality: demonstrated drive to self-generate pipeline, prospect into target accounts, and close new business independently</li> <li>Experience selling to platform engineering / DevOps teams.</li> <li>Comfort selling something new — you've sold a product before there was a Gartner quadrant for it, and you preferred it that way</li> <li>Technical curiosity: you understand the cloud computing market and can hold your own in conversations about AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure products and architecture</li> <li>Genuine interest in FinOps and how engineering organisations actually consume the cloud — you don't need to be a practitioner, but you need to care</li> <li>Ability to build influential relationships across matrixed organisations and turn professional networks into real partnerships</li> <li>"Roll up your sleeves" attitude that pervades both sales and business development activities</li> <li>Prior experience at AWS, ISVs, or in strategic partnerships is a big plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Are You a Doer?</strong><br>Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.</p> <p>We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.</p> <p>What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun!<a href="https://careers.doit.com/life-at-doit/"> Click here to learn more about our Life at DoiT</a>.</p> <p>Sounds too good to be true? Check out our<a href="https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-DoiT-International-EI_IE1972488.11,29.htm"> Glassdoor reviews</a>.</p> <p>We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.</p> <p>Full-time employee benefits include:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited PTO</li> <li>Flexible Working Options</li> <li>Health Insurance</li> <li>Parental Leave</li> <li>Employee Stock Option Plan</li> <li>Home Office Allowance</li> <li>Professional Development Stipend</li> <li>Peer Recognition Program</li> </ul> <p><strong>Many Doers, One Team</strong><strong><br></strong>DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal — it's our strength. title: Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
description: The Practical Detail Location: Vienna Working Model: Hybrid (3 days per week in-office) Contract Type: Permanent Why this role matters In your first year, you will drive growth and strengthen Flora Food Group's position as the leading provider of plant-based spreads in the Austrian and Swiss market. This role is essential to advancing our mission of offering healthy, sustainable, and affordable alternatives to dairy. You will actively manage key accounts, ensuring forecast accuracy and developing negotiation strategies that unlock value. Your work will directly influence how our products reach kitchens across Austria, supporting better food choices for consumers. What you'll do Manage major Swiss accounts, actively understanding and responding to customer needs and expectations. Control and ensure accuracy of sales forecasts to support business planning. Plan and oversee customer budgets to align with growth objectives. Develop and implement negotiation strategies that deliver value-adding measures in 2027. Drive growth strategies with key customers to elevate Flora's market presence. Performance You will own the accuracy of forecasts and the execution of growth plans, directly impacting sales volume and market share in Switzerland. Success will be measured by your ability to manage risks and opportunities in customer business and to implement effective negotiation strategies. Your data-driven approach will ensure that Flora remains a step ahead in a competitive market. Care You will report to the Head of Sales CHATIT and collaborate closely with Sales Leads, Finance, Demand Planning, and Marketing teams. Working within a dynamic team, you will contribute to a culture that values shared success and entrepreneurial spirit. Your decisions will reflect long-term thinking, balancing immediate business needs with sustainable growth. Passion You are passionate about plant-based food and the role it plays in healthier, more sustainable diets. You bring curiosity about consumer trends and a commitment to raising the bar in how Flora's products meet taste, nutrition, and functionality expectations. Your enthusiasm for food innovation will inspire your approach to account management and market development. About you You have a strong background in key account management within the fast-moving consumer goods sector, with experience in the Swiss retail and food service markets. You are skilled in using data tools such as Excel, Nielsen, and GfK to inform your decisions and strategies. Your negotiation skills are proven, with a track record of implementing sustainable growth strategies with major customers. You thrive in a role that offers autonomy and the chance to shape negotiation approaches and business development. You are fluent in German and English and comfortable working in a hybrid environment. You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences. Where this could lead to This role typically leads to a Senior Key Account Manager or Key Account Teamlead position, where you will take on greater responsibility for strategic accounts and broader market influence. title: Credit Risk Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Dublin | 💶 €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐ About the team:</strong></p> <p>Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and the planned launch of new initiatives. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Credit Risk Manager to help drive the credit and growth strategy for our consumer lending products as we grow our business in Ireland. Our credit teams are part of our Credit Discipline which drives a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives analysts the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Our credit analysts and managers are fully embedded into a product squad alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Marketers, Customer Researchers, Data Scientists etc. This enables us to solve customer problems in a fast paced and innovative way.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working closely with Borrowing squad leadership to develop and execute an ambitious growth strategy </li> <li>Collaborating with people from engineering, marketing, product, risk and control to design and deliver new products and customer journeys</li> <li>Leading the development and maintenance of the NPV models and affordability strategies that underpin the Borrowing underwriting decisions</li> <li>Monthly monitoring and reporting on Borrowing performance to stakeholders up to executive level</li> <li>Collaborating with the Decision Science team to maximise value from our internal and external data through cutting-edge ML models</li> <li>Promoting a culture of proactive, high quality analysis and ensure we have the right credit capabilities, infrastructure and talent in place to scale safely</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> <li>You have extensive experience in unsecured lending in Ireland</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of lending economics and have experience developing and deploying underwriting strategies and credit models</li> <li>You have strong analytical and data capabilities, backed up by technical coding skills. SQL, Python and Looker experience is a plus</li> <li>You have experience with the development and maintenance of NPV models</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of the regulations that apply to lending in Ireland</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are keen for the chance to improve our products and help ship changes to our customers</li> <li>You are a strong communicator, able to cut through complex problems and articulate decision points, particularly to senior leadership</li> <li>You have experience in project management and coordination across teams</li> <li>You work well collaborating in a team with diverse skill-sets and personality types</li> <li>You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing a positive impact to our customers and Monzo</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, case study & behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with senior leadership</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p> <p>#LI-MOS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Model Risk Officer
description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used. This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day. You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle. What you'll ship Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle. Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk tiering for each. Coordinate independent second line validation and challenge before models are used, including credit risk and ECL, IRRBB, and Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 capital models. Design the ongoing monitoring and re-validation cycle with the Machine Learning team, covering performance testing, limitation tracking and re-validation triggers. Partner with model owners in Credit Risk and Treasury ALM, and coordinate within the second line Risk function, so model risk challenge is built into the wider risk and capital frameworks. Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit. What you'll bring Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models. Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced. Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook. Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them. The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge. Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge. Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. title: HR Consultant
description: De functie Als HR Consultant zorg je ervoor dat de dagelijkse HR-processen binnen Interconnect soepel en zorgvuldig verlopen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een correcte personeelsadministratie, bewaakt de kwaliteit van HR-processen en ondersteunt leidinggevenden en medewerkers bij uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je werkt aan verschillende onderdelen van de employee journey, waaronder in-, door- en uitstroom, verzuimadministratie, personeelsmutaties en werving & selectie. Daarnaast denk je actief mee over het verbeteren van processen en het verder professionaliseren van de HR-dienstverlening. Je maakt deel uit van een betrokken HR-team, bestaande uit een HR Teamlead, HR Business Partner en HR-medewerker. Het team valt onder de afdeling Business Support. Wat ga je doen? Beheren en bewaken van de kwaliteit en volledigheid van personeelsdossiers. Verwerken en controleren van personeelsgegevens in HR-systemen, waaronder Nmbrs. Ondersteunen bij de salarisverwerking en uitvoeren van administratieve controles. Adviseren over personeelsregelingen, arbeidsvoorwaarden en HR-procedures. Beantwoorden van HR-gerelateerde vragen van leidinggevenden en medewerkers. Verzorgen van administratieve processen rondom in-, door- en uitstroom en verzuim. Bijdragen aan HR-projecten en de realisatie van HR-doelstellingen. Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden en optimaliseren van HR-processen en werkwijzen. Wie ben jij? Je houdt van structuur, werkt zorgvuldig en vindt het leuk om collega's verder te helpen. Tegelijkertijd kijk je kritisch naar bestaande processen en denk je actief mee over hoe zaken slimmer en efficiënter kunnen worden georganiseerd. Je beschikt over: Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding. Kennis van HR-processen, personeelsadministratie en relevante wet- en regelgeving. Bij voorkeur enkele jaren werkervaring als HR-medewerker, HR Consultant of in een vergelijkbare functie. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling. Een proactieve, nauwkeurige en resultaatgerichte werkhouding. Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 32 uur per week. Ervaring met Nmbrs is een mooie aanvulling. Wat biedt Interconnect? Je komt terecht bij een stabiel en groeiend familiebedrijf waar samenwerking, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en een prettige werksfeer centraal staan. Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Een bruto maandsalaris tot € 4.250 op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis, ervaring en opleidingsniveau. Een jaarlijkse prestatiebonus die kan oplopen tot één bruto maandsalaris. Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband. Een goede pensioenregeling waarbij Interconnect gemiddeld twee derde van de premie betaalt. 25 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis, met de mogelijkheid om maximaal 10 extra dagen bij te kopen. Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,21 per kilometer of volledige vergoeding van het openbaar vervoer. Mogelijkheid om maximaal 40% van de contracturen vanuit huis te werken. Een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan en mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op: Een moderne werkomgeving in het hoofdkantoor in ’s-Hertogenbosch, inclusief lunch-/werkcafé, gaming room en skybar. Een eigen fitnessruimte met moderne apparatuur en groepslessen onder begeleiding van een professionele trainer. Regelmatige teamactiviteiten, waaronder een zomer-BBQ, game nights, vitaliteitsdagen en teamuitjes. Over Interconnect Interconnect is een Nederlands familiebedrijf dat sinds 1995 actief is in de wereld van IT-infrastructuur, datacenters en clouddiensten. Met ongeveer 130 medewerkers en eigen Tier III-datacenters in ’s-Hertogenbosch en Eindhoven levert Interconnect veilige en betrouwbare IT-oplossingen aan onder andere managed service providers, softwarebedrijven en zakelijke eindgebruikers. De organisatie speelt een belangrijke rol in de digitale infrastructuur van Nederland en combineert technologische expertise met de betrokkenheid en korte communicatielijnen van een familiebedrijf. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. - Fluency in German. NICE TO HAVES: - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €234,000 - €246,000 per year. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. title: Offensive Security Engineer
description: <blockquote>Shape our offensive security services</blockquote> <p>Ready to immerse yourself in the world of securing critical IT by thinking and acting like a real adversary? Join our security team at Schuberg Philis! We are an engineering company with a people-centric approach and a focus on customer satisfaction, dedicated to delivering mission critical IT solutions to our customers.<br><br>As an offensive security specialist, you will collaborate with about 30 customer-oriented teams managing critical system environments. Your role is pivotal in ensuring the security of Schuberg Philis and its customers by identifying and exploiting realistic paths in our complex, one-of-a-kind environments. You will scope, execute, and report on penetration tests, purple and red teaming engagements, and threat modeling assessments tailored to our unique and complex mission-critical environments. We focus on what real-world adversaries search for and abuse, not compliance-driven checks that look good on paper but don't raise resilience.<br><br>You will engage closely with engineers, customer teams, external experts, vendors, and stakeholders to define and drive work that measurably strengthens these environments. The engagements are hands-on and technical, and we want someone who can own an engagement end-to-end: from a customer saying "we want to test something, can you help us figure out what?" all the way to presenting the results of a bespoke engagement to their board.<br><br>At Schuberg Philis, we thrive on growth and innovation, offering an exciting environment for security enthusiasts. We are actively seeking security professionals at various seniority levels to join our security team. We provide a challenging and rewarding atmosphere where autonomy in your day-to-day operations is valued.</p> <p>We are a small team and we are part of the team that works on our value propositions for security. This means we have a lot of mandate to define and shape offensive security services within Schuberg Philis. <br><br>In this role, you will work with cutting-edge technologies, spanning private and public clouds and VMs to serverless - all highly automated. As an offensive security specialist your skills will be put to the test in a diverse technological landscape.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Success in this role requires a unique blend of skills and traits</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience (the more the better) in an offensive security role.</li> <li>A security mindset aimed at identifying realistic attack paths from a real-world adversaries' perspective.</li> <li>Giving security advice that fits the unique and challenging mission-critical environments we manage to help our teams set up strong defense-in-depth. Recommendations should fit the environment in front of you, not a textbook fix that can't be applied there.</li> <li>You will have the experience and judgment to run engagements on your own, and the collaborative instinct to tackle the hardest problems together. Our teams will love you if you can take them by the hand through the entire process.</li> <li>Experience and understanding at least one of the major clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP).</li> <li>Strong risk management thinking, sense of ownership, and a solid BS radar.</li> <li>Eagerness to learn, coupled with a stubborn determination to make things happen.</li> <li>Experience with building solid tools that support our activities.</li> <li>Experience in IT engineering and IT engineering heavy environments preferred.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>What will be your focus?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help scope, lead, execute, and report on various types of complex offensive security engagements. Every environment is unique, and we expect our engagements to treat them as such as well.</li> <li>Build and maintain tools to help scale our offensive security services well beyond a small team. As an example: by building and maintaining a secure AI penetration testing methodology and toolkit that can be used by our customer teams.</li> <li>Collaborating with all customer teams, offering guidance on security-related topics.</li> <li>Evaluating and improving the security resilience of Schuberg Philis itself through red and purple teaming engagements.</li> <li>Using your technical and soft skills to guide the organization in adopting security measures along with the broader security team. We show impact, and can help limit it.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Where we would love to grow as a team</strong><br>We care more about mindset, experience, and being calm under pressure than a checklist of specific technologies. Our best work comes from people who can rely on experience and the right mindset to tackle the unfamiliar. However, if you bring depth in advanced malware development, Kubernetes, or OT security, you'll find eager sparring partners and plenty of room to make those areas your own.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics. </em><br><em> </em><br><em>It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
