title: Customer Service Agent
description: Bij Crisp staan onze klanten op nummer één. Ons gezellige en hechte serviceteam doet er alles aan om die klanten van de beste service te voorzien. We hebben daarom veel persoonlijk contact met de klant, en ondersteunen onze bezorgers voor een vlekkeloze bezorging. We zijn nog volop in ontwikkeling, dus je denkt ook mee over hoe we onze service kunnen verbeteren. Wat je gaat doen Je hebt elke dag direct contact met onze klanten, vooral via Whatsapp. Zo maak je ze nog blijer nadat ze ons gesproken hebben. Daarnaast geef je feedback van klanten door aan de juiste teams binnen Crisp, zodat we onze service kunnen blijven verbeteren. Ook zorg je samen met onze bezorgers en je collega's op onze logistieke hubs dat bezorgingen vlekkeloos verlopen. Verder verdiep je je in onze processen. Zoals je al hoort, geen dag is hetzelfde! Hoe ziet een werkdag eruit? 's Ochtends hou je onze bezorgroutes goed in de gaten. Is het druk op de weg? Dan zorg jij ervoor dat onze klanten op tijd weten dat hun bezorger iets later is. Ondertussen pak je WhatsApp-berichtjes van klanten op. Je helpt ze met het aanpassen van hun bestelling, het kiezen van een bezorgtijd of beantwoordt vragen over ons assortiment. Zo leer je elke dag iets nieuws over eten! Lunchtijd! Elke dag lunchen we met onze eigen boodschappen. Een ideaal moment om ons assortiment én je collega's beter te leren kennen. Na de lunch beantwoord je vragen via WhatsApp, social media en e-mail, terwijl je collega's de bezorgingen in de gaten houden of bezig zijn met de processen. Je merkt dat er veel vragen zijn over een bepaalde marketingactie. Dat geef je dus meteen even door aan de juiste collega. De collega's die 's avonds werken nemen jouw taken over. Dat zorgt ervoor dat je de feedback die klanten doorgeven via de app nog even kunt verwerken. Tijd om af te sluiten. Samen met je collega's drink je nog een ijskoud Crisp-drankje in onze gezellige keuken. Dit ben jij Je herkent je in het volgende profiel: Je bent parttime (16-24 uur per week) beschikbaar. We zijn 7 dagen per week open van 07:30 tot 23:00 uur, en je werkt straks in shifts van 4 tot 8 uur. Daarom is flexibele beschikbaarheid voor overdag, avonden én in het weekend een must. Je woont in omgeving Amsterdam en bent voor minimaal één jaar beschikbaar. Een kantoor in de Amsterdamse Pijp met een grote keuken waar flink wordt geluncht, gezellig gekookt en waar de kans op zelfgebakken taart of vegan roze koeken groot is. Goed om te weten: vanaf januari 2027 groeien we door en verhuizen we naar een gloednieuwe, grotere locatie in de buurt van Zaandam, Sloterdijk en de Houthavens, waar we vanaf dan onze nieuwe thuisbasis hebben. Je schrijft en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands. Op een persoonlijke en creatieve manier reageren op klanten gaat jou makkelijk af. Je bent oplossingsgericht en empathisch. Je kunt je verplaatsen in onze klanten en begrijpt wat er nodig is om hun ervaring met Crisp nog beter te maken. Je bedenkt creatieve oplossingen om onze klanten te verrassen en verwachtingen te overtreffen. Als je klantenservice-ervaring hebt binnen organisaties waar kwaliteit hoog in het vaandel staat, is dat super! Wat wij bieden Een marktconform salaris, afhankelijk van leeftijd. Een gezellig en hecht team. Veel verantwoordelijkheid, uitdagend werk en een dynamische omgeving. Een kijkje in de keuken van een snelgroeiende start-up. We zijn volop in ontwikkeling dus jouw ideeën tellen mee. Werken bij een B-Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op ons voedselsysteem en échte verandering teweeg te brengen Enthousiaste en ondernemende collega’s om mee te werken en te leren. Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL. Voor nu een persoonlijk budget voor yoga, sport, mobiliteit en downtime via bijvoorbeeld ClassPass, Pathé en Blendle. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Tijd om je collega’s te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. Een kantoor in de Amsterdamse Pijp met een grote keuken waar flink wordt geluncht, gezellig gekookt en grote kans op zelfgebakken taart of vegan roze koeken. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Ben jij geïnteresseerd? Is de functie van Service Agent jou op het lijf geschreven, solliciteer dan via onderstaand button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. title: Enterprise Applications Manager
description: Enterprise Applications Manager About the role As SkyNRG grows, applications such as SAP Public Cloud, HubSpot, and our Inventory Management System are becoming increasingly important to our operations. We are looking for an Enterprise Applications Manager to take functional ownership of this landscape and ensure our systems effectively support the business. You will connect business needs with IT solutions, translating requests into clear requirements and coordinated improvements. Working across Commercial, Operations, Maintenance, HSE, Finance and QA, you will create structure, improve adoption and act as the main point of contact for our enterprise applications. Your key responsibilities include: Take functional ownership of SAP Public Cloud, including EAM and HSE, HubSpot, IMS, and other enterprise applications. Translate business processes and needs into clear requirements, functional designs, user stories and test scenarios. Manage functional support, incidents and change requests, coordinating with external partners and vendors where necessary. Build and maintain the enterprise application roadmap, backlogs and change priorities with IT and business owners. Configure applications within the functional scope and coordinate releases, testing and implementation. Improve application adoption, data quality, reporting and integrations across the application landscape. Maintain process documentation, user guides, application records and access roles in line with security and compliance requirements. Train and support key users across the organization, helping teams make effective use of the available systems. Your initial focus will include strengthening the use of SAP EAM and HSE, improving HubSpot’s commercial processes and reporting, and introducing a consistent intake and change process for business requests. While this role does not have direct reports, you will coordinate external implementation partners and application vendors. You will also work closely with the wider IT team to ensure our enterprise applications are reliable, secure and aligned with business priorities. Your profile As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You feel comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, take ownership, and thrive when things are still developing. You understand both business processes and enterprise technology. You can move comfortably between conversations with business stakeholders, technical colleagues, and external partners, translating different perspectives into practical solutions. Structured and pragmatic, you take end-to-end responsibility rather than simply passing requests along. You recognize yourself in the following: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline. At least five years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, Application Owner, or in a comparable enterprise applications role. Hands-on functional experience with SAP, ideally SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, in at least one relevant area such as EAM or Plant Maintenance, HSE or EHS, Finance, or Procurement. Experience working with a CRM platform, preferably HubSpot. Demonstrated ability to translate business processes and needs into clear requirements, functional designs, and test scenarios. Experience managing application vendors or implementation partners, including support agreements and service levels. Understanding of change management, release management, testing and access control in an enterprise environment. Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to constructively challenge business requests. Professional fluency in English. Experience in an industrial, energy, chemical, manufacturing or asset-intensive environment would be an advantage. Familiarity with system integrations, SAP BTP, APIs, Power BI or data-quality initiatives would also be beneficial. Knowledge of relevant regulatory and compliance frameworks, such as NIS2, ISO 27001 and GDPR, is considered a plus. About SkyNRG Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel. Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions. title: Director Go-to-Market and Revenue Strategy
description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. WHO YOU ARE You are a commercial leader who has built the go-to-market of a platform from a blank page and knows what it takes to turn a product that people already use into a business that pays for itself. You have priced and packaged products for marketplaces, brands or merchants, and you have seen the difference between a model that looks good in a spreadsheet and one that a small business owner actually adopts. You are comfortable in a B2B2C world: the customer is reached through someone else's channel, the data belongs to the ecosystem, and the money comes from several ends of a transaction at once. You influence without authority, because the teams that execute will rarely report to you. You are rigorous with numbers and plain with people, and you are at ease saying what the evidence shows even when the room expects something else. You want to build something that reaches millions of small businesses, you are prepared to work for it. THE OPPORTUNITY Toqan for Partners is the AI assistant for the merchants across the companies of the Prosus ecosystem: restaurants, pharmacies, hotels, sellers, real estate agencies and car dealers, five million businesses in total. It launched to restaurants on iFood in Brazil in September 2026 and reached 65,000 restaurants in four weeks with no media spend. The next twelve months decide how it will become a business: which applications partners pay for and at what price, how value is shared with everyone the partner transacts with, how the uplift is measured and published so the next company embeds, and how the product travels from iFood to the rest of the ecosystem and to India and Europe. You will lead that work, as the owner of the go-to-market and the revenue strategy of Toqan for Partners, alongside the product and technology leads who own what gets built. WHAT YOU’LL DO Own the commercial model Define pricing and packaging for the applications partners pay for, media management, supply, finance and operations, at a fraction of what they spend today and justified by the return they see. Design how Toqan takes part in the value it creates for the other end: take rate on agent-negotiated supply, credit origination, brand and industry media, and cross-sell of the ecosystem companies' own products. Set the rules that keep it honest, starting with the separation between paid placement and recommendation. Drive the rollout across the ecosystem With the Head of Operations, secure the commitment of each business in the ecosystem: sponsor, distribution, conditional yes and first market. Run the rollout inside each one, working through the teams that own the merchant relationship, and bring the product to its next verticals and markets. Build the measurement Own the scoreboard: active partners under a strict definition, uplift per business in retention and GMV, cost and value per active partner. Make the uplift the argument that brings the next company in and the evidence behind every pricing decision. Structure the partnerships that carry the revenue Lead the commercial agreements with distributors, industry, fintechs and the ecosystem companies' commercial platforms, from first conversation to signed terms, and the co-investment models that align their incentives with the partner's. Build and lead the team Hire and develop a small go-to-market and revenue team, growth on the merchant side, monetisation and analytics, and set its standard for rigour, ownership and candour. WHAT YOU BRING Ten or more years in go-to-market, revenue or commercial strategy, with at least one commercial function built from scratch and grown to scale. Hands-on experience with pricing and packaging, ideally for marketplaces, retail media, payments or SaaS sold to small businesses. Experience on more than one side of a marketplace: merchants or sellers, brands or suppliers, the platform itself. A track record of adoption at scale with a long tail of small customers, not only of large enterprise deals. Proven ability to move a result through teams that do not report to you, and to work inside another company's channel. Fluency with data: you build the business case, run the analysis and read the uplift yourself, and use AI tooling as a normal part of how you work. Candour, humility and patience: you say what the numbers say, you arrive to learn before you teach. English required; Portuguese or Spanish strongly preferred. WHAT WE OFFER Global impact: a product that reaches five million small businesses across Latin America, Europe and India. Ownership: the commercial model of a new business, with the numbers to be judged on and the autonomy to build it. Growth: exposure to the leadership of the group and of its companies, and a clear path into operating roles in the ecosystem. Competitive compensation and the Prosus benefits package for the location of the role. Why Prosus? At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next. Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing. Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page . Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have. Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values . Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer

Embedded in the engineering team, you own mechanical design, qualification and industrialization through initial ramp-up. title: Head of Insurance Supply
description: 🍇 About grape: Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first. At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you! Your role As Head of Insurance Supply, you will own grape’s carrier and reinsurance partnerships. You will build and diversify our capacity panel, secure the structures behind existing and new products, and ensure our insurance supply grows with the business. Today, this responsibility is led by our CEOs. You will take it over, build it into a dedicated function and represent Insurance Supply as a member of grape’s Leadership Team. What you’ll do: 1. Build and diversify our capacity panel Develop grape’s capacity strategy for Switzerland and Liechtenstein. Identify, qualify, negotiate with and onboard new carriers and reinsurers. Lead relationships from the first conversation through due diligence, commercial negotiation and signed agreement. Secure the contracted capacity required for grape’s annual business plan and written commitments for the following year. Diversify the panel to support growth, enable new products and reduce concentration risk. 2. Build strong carrier partnerships Own carrier and reinsurer relationships at operational, commercial and executive level. Establish a clear governance cadence, including operational reviews, strategic meetings and annual capacity negotiations. Own commercial terms, contracts, renewals, outsourcing agreements and service levels. Monitor partnership performance, resolve issues early and build relationships that grow over time. Represent grape credibly across the insurance, reinsurance and broking market. 3. Shape products and build the function Design and secure the carrier and reinsurance structures required for new products. Evaluate pricing, loss ratios, reserving, commissions, capital requirements and solvency implications. Work closely with Actuarial, Underwriting, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Product and Distribution. Own the Insurance Supply strategy, priorities, OKRs, processes and reporting. Provide the Leadership Team with a clear view of capacity coverage, pipeline and risk. Hire and lead a Carrier Partnerships Manager as the function grows. What you’ll bring: At least eight years of insurance experience, including carrier partnerships, MGA capacity management, programme business, reinsurance broking or business development at a carrier. A demonstrated track record of taking capacity relationships from initial contact through negotiation to a signed binding authority, treaty or comparable agreement. Strong commercial judgement and the confidence to negotiate with senior stakeholders across carriers, reinsurers, MGAs and brokers. A strong understanding of insurance portfolio economics, including loss ratios, reserving, pricing, capacity and capital implications. Experience building long-term external partnerships and a relevant network across the carrier, reinsurance or broking market. The ability to move between strategy, relationship building, negotiation and operational detail. Fluent English. Strong advantage: Experience working within an MGA or directly with MGA and programme structures. Knowledge of Swiss and Liechtenstein employee insurance, particularly KTG, UVG and UVG-Z. Familiarity with the Swiss and Liechtenstein regulatory environment. German or French proficiency. Experience building or leading a capacity or carrier-partnerships function. If you have built insurance capacity partnerships in another European market and can transfer that experience to Switzerland and Liechtenstein, we would still like to hear from you. 🤝 What we offer in return: 🌱 Empowering workplace: Join a passionate team and an empowering workplace where you are given the ownership, tools, and support to make decisions and take initiative. Together we grow and build innovative solutions. 💻 Hybrid setup: Enjoy the flexibility of our hybrid work schedule, with the freedom to work remotely or from our office in Zurich. On Thursdays, our team day, we meet together in our Zurich office. 🪑 Home office stipend: To enable our hybrid setup, we allocate a one-off CHF 200.- home office budget to help you set up your dream workspace in the comfort of your own home. 🌐 Internet allowance: We give you a monthly internet allowance to help cover your internet costs at home and enable you to work seamlessly from your home office. ⏳ Flexible working time: You can distribute your working hours the way you want to. 🧠 Learning budget: We support you in improving your skills, acquiring new knowledge and advancing your career. We also allocate a CHF 1'500.- budget annually ❤️‍🩹 Well-being: Work-life balance is important to us and we foster a supportive work environment. We support you with mental health sessions with our partner Aepsy. 🎫 Team events: Every month we gather for fun and engaging events where we can connect and bond with our colleagues and our teams. ✈️ Team retreats: Once a year we travel somewhere nice to bond with our colleagues. 🚂 Travel and commute: We will cover your SBB half fare card, so we can spend some time together in the office. 🌴 Paid vacation: You get 5 weeks (25 days) of paid vacation every year and 2 additional days of paid vacation to compensate for canton-related holidays, religious holidays, birthdays, etc. The total amount of paid vacation days per year is 27 days. 🧖‍♀️ Wellness budget: Health and well-being looks different for everyone. You can optimize your wellness budget to best fit your needs. 👨‍👨‍👦‍👦 Parental and adoptive leave: We offer additional time off to support employees who are balancing family and work time in the most crucial stages of family life. ✈️ Digital nomad: For every 3 years of employment, you can work for an extended period of time from anywhere in the world (location subject to review). 🏁 Our recruitment process We place particular emphasis on four areas when making our selection decision: professional and technical skills, mindset & values. We evaluate these through the following steps: Step 1 - Your motivation To get to know you better, we invite you to a 30-minute motivational interview with our Talent Acquisition Team. Step 2 - Role fit In the first interview, we assess how well your qualifications and skills align with the role requirements. This discussion will take place with your Hiring Manager. Step 3 - Case study For roles with higher technical demands, we will invite you to complete a case study or technical assessment. This allows us to better evaluate your specific skills and problem-solving abilities. Step 4 - Our culture connect Throughout the interview process, you'll gain insight into our company culture, and we'll explore how your values and mindset align with our ways of working. The final interview will offer a deeper look into this connection, along with broader discussions about the role and our vision. Our diverse experiences, perspectives, and voices make us the company we are, and we would love to learn more about you! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- Health is our foundation. Innovation drives our mission. Together, we’re building the future of employee insurance. At grape, collaboration isn’t just a buzzword, it’s the foundation of how we work, live, and succeed. From bold brainstorms and lessons learned, we overcome challenges side by side. Our time together is our greatest asset. Disrupting an industry that truly needs change takes courage, creativity, and team spirit and that’s exactly what defines us. With well-being at the core, we foster an environment where ideas and people thrive. Your growth matters as much as our mission. Whether it’s supporting your self-care, developing new solutions, or redefining how health and insurance connect, we grow together. Our values guide us every step of the way: keeping Health at Heart , Invent ing Together , and always striving to Embrace Clarity . Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: 🍇 About grape: Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We can’t wait to get to know you! Your role Our data and tech give us an edge in risk assessment, pricing and premium calculation. This role turns that into accurate models that support our carrier partners and our growth, builds tuned models where they beat rules and off-the-shelf LLMs in claims (triage, intervention, return-to-work, fraud), and responsibly explores how data can help employees stay healthy through grape Care. We’re looking for an applied ML engineer / data scientist to build predictive models from the ground up on real, regulated insurance data. You’ll own problems end to end, from effective-dated records to production, in a domain where correctness and responsible use genuinely matter. Starting points include pricing and risk, portfolio monitoring, claims and payment patterns, triage and return-to-work, absence, and fraud detection. grape sits on a rich dataset, though, and you’ll help find the next high-value use cases. You’re candid about what the data can support, and you propose simpler approaches when they’re the right answer. This is not an LLM role. LLM and agent workflows and document extraction sit with our engineering teams, and you’ll use their outputs as features. What you'll do: Build and validate models Own the full model lifecycle: feature engineering, training, evaluation, explainability, deployment, and drift monitoring. If you've built something before, start here The hardest part of a startup usually isn't the code. It's finding customers who really need what you build and getting them to change how they work. At Scalera, that part is done: manufacturers, suppliers and contractors across Switzerland, Austria and Germany already run their tenders through us every day. What we need now are people who can take the next unsolved problem and turn it into a product customers can't do without. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first engineer somewhere, or built something people paid for, this role was written for you. About Scalera Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Large manufacturers and suppliers still run their most document-heavy processes by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate them one by one. Our product matching already handles 1,400 tender positions in 16 minutes at 98% precision, work that used to take a sales rep most of a day. What you'll do You'll be part product manager, part engineer. You'll spend real time with customers and help shape what we build. Sometimes you'll spot the next problem yourself, and sometimes we'll hand you a clear priority to run with. Spend real time with customers. Join calls and site visits, sit with the people who do the work, and understand why they do it the way they do. You'll know their problems firsthand, not from a ticket. Shape what to build. Turn what you hear into a clear problem, a scope and a plan, and push back when the obvious request isn't the real need. When we bring you a priority, you'll own how it gets solved. Build it. Design and build backend services in Go and Python that turn messy tenders, catalogs and purchase orders into data customers can rely on. Ship, then check. Get it in front of customers fast, watch how they actually use it, and iterate. Own it in production. When something breaks at a customer, it's yours to understand and fix. Build with AI. Use AI heavily in how you work, and design systems that agents can use as well as people. What success looks like after 3 months There's a part of the product people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version You've shipped features from both sources: priorities we set and ideas from your own customer conversations At least once, you've talked us out of building something customers didn't really need You've left a part of the platform simpler than you found it You'll probably thrive here if You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a product line, or a side project with paying users You've built and run backend systems in production that other people depend on. We care more about your judgment than your language; you're strong in Go or Python and happy to work in both You're solid on data modeling, API design and messy real-world data You'd rather talk to a customer than wait for a spec You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make progress while the problem is still half-defined, which at a startup it usually is You want a large scope of responsibility and are happy to own things well beyond your job title Rapidly changing requirements don't throw you. When customers or priorities shift, you adapt and keep going You enjoy direct customer contact and want to be on customer calls You make things simpler over time, not more clever You write clearly in English. German is a plus, not a requirement You probably won't enjoy it if You just want to code and go home You don't like talking to customers, whether on calls or on the occasional site visit Ambiguity and chaos bother you You want a well-defined backlog handed to you Your main goal is managing people soon. Here, scope grows with what you own, not with headcount Our stack Go and Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL, GCP, and LLMs throughout the document pipeline. You don't need to know all of it on day one. How we hire Screening call (30 min) with our VP Engineering. It's two-way: ask us anything, including the hard questions. Technical deep-dive call : walk us through something you built from scratch, the decisions you made and what went wrong. Meet Scalera Day : join us remotely to work on a real problem with real (anonymized) construction documents, and meet the team. Offer : if it's a fit on both sides, we'll move quickly to an offer. Working at Scalera Remote within the EU or EEA Small team, no bureaucracy. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO, VP Engineering and Customer Success Competitive compensation Founders and former founders: if you're unsure whether you fit, send a few lines about what you built and why you moved on. title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
description: This role is also open to candidates living in the EU or EEA. We can't consider applications from other locations. If you've built something before, start here Most ML jobs hand you a benchmark. This one hands you a business problem with paying customers and their real data. Construction tenders are long, messy and full of trade jargon, and every decision a customer makes on our platform becomes a labeled example you can train on. We need someone who can turn that data into models that customers notice: from the first experiment to the model serving production traffic, and back again when a customer says it got something wrong. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first ML engineer somewhere, or shipped a model people paid for, this role was written for you. About Scalera Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Manufacturers, wholesalers and suppliers in Switzerland, Austria and Germany still run their most document-heavy work by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate that work one process at a time, and ML sits at the center of every one of them. What you'll own You'll own the ML behind our products, end to end. In practice that means: Training and fine-tuning : embedding models, rerankers, classifiers and LLMs, trained on our own data. Document understanding : models that pull structure, quantities and product specs out of tenders, orders and catalogs. Product matching : retrieval and LLM agents that match tender positions to the right products. Evaluation : offline benchmarks, per-customer evals and gates that keep a new model from shipping if it makes things worse. Training and serving infrastructure : automated retrain pipelines, GPU serving and vector search in production. Customer problems : when a model gets something wrong for a customer, finding out why and fixing it. What success looks like after 3 months There's a model or part of the pipeline people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next. You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version. A model you trained runs in production, and customers can see the difference in their results. Retraining runs automatically, and nothing reaches customers without passing an eval you designed. You've cut LLM cost or latency by replacing an expensive step with a smaller model of your own. You've decided at least one thing we should stop building. You'll probably thrive here if You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a model in production, or a side project with real users. You've trained and fine-tuned models yourself, ideally embeddings, retrieval or document models, and evaluated them honestly on held-out data. You've built with LLMs in production and know where agents fail. You write strong Python and can run what you build: Docker, CI/CD, and cloud on GCP, AWS or Azure. You measure before you believe, and a single aggregate score doesn't convince you. You'd rather open a customer's actual document than wait for a spec. You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make progress while the problem is still half-defined, which at a startup it usually is. You want a large scope of responsibility and are happy to own things well beyond your job title. Rapidly changing requirements don't throw you. When customers or priorities shift, you adapt and keep going. You enjoy direct customer contact and want to be on customer calls. You write clearly in English. German is a plus, not a requirement. You probably won't enjoy it if You just want to code and go home. You don't like talking to customers. Ambiguity and chaos bother you. You want a well-defined research agenda handed to you. You'd rather hand a model to someone else to deploy and debug. Your main goal is managing people soon. Here, scope grows with what you own, not with headcount. Our stack Python and PyTorch, open-weight and frontier LLMs, LangGraph, Langfuse, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Pinecone, and GCP. Position overview Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship. Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible. The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision. The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against. This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep. The mandate Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down. Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would. You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved. Win the right members, efficiently. You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it. Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances. Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost. Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless. You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay. Build one Customer organisation, not four. Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week. Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call. You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations. How you'll operate This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here. You lead from inside the work. You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them. You move people with the business case, not the whip. When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title. You have extreme ownership. You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach. You have genuine gravitas. Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger. You diagnose before you prescribe. You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom. What you'll have done 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime). Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app. Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product's economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage. Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that's sustainable and growth that's borrowed from tomorrow's risk appetite. A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn't support them, and outcomes you can prove. The first 90 days Day 30: The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board. Day 90: At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week. What this role is not Not a requirements-gathering role. Other requirements A dedicated workspace. A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area. Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles. title: Storytelling and narrative lead
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>We are looking for an outstanding <strong>storytelling and narrative development lead</strong> to lead our content marketing team. Canonical has a robust portfolio of open source products and offers support for a wide range of open source technologies. This role is for someone who cares deeply about narrative quality and wants to elevate our brand positioning. It requires process discipline and creative smarts, leadership skills and performance-driven strategy to ensure our content aligns with our business objectives. </p> <p>The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, technology marketing and the use of technology in marketing. They would love to gain experience optimizing content processes, coaching others on their narrative skills and building brand authority. They enjoy learning and improving themselves, the team and the organization. They problem solve, get hands-on, experiment, measure and use automation to make daily life easier. To succeed in this role, the candidate must be metrics-driven, highly organized and skilled at team development, capacity planning and cross-functional collaboration.  </p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Communications. </p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is home based in the EMEA region. </p> <h2>What your day will look like</h2> <ul> <li>Develop and execute a content strategy that aligns with our business goals, SEO and brand. </li> <li>Manage our content calendar end to end, ensuring content is efficiently produced with minimum friction and process clarity.</li> <li>Ensure content quality, consistency and brand alignment in everything we produce. </li> <li>Collaborate with our web and growth engineering teams to optimize content for search and AI engines, building on proven SEO or GEO expertise. </li> <li>Supervise quarterly content planning sessions and work closely with content specialists, product management and marketing to optimize content plans.</li> <li>Monitor and report on KPIs for our content program and use analytics tools to identify improvement opportunities. </li> <li>Align messaging to ensure integrated campaign support across channels, working closely with our marketing, product and brand teams.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for in you</h2> <ul> <li>At least 5 years of work experience in content or related roles, preferably at technology companies, with 2+ years of experience as a manager or team lead. </li> <li>Proven experience creating authoritative and engaging content. Portfolio of written work required.</li> <li>Applied knowledge of GEO and SEO, experience with relevant tools and SEO-driven content calendars. </li> <li>Excellent project management and interpersonal skills with the ability to create highly efficient processes for content production and reuse. </li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications or a relevant discipline. </li> <li>Someone who is passionate about technology and open source. </li> <li>A problem solver: you don’t shy away from taking on challenges and see projects through to completion. </li> <li>Attention to detail and appreciation for standards: you value quality and accuracy but can adapt quickly when the need arises.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer you</h2> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.  <br>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.</p> <p>🏠Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</p> <p>📚Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum</p> <p>💰Annual compensation review</p> <p>🏆Recognition rewards</p> <p>🏝 Annual holiday leave</p> <p>👶Parental Leave</p> <p>🧑‍💼Employee Assistance Programme</p> <p>🧳Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</p> <h2><strong>About Canonical</strong></h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

title: Stagiair(e) Digitale Transformatie & Publieke Innovatie
description: Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot Digitalisering verandert de manier waarop overheden en publieke organisaties werken, besluiten nemen en dienstverlening organiseren. Tegelijkertijd groeit de behoefte aan praktische oplossingen, toepasbare kennis en slimme instrumenten die organisaties helpen om complexe digitale vraagstukken beheersbaar te maken. Wil jij ervaring opdoen binnen een toonaangevend adviesbureau en bijdragen aan vraagstukken op het gebied van digitalisering, data, digitale autonomie en publieke innovatie? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou. Dit ga je doen Als stagiair(e) binnen het team Digitale Transformatie ondersteun je adviseurs bij uiteenlopende opdrachten voor ministeries, uitvoeringsorganisaties, provincies, gemeenten en andere maatschappelijke organisaties. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Ondersteunen bij onderzoeken, analyses en adviesopdrachten. Voorbereiden en ondersteunen van workshops, werksessies en bijeenkomsten voor opdrachtgevers. Meewerken aan de ontwikkeling van praktische handreikingen, methodieken en kennisproducten. Uitwerken van onderzoeksresultaten naar concrete producten voor opdrachtgevers. Actualiseren en verrijken van onze website, publicaties en online kennisproducten. Structureren, actualiseren en verder ontwikkelen van bestaande kenniscollecties tot een deelbare kenniscatalogus. Uitvoeren van markt- en deskresearch naar ontwikkelingen op het gebied van digitalisering, data en digitale autonomie. Ondersteunen bij de doorontwikkeling van onze digitale-autonomie-quickscan en andere proposities. Afhankelijk van jouw interesses en achtergrond draai je bovendien mee in lopende adviesprojecten. Hier kom je terecht Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen. Dit zijn je directe collega’s Je wordt onderdeel van het team Digitale Transformatie binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur van Berenschot. Ons team ondersteunt organisaties bij vraagstukken rond digitale strategie, informatiehuishouding, digitale autonomie, datastrategie, cybersecurity en continuiteit, governance, dienstverlening en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij combineren we inhoudelijke kennis van technologie met inzicht in recht, bestuur, beleid en organisatie. Je werkt samen met adviseurs met uiteenlopende achtergronden, waaronder bestuurskunde, informatiemanagement, bedrijfskunde, data en technologie. Vanaf dag één krijg je verantwoordelijkheid en lever je een concrete bijdrage aan opdrachten en producten. Dit neem je mee Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding op het snijvlak van data, digitalisering, IT en organisatievraagstukken, bijvoorbeeld informatiemanagement, business IT & management, digital business, data science & business, technische bedrijfskunde, bestuurskunde (met een focus op digitalisering), bedrijfskunde (met een focus op technologie of innovatie) of een vergelijkbare opleiding. Daarnaast: Heb je affiniteit met digitalisering en maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Ben je analytisch sterk en nieuwsgierig. Werk je zelfstandig en gestructureerd. Kun je complexe informatie helder opschrijven. Vind je het leuk om kennis te ontwikkelen én praktisch toepasbaar te maken. Dit bieden we jou Een meewerkstage van 4 tot 6 maanden. Startdatum januari/februari 2027. Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,- per maand (op fulltimebasis). Een laptop. Flexibele werkmogelijkheden, ook thuis. Persoonlijke begeleiding door een ervaren adviseur. Een stimulerende en leerzame werkomgeving waarin ruimte is voor eigen inbreng. De mogelijkheid om een netwerk op te bouwen binnen Berenschot en met bedrijven. De mogelijkheid om in te stromen in het traineeship van Berenschot. title: Data & AI Governance Consultant
description: Help organisaties om data en AI verantwoord, betrouwbaar en effectief in te zetten. Data- en AI-governance is meer dan beleid en procedures. Het zorgt ervoor dat organisaties grip krijgen op hun data, betere beslissingen nemen en AI op een verantwoorde manier kunnen inzetten. Bij adesso helpen we organisaties om datagedreven en AI-gedreven werken duurzaam te organiseren. Niet door alleen modellen en policies te introduceren, maar door governance te verbinden aan businesswaarde, adoptie en de dagelijkse praktijk. Als Data & AI Governance Consultant help jij klanten om structuur aan te brengen, eigenaarschap te organiseren en hun datamanagement en AI-governance verder te professionaliseren. Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen die daadwerkelijk werken. Jouw rol Jij brengt structuur in complexe data- en AI-vraagstukken. Je helpt organisaties om hun governanceprocessen te verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheden helder te maken en data beter te benutten. Je werkt zelfstandig aan analyses, workshops en verbeterinitiatieven en schakelt daarbij met stakeholders uit business en IT. Samen met collega's en klanten vertaal je strategische doelstellingen naar concrete acties. Je krijgt de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je expertise te verdiepen en steeds meer zelfstandig klanten te adviseren. Wat je doet Data- en AI-governance Je adviseert klanten over data governance, datamanagement en verantwoord gebruik van AI. Je helpt bij het ontwerpen en implementeren van governance operating models, inclusief rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en besluitvorming. Je voert zelfstandig maturity assessments uit en vertaalt de resultaten naar concrete verbeteradviezen. Je ondersteunt bij het ontwikkelen van datastrategieën, governanceprincipes, policies en praktische roadmaps. Je helpt organisaties om data ownership en data stewardship goed in te richten. Data quality, metadata & AI Je analyseert en verbetert processen rondom datakwaliteit, metadata en data lineage. Je helpt bij het definiëren van kwaliteitsafspraken, KPI's en verantwoordelijkheden. Je werkt samen met data engineers, architecten en andere specialisten om governancevraagstukken te vertalen naar werkbare oplossingen. Je onderzoekt hoe AI en automatisering datamanagementprocessen kunnen verbeteren. Je houdt rekening met privacy, security, Responsible AI en relevante wet- en regelgeving, zoals de EU AI Act. Consultancy & stakeholdermanagement Je faciliteert workshops met business- en IT-stakeholders om behoeften, knelpunten en verbeterkansen in kaart te brengen. Je vertaalt zakelijke doelstellingen naar concrete governance-initiatieven en meetbare resultaten. Je presenteert analyses, bevindingen en aanbevelingen op een duidelijke en overtuigende manier. Je ondersteunt klanten bij het invoeren van nieuwe processen en werkwijzen en helpt draagvlak te creëren. Je signaleert kansen voor aanvullende dienstverlening en bespreekt deze met je team. Samenwerking & ontwikkeling Je neemt zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid voor onderdelen van klantprojecten en bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van je werkzaamheden. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en schakelt tijdig wanneer ondersteuning nodig is. Je gebruikt AI-tools waar ze waarde toevoegen en beoordeelt de uitkomsten kritisch, met aandacht voor vertrouwelijkheid en dataveiligheid. Je deelt kennis, begeleidt waar mogelijk minder ervaren collega's en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening. Wat jij meebrengt Je bent analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken. Je vindt het leuk om met klanten samen te werken en krijgt energie van het verbeteren van processen en organisaties. Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting. Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ervaring binnen data governance, datamanagement of dataconsultancy. Kennis van data governance, data quality, data stewardship en governanceprocessen. Ervaring met het uitvoeren van analyses, begeleiden van workshops of adviseren van stakeholders. Begrip van data-architectuur, datamodellering en de samenwerking tussen business en IT. Interesse in AI-governance en het verantwoord toepassen van AI binnen organisaties. Je gebruikt AI zelf in je werk en onderzoekt graag hoe het slimmer kan. Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en weet wanneer je collega's moet betrekken. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende belangen samen te brengen. Een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels. Mooi meegenomen Ervaring met maturity assessments, governance operating models of het opstellen van RACI's. Kennis van DAMA-DMBOK of een CDMP-certificering, of de ambitie om deze te behalen. Ervaring met datacatalogustools zoals Microsoft Purview, Collibra of Alation. Kennis van metadata, data lineage en data quality frameworks. Kennis van Responsible AI, de EU AI Act of data-readiness voor AI. Over ons team Je komt terecht in een klein, enthousiast en leergierig team van drie collega's. De lijnen zijn kort, iedereen heeft invloed en ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd. Onze focus ligt op de consultancykant van data en AI. We begeleiden organisaties bij AI-transformaties en beginnen altijd bij het echte probleem van de klant. Van daaruit ontwikkelen we roadmaps en helpen we bij de implementatie. title: Teamleider Electromagnetic Warfare (m/v/x)
description: Ben jij die ambitieuze Teamleider / R&D engineer die graag helpt om civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie en duurzaamheid? Wij zijn op zoek naar een teamleider voor de afdeling. Wat ga je doen? In een wereld waarin lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen steeds complexer worden, is het belangrijk om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen om de veiligheid en efficiëntie te garanderen. Binnen NLR werken we aan de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde aerospace systemen. We maken hierbij gebruik van software modelering en simulatie om het gedrag van complexe systemen te begrijpen en te optimaliseren. Onze expertise in hardware testen en operationele ondersteuning (OPS) zorgt ervoor dat onze oplossingen niet alleen theoretisch solide zijn, maar ook praktisch toepasbaar en robuust. De belangstelling voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) neemt toe, met de noodzaak om onze lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen te beschermen tegen elektromagnetische bedreigingen. We zoeken hierom een teamleider binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electronic Warfare (ASEW) Als teamleider EW zal je leiding geven aan een team van professionals met expertise in het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en het testen van aerospace systemen met focus op Electronic Warfare. Binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electromagnetic Warfare zoeken wij een ervaren en gedreven Teamleider om ons team te leiden en te inspireren. De afdeling is gericht op het ontwikkelen van innovatieve oplossingen voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) en heeft als doel om de Nederlandse en internationale lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie te ondersteunen. Als Teamleider binnen onze afdeling ASEW ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW. Je werkt nauw samen met de Afdelingsmanager en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken. In afstemming met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW zal je één van de twee Electromagnetic Warfare kennisgebied overzien, namelijk Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses. In de rol van teamleider blijf je actief en inhoudelijk betrokken bij het uitvoeren van projecten en krijg je de coördinatie over een team van technische collega’s en het verder ontwikkelen en uitbouwen van de faciliteiten waarvoor ASEW verantwoordelijk is. Je bent dus zowel een teamleider als een R&D Engineer. Als teamleider … Als teamleider bied jij het team alles wat nodig is om de werkzaamheden van jouw team succesvol te laten verlopen. Je bent de directe leidinggevende van betreffende collega’s en draagt ook de HR-verantwoordelijkheid. Je coacht, stuurt, geeft én vraagt feedback en je pakt de leiding wanneer nodig. title: Software Engineer - Optimisation Team
description: Role - Software Engineer - Optimisation Team Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy Location - Utrecht About iwell At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead. We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof. We are a fast-growing international team of bold, talented individuals. From engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact. The Role The Optimisation team builds the Python applications that decide what our customers' energy assets should do, and when. Batteries, EV fleets, solar and grid connections all come together in our optimiser, and the team turns prices, forecasts and constraints into schedules and decisions that run in production every day. Much of this work has an operations-research flavour, and the problems rarely arrive neatly defined.. They arrive as a customer who needs their vans charged by 6:00 at the lowest cost or a battery whose value depends on the hour. We're looking for someone who is comfortable across that whole path: understanding the real-world problem, shaping it into something a computer can solve, and shipping and operating the result. You don't need to be an OR specialist. You do need to be a strong Python engineer who enjoys messy, concrete problems. Success in this role means being able to: Take a loosely defined operational problem and turn it into working, maintainable production code. Work with data and models (optimisation, forecasting or plain statistics) without losing sight of the engineering. What you will do Create charging schedules for EV fleets that minimise electricity costs while guaranteeing every vehicle is ready when it needs to be. This means modelling tariffs, grid limits and departure times, and handling what happens when reality deviates from the plan. Calculate the value of each kWh produced or consumed, so that batteries, solar and flexible loads are steered by what energy is actually worth at that moment, and customers can see where their savings come from. Build forecasting models that predict operational issues before they happen, to maximise asset uptime and reduce the number of support tickets our Operations team has to handle. Take your work all the way to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring and bugfixing. Work with the rest of the Optimisation team on the shared tooling, data pipelines and modelling conventions the team uses.. What are looking for 5+ years of production Python development experience, writing clean, tested, maintainable code. A proven ability to translate real-world problems into working code. A pragmatic mindset: you choose the boring, well-understood solution when it's the right one, and you know when it isn't. Strong communication skills and a habit of documenting your work. Fluency in English is required. Weekly working hours of 32-40 hours Coming into the office 3-4 days per week Bonus points for None of these are required. We'd rather hire a strong engineer and teach the domain than the other way around. Experience with a modelling library such as cvxpy or Pyomo, or other operations research experience.. Time-series forecasting in production, or basic MLOps: keeping models trained, monitored and honest. Data analysis experience Energy, battery or electricity domain knowledge: tariffs, grid constraints, day-ahead and imbalance markets. The willingness to take on a People lead role in the team. Note: at iwell, we value growth potential over perfection. Feel free to respond if you can see yourself meeting this list in the (near) future. What we offer A competitive salary within the range of EUR 4400-EUR6600 + 8% holiday allowance 30 holidays per year, plus an annual company trip of 3 days The opportunity to do volunteer work, by offering 1 volunteer day per year Learning & Development budget of EUR 1,500 per year Attractive pension plan with Brand New Day Working remotely for 2 weeks per year We cover your travel costs, regardless of whether you come by bike, car, or public transport. A mobile phone allowance of EUR 25 per month Additional activities such as a bootcamp, volleyball tournament, company drinks etc. iwell is a family-friendly company and employs many employees with care-taking responsibilities Interested? For more information about iwell, what we do, why we do it, and an overview of our partners, visit https://iwell.eu/ . Our application process Apply. The role receives, stores and issues high-value hardware (GPU racks, servers, network equipment, spare parts), keeps stock and asset records accurate, and provides equipment to data center engineers on time.<br>The specialist is the site's hands-on link to the wider logistics function: Transportation and Transport Coordination for arrivals and pickups, Logistics Planning and 3PL Planning for schedules, Back Office for system records, and the Project Office for new processes and tools.<br>Key Responsibilities<br>1. Receiving & Dispatch<br>•    Receive inbound shipments per the delivery schedule; check seals, packaging and contents against ASN, packing list and PO.<br>•    Record damage and discrepancies with photos on arrival and hand them to Transport Coordination for insurance cases.<br>•    Prepare outbound shipments and RMA returns: picking, packing, labelling, documents; hand over to carriers at the agreed pickup time.<br>•    Follow handling standards for heavy, fragile and high-value equipment.<br>2. Provisioning to Data Center Operations<br>•    Issue equipment and spare parts to DC engineers on time, according to requests and project priorities.<br>•    Stage and kit hardware for rack deployments as agreed with ITDC and Project Managers.<br>•    Keep a clear view of what is available on site and flag shortages to the Team Lead and Logistics Planning.<br>3. Inventory & Asset Control<br>•    Post receipts, issues and transfers in ERP/WMS on the same day as the physical movement.<br>•    Create inventory and asset records for received equipment, including serial numbers.<br>•    Carry out cycle counts and annual stock takes; investigate and report discrepancies to Back Office.<br>•    Keep the warehouse tidy, labelled and organized by location.<br>4. Security, Safety & Compliance<br>•    Follow site security procedures for deliveries, access control and storage of high-value items.<br>•    Apply safety rules for handling equipment and operating material handling equipment.<br>•    Keep records complete and audit-ready (SOX, internal and external audits).<br>5. Process & Continuous Improvement<br>•    Work according to global SOPs and site-specific instructions.<br>•    Suggest improvements and report recurring issues to the Team Lead and the Project Office.<br>•    Take part in pilots and rollouts of new processes and tools (WMS/TMS, automations) at the site.<br>6. title: Commercial Account Executive, Netherlands
description: Get to Know Us Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. About the role We are hiring for our second Commercial Account Executive to help grow the Commercial business across the Netherlands. You will help grow the Commercial business in your market by building strong relationships, creating new logo momentum, and working closely with partners and the wider team to expand Horizon3’s reach. We are looking for experienced sellers who enjoy building. They should be proactive, thoughtful, and comfortable helping markets develop. They should carry the story well, build trust with customers and partners, and help turn ambition into market presence, new logo growth, and long-term opportunity. title: Software Engineer, Web Crawling
description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen.
